npcLine.japanese: 良い経験になったね。
npcLine.romaji: Ii keiken ni natta ne.
npcLine.translationEn: That became a good experience.

options.japanese: うん、本当に良い経験だった。
options.romaji: Un, hontou ni ii keiken datta.
options.translationEn: Yeah, it was really a great experience.

options.japanese: あまり良い経験じゃなかったな。
options.translationEn: Not that great of an experience.

titleEn: Talking About Your First Time Riding the Bullet Train
descriptionEn: You tell a friend about your first experience riding the shinkansen.

title: Menjelaskan Perbedaan Jenis Tiket Kereta
description: Kamu menjelaskan ke teman perbedaan kursi terjadwal dan kursi bebas.

npcLine.japanese: 指定席と自由席、どう違うの？
npcLine.romaji: Shiteiseki to jiyuuseki, dou chigau no?
npcLine.translation: Kursi terjadwal dan kursi bebas, bedanya apa?
npcLine.translationEn: What's the difference between a reserved seat and a non-reserved seat?

options.japanese: 指定席は席が決まっている分、確実に座れるんだ。
options.romaji: Shiteiseki wa seki ga kimatte iru bun, kakujitsu ni suwareru n da.
options.translation: Karena kursi terjadwal sudah ditentukan, jadi pasti bisa duduk.
options.translationEn: Since the reserved seat is already assigned, you're guaranteed to sit.

options.japanese: どちらも全く同じ仕組みだよ。
options.romaji: Dochira mo mattaku onaji shikumi da yo.
options.translationEn: Both have exactly the same mechanism.

npcLine.japanese: 値段はどのくらい違うの？
npcLine.romaji: Nedan wa dono kurai chigau no?
npcLine.translationEn: How much does the price differ by?

options.japanese: 指定席のほうが、五百円ほど高くなる場合が多いよ。
options.romaji: Shiteiseki no hou ga, gohyakuen hodo takaku naru baai ga ooi yo.
options.translation: Kursi terjadwal biasanya lebih mahal sekitar 500 yen.
options.translationEn: A reserved seat is usually about 500 yen more expensive.

options.japanese: 値段は全く変わらないよ。
options.translationEn: The price hasn't changed at all.

npcLine.japanese: 混雑する時期は、指定席にしたほうがいいのかな。
npcLine.romaji: Konzatsu suru jiki wa, shiteiseki ni shita hou ga ii no ka na.
npcLine.translation: Waktu musim ramai, mungkin lebih baik pilih kursi terjadwal ya.
npcLine.translationEn: During busy season, it might be better to choose a reserved seat.

options.japanese: うん、混雑期は自由席だと座れないこともあるからね。
options.romaji: Un, konzatsuki wa jiyuuseki da to suwarenai koto mo aru kara ne.
options.translation: Iya, karena waktu musim ramai kursi bebas kadang tidak kebagian duduk.
options.translationEn: Yeah, because during busy season the unreserved seats sometimes run out.

options.japanese: 混雑期でも自由席で十分だよ。
options.romaji: Konzatsuki demo jiyuuseki de juubun da yo.
options.translation: Waktu musim ramai pun kursi bebas cukup.
options.translationEn: Even during busy season, unreserved seats are enough.

npcLine.japanese: グリーン車っていうのもあるよね。
npcLine.romaji: Guriinsha tte iu no mo aru yo ne.
npcLine.translation: Ada juga yang namanya gerbong Green ya.
npcLine.translationEn: There's also something called a Green car, right.

options.japanese: うん、あれは指定席よりさらに快適な席なんだ。
options.romaji: Un, are wa shiteiseki yori sara ni kaiteki na seki nan da.
options.translation: Iya, itu kursi yang lebih nyaman lagi dari kursi terjadwal.
options.translationEn: Yeah, that seat is even more comfortable than a reserved seat.

options.japanese: グリーン車は自由席と同じだよ。
options.romaji: Guriinsha wa jiyuuseki to onaji da yo.
options.translation: Gerbong Green sama dengan kursi bebas.
options.translationEn: The Green car is the same as an unreserved seat.

npcLine.japanese: 今度使ってみようかな。
npcLine.romaji: Kondo tsukatte miyou ka na.
npcLine.translation: Mungkin lain kali coba pakai ya.
npcLine.translationEn: Maybe I'll try using it next time.

options.japanese: うん、一度試してみるといいよ。
options.romaji: Un, ichido tameshite miru to ii yo.
options.translationEn: Yeah, try it once, it's good.

options.japanese: 使わないほうがいいよ。

titleEn: Explaining the Different Types of Train Tickets
descriptionEn: You explain to a friend the difference between reserved and non-reserved seating.

title: Mendiskusikan Etika Naik Kereta yang Padat
description: Kamu dan teman mendiskusikan etika yang benar saat naik kereta yang padat.

npcLine.japanese: 満員電車でのマナーって、意外と難しいよね。
npcLine.romaji: Man'in densha de no manaa tte, igai to muzukashii yo ne.
npcLine.translation: Etika di kereta yang penuh sesak itu, ternyata cukup sulit ya.
npcLine.translationEn: Turns out etiquette on a packed train is quite tricky.

options.japanese: うん、リュックを前に抱えるだけでも、だいぶ違うらしいよ。
options.romaji: Un, ryukku wo mae ni kakaeru dake demo, daibu chigau rashii yo.
options.translation: Iya, katanya cukup dengan memeluk ransel di depan saja, sudah cukup berbeda.
options.translationEn: Yeah, they say just holding the backpack in front already makes quite a difference.

options.japanese: リュックの持ち方なんて誰も気にしないよ。
options.romaji: Ryukku no mochikata nante dare mo ki ni shinai yo.
options.translation: Cara bawa ransel tidak dipedulikan siapa pun.
options.translationEn: No one cares how you carry your backpack.

npcLine.japanese: イヤホンの音漏れも気をつけないとね。
npcLine.romaji: Iyahon no otomore mo ki wo tsukenai to ne.
npcLine.translation: Kebocoran suara earphone juga harus diperhatikan ya.
npcLine.translationEn: Earphone sound leakage needs to be watched too.

options.japanese: そうだね、音量には特に気をつけるようにしているよ。
options.romaji: Sou da ne, onryou ni wa toku ni ki wo tsukeru you ni shite iru yo.
options.translation: Betul juga, aku usahakan sangat memperhatikan volumenya.
options.translationEn: True, I try to be very mindful of the volume.

options.japanese: 音漏れなんて誰も気にしていないと思うよ。
options.romaji: Otomore nante dare mo ki ni shite inai to omou yo.
options.translation: Kupikir tidak ada yang peduli kebocoran suara.
options.translationEn: I don't think anyone cares about sound leakage.

npcLine.japanese: 優先席の扱いについてはどう思う？
npcLine.romaji: Yuuseiseki no atsukai ni tsuite wa dou omou?
npcLine.translation: Bagaimana pendapatmu soal perlakuan kursi prioritas?
npcLine.translationEn: What's your opinion on priority seat etiquette?

options.japanese: 必要な人には、迷わず譲るべきだと思うよ。
options.romaji: Hitsuyou na hito ni wa, mayowazu yuzuru beki da to omou yo.
options.translation: Kurasa harus tanpa ragu memberikan ke orang yang membutuhkan.
options.translationEn: I think you should give it without hesitation to someone who needs it.

options.japanese: 優先席は誰が座ってもいいと思うよ。
options.romaji: Yuuseiseki wa dare ga suwattemo ii to omou yo.
options.translation: Kupikir kursi prioritas boleh diduduki siapa saja.
options.translationEn: I think priority seats can be sat in by anyone.

npcLine.japanese: 荷物を座席に置くのも良くないよね。
npcLine.romaji: Nimotsu wo zaseki ni oku no mo yokunai yo ne.
npcLine.translation: Meletakkan barang di kursi juga tidak baik ya.
npcLine.translationEn: Putting things on the seat isn't good either.

options.japanese: うん、他の人が座れなくなってしまうからね。
options.romaji: Un, hoka no hito ga suwarenaku natte shimau kara ne.
options.translation: Iya, karena jadi membuat orang lain tidak bisa duduk.
options.translationEn: Yeah, because it makes it so others can't sit.

options.japanese: 荷物ぐらい置いても問題ないと思うよ。
options.romaji: Nimotsu gurai oitemo mondai nai to omou yo.
options.translation: Kupikir taruh barang sedikit tidak masalah.
options.translationEn: I think putting a little bit of stuff there is fine.

npcLine.japanese: マナーを守れば、みんな気持ちよく乗れるね。
npcLine.romaji: Manaa wo mamoreba, minna kimochiyoku noreru ne.
npcLine.translation: Kalau menjaga etika, semua bisa naik dengan nyaman ya.
npcLine.translationEn: By keeping proper etiquette, everyone can ride comfortably.

options.translationEn: I think it's up to you.

titleEn: Discussing Etiquette on a Crowded Train
descriptionEn: You and a friend discuss proper etiquette on a crowded train.

title: Menceritakan Pengalaman Tersesat di Stasiun Besar
description: Kamu bercerita ke teman tentang pengalaman tersesat di stasiun Shinjuku.

npcLine.japanese: 新宿駅で迷ったことがあるって言ってたよね。
npcLine.romaji: Shinjuku eki de mayotta koto ga aru tte itteta yo ne.
npcLine.translation: Katanya pernah tersesat di stasiun Shinjuku ya.
npcLine.translationEn: I heard you once got lost at Shinjuku Station.

options.japanese: うん、出口の多さに圧倒されて、迷子になってしまったんだ。
options.romaji: Un, deguchi no oosa ni attousarete, maigo ni natte shimatta n da.
options.translation: Iya, karena kewalahan dengan banyaknya pintu keluar, aku jadi tersesat.
options.translationEn: Yeah, overwhelmed by the number of exits, I got lost.

options.japanese: 一度も迷ったことないよ。
options.romaji: Ichido mo mayotta koto nai yo.

npcLine.japanese: どのくらい迷ったの？
npcLine.romaji: Dono kurai mayotta no?
npcLine.translationEn: How long were you lost?

options.japanese: 三十分ぐらい、同じところをぐるぐる回っていたと思う。
options.romaji: Sanjuppun gurai, onaji tokoro wo guruguru mawatte ita to omou.
options.translation: Kurasa sekitar tiga puluh menit muter-muter di tempat yang sama.
options.translationEn: I think I went in circles in the same spot for about thirty minutes.

options.japanese: すぐに出口が見つかったよ。
options.romaji: Sugu ni deguchi ga mitsukatta yo.

npcLine.japanese: どうやって解決したの？
npcLine.romaji: Dou yatte kaiketsu shita no?
npcLine.translationEn: How did it get resolved?

options.japanese: 駅員さんに聞いたところ、すぐに教えてもらえたんだ。
options.romaji: Ekiin san ni kiita tokoro, sugu ni oshiete moraeta n da.
options.translation: Setelah tanya petugas stasiun, langsung diberi tahu.
options.translationEn: After asking the station staff, I was told right away.

options.japanese: 誰にも聞かずに自力で解決したよ。
options.romaji: Dare ni mo kikazu ni jiriki de kaiketsu shita yo.
options.translation: Menyelesaikan sendiri tanpa tanya siapa pun.
options.translationEn: Resolved it myself without asking anyone.

npcLine.japanese: それ以来、大きい駅では気をつけるようになった？
npcLine.romaji: Sore irai, ookii eki dewa ki wo tsukeru you ni natta?
npcLine.translation: Sejak itu, jadi lebih hati-hati di stasiun besar?
npcLine.translationEn: Since then, have you been more careful at big stations?

options.japanese: うん、事前に地図を確認するようになったよ。
options.romaji: Un, jizen ni chizu wo kakunin suru you ni natta yo.
options.translation: Iya, jadi terbiasa mengecek peta terlebih dahulu.
options.translationEn: Yeah, I've gotten used to checking the map first.

options.japanese: 全く気をつけなくなったよ。
options.romaji: Mattaku ki wo tsukenaku natta yo.

npcLine.japanese: いい教訓になったね。
npcLine.romaji: Ii kyoukun ni natta ne.
npcLine.translationEn: That became a good lesson.

options.japanese: 別に教訓にはならなかったよ。
options.romaji: Betsu ni kyoukun ni wa naranakatta yo.
options.translationEn: It wasn't really a lesson learned.

titleEn: Talking About Getting Lost at a Major Station
descriptionEn: You tell a friend about the experience of getting lost at Shinjuku Station.

title: Menjelaskan Cara Kerja Sistem Transfer Kereta
description: Kamu menjelaskan cara kerja sistem transfer kereta ke teman.

npcLine.japanese: 乗り換えの仕組みが、いまいちよく分からないんだけど。
npcLine.romaji: Norikae no shikumi ga, imaichi yoku wakaranai n da kedo.
npcLine.translation: Aku tidak begitu paham sistem transfernya nih.
npcLine.translationEn: I don't quite understand the transfer system.

options.japanese: 改札を出ずに乗り換えられる駅もあれば、出る必要がある駅もあるんだ。
options.romaji: Kaisatsu wo dezu ni norikaerareru eki mo areba, deru hitsuyou ga aru eki mo aru n da.
options.translation: Ada stasiun yang bisa transfer tanpa keluar gerbang tiket, ada juga yang harus keluar dulu.
options.translationEn: Some stations let you transfer without exiting the ticket gate, others require you to exit first.

options.japanese: どの駅でも同じ方法で乗り換えられるよ。
options.romaji: Dono eki demo onaji houhou de norikaerareru yo.
options.translation: Di stasiun mana pun cara transfernya sama.
options.translationEn: The way to transfer is the same at any station.

npcLine.japanese: どうやって見分ければいいの？
npcLine.romaji: Dou yatte miwakereba ii no?
npcLine.translationEn: How do you tell them apart?

options.japanese: アプリの案内に従えば、迷わず乗り換えられるはずだよ。
options.romaji: Apuri no annai ni shitagaeba, mayowazu norikaerareru hazu da yo.
options.translation: Kalau ikuti petunjuk aplikasi, seharusnya bisa transfer tanpa tersesat.
options.translationEn: If you follow the app's directions, you should be able to transfer without getting lost.

options.japanese: アプリなんて見なくても大丈夫だよ。
options.romaji: Apuri nante minakutemo daijoubu da yo.
options.translation: Tanpa lihat aplikasi pun tidak apa-apa.
options.translationEn: It's fine even without checking the app.

npcLine.japanese: ICカードを使えば、料金も自動で調整されるんだよね。
npcLine.romaji: Aishii kaado wo tsukaeba, ryoukin mo jidou de chousei sareru n da yo ne.
npcLine.translation: Kalau pakai kartu IC, biayanya juga otomatis disesuaikan ya.
npcLine.translationEn: If you use an IC card, the fare is automatically adjusted too.

options.japanese: そうそう、その点はとても便利だと思うよ。
options.romaji: Sou sou, sono ten wa totemo benri da to omou yo.
options.translation: Betul, kurasa itu bagian yang sangat praktis.
options.translationEn: Right, I think that's a really practical part.

options.japanese: それは全く便利じゃないと思うよ。
options.romaji: Sore wa mattaku benri janai to omou yo.
options.translation: Kupikir itu sama sekali tidak praktis.
options.translationEn: I don't think that's practical at all.

npcLine.japanese: 乗り換え時間が短いと焦るよね。
npcLine.romaji: Norikae jikan ga mijikai to aseru yo ne.
npcLine.translation: Kalau waktu transfernya singkat jadi panik ya.
npcLine.translationEn: If the transfer time is short, it gets stressful, huh.

options.japanese: うん、走らないと間に合わないこともあるからね。
options.romaji: Un, hashiranai to maniawanai koto mo aru kara ne.
options.translation: Iya, karena kadang kalau tidak lari tidak akan sempat.
options.translationEn: Yeah, because sometimes if you don't run you won't make it.

options.japanese: いつも時間に余裕があるよ。
options.romaji: Itsumo jikan ni yoyuu ga aru yo.

npcLine.japanese: 慣れれば、そんなに難しくないはずだよ。
npcLine.romaji: Narereba, sonna ni muzukashikunai hazu da yo.
npcLine.translation: Kalau sudah terbiasa, seharusnya tidak terlalu sulit.
npcLine.translationEn: Once you're used to it, it shouldn't be too difficult.

options.japanese: 絶対に無理だと思うよ。
options.romaji: Zettai ni muri da to omou yo.
options.translationEn: I think it's definitely not possible.

titleEn: Explaining How the Train Transfer System Works
descriptionEn: You explain to a friend how the train transfer system works.

title: Membicarakan Kenangan Perjalanan Kereta Jarak Jauh
description: Kamu bercerita ke teman tentang kenangan naik kereta jarak jauh.

npcLine.japanese: 長距離列車に乗った時の思い出とかある？
npcLine.romaji: Choukyori ressha ni notta toki no omoide toka aru?
npcLine.translation: Ada kenangan waktu naik kereta jarak jauh?
npcLine.translationEn: Do you have memories of long-distance train rides?

options.japanese: うん、車窓の景色に、ずっと見とれていたのを覚えているよ。
options.romaji: Un, shasou no keshiki ni, zutto mitorete ita no wo oboete iru yo.
options.translation: Iya, aku ingat terus terpukau melihat pemandangan dari jendela kereta.
options.translationEn: Yeah, I remember being amazed looking at the scenery from the train window.

options.romaji: Toku ni omoide wa nai yo.

npcLine.japanese: どのくらいの時間乗っていたの？
npcLine.romaji: Dono kurai no jikan notte ita no?
npcLine.translationEn: How long is the ride?

options.japanese: 八時間ほど乗っていたと思う。
options.romaji: Hachijikan hodo notte ita to omou.
options.translationEn: I think the ride is about eight hours.

options.japanese: 十分ほどしか乗っていなかったよ。
options.romaji: Juppun hodo shika notte inakatta yo.
options.translationEn: Only rode for about ten minutes.

npcLine.japanese: 長時間、退屈しなかった？
npcLine.romaji: Choujikan, taikutsu shinakatta?
npcLine.translationEn: Isn't it boring for that long?

options.japanese: 本を読みつつ、景色も楽しんでいたから平気だったよ。
options.romaji: Hon wo yominitsutsu, keshiki mo tanoshinde ita kara heiki datta yo.
options.translation: Aku sambil baca buku, juga menikmati pemandangan, jadi tidak apa-apa.
options.translationEn: I read a book while also enjoying the scenery, so it's fine.

options.japanese: すごく退屈で、何もできなかったよ。
options.romaji: Sugoku taikutsu de, nanimo dekinakatta yo.

npcLine.japanese: 途中で降りて観光したりした？
npcLine.romaji: Tochuu de orite kankou shitari shita?
npcLine.translation: Sempat turun di tengah jalan untuk wisata?
npcLine.translationEn: Did you stop along the way to sightsee?

options.japanese: うん、一度だけ途中下車して、名物を食べたよ。
options.romaji: Un, ichido dake tochuu gesha shite, meibutsu wo tabeta yo.
options.translation: Iya, sekali turun di tengah jalan, makan makanan khas.
options.translationEn: Yeah, I got off partway through once to eat some local food.

options.japanese: 一度も降りなかったよ。

npcLine.japanese: いい旅だったんだね。
npcLine.romaji: Ii tabi datta n da ne.
npcLine.translationEn: That was a great trip.

options.japanese: うん、忘れられない思い出になったよ。
options.romaji: Un, wasurerarenai omoide ni natta yo.
options.translation: Iya, jadi kenangan yang tidak terlupakan.
options.translationEn: Yeah, it became an unforgettable memory.

options.japanese: あまりいい旅じゃなかったよ。
options.translationEn: Not that great of a trip.

titleEn: Talking About Memories of a Long-Distance Train Trip
descriptionEn: You tell a friend about a memory of a long-distance train trip.

title: Menjelaskan Alasan Memilih Kereta daripada Pesawat
description: Kamu menjelaskan ke teman kenapa memilih naik shinkansen daripada pesawat.

npcLine.japanese: なんで飛行機じゃなくて、新幹線にしたの？
npcLine.romaji: Nande hikouki janakute, shinkansen ni shita no?
npcLine.translationEn: Why choose the shinkansen instead of a plane?

options.japanese: 空港までの移動を考えると、かえって時間がかからないんだ。
options.romaji: Kuukou made no idou wo kangaeru to, kaette jikan ga kakaranai n da.
options.translation: Kalau memperhitungkan perjalanan ke bandara, malah tidak makan waktu lebih lama.
options.translationEn: If you factor in the trip to the airport, it doesn't actually take any longer.

options.japanese: 飛行機のほうが絶対早いと思うよ。
options.romaji: Hikouki no hou ga zettai hayai to omou yo.
options.translationEn: I think the plane is definitely faster.

npcLine.japanese: 値段の違いもあるんじゃない？
npcLine.romaji: Nedan no chigai mo aru n janai?
npcLine.translationEn: There's a price difference too, right?

options.japanese: 値段はそこまで変わらないから、快適さで選んだんだ。
options.romaji: Nedan wa soko made kawaranai kara, kaitekisa de eranda n da.
options.translation: Karena harganya tidak terlalu beda, aku memilih berdasarkan kenyamanan.
options.translationEn: Since the price isn't too different, I chose based on comfort.

options.japanese: 値段は全く関係ないよ。
options.romaji: Nedan wa mattaku kankei nai yo.
options.translation: Harga sama sekali tidak ada hubungannya.
options.translationEn: Price has nothing to do with it at all.

npcLine.japanese: 新幹線のほうが快適だと感じるの？
npcLine.romaji: Shinkansen no hou ga kaiteki da to kanjiru no?
npcLine.translationEn: Feel that the shinkansen is more comfortable?

options.japanese: うん、席も広いし、自由に立ち歩けるところがいいんだ。
options.romaji: Un, seki mo hiroi shi, jiyuu ni tachiarukeru tokoro ga ii n da.
options.translation: Iya, kursinya juga luas, dan bagusnya bisa bebas berdiri berjalan.
options.translationEn: Yeah, the seats are also spacious, and it's nice being able to freely stand and walk.

options.japanese: 飛行機のほうがずっと快適だと思うよ。
options.romaji: Hikouki no hou ga zutto kaiteki da to omou yo.
options.translationEn: I think the plane is much more comfortable.

npcLine.japanese: 荷物の持ち運びも楽なんじゃない？
npcLine.romaji: Nimotsu no mochihakobi mo raku nan janai?
npcLine.translation: Bawa barang juga lebih gampang kan?
npcLine.translationEn: It's also easier to carry things, right?

options.japanese: そうなんだよ、預ける手続きがない分、楽なんだ。
options.romaji: Sou nan da yo, azukeru tetsuzuki ga nai bun, raku nan da.
options.translation: Betul, karena tidak ada proses check-in bagasi, jadi lebih mudah.
options.translationEn: Right, since there's no baggage check-in process, it's easier.

options.japanese: 荷物の持ち運びは同じぐらい大変だよ。
options.romaji: Nimotsu no mochihakobi wa onaji gurai taihen da yo.
options.translationEn: Carrying luggage is just as much of a hassle either way.

npcLine.japanese: なるほど、それなら新幹線もいいね。
npcLine.romaji: Naruhodo, sore nara shinkansen mo ii ne.
npcLine.translation: Begitu ya, kalau begitu shinkansen juga bagus ya.
npcLine.translationEn: I see, in that case the shinkansen is a good option too.

options.japanese: うん、次もきっと新幹線を選ぶと思う。
options.romaji: Un, tsugi mo kitto shinkansen wo erabu to omou.
options.translation: Iya, kurasa lain kali juga pasti akan pilih shinkansen.
options.translationEn: Yeah, I think I'll definitely choose the shinkansen next time too.

options.japanese: 次は絶対飛行機にするよ。
options.romaji: Tsugi wa zettai hikouki ni suru yo.
options.translation: Lain kali pasti akan pilih pesawat.
options.translationEn: I'll definitely choose the plane next time.

titleEn: Explaining Why You Chose the Train Over a Plane
descriptionEn: You explain to a friend why you chose the shinkansen over flying.

title: Mendiskusikan Kepadatan Kereta di Jam Sibuk
description: Kamu dan teman mendiskusikan kepadatan kereta di jam sibuk pagi.

npcLine.japanese: 朝のラッシュ、本当にすごいよね。
npcLine.romaji: Asa no rasshu, hontou ni sugoi yo ne.
npcLine.translation: Rush hour pagi, benar-benar luar biasa ya.
npcLine.translationEn: Morning rush hour is really something else.

options.japanese: うん、息もできないくらい混んでいる時があるよ。
options.romaji: Un, iki mo dekinai kurai konde iru toki ga aru yo.
options.translation: Iya, kadang penuh sampai susah bernapas.
options.translationEn: Yeah, sometimes it's so crowded it's hard to breathe.

options.japanese: 全然混んでいないと思うよ。
options.romaji: Zenzen konde inai to omou yo.
options.translationEn: I don't think it's crowded at all.

npcLine.japanese: 時間をずらして乗ったりはしないの？
npcLine.romaji: Jikan wo zurashite nottari wa shinai no?
npcLine.translationEn: Haven't you tried shifting your ride time?

options.japanese: 会社の始業時間があるから、ずらすわけにはいかないんだ。
options.romaji: Kaisha no shigyou jikan ga aru kara, zurasu wake ni wa ikanai n da.
options.translation: Karena ada jam masuk kantor, tidak bisa menggesernya begitu saja.
options.translationEn: Since there's a set office start time, it can't just be shifted.

options.japanese: いつでも自由に時間を変えられるよ。
options.romaji: Itsudemo jiyuu ni jikan wo kaerareru yo.
options.translation: Kapan pun bisa bebas ganti waktu.
options.translationEn: The time can be changed freely at any time.

npcLine.japanese: ストレスにならない？
npcLine.romaji: Sutoresu ni naranai?
npcLine.translationEn: Doesn't it become stressful?

options.japanese: 正直、慣れたとはいえ、多少のストレスは感じるよ。
options.romaji: Shoujiki, nareta to wa ie, tashou no sutoresu wa kanjiru yo.
options.translation: Jujur, meski sudah terbiasa, tetap merasakan sedikit stres.
options.translationEn: Honestly, even though I'm used to it, I still feel a bit of stress.

options.japanese: 全くストレスにならないよ。

npcLine.japanese: 何か対策はしているの？
npcLine.romaji: Nanika taisaku wa shite iru no?
npcLine.translationEn: Was any particular action taken?

options.japanese: 音楽を聴きながら気を紛らわせるようにしているよ。
options.romaji: Ongaku wo kikinagara ki wo magirawaseru you ni shite iru yo.
options.translation: Aku usahakan mengalihkan perhatian sambil dengar musik.
options.translationEn: I try to distract myself by listening to music.

options.japanese: 特に何も対策していないよ。
options.romaji: Toku ni nanimo taisaku shite inai yo.
options.translation: Tidak melakukan tindakan apa pun khususnya.

npcLine.japanese: 在宅勤務が増えるといいね。
npcLine.romaji: Zaitaku kinmu ga fueru to ii ne.
npcLine.translation: Semoga kerja dari rumah makin banyak ya.
npcLine.translationEn: Hope working from home becomes more common.

options.japanese: うん、本当にそう思うよ。
options.romaji: Un, hontou ni sou omou yo.

options.japanese: 別に増えなくていいよ。
options.translation: Tidak perlu bertambah juga tidak apa-apa.
options.translationEn: It's fine even if it doesn't need to increase.

titleEn: Discussing Train Crowding During Rush Hour
descriptionEn: You and a friend discuss how crowded the trains are during morning rush hour.

title: Menceritakan Pengalaman Membantu Orang di Stasiun
description: Kamu bercerita ke teman tentang pengalaman menolong orang di stasiun.

npcLine.japanese: 駅で誰かを助けたことがあるって聞いたよ。
npcLine.romaji: Eki de dareka wo tasuketa koto ga aru tte kiita yo.
npcLine.translation: Kudengar pernah menolong seseorang di stasiun.
npcLine.translationEn: I heard you helped someone at the station once.

options.japanese: うん、階段でベビーカーを運ぶのに苦労している人を見かけて、手伝ったんだ。
options.romaji: Un, kaidan de bebiikaa wo hakobu no ni kurou shite iru hito wo mikakete, tetsudatta n da.
options.translation: Iya, aku melihat orang yang kesulitan membawa kereta bayi di tangga, jadi aku bantu.
options.translationEn: Yeah, I saw someone struggling to carry a stroller on the stairs, so I helped.

options.japanese: 特に誰も助けたことないよ。
options.romaji: Toku ni dare mo tasuketa koto nai yo.
options.translation: Belum pernah menolong siapa pun khususnya.

npcLine.japanese: 声をかけるのに勇気がいらなかった？
npcLine.romaji: Koe wo kakeru no ni yuuki ga iranakatta?
npcLine.translationEn: Doesn't it take courage to say hi?

options.japanese: 少し緊張したけど、見て見ぬふりはできなかったんだ。
options.romaji: Sukoshi kinchou shita kedo, mite minu furi wa dekinakatta n da.
options.translation: Agak gugup, tapi tidak bisa pura-pura tidak melihat.
options.translationEn: A bit nervous, but I couldn't pretend not to see it.

options.japanese: 全然緊張しなかったよ。

npcLine.japanese: その人はどんな反応だった？
npcLine.romaji: Sono hito wa donna hannou datta?
npcLine.translationEn: How did that person react?

options.japanese: すごく感謝されて、こちらまで嬉しくなったよ。
options.romaji: Sugoku kansha sarete, kochira made ureshiku natta yo.
options.translation: Sangat diucapkan terima kasih, sampai aku ikut senang.
options.translationEn: They thanked me so much that I felt happy too.

options.japanese: 特に何も言われなかったよ。

npcLine.japanese: そういう経験があると、また助けたいと思うよね。
npcLine.romaji: Sou iu keiken ga aru to, mata tasuketai to omou yo ne.
npcLine.translation: Kalau ada pengalaman begitu, jadi ingin menolong lagi ya.
npcLine.translationEn: With an experience like that, you'd want to help again.

options.japanese: うん、今度も困っている人がいたら声をかけようと思う。
options.romaji: Un, kondo mo komatte iru hito ga itara koe wo kakeyou to omou.
options.translation: Iya, lain kali kalau ada orang kesulitan aku berniat menyapa.
options.translationEn: Yeah, next time if someone's struggling I intend to speak up.

options.japanese: もう二度と助けないと思う。

npcLine.japanese: 素敵な心がけだね。
npcLine.romaji: Suteki na kokorogake da ne.
npcLine.translationEn: What a beautiful attitude.

options.japanese: そう言ってもらえると嬉しいな。
options.romaji: Sou itte moraeru to ureshii na.

options.japanese: 別にそんなことないよ。
options.romaji: Betsu ni sonna koto nai yo.

titleEn: Talking About Helping Someone at the Station
descriptionEn: You tell a friend about the experience of helping someone at the station.

title: Menjelaskan Cara Menggunakan Loker Penitipan Barang di Stasiun
description: Kamu menjelaskan ke teman cara memakai loker koin di stasiun.

npcLine.japanese: コインロッカーって、初めて使うんだけど、使い方分かる？
npcLine.romaji: Koin rokkaa tte, hajimete tsukau n da kedo, tsukaikata wakaru?
npcLine.translation: Loker koin, ini pertama kali pakai, tahu caranya?
npcLine.translationEn: Coin lockers, is this your first time using one, do you know how?

options.japanese: うん、荷物を入れてから、料金を払う仕組みになっているはずだよ。
options.romaji: Un, nimotsu wo irete kara, ryoukin wo harau shikumi ni natte iru hazu da yo.
options.translation: Iya, seharusnya sistemnya masukkan barang dulu, lalu bayar.
options.translationEn: Yeah, the system should be to put in the items first, then pay.

options.japanese: 先にお金を払わないと開かないと思うよ。
options.romaji: Saki ni okane wo harawanai to hirakanai to omou yo.
options.translation: Kupikir kalau tidak bayar dulu tidak akan terbuka.
options.translationEn: I think it won't open unless you pay first.

npcLine.japanese: 支払い方法は現金だけなのかな。
npcLine.romaji: Shiharai houhou wa genkin dake na no ka na.
npcLine.translation: Cara bayarnya cuma tunai saja ya kali.
npcLine.translationEn: The payment method is probably cash only.

options.japanese: ううん、最近はICカードにも対応しているみたいだよ。
options.romaji: Uun, saikin wa aishii kaado ni mo taiou shite iru mitai da yo.
options.translation: Tidak, belakangan sepertinya juga mendukung kartu IC.
options.translationEn: No, it seems it also supports IC cards these days.

options.japanese: 現金しか使えないと思うよ。
options.romaji: Genkin shika tsukaenai to omou yo.
options.translationEn: I think only cash can be used.

npcLine.japanese: 鍵をなくしたらどうすればいいんだろう。
npcLine.romaji: Kagi wo nakushitara dou sureba ii n darou.
npcLine.translation: Kalau kunci hilang harus bagaimana ya.
npcLine.translationEn: I wonder what to do if the key is lost.

options.japanese: その場合は、駅員さんに相談すればいいはずだよ。
options.romaji: Sono baai wa, ekiin san ni soudan sureba ii hazu da yo.
options.translation: Kalau begitu, seharusnya cukup konsultasi ke petugas stasiun.
options.translationEn: In that case, consulting the station staff should be enough.

options.japanese: 荷物は諦めるしかないと思うよ。
options.romaji: Nimotsu wa akirameru shika nai to omou yo.
options.translationEn: I think I can only just let the item go.

npcLine.japanese: 使用期限とかあるの？
npcLine.romaji: Shiyou kigen toka aru no?
npcLine.translationEn: Is there a usage time limit?

options.japanese: あるらしいよ、期限を過ぎると追加料金がかかるみたい。
options.romaji: Aru rashii yo, kigen wo sugiru to tsuika ryoukin ga kakaru mitai.
options.translation: Sepertinya ada, kalau melewati batas kena biaya tambahan.
options.translationEn: It seems there is one — if you exceed the limit there's an extra fee.

options.japanese: 期限は特にないと思うよ。
options.romaji: Kigen wa toku ni nai to omou yo.
options.translation: Kupikir tidak ada batas waktu khususnya.
options.translationEn: I don't think there's a particular deadline.

npcLine.japanese: なるほど、気をつけないとね。
npcLine.romaji: Naruhodo, ki wo tsukenai to ne.
npcLine.translationEn: I see, need to be careful.

options.japanese: うん、時間内に取りに来るようにしよう。
options.romaji: Un, jikannai ni tori ni kuru you ni shiyou.
options.translation: Iya, ayo usahakan ambil dalam waktu yang ditentukan.
options.translationEn: Yeah, let's try to collect it within the set time.

options.japanese: 別に気にしなくていいよ。
options.romaji: Betsu ni ki ni shinakute ii yo.
options.translationEn: No need to worry about it.

titleEn: Explaining How to Use Station Luggage Lockers
descriptionEn: You explain to a friend how to use the coin lockers at the station.

title: Membicarakan Rencana Perjalanan dengan JR Pass
description: Kamu membicarakan rencana perjalanan pakai JR Pass dengan teman.

npcLine.japanese: JRパスを使って旅行しようと思ってるんだけど、どう思う？
npcLine.romaji: JR pasu wo tsukatte ryokou shiyou to omotteru n da kedo, dou omou?
npcLine.translation: Aku berpikir mau jalan-jalan pakai JR Pass, menurutmu gimana?
npcLine.translationEn: I'm thinking of traveling with a JR Pass, what do you think?

options.japanese: いいと思うよ、たくさん移動するならお得なはずだよ。
options.romaji: Ii to omou yo, takusan idou suru nara otoku na hazu da yo.
options.translation: Kurasa bagus lho, kalau banyak berpindah tempat pasti hemat.
options.translationEn: I think it's good — if you move around a lot it's definitely economical.

options.japanese: あまりお得じゃないと思うよ。
options.romaji: Amari otoku janai to omou yo.
options.translationEn: I don't think it's that economical.

npcLine.japanese: どのくらいの期間、使えるものなの？
npcLine.romaji: Dono kurai no kikan, tsukaeru mono na no?
npcLine.translationEn: How long can it be used?

options.japanese: 種類によるけど、七日間から使えるものが多いよ。
options.romaji: Shurui ni yoru kedo, nanokakan kara tsukaeru mono ga ooi yo.
options.translation: Tergantung jenisnya, tapi banyak yang bisa dipakai mulai tujuh hari.
options.translationEn: It depends on the type, but many can be used starting from seven days.
Can only be used for one day.

npcLine.japanese: 新幹線にも乗れるの？
npcLine.romaji: Shinkansen ni mo noreru no?
npcLine.translationEn: Can you take the shinkansen too?

options.japanese: 一部の新幹線を除いて、ほとんど乗り放題らしいよ。
options.romaji: Ichibu no shinkansen wo nozoite, hotondo norihoudai rashii yo.
options.translation: Katanya hampir semua bisa naik sepuasnya kecuali sebagian shinkansen.
options.translationEn: They say you can ride almost everything as much as you like except some shinkansen.

options.japanese: 新幹線には全く乗れないよ。
options.romaji: Shinkansen ni wa mattaku norenai yo.
options.translation: Sama sekali tidak bisa naik shinkansen.
options.translationEn: Can't ride the shinkansen at all.

npcLine.japanese: どこを回る予定なの？
npcLine.romaji: Doko wo mawaru yotei na no?
npcLine.translationEn: Where do you plan to travel around to?

options.japanese: 京都と大阪を中心に回ろうと思っているんだ。
options.romaji: Kyouto to Oosaka wo chuushin ni mawarou to omotte iru n da.
options.translation: Aku berpikir mau keliling terutama Kyoto dan Osaka.
options.translationEn: I've been thinking of touring mainly Kyoto and Osaka.

options.japanese: 特にどこも回るつもりはないよ。
options.romaji: Toku ni doko mo mawaru tsumori wa nai yo.
options.translation: Tidak berniat keliling ke mana pun khususnya.
options.translationEn: Not intending to tour anywhere in particular.

npcLine.japanese: 楽しい旅になるといいね。
npcLine.romaji: Tanoshii tabi ni naru to ii ne.
npcLine.translation: Semoga jadi perjalanan yang menyenangkan ya.
npcLine.translationEn: Hope it's a fun trip.

options.japanese: うん、今からすごく楽しみにしてる。
options.romaji: Un, ima kara sugoku tanoshimi ni shiteru.
options.translation: Iya, dari sekarang sudah sangat tidak sabar.
options.translationEn: Yeah, I'm already really excited from now.

options.japanese: 別に楽しみじゃないよ。

titleEn: Talking About Travel Plans With a JR Pass
descriptionEn: You talk with a friend about travel plans using a JR Pass.

title: Menegosiasikan Harga di Pasar Tradisional
description: Kamu menegosiasikan harga sayur dengan penjual di pasar tradisional.

npcLine.japanese: いらっしゃい、これ新鮮だよ。
npcLine.romaji: Irasshai, kore shinsen da yo.
npcLine.translationEn: Welcome, this is fresh, you know.

options.japanese: いいですね、少し安くしていただくことはできますか。
options.romaji: Ii desu ne, sukoshi yasuku shite itadaku koto wa dekimasu ka.
options.translationEn: Great, could you give it to me a bit cheaper?

options.japanese: 高くてもいいので、ください。
options.translation: Mahal juga tidak apa-apa, tolong berikan.
options.translationEn: It's fine even if it's expensive, please give it to me.

npcLine.japanese: そうだね、二つ買うなら少し負けるよ。
npcLine.romaji: Sou da ne, futatsu kau nara sukoshi makeru yo.
npcLine.translation: Begitu ya, kalau beli dua bisa dikurangi sedikit.
npcLine.translationEn: I see, if you buy two it can be discounted a bit.

options.japanese: それなら、二つお願いします。
options.translationEn: In that case, please give me two.

npcLine.japanese: はい、まけておくよ。
npcLine.romaji: Hai, makete oku yo.
npcLine.translationEn: Alright, I'll reduce it.

options.japanese: ありがとうございます、助かります。
もっと安くしてください。
options.translationEn: Please make it a bit cheaper.

npcLine.japanese: 他にも何か見ていく？
npcLine.romaji: Hoka ni mo nanika mite iku?
npcLine.translationEn: Want to see others too?

options.japanese: せっかくなので、少し見せてもらってもいいですか。
options.romaji: Sekkaku na node, sukoshi misete moratte mo ii desu ka.
options.translation: Karena sudah di sini, boleh saya lihat-lihat sebentar?
options.translationEn: Since I'm already here, may I take a look around for a bit?

npcLine.japanese: どうぞどうぞ、ゆっくり見て。
npcLine.romaji: Douzo douzo, yukkuri mite.
npcLine.translationEn: Please, go ahead, take your time browsing.

options.japanese: ありがとうございます。
急いでいるので結構です。
options.translationEn: Since I'm in a hurry, no need.

titleEn: Haggling Over Prices at a Traditional Market
descriptionEn: You haggle over the price of vegetables with a vendor at a traditional market.

title: Menjelaskan Alasan Mengembalikan Barang Cacat
description: Kamu mengembalikan barang yang ternyata cacat ke toko.

npcLine.japanese: 本日はどのようなご用件でしょうか。
npcLine.romaji: Honjitsu wa dono you na goyouken deshou ka.
npcLine.translationEn: What do you need today?

options.japanese: 昨日買った商品に、傷が見つかったので返品したいんです。
options.romaji: Kinou katta shouhin ni, kizu ga mitsukatta node henpin shitai n desu.
options.translation: Barang yang saya beli kemarin ditemukan cacat, jadi saya ingin mengembalikannya.
options.translationEn: The item I bought yesterday turned out to be defective, so I'd like to return it.

options.japanese: 商品を買いに来ました。

npcLine.japanese: どのような傷でしょうか、見せていただけますか。
npcLine.romaji: Dono you na kizu deshou ka, misete itadakemasu ka.
npcLine.translationEn: What kind of defect, could you show me?

options.japanese: はい、こちらです、表面に傷がついているんです。
options.romaji: Hai, kochira desu, hyoumen ni kizu ga tsuite iru n desu.
options.translationEn: This one, the surface is scratched.

options.japanese: 傷はどこにもありません。
options.romaji: Kizu wa doko ni mo arimasen.
options.translation: Tidak ada cacat di mana pun.

npcLine.japanese: 確かに傷がございますね、大変失礼いたしました。
npcLine.romaji: Tashika ni kizu ga gozaimasu ne, taihen shitsurei itashimashita.
npcLine.translation: Betul ada cacat ya, mohon maaf sebesar-besarnya.
npcLine.translationEn: You're right, there's a defect, we're truly sorry.

options.japanese: いえ、確認していただき、ありがとうございます。
options.romaji: Ie, kakunin shite itadaki, arigatou gozaimasu.
options.translation: Tidak apa-apa, terima kasih sudah diperiksa.
options.translationEn: It's fine, thank you for checking.

options.japanese: もう二度と買いません。
options.translationEn: Never going to buy it again.

npcLine.japanese: 交換と返金、どちらがよろしいですか。
npcLine.romaji: Koukan to henkin, dochira ga yoroshii desu ka.
npcLine.translation: Mau tukar atau uang dikembalikan, mana yang lebih baik?
npcLine.translationEn: Exchange or a refund, which is better?

options.japanese: できれば、同じ商品と交換していただきたいです。
options.romaji: Dekireba, onaji shouhin to koukan shite itadakitai desu.
options.translation: Kalau bisa, saya ingin tukar dengan barang yang sama.
options.translationEn: If possible, I'd like to exchange it for the same item.

npcLine.japanese: かしこまりました、すぐにご用意いたします。
npcLine.romaji: Kashikomarimashita, sugu ni goyoui itashimasu.
npcLine.translationEn: Alright, we'll prepare it right away.

options.japanese: ありがとうございます、お願いします。

titleEn: Explaining Why You're Returning a Defective Item
descriptionEn: You return an item to the store that turned out to be defective.

title: Membandingkan Kualitas Produk Sebelum Membeli
description: Kamu dan teman membandingkan kualitas dua produk sebelum membeli.

npcLine.japanese: この二つ、どっちがいいと思う？
npcLine.romaji: Kono futatsu, docchi ga ii to omou?
npcLine.translation: Yang dua ini, menurutmu mana yang bagus?
npcLine.translationEn: Between these two, which do you think is better?

options.japanese: 素材からして、こっちのほうが良さそうだね。
options.romaji: Sozai kara shite, kocchi no hou ga yosasou da ne.
options.translation: Dari bahannya, sepertinya yang ini lebih bagus.
options.translationEn: Judging by the material, this one seems better.

options.japanese: どちらも全く同じに見えるよ。
options.romaji: Dochira mo mattaku onaji ni mieru yo.

npcLine.japanese: でも、値段がだいぶ違うよね。
npcLine.romaji: Demo, nedan ga daibu chigau yo ne.
npcLine.translationEn: But the price is quite different.

options.japanese: うん、高いだけあって、作りも丁寧な気がする。
options.romaji: Un, takai dake atte, tsukuri mo teinei na ki ga suru.
options.translation: Iya, mahal wajar karena rasanya pengerjaannya juga rapi.
options.translationEn: Yeah, it's reasonably priced since the workmanship also feels neat.

options.japanese: 値段が高いのに、質は悪いと思うよ。
options.romaji: Nedan ga takai noni, shitsu wa warui to omou yo.
options.translationEn: Even though it's expensive, I think the quality is bad.

npcLine.japanese: レビューも見比べてみたら？
npcLine.romaji: Rebyuu mo mikurabete mitara?
npcLine.translationEn: Have you compared the reviews too?

options.japanese: そうだね、参考にしてみよう。
options.romaji: Sou da ne, sankou ni shite miyou.
options.translationEn: True, let's use it as a reference.

options.japanese: レビューなんて見る必要ないよ。
options.romaji: Rebyuu nante miru hitsuyou nai yo.
options.translationEn: No need to look at reviews.

npcLine.japanese: 長く使うことを考えると、どっちがいいと思う？
npcLine.romaji: Nagaku tsukau koto wo kangaeru to, docchi ga ii to omou?
npcLine.translation: Kalau memikirkan pemakaian jangka panjang, mana yang bagus menurutmu?
npcLine.translationEn: Thinking about long-term use, which do you think is better?

options.japanese: 長期的に見れば、質のいいほうがお得だと思う。
options.romaji: Choukiteki ni mireba, shitsu no ii hou ga otoku da to omou.
options.translation: Kalau dilihat jangka panjang, kurasa yang kualitasnya bagus lebih hemat.
options.translationEn: In the long run, I think the higher-quality one is more economical.

options.japanese: どうせすぐ壊れるから、どちらでもいいよ。
options.romaji: Douse sugu kowareru kara, dochira demo ii yo.
options.translation: Toh sama-sama cepat rusak, jadi mana saja boleh.
options.translationEn: Either way it breaks quickly anyway, so any one is fine.

npcLine.japanese: じゃあ、こっちに決めようか。
npcLine.romaji: Jaa, kocchi ni kimeyou ka.
npcLine.translation: Kalau begitu, kita putuskan yang ini ya?
npcLine.translationEn: In that case, let's go with this one, alright?

options.japanese: やっぱり買わないでおこう。
options.translationEn: Better to just not buy it.

titleEn: Comparing Product Quality Before Buying
descriptionEn: You and a friend compare the quality of two products before buying.

title: Menjelaskan Kekecewaan terhadap Produk yang Dibeli Online
description: Kamu bercerita ke teman tentang kekecewaan produk yang dibeli online.

npcLine.japanese: 通販で買った服、届いたんでしょう？どうだった？
npcLine.romaji: Tsuuhan de katta fuku, todoita n deshou? Dou datta?
npcLine.translation: Baju yang dibeli online, sudah sampai kan? Gimana?
npcLine.translationEn: The clothes you bought online, they've arrived, right? How are they?

options.japanese: 実は、写真で見たのとはだいぶ印象が違ったんだ。
options.romaji: Jitsu wa, shashin de mita no to wa daibu inshou ga chigatta n da.
options.translation: Sebenarnya, kesannya cukup beda dari yang dilihat di foto.
options.translationEn: Actually, the impression is quite different from what I saw in the photo.

options.japanese: 写真の通りで、すごく満足したよ。
options.romaji: Shashin no toori de, sugoku manzoku shita yo.
options.translationEn: Just like the photo, very satisfied.

npcLine.japanese: どんな風に違ったの？
npcLine.romaji: Donna fuu ni chigatta no?
npcLine.translationEn: What's the difference like?

options.japanese: 色が想像していたより、だいぶ暗かったんだ。
options.romaji: Iro ga souzou shite ita yori, daibu kurakatta n da.
options.translation: Warnanya jauh lebih gelap dari bayangan.
options.translationEn: The color is much darker than I imagined.

options.japanese: 色は写真と全く同じだったよ。
options.romaji: Iro wa shashin to mattaku onaji datta yo.
options.translationEn: The color is exactly the same as the photo.

npcLine.japanese: 返品は考えているの？
npcLine.romaji: Henpin wa kangaete iru no?
npcLine.translationEn: Thinking of returning it?

options.japanese: うん、返品するかどうか、正直迷っているんだ。
options.romaji: Un, henpin suru ka dou ka, shoujiki mayotte iru n da.
options.translation: Iya, jujur aku masih bimbang mau dikembalikan atau tidak.
options.translationEn: Yeah, honestly I'm still torn about whether to return it or not.

options.japanese: 返品する気は全くないよ。
options.romaji: Henpin suru ki wa mattaku nai yo.
options.translationEn: Not intending to return it at all.

npcLine.japanese: レビューを先に見ておけば良かったかもね。
npcLine.romaji: Rebyuu wo saki ni mite okeba yokatta kamo ne.
npcLine.translation: Mungkin lebih baik kalau lihat review dulu ya.
npcLine.translationEn: It might be better to check the reviews first.

options.japanese: 本当にそう思う、次からは気をつけるよ。
options.romaji: Hontou ni sou omou, tsugi kara wa ki wo tsukeru yo.
options.translation: Aku benar-benar setuju, mulai lain kali akan lebih hati-hati.
options.translationEn: I completely agree, from next time I'll be more careful.

options.japanese: レビューなんて見る意味ないと思うよ。
options.romaji: Rebyuu nante miru imi nai to omou yo.
options.translation: Kupikir tidak ada gunanya lihat review.
options.translationEn: I don't think there's any point in looking at reviews.

npcLine.japanese: 次はもっと慎重に選んだほうがいいね。
npcLine.romaji: Tsugi wa motto shinchou ni eranda hou ga ii ne.
npcLine.translation: Lain kali sebaiknya pilih lebih hati-hati ya.
npcLine.translationEn: It's better to choose more carefully next time.

options.japanese: うん、その通りだと思う。
options.romaji: Un, sono toori da to omou.

options.japanese: 別に気にしなくていいと思うよ。
options.romaji: Betsu ni ki ni shinakute ii to omou yo.
options.translationEn: I think it doesn't need to be worried about.

titleEn: Explaining Disappointment With an Online Purchase
descriptionEn: You tell a friend about your disappointment with a product bought online.

title: Mendiskusikan Kebiasaan Belanja yang Boros
description: Kamu dan teman mendiskusikan kebiasaan belanja yang boros dan cara memperbaikinya.

npcLine.japanese: 最近、また買いすぎてない？
npcLine.romaji: Saikin, mata kaisugitenai?
npcLine.translation: Belakangan, tidak beli terlalu banyak lagi?
npcLine.translationEn: Not buying too much anymore lately?

options.japanese: うん、正直、ストレス発散のためについ買ってしまうんだ。
options.romaji: Un, shoujiki, sutoresu hassan no tame ni tsui katte shimau n da.
options.translation: Iya, jujur, karena melampiaskan stres jadi keceplosan beli.
options.translationEn: Yeah, honestly, I ended up buying it on impulse to relieve stress.

options.japanese: 全然買いすぎていないよ。
options.translation: Sama sekali tidak beli terlalu banyak.
options.translationEn: Didn't buy too much at all.

npcLine.japanese: 家計は大丈夫なの？
npcLine.romaji: Kakei wa daijoubu na no?
npcLine.translationEn: Is the household finances okay?

options.japanese: 正直、あまり余裕があるとは言えないんだ。
options.romaji: Shoujiki, amari yoyuu ga aru to wa ienai n da.
options.translation: Jujur, tidak bisa dibilang ada banyak sisa.
options.translationEn: Honestly, I can't say there's much left over.

options.japanese: すごく余裕があるから大丈夫だよ。
options.romaji: Sugoku yoyuu ga aru kara daijoubu da yo.
options.translation: Karena sangat lapang jadi tidak apa-apa.
options.translationEn: Since it's very spacious, it's fine.

npcLine.japanese: 何か対策は考えているの？
npcLine.romaji: Nanika taisaku wa kangaete iru no?
npcLine.translationEn: Do you have a particular action plan?

options.japanese: 買い物リストを作ってから行くようにしようと思っているんだ。
options.romaji: Kaimono risuto wo tsukutte kara iku you ni shiyou to omotte iru n da.
options.translation: Aku berpikir mau usahakan buat daftar belanja dulu sebelum pergi.
options.translationEn: I've been thinking of trying to make a shopping list before going.

options.japanese: 特に対策は考えていないよ。
options.romaji: Toku ni taisaku wa kangaete inai yo.
options.translation: Tidak memikirkan tindakan apa pun khususnya.
options.translationEn: Not thinking of any particular action.

npcLine.japanese: それはいい考えだね。
npcLine.romaji: Sore wa ii kangae da ne.
npcLine.translationEn: That's a good idea.

options.japanese: うん、少しずつ改善していきたいな。
options.romaji: Un, sukoshi zutsu kaizen shite ikitai na.
options.translation: Iya, aku ingin memperbaiki sedikit demi sedikit.
options.translationEn: Yeah, I want to improve little by little.

options.japanese: 別に改善する気はないよ。
options.romaji: Betsu ni kaizen suru ki wa nai yo.
options.translationEn: Not intending to fix it at all.

npcLine.japanese: 応援してるよ。
npcLine.romaji: Ouen shiteru yo.
npcLine.translationEn: I support you.

options.japanese: ありがとう、頑張ってみる。
options.translation: Terima kasih, akan aku coba usahakan.

titleEn: Discussing Wasteful Spending Habits
descriptionEn: You and a friend discuss wasteful spending habits and how to fix them.

title: Menjelaskan Cara Kerja Sistem Poin Member
description: Kamu menjelaskan ke teman cara kerja sistem poin member sebuah toko.

npcLine.japanese: このお店のポイントカード、どういう仕組みなの？
npcLine.romaji: Kono omise no pointo kaado, dou iu shikumi na no?
npcLine.translation: Kartu poin toko ini, sistemnya bagaimana?
npcLine.translationEn: How does this store's point card system work?

options.japanese: 百円につき一ポイントたまる仕組みになっているんだ。
options.romaji: Hyakuen ni tsuki ichi pointo tamaru shikumi ni natte iru n da.
options.translation: Sistemnya untuk setiap 100 yen dapat satu poin.
options.translationEn: The system is you get one point for every 100 yen.

options.japanese: ポイントは全くたまらない仕組みなんだ。
options.romaji: Pointo wa mattaku tamaranai shikumi nan da.
options.translation: Sistemnya sama sekali tidak dapat poin.
options.translationEn: The system doesn't give points at all.

npcLine.japanese: たまったポイントはどうやって使うの？
npcLine.romaji: Tamatta pointo wa dou yatte tsukau no?
npcLine.translationEn: How do you use the points you've collected?

options.japanese: 次回の買い物の際に、割引として使えるようになっているよ。
options.romaji: Jikai no kaimono no sai ni, waribiki toshite tsukaeru you ni natte iru yo.
options.translation: Bisa dipakai sebagai diskon saat belanja berikutnya.
options.translationEn: It can be used as a discount on your next purchase.

options.japanese: ポイントは使い道が全くないよ。
options.romaji: Pointo wa tsukaimichi ga mattaku nai yo.
options.translation: Poin sama sekali tidak ada gunanya.

npcLine.japanese: 有効期限とかあるのかな。
npcLine.romaji: Yuukou kigen toka aru no ka na.
npcLine.translation: Ada batas waktu berlaku kali ya.
npcLine.translationEn: There's probably a validity period.

options.japanese: あるみたいだよ、一年以内に使わないと失効するらしい。
options.romaji: Aru mitai da yo, ichinen inai ni tsukawanai to shikkou suru rashii.
options.translation: Sepertinya ada, katanya kalau tidak dipakai dalam satu tahun akan hangus.
options.translationEn: It seems there is — they say if not used within a year it expires.

options.japanese: 有効期限は特にないと思うよ。
options.romaji: Yuukou kigen wa toku ni nai to omou yo.
options.translation: Kupikir tidak ada batas waktu khususnya.
options.translationEn: I don't think there's a particular deadline.

npcLine.japanese: 意外と忘れがちだよね。
npcLine.romaji: Igai to wasuregachi da yo ne.
npcLine.translationEn: Turns out it's often forgotten.

options.japanese: そうなんだよ、定期的に確認するようにしているよ。
options.romaji: Sou nan da yo, teikiteki ni kakunin suru you ni shite iru yo.
options.translation: Betul, aku usahakan cek secara rutin.
options.translationEn: Right, I try to check it regularly.

options.japanese: 一度も確認したことないよ。
options.romaji: Ichido mo kakunin shita koto nai yo.

npcLine.japanese: いいこと聞いたよ、ありがとう。
npcLine.romaji: Ii koto kiita yo, arigatou.
npcLine.translationEn: Good info, thanks.

titleEn: Explaining How a Membership Points System Works
descriptionEn: You explain to a friend how a store's membership points system works.

title: Membicarakan Tren Belanja Ramah Lingkungan
description: Kamu membicarakan kebiasaan belanja ramah lingkungan dengan teman.

npcLine.japanese: 最近、エコバッグを持ち歩くようになったんだよね。
npcLine.romaji: Saikin, ekobaggu wo mochiaruku you ni natta n da yo ne.
npcLine.translation: Belakangan, jadi terbiasa bawa tas belanja sendiri ya.
npcLine.translationEn: You've gotten used to bringing your own shopping bag lately, huh.

options.japanese: うん、レジ袋を減らすことを意識するようになったんだ。
options.romaji: Un, rejibukuro wo herasu koto wo ishiki suru you ni natta n da.
options.translation: Iya, aku jadi sadar untuk mengurangi kantong plastik.
options.translationEn: Yeah, it made me aware of reducing plastic bags.

options.japanese: 全く気にしていないよ。
options.romaji: Mattaku ki ni shite inai yo.

npcLine.japanese: 他にも何か心がけていることある？
npcLine.romaji: Hoka ni mo nanika kokorogakete iru koto aru?
npcLine.translation: Ada hal lain yang diperhatikan juga?
npcLine.translationEn: Is there anything else you've noticed too?

options.japanese: 過剰包装を避けるようにしているよ。
options.romaji: Kajou housou wo sakeru you ni shite iru yo.
options.translationEn: I try to avoid excessive packaging.

options.japanese: 包装は多ければ多いほどいいと思っているよ。
options.romaji: Housou wa oi kereba ooi hodo ii to omotte iru yo.
options.translation: Kupikir semakin banyak pembungkusan semakin bagus.
options.translationEn: I think the more packaging, the better.

npcLine.japanese: 環境に配慮した商品って、値段が高くない？
npcLine.romaji: Kankyou ni hairyo shita shouhin tte, nedan ga takakunai?
npcLine.translation: Barang yang ramah lingkungan itu, tidak mahal?
npcLine.translationEn: Eco-friendly items, aren't they expensive?

options.japanese: 高いものもあるけど、選び方次第だと思うよ。
options.romaji: Takai mono mo aru kedo, erabikata shidai da to omou yo.
options.translation: Ada yang mahal, tapi kurasa tergantung cara memilihnya.
options.translationEn: Some are expensive, but I think it depends on how you choose.

npcLine.japanese: 続けるのは大変じゃない？
npcLine.romaji: Tsuzukeru no wa taihen janai?
npcLine.translationEn: Isn't it hard to keep it up?

options.japanese: 最初は大変だったけど、今では習慣になっているよ。
options.romaji: Saisho wa taihen datta kedo, ima dewa shuukan ni natte iru yo.
options.translation: Awalnya berat, tapi sekarang sudah jadi kebiasaan.
options.translationEn: It was tough at first, but now it's become a habit.

options.japanese: 全然大変じゃなかったよ。

npcLine.japanese: 素晴らしい取り組みだね。
npcLine.romaji: Subarashii torikumi da ne.
npcLine.translationEn: That's an amazing effort.

options.japanese: そう言ってもらえると嬉しいな。
options.romaji: Sou itte moraeru to ureshii na.

options.japanese: 別に大したことないよ。
options.romaji: Betsu ni taishita koto nai yo.

titleEn: Talking About the Eco-Friendly Shopping Trend
descriptionEn: You talk about eco-friendly shopping habits with a friend.

title: Menegosiasikan Garansi Produk Elektronik
description: Kamu meminta klaim garansi untuk vacuum cleaner yang rusak.

npcLine.japanese: 本日はどのようなご用件でしょうか。
npcLine.romaji: Honjitsu wa dono you na goyouken deshou ka.
npcLine.translationEn: What do you need today?

options.japanese: 先月買った掃除機の調子が悪くて、保証を使いたいんです。
options.romaji: Sengetsu katta soujiki no choushi ga warukute, hoshou wo tsukaitai n desu.
options.translation: Vacuum cleaner yang saya beli bulan lalu kondisinya kurang baik, saya ingin pakai garansi.
options.translationEn: The vacuum cleaner I bought last month isn't in good condition, I'd like to use the warranty.

options.japanese: 掃除機を買いに来ました。
options.translationEn: Came to buy a vacuum cleaner.

npcLine.japanese: 保証書はお持ちですか。
npcLine.romaji: Hoshousho wa omochi desu ka.
npcLine.translationEn: Did you bring the warranty card?

options.japanese: はい、レシートと一緒に持ってきました。
options.romaji: Hai, reshiito to issho ni motte kimashita.
options.translationEn: Yeah, I brought it along with the receipt.

options.japanese: 保証書は持っていません。

npcLine.japanese: どのような症状か、詳しく教えていただけますか。
npcLine.romaji: Dono you na shoujou ka, kuwashiku oshiete itadakemasu ka.
npcLine.translationEn: Can you explain the symptoms in detail?

options.japanese: スイッチを入れても、全く動かなくなってしまったんです。
options.romaji: Suicchi wo iretemo, mattaku ugokanaku natte shimatta n desu.
options.translation: Meski dinyalakan, jadi sama sekali tidak bergerak.
options.translationEn: Even when turned on, it doesn't move at all.

options.japanese: 特に問題は起きていません。
options.romaji: Toku ni mondai wa okite imasen.
options.translation: Tidak ada masalah yang terjadi khususnya.

npcLine.japanese: 承知しました、無償で修理させていただきます。
npcLine.romaji: Shouchi shimashita, mushou de shuuri sasete itadakimasu.
npcLine.translation: Mengerti, akan kami perbaiki tanpa biaya.
npcLine.translationEn: Understood, we'll fix it free of charge.

options.japanese: ありがとうございます、助かります。

npcLine.japanese: 一週間ほどお時間をいただきます。
npcLine.romaji: Isshuukan hodo ojikan wo itadakimasu.
npcLine.translationEn: It'll take about a week.

options.japanese: 分かりました、お願いします。

titleEn: Negotiating an Electronics Warranty
descriptionEn: You file a warranty claim for a broken vacuum cleaner.

title: Menjelaskan Alasan Memilih Produk Lokal
description: Kamu menjelaskan ke teman kenapa memilih produk lokal.

npcLine.japanese: 最近、地元の商品ばかり選んでるよね。
npcLine.romaji: Saikin, jimoto no shouhin bakari erandeiru yo ne.
npcLine.translation: Belakangan, memilih produk lokal saja ya.
npcLine.translationEn: Choosing local products lately, huh.

options.japanese: うん、地域の経済を支えたいと思うようになったんだ。
options.romaji: Un, chiiki no keizai wo sasaetai to omou you ni natta n da.
options.translation: Iya, aku jadi berpikir mau mendukung ekonomi daerah.
options.translationEn: Yeah, it made me think of wanting to support the local economy.

options.romaji: Betsu ni riyuu wa nai yo.

npcLine.japanese: 品質はどうなの？
npcLine.romaji: Hinshitsu wa dou na no?
npcLine.translationEn: How's the quality?

options.japanese: むしろ、輸入品より品質がいいと感じることも多いよ。
options.romaji: Mushiro, yunyuuhin yori hinshitsu ga ii to kanjiru koto mo ooi yo.
options.translation: Malah, sering merasa kualitasnya lebih bagus dari barang impor.
options.translationEn: Actually, I often feel the quality is better than imported goods.

options.japanese: 品質は全然良くないと感じるよ。
options.romaji: Hinshitsu wa zenzen yokunai to kanjiru yo.
options.translation: Merasa kualitasnya sama sekali tidak bagus.
options.translationEn: Feel the quality isn't good at all.

npcLine.japanese: 値段は高くなりがちじゃない？
npcLine.romaji: Nedan wa takaku narigachi janai?
npcLine.translationEn: The price tends to be expensive, right?

options.japanese: そうだね、でも納得できる価格だと思うよ。
options.romaji: Sou da ne, demo nattoku dekiru kakaku da to omou yo.
options.translation: Betul juga, tapi kurasa harganya masuk akal.
options.translationEn: True, but I think the price makes sense.

options.japanese: いつも激安だと思うよ。
options.romaji: Itsumo gekiyasu da to omou yo.
options.translationEn: I think it's always really cheap.

npcLine.japanese: 私も試してみようかな。
npcLine.romaji: Watashi mo tameshite miyou ka na.
npcLine.translationEn: Maybe I'll try it too.

options.japanese: あまりおすすめしないよ。

npcLine.japanese: 良い取り組みだと思う。
npcLine.romaji: Ii torikumi da to omou.
npcLine.translationEn: I think that's a good effort.

options.japanese: ありがとう、これからも続けるよ。
options.romaji: Arigatou, kore kara mo tsuzukeru yo.
options.translationEn: Thank you, I'll keep it up.

options.japanese: もうやめようと思っているよ。
options.romaji: Mou yameyou to omotte iru yo.

titleEn: Explaining Why You Choose Local Products
descriptionEn: You explain to a friend why you choose local products.

title: Mendiskusikan Pengalaman Ditipu Saat Belanja
description: Kamu bercerita ke teman tentang pengalaman ditipu saat belanja online.

npcLine.japanese: ネットショッピングで騙されたことがあるって聞いたよ。
npcLine.romaji: Netto shoppingu de damasareta koto ga aru tte kiita yo.
npcLine.translation: Kudengar pernah ditipu saat belanja online.
npcLine.translationEn: I heard you got scammed while shopping online once.

options.japanese: うん、代金を払ったのに、商品が全く届かなかったんだ。
options.romaji: Un, daikin wo haratta noni, shouhin ga mattaku todokanakatta n da.
options.translation: Iya, meski sudah bayar, barangnya sama sekali tidak sampai.
options.translationEn: Yeah, even though I already paid, the item never arrived at all.

options.japanese: 一度も騙されたことないよ。
options.romaji: Ichido mo damasareta koto nai yo.

npcLine.japanese: どうやって気づいたの？
npcLine.romaji: Dou yatte kizuita no?
npcLine.translationEn: How did you come to realize it?

options.japanese: 問い合わせても返信がないことから、おかしいと気づいたんだ。
options.romaji: Toiawasetemo henshin ga nai koto kara, okashii to kizuita n da.
options.translation: Karena tidak ada balasan meski sudah menghubungi, aku sadar ada yang aneh.
options.translationEn: Since there was no reply even after contacting them, I realized something was off.

options.japanese: すぐに商品が届いたから、何も気づかなかったよ。
options.romaji: Sugu ni shouhin ga todoita kara, nanimo kizukanakatta yo.
options.translation: Karena langsung sampai barangnya, tidak sadar apa-apa.
options.translationEn: Since the item arrived right away, I didn't notice anything.

npcLine.japanese: それからどうしたの？
npcLine.romaji: Sore kara dou shita no?
npcLine.translationEn: How was it after that?

options.japanese: 消費者センターに相談することにしたんだ。
options.romaji: Shouhisha sentaa ni soudan suru koto ni shita n da.
options.translation: Aku memutuskan konsultasi ke pusat perlindungan konsumen.
options.translationEn: I decided to consult the consumer protection center.

npcLine.japanese: お金は戻ってきたの？
npcLine.romaji: Okane wa modotte kita no?
npcLine.translationEn: Did you get the money back?

options.japanese: 時間はかかったけど、最終的には返金されたよ。
options.romaji: Jikan wa kakatta kedo, saishuuteki ni wa henkin sareta yo.
options.translation: Butuh waktu, tapi akhirnya uangnya dikembalikan.
options.translationEn: It took time, but the money was eventually refunded.

options.japanese: 結局、一円も戻ってこなかったよ。
options.romaji: Kekkyoku, ichien mo modotte konakatta yo.
options.translation: Akhirnya, satu yen pun tidak kembali.
options.translationEn: In the end, not even a single yen came back.

npcLine.japanese: それは大変な経験だったね。
npcLine.romaji: Sore wa taihen na keiken datta ne.
npcLine.translationEn: That's a tough experience.

options.japanese: うん、今では買う前に必ず確認するようにしているよ。
options.romaji: Un, ima dewa kau mae ni kanarazu kakunin suru you ni shite iru yo.
options.translation: Iya, sekarang aku usahakan selalu cek dulu sebelum beli.
options.translationEn: Yeah, now I always try to check first before buying.

options.japanese: それでも全く気をつけていないよ。
options.romaji: Sore demo mattaku ki wo tsukete inai yo.
options.translation: Meski begitu tetap sama sekali tidak berhati-hati.
options.translationEn: Even so, still not careful at all.

titleEn: Discussing an Experience of Being Scammed While Shopping
descriptionEn: You tell a friend about the experience of being scammed while shopping online.

title: Membicarakan Filosofi Minimalisme dalam Berbelanja
description: Kamu membicarakan filosofi minimalisme dalam berbelanja dengan teman.

npcLine.japanese: 最近、物を減らすようにしてるって言ってたよね。
npcLine.romaji: Saikin, mono wo herasu you ni shiteru tte itteta yo ne.
npcLine.translation: Katanya belakangan usaha mengurangi barang ya.
npcLine.translationEn: I heard you've been trying to reduce your belongings lately.

options.japanese: うん、本当に必要なものだけを買うように心がけているんだ。
options.romaji: Un, hontou ni hitsuyou na mono dake wo kau you ni kokorogakete iru n da.
options.translation: Iya, aku usahakan hanya beli barang yang benar-benar diperlukan.
options.translationEn: Yeah, I try to only buy things that are really needed.

options.japanese: 逆に、物を増やすようにしているよ。
options.romaji: Gyaku ni, mono wo fuyasu you ni shite iru yo.
options.translationEn: On the contrary, I try to add more items.

npcLine.japanese: きっかけは何だったの？
npcLine.romaji: Kikkake wa nan datta no?
npcLine.translationEn: What was the trigger?

options.japanese: 使わない物が増えていく一方だと気づいたのがきっかけなんだ。
options.romaji: Tsukawanai mono ga fuete iku ippou da to kizuita no ga kikkake nan da.
options.translation: Pemicunya karena sadar barang yang tidak dipakai terus bertambah.
options.translationEn: The trigger was realizing that unused items kept piling up.

options.japanese: 特にきっかけはないんだ。
options.romaji: Toku ni kikkake wa nai n da.

npcLine.japanese: 何か変化はあった？
npcLine.romaji: Nanika henka wa atta?
npcLine.translationEn: Any changes?

options.japanese: 部屋がすっきりして、気持ちも軽くなった気がするよ。
options.romaji: Heya ga sukkiri shite, kimochi mo karuku natta ki ga suru yo.
options.translation: Kamar jadi rapi, dan rasanya perasaanku juga jadi ringan.
options.translationEn: The room got tidy, and it feels like my mood got lighter too.

options.japanese: 特に何も変わらなかったよ。

npcLine.japanese: 買い物する時、何を基準にしてるの？
npcLine.romaji: Kaimono suru toki, nani wo kijun ni shiteru no?
npcLine.translationEn: What criteria do you use when shopping?

options.japanese: 本当に長く使えるかどうかを基準にしているんだ。
options.romaji: Hontou ni nagaku tsukaeru ka dou ka wo kijun ni shite iru n da.
options.translation: Aku pakai patokan apakah benar-benar bisa dipakai lama atau tidak.
options.translationEn: I use the standard of whether it can really be used for a long time or not.

options.japanese: 安いかどうかだけを基準にしているんだ。
options.romaji: Yasui ka dou ka dake wo kijun ni shite iru n da.
options.translation: Cuma pakai patokan murah atau tidak.
options.translationEn: Just going by whether it's cheap or not.

npcLine.japanese: 参考になるな。
npcLine.romaji: Sankou ni naru na.
npcLine.translationEn: That's a good reference.

options.japanese: 少しでも参考になれば嬉しいよ。
options.romaji: Sukoshi demo sankou ni nareba ureshii yo.
options.translation: Kalau sedikit saja jadi referensi, aku senang.
options.translationEn: I'd be happy if even a little of it becomes a reference for you.

options.japanese: 別に参考にならないと思うよ。
options.romaji: Betsu ni sankou ni naranai to omou yo.
options.translationEn: I don't think it'll be a reference.

titleEn: Talking About Minimalist Shopping Philosophy
descriptionEn: You talk about a minimalist shopping philosophy with a friend.

title: Menjelaskan Cara Klaim Asuransi Barang Rusak
description: Kamu menjelaskan ke teman cara klaim asuransi untuk HP yang rusak.

npcLine.japanese: このスマホ、保険入ってたよね？画面割れたらどうすればいいの？
npcLine.romaji: Kono sumaho, hoken haitteta yo ne? Gamen warettara dou sureba ii no?
npcLine.translation: HP ini, punya asuransi kan? Kalau layarnya pecah harus gimana?
npcLine.translationEn: This phone has insurance, right? What do I do if the screen breaks?

options.japanese: まず、保険会社に連絡して、手続き方法を確認する必要があるよ。
options.romaji: Mazu, hoken gaisha ni renraku shite, tetsuzuki houhou wo kakunin suru hitsuyou ga aru yo.
options.translation: Pertama, harus hubungi perusahaan asuransi dan cek cara prosesnya.
options.translationEn: First, I have to contact the insurance company and check the process.

options.japanese: 特に何もしなくていいよ。
options.romaji: Toku ni nanimo shinakute ii yo.
options.translation: Tidak perlu melakukan apa pun khususnya.
options.translationEn: No particular need to do anything.

npcLine.japanese: 修理代は全額カバーされるの？
npcLine.romaji: Shuuridai wa zengaku kabaa sareru no?
npcLine.translationEn: Is the repair cost fully covered?

options.japanese: いや、契約内容によっては、自己負担が発生することもあるよ。
options.romaji: Iya, keiyaku naiyou ni yotte wa, jiko futan ga hassei suru koto mo aru yo.
options.translation: Tidak, tergantung isi kontrak, kadang timbul biaya sendiri juga.
options.translationEn: No, depending on the contract terms, sometimes there's an out-of-pocket cost too.

options.japanese: うん、絶対に全額カバーされるよ。
options.romaji: Un, zettai ni zengaku kabaa sareru yo.

npcLine.japanese: 申請には何が必要なの？
npcLine.romaji: Shinsei ni wa nani ga hitsuyou na no?
npcLine.translationEn: What's needed to apply?

options.japanese: 破損した状況が分かる写真と、購入時の領収書が必要みたいだよ。
options.romaji: Hason shita joukyou ga wakaru shashin to, kounyuuji no ryoushuusho ga hitsuyou mitai da yo.
options.translation: Sepertinya perlu foto yang menunjukkan kondisi kerusakan dan struk pembelian.
options.translationEn: It seems photos showing the damage and the purchase receipt are needed.

options.japanese: 何も準備しなくていいみたいだよ。
options.romaji: Nanimo junbi shinakute ii mitai da yo.
options.translation: Sepertinya tidak perlu siapkan apa pun.
options.translationEn: It seems nothing needs to be prepared.

npcLine.japanese: 申請してから、どのくらいで結果が出るの？
npcLine.romaji: Shinsei shite kara, dono kurai de kekka ga deru no?
npcLine.translation: Setelah mengajukan, berapa lama hasilnya keluar?
npcLine.translationEn: After applying, how long until the results come out?

options.japanese: 場合によるけど、一週間ほどかかるらしいよ。
options.romaji: Baai ni yoru kedo, isshuukan hodo kakaru rashii yo.
options.translation: Tergantung kasus, tapi katanya perlu sekitar seminggu.
options.translationEn: It depends on the case, but they say it takes about a week.

options.japanese: 即日で結果が出るらしいよ。
options.romaji: Sokujitsu de kekka ga deru rashii yo.
options.translation: Katanya hasilnya keluar hari itu juga.
options.translationEn: They say the results come out that same day.

npcLine.japanese: 参考になったよ、ありがとう。
npcLine.romaji: Sankou ni natta yo, arigatou.
npcLine.translationEn: That's a good reference, thanks.

options.japanese: どういたしまして、役に立てて良かった。
options.romaji: Dou itashimashite, yaku ni tatete yokatta.
options.translationEn: You're welcome, glad I could help.

options.japanese: 別に役に立ててないと思うよ。
options.romaji: Betsu ni yaku ni tattenai to omou yo.
options.translationEn: I don't think it helps at all.

titleEn: Explaining How to Claim Insurance for a Damaged Item
descriptionEn: You explain to a friend how to claim insurance for a broken phone.

title: Mendiskusikan Perbedaan Belanja Offline dan Online
description: Kamu dan teman mendiskusikan perbedaan belanja baju offline dan online.

npcLine.japanese: 服はネットで買う派？それとも実際に見て買う派？
npcLine.romaji: Fuku wa netto de kau ha? Sore tomo jissai ni mite kau ha?
npcLine.translation: Baju, tipe beli online atau tipe lihat langsung dulu?
npcLine.translationEn: For clothes, are you the buy-online type or the see-it-in-person-first type?

options.japanese: 実際に試着できる分、実店舗で買うことが多いかな。
options.romaji: Jissai ni shichaku dekiru bun, jitten pode kau koto ga ooi ka na.
options.translation: Karena bisa coba langsung, mungkin lebih sering beli di toko fisik.
options.translationEn: Since I can try it directly, I probably buy more often at physical stores.

options.japanese: ネットでしか買わないよ。

npcLine.japanese: ネットで買うメリットは何だと思う？
npcLine.romaji: Netto de kau meritto wa nan da to omou?
npcLine.translationEn: What do you think is the advantage of buying online?

options.japanese: 家にいながら、いろんな商品を比較できるところだと思う。
options.romaji: Ie ni inagara, iroiro na shouhin wo hikaku dekiru tokoro da to omou.
options.translation: Menurutku sambil di rumah, bisa bandingkan berbagai barang.
options.translationEn: I think while at home, you can compare various items.

options.japanese: 特にメリットはないと思う。
options.romaji: Toku ni meritto wa nai to omou.
options.translationEn: I don't think there's a particular benefit.

npcLine.japanese: サイズが合わないことはない？
npcLine.romaji: Saizu ga awanai koto wa nai?
npcLine.translationEn: Has the size never not fit?

options.japanese: たまにあるよ、それがネットで服を買う難しさだと思う。
options.romaji: Tamani aru yo, sore ga netto de fuku wo kau muzukashisa da to omou.
options.translation: Kadang ada, kurasa itu kesulitan beli baju online.
options.translationEn: Sometimes there is, I think that's the difficulty of buying clothes online.

options.japanese: 一度もサイズが合わなかったことないよ。
options.romaji: Ichido mo saizu ga awanakatta koto nai yo.
options.translation: Belum pernah ukurannya tidak pas sama sekali.
options.translationEn: The size has never not fit at all.

npcLine.japanese: これからも両方使い分けていくの？
npcLine.romaji: Kore kara mo ryouhou tsukaiwakete iku no?
npcLine.translation: Ke depannya juga akan pakai keduanya secara bergantian?
npcLine.translationEn: Will you keep using both interchangeably going forward too?

options.japanese: うん、商品によって使い分けていこうと思っているよ。
options.romaji: Un, shouhin ni yotte tsukaiwakete ikou to omotte iru yo.
options.translation: Iya, aku berpikir mau pakai secara bergantian tergantung barangnya.
options.translationEn: Yeah, I'm thinking of alternating depending on the item.

options.japanese: これからはネットだけにするつもりだよ。
options.romaji: Kore kara wa netto dake ni suru tsumori da yo.
options.translation: Ke depannya berniat hanya online saja.
options.translationEn: Going forward, intending to only go online.

npcLine.japanese: バランスが取れているね。
npcLine.romaji: Baransu ga torete iru ne.
npcLine.translationEn: That's balanced.

titleEn: Discussing the Difference Between Offline and Online Shopping
descriptionEn: You and a friend discuss the difference between buying clothes offline and online.

title: Menceritakan Pengalaman Kerja Sebagai Pramuniaga
description: Kamu bercerita ke teman tentang pengalaman kerja paruh waktu sebagai pramuniaga.

npcLine.japanese: アパレルショップで働いてたことあるんだって？
npcLine.romaji: Apareru shoppu de hataraiteta koto aru n datte?
npcLine.translation: Katanya pernah kerja di toko pakaian ya?
npcLine.translationEn: I heard you used to work at a clothing store?

options.japanese: うん、大学生の頃に、二年ほど働いていたんだ。
options.romaji: Un, daigakusei no koro ni, ninen hodo hataraite ita n da.
options.translation: Iya, waktu kuliah, aku kerja sekitar dua tahun.
options.translationEn: Yeah, during college, I worked for about two years.

options.japanese: 一度も働いたことないよ。
options.romaji: Ichido mo hataraita koto nai yo.

npcLine.japanese: 接客で大変だったことは？
npcLine.romaji: Sekkyaku de taihen datta koto wa?
npcLine.translation: Yang berat waktu melayani pelanggan apa?
npcLine.translationEn: What's the hardest part of serving customers?

options.japanese: お客様の好みを瞬時に見抜くのが、最初は難しかったな。
options.romaji: Okyakusama no konomi wo shunji ni minuku no ga, saisho wa muzukashikatta na.
options.translation: Awalnya susah untuk langsung memahami selera pelanggan.
options.translationEn: At first it was hard to immediately understand the customers' preferences.

options.japanese: 接客は全く大変じゃなかったな。
options.romaji: Sekkyaku wa zenzen taihen janakatta na.
options.translation: Melayani pelanggan sama sekali tidak berat.
options.translationEn: Serving customers isn't tough at all.

npcLine.japanese: どうやって上達したの？
npcLine.romaji: Dou yatte joutatsu shita no?
npcLine.translationEn: How did you become skilled at it?

options.japanese: 先輩の接客を観察しつつ、自分なりに工夫していったんだ。
options.romaji: Senpai no sekkyaku wo kansatsu shitsutsu, jibun nari ni kufuu shite itta n da.
options.translation: Aku melakukan penyesuaian sendiri sambil mengamati pelayanan senior.
options.translationEn: I made adjustments on my own while observing the seniors' service.

options.japanese: 特に何もせずに、自然に上手になったよ。
options.romaji: Toku ni nanimo sezu ni, shizen ni jouzu ni natta yo.
options.translation: Tanpa melakukan apa pun, alami jadi mahir.
options.translationEn: Became skilled naturally without doing anything.

npcLine.japanese: 印象に残っているお客さんとかいる？
npcLine.romaji: Inshou ni nokotte iru okyakusan toka iru?
npcLine.translationEn: Is there a customer that left an impression?

options.japanese: うん、後で丁寧にお礼を言いに戻ってきてくれた方がいたよ。
options.romaji: Un, ato de teinei ni orei wo ii ni modotte kite kureta kata ga ita yo.
options.translation: Iya, ada yang kembali untuk mengucapkan terima kasih dengan sopan.
options.translationEn: Yeah, some come back to politely say thank you.

options.japanese: 特に印象に残っている人はいないよ。
options.romaji: Toku ni inshou ni nokotte iru hito wa inai yo.
options.translation: Tidak ada orang yang membekas khususnya.
options.translationEn: No particular person left an impression.

npcLine.japanese: いい経験になったんだね。
npcLine.romaji: Ii keiken ni natta n da ne.
npcLine.translationEn: That became a good experience.

options.japanese: うん、今の仕事にも活かされていると思う。
options.romaji: Un, ima no shigoto ni mo ikasarete iru to omou.
options.translation: Iya, kurasa masih terpakai di pekerjaan sekarang.
options.translationEn: Yeah, I think it's still applicable in my current job.

options.japanese: 全く活かされていないと思う。
options.translationEn: I don't think it's used at all.

titleEn: Talking About Your Experience Working as a Shop Assistant
descriptionEn: You tell a friend about your experience working part-time as a shop assistant.

title: Membicarakan Rencana Belanja untuk Acara Besar
description: Kamu membicarakan rencana belanja untuk pernikahan dengan teman.

npcLine.japanese: 結婚式のための買い物、進んでる？
npcLine.romaji: Kekkonshiki no tame no kaimono, susunderu?
npcLine.translationEn: Has the wedding shopping been going well?

options.japanese: 少しずつだけど、リストを作りながら進めているよ。
options.romaji: Sukoshi zutsu dakedo, risuto wo tsukurinagara susumete iru yo.
options.translation: Sedikit demi sedikit, aku jalankan sambil buat daftar.
options.translationEn: Little by little, I carry it out while making a list.

npcLine.japanese: 予算はどのくらい考えているの？
npcLine.romaji: Yosan wa dono kurai kangaete iru no?
npcLine.translationEn: About what's your budget?

options.japanese: 無理のない範囲で、上限を決めているよ。
options.romaji: Muri no nai han'i de, jougen wo kimete iru yo.
options.translation: Aku menentukan batas atas sebatas yang tidak memaksakan diri.
options.translationEn: I set an upper limit as long as I'm not pushing myself too hard.

options.japanese: 予算は全く考えていないよ。
options.romaji: Yosan wa mattaku kangaete inai yo.
options.translationEn: The budget wasn't thought about at all.

npcLine.japanese: 何から揃え始めたの？
npcLine.romaji: Nani kara soroe hajimeta no?
npcLine.translationEn: What should I start completing first?

options.japanese: まず、必要不可欠な物から揃えることにしたんだ。
options.romaji: Mazu, hitsuyou fukaketsu na mono kara soroeru koto ni shita n da.
options.translation: Pertama, aku putuskan lengkapi dari barang yang benar-benar diperlukan dulu.
options.translationEn: First, I decided to fill in the things I really need first.

options.japanese: 特に順番は決めずに揃えているよ。
options.romaji: Toku ni junban wa kimezu ni soroete iru yo.
options.translationEn: Filling it in without any particular order.

npcLine.japanese: 大変なことも多いんじゃない？
npcLine.romaji: Taihen na koto mo ooi n janai?
npcLine.translationEn: There's a lot of tough parts too, right?

options.japanese: 正直、決めることが多くて、少し疲れることもあるよ。
options.romaji: Shoujiki, kimeru koto ga ookute, sukoshi tsukareru koto mo aru yo.
options.translation: Jujur, karena banyak yang harus diputuskan, kadang jadi agak lelah.
options.translationEn: Honestly, since there's a lot to decide, it sometimes gets a bit tiring.

npcLine.japanese: 素敵な式になるといいね。
npcLine.romaji: Suteki na shiki ni naru to ii ne.
npcLine.translation: Semoga jadi acara yang indah ya.
npcLine.translationEn: Hope it's a beautiful event.

options.japanese: うん、そうなるように頑張るよ。
options.romaji: Un, sou naru you ni ganbaru yo.
options.translation: Iya, akan aku usahakan supaya jadi begitu.
options.translationEn: Yeah, I'll try to make it that way.

titleEn: Talking About Shopping Plans for a Big Event
descriptionEn: You talk about shopping plans for a wedding with a friend.

title: Menjelaskan Rute Rumit dengan Detail
description: Kamu menjelaskan rute yang cukup rumit ke seseorang yang bertanya jalan.

npcLine.japanese: すみません、市役所への行き方を教えていただけますか。
npcLine.romaji: Sumimasen, shiyakusho e no ikikata wo oshiete itadakemasu ka.
npcLine.translation: Maaf, bisa tolong ajari jalan ke balai kota?
npcLine.translationEn: Sorry, could you show me the way to city hall?

options.japanese: はい、この道をまっすぐ行った上で、二つ目の信号を右に曲がってください。
options.romaji: Hai, kono michi wo massugu itta ue de, futatsume no shingou wo migi ni magatte kudasai.
options.translation: Baik, setelah jalan lurus di jalan ini, tolong belok kanan di lampu merah kedua.
options.translationEn: Okay, after going straight on this road, please turn right at the second traffic light.

options.japanese: この道はどこにも続いていません。
options.romaji: Kono michi wa doko ni mo tsuzuite imasen.
options.translation: Jalan ini tidak menuju ke mana pun.

npcLine.japanese: 二つ目の信号ですね、その後は？
npcLine.romaji: Futatsume no shingou desu ne, sono ato wa?
npcLine.translation: Lampu merah kedua ya, setelah itu?
npcLine.translationEn: The second traffic light, right, then what?

options.japanese: そのまま進めば、左側に大きい建物が見えてくるはずです。
options.romaji: Sono mama susumeba, hidarigawa ni ookii tatemono ga miete kuru hazu desu.
options.translation: Kalau terus jalan, seharusnya di sisi kiri akan terlihat gedung besar.
options.translationEn: If you keep walking, you should see a big building on the left.

options.japanese: そこで行き止まりになります。

npcLine.japanese: その建物が市役所ということですか。
npcLine.romaji: Sono tatemono ga shiyakusho to iu koto desu ka.
npcLine.translationEn: So that building is the city hall?

options.japanese: いいえ、その建物の裏に回っていただく必要があります。
options.romaji: Iie, sono tatemono no ura ni mawatte itadaku hitsuyou ga arimasu.
options.translation: Tidak, perlu berputar ke belakang gedung itu.
options.translationEn: No, you need to go around behind that building.

options.japanese: はい、それが市役所です。

npcLine.japanese: なるほど、少し複雑ですね。
npcLine.romaji: Naruhodo, sukoshi fukuzatsu desu ne.
npcLine.translationEn: I see, that's a bit complicated.

options.japanese: そうなんです、地図アプリを使ったほうが確実かもしれません。
options.romaji: Sou nan desu, chizu apuri wo tsukatta hou ga kakujitsu kamoshiremasen.
options.translation: Betul, mungkin lebih pasti kalau pakai aplikasi peta.
options.translationEn: Right, it's probably more reliable to use a map app.

options.japanese: 全く複雑ではありません。

npcLine.japanese: 丁寧に教えていただき、ありがとうございます。
npcLine.romaji: Teinei ni oshiete itadaki, arigatou gozaimasu.
npcLine.translation: Terima kasih sudah menjelaskan dengan teliti.
npcLine.translationEn: Thanks for explaining so carefully.

options.japanese: いえいえ、お役に立てて良かったです。
options.romaji: Ieie, oyaku ni tatete yokatta desu.
options.translationEn: It's fine, glad I could help.

options.japanese: もう教えたくありません。

titleEn: Explaining a Complicated Route in Detail
descriptionEn: You explain a fairly complicated route to someone asking for directions.

title: Menanyakan Jalan Pintas ke Tempat Tujuan
description: Kamu dan teman membicarakan jalan pintas menuju stasiun.

npcLine.japanese: 駅まで、もっと早く着ける道知らない？
npcLine.romaji: Eki made, motto hayaku tsukeru michi shiranai?
npcLine.translation: Ke stasiun, tahu jalan yang bisa lebih cepat sampai tidak?
npcLine.translationEn: Do you know a faster way to get to the station?

options.japanese: あるよ、あの路地を通れば、五分は短縮できるはずだよ。
options.romaji: Aru yo, ano roji wo tooreba, gofun wa tanshuku dekiru hazu da yo.
options.translation: Ada, kalau lewat gang itu, seharusnya bisa menghemat lima menit.
