options.translationEn: There is — if you go through that alley, you should save five minutes.

options.japanese: 近道なんて存在しないと思うよ。
options.romaji: Chikamichi nante sonzai shinai to omou yo.
options.translationEn: I don't think there's a shortcut.

npcLine.japanese: その路地、夜でも安全なのかな。
npcLine.romaji: Sono roji, yoru demo anzen na no ka na.
npcLine.translation: Gang itu, malam hari juga aman kali ya.
npcLine.translationEn: That alley is probably safe at night too.

options.japanese: 昼間は問題ないけど、夜はちょっと不安かもしれない。
options.romaji: Hiruma wa mondai nai kedo, yoru wa chotto fuan kamoshirenai.
options.translation: Siang hari tidak masalah, tapi malam mungkin agak mencemaskan.
options.translationEn: During the day it's fine, but at night it might be a bit worrying.

options.japanese: 夜のほうがずっと安全だよ。
options.romaji: Yoru no hou ga zutto anzen da yo.

npcLine.japanese: じゃあ、昼間に使うことにするよ。
npcLine.romaji: Jaa, hiruma ni tsukau koto ni suru yo.
npcLine.translation: Kalau begitu, aku putuskan pakai waktu siang saja.
npcLine.translationEn: In that case, I'll decide to use the daytime.

options.japanese: それがいいと思う、念のためね。
options.romaji: Sore ga ii to omou, nen no tame ne.
options.translation: Kurasa itu bagus, buat jaga-jaga ya.
options.translationEn: I think that's good, just in case.

options.romaji: Yoru dake tsukau to ii yo.
options.translationEn: It's best used only at night.

npcLine.japanese: 他にも近道知ってる？
npcLine.romaji: Hoka ni mo chikamichi shitteru?
npcLine.translationEn: Do you know another shortcut too?

options.japanese: 公園を突っ切るルートもあるけど、遠回りになる時もあるよ。
options.romaji: Kouen wo tsukkiru ruuto mo aru kedo, toomawari ni naru toki mo aru yo.
options.translation: Ada juga rute lewat memotong taman, tapi kadang jadi memutar.
options.translationEn: There's also a route cutting through the park, but it sometimes ends up being a detour.

options.japanese: 他には一つも知らないよ。
options.romaji: Hoka ni wa hitotsu mo shiranai yo.
options.translation: Tidak tahu satu pun yang lain.
options.translationEn: Don't know any of the others.

npcLine.japanese: 教えてくれてありがとう。
npcLine.romaji: Oshiete kurete arigatou.
npcLine.translationEn: Thanks for letting me know.

options.japanese: どういたしまして、気をつけて行ってね。
options.romaji: Dou itashimashite, ki wo tsukete itte ne.
options.translationEn: You're welcome, be careful on the way.

titleEn: Asking About a Shortcut to a Destination
descriptionEn: You and a friend talk about a shortcut to the station.

title: Menjelaskan Cara Sampai Menggunakan Landmark
description: Kamu menjelaskan cara ke suatu alamat dengan memakai landmark sebagai patokan.

npcLine.japanese: すみません、この住所、どう行けばいいか分からなくて。
npcLine.romaji: Sumimasen, kono juusho, dou ikeba ii ka wakaranakute.
npcLine.translation: Maaf, saya tidak tahu cara ke alamat ini.
npcLine.translationEn: Sorry, I don't know how to get to this address.

options.japanese: あの赤い看板の店を目印にすると、分かりやすいですよ。
options.romaji: Ano akai kanban no mise wo mejirushi ni suru to, wakariyasui desu yo.
options.translation: Kalau pakai toko bertanda merah itu sebagai patokan, jadi mudah dipahami lho.
options.translationEn: If you use that shop with the red sign as a landmark, it becomes easy to understand.

options.japanese: 目印になるものは何もありません。
options.romaji: Mejirushi ni naru mono wa nanimo arimasen.
options.translation: Tidak ada apa pun yang bisa jadi patokan.
options.translationEn: There's nothing that can serve as a landmark.

npcLine.japanese: 赤い看板の店、ですか。そこから先はどう行けば？
npcLine.romaji: Akai kanban no mise, desu ka. Soko kara saki wa dou ikeba?
npcLine.translation: Toko bertanda merah, ya. Dari situ bagaimana lagi?
npcLine.translationEn: The store with the red sign, right. What's the way from there?

options.japanese: その店の角を曲がれば、目的地はすぐです。
options.romaji: Sono mise no kado wo magareba, mokutekichi wa sugu desu.
options.translation: Kalau belok di sudut toko itu, tempat tujuannya langsung dekat.
options.translationEn: If you turn at the corner of that shop, your destination is right nearby.

options.japanese: その店からは全く見えません。
options.romaji: Sono mise kara wa mattaku miemasen.
options.translation: Dari toko itu sama sekali tidak terlihat.
options.translationEn: It's not visible from that shop at all.

npcLine.japanese: なるほど、分かりやすい説明ですね。
npcLine.romaji: Naruhodo, wakariyasui setsumei desu ne.
npcLine.translation: Begitu ya, penjelasan yang mudah dipahami ya.
npcLine.translationEn: I see, that's an easy-to-understand explanation.

options.japanese: 目印があると、迷いにくくなりますからね。
options.romaji: Mejirushi ga aru to, mayoinikuku narimasu kara ne.
options.translation: Karena kalau ada patokan, jadi tidak mudah tersesat.
options.translationEn: Because with a landmark, it's not easy to get lost.

options.japanese: 目印があっても、結局迷うと思いますよ。
options.romaji: Mejirushi ga attemo, kekkyoku mayou to omoimasu yo.
options.translation: Meski ada patokan, kupikir akhirnya tetap tersesat.
options.translationEn: Even with a landmark, I think you'd still end up lost.

npcLine.japanese: 他にも分かりやすい目印ってありますか。
npcLine.romaji: Hoka ni mo wakariyasui mejirushi tte arimasu ka.
npcLine.translation: Ada patokan lain yang mudah dipahami?
npcLine.translationEn: Is there another easy-to-understand benchmark?

options.japanese: 大きい時計台も、いい目印になると思います。
options.romaji: Ookii tokeidai mo, ii mejirushi ni naru to omoimasu.
options.translation: Menara jam besar juga menurut saya bisa jadi patokan yang bagus.
options.translationEn: I think the big clock tower can also be a good landmark.

options.japanese: 目印は一つで十分です。
options.romaji: Mejirushi wa hitotsu de juubun desu.

npcLine.japanese: おかげで迷わずに行けそうです、ありがとうございます。
npcLine.romaji: Okage de mayowazu ni ikesou desu, arigatou gozaimasu.
npcLine.translation: Berkat itu sepertinya bisa pergi tanpa tersesat, terima kasih.
npcLine.translationEn: Thanks to that, it seems I could go without getting lost, thank you.

options.japanese: どういたしまして、気をつけて行ってください。
options.romaji: Dou itashimashite, ki wo tsukete itte kudasai.
options.translationEn: You're welcome, be careful on the way.
If you get lost, that's not my problem.

titleEn: Explaining How to Get There Using a Landmark
descriptionEn: You explain how to get to an address using a landmark as a reference.

title: Membantu Turis Asing yang Tersesat
description: Kamu membantu turis asing yang tersesat mencari tempat tujuannya.

npcLine.japanese: すみません、ちょっと道に迷ってしまったんですが。
npcLine.romaji: Sumimasen, chotto michi ni mayotte shimatta n desu ga.
npcLine.translationEn: Sorry, I'm a bit lost.

options.japanese: 大丈夫ですか、どちらに行きたいんですか。
options.romaji: Daijoubu desu ka, dochira ni ikitai n desu ka.
options.translationEn: Are you okay? Where are you headed?

npcLine.japanese: この地図に書いてある場所に行きたいんですが、うまく読めなくて。
npcLine.romaji: Kono chizu ni kaite aru basho ni ikitai n desu ga, umaku yomenakute.
npcLine.translation: Saya mau ke tempat yang tertulis di peta ini, tapi tidak bisa membacanya dengan baik.
npcLine.translationEn: I want to go to the place written on this map, but I can't read it well.

options.japanese: 見せていただけますか、一緒に確認しましょう。
options.romaji: Misete itadakemasu ka, issho ni kakunin shimashou.
options.translation: Bisa ditunjukkan? Ayo kita periksa bersama.
options.translationEn: Could you show me? Let's check it together.

options.japanese: 地図なんて見なくていいですよ。
options.romaji: Chizu nante minakute ii desu yo.
options.translationEn: No need to look at that kind of map.

npcLine.japanese: ありがとうございます、助かります。
npcLine.romaji: Arigatou gozaimasu, tasukarimasu.
npcLine.translationEn: Thank you, that's really helpful.

options.japanese: ここから歩いて十分ほどのところにありますよ。
options.romaji: Koko kara aruite juppun hodo no tokoro ni arimasu yo.
options.translation: Dari sini jalan kaki sekitar sepuluh menit ada di sana lho.
options.translationEn: From here it's about a ten-minute walk, it's right there.

options.japanese: ここからはかなり遠いです。
options.romaji: Koko kara wa kanari tooi desu.

npcLine.japanese: 道順を教えていただけますか。
npcLine.romaji: Michijun wo oshiete itadakemasu ka.
npcLine.translationEn: Could you tell me the travel route?

options.japanese: もちろんです、一緒に途中まで歩きましょうか。
options.romaji: Mochiron desu, issho ni tochuu made arukimashou ka.
options.translation: Tentu, mau kita jalan bersama sampai sebagian jalan?
options.translationEn: Sure, shall we walk together part of the way?

options.japanese: 自分で調べてください。

npcLine.japanese: 本当にありがとうございます、助かりました。
npcLine.romaji: Hontou ni arigatou gozaimasu, tasukarimashita.
npcLine.translationEn: Thank you so much, that's really helpful.

options.japanese: どういたしまして、良い旅を。
options.translationEn: You're welcome, have a nice walk.

options.japanese: もう聞かないでください。

titleEn: Helping a Lost Foreign Tourist
descriptionEn: You help a lost foreign tourist find their destination.

title: Menjelaskan Perbedaan Rute Cepat dan Rute Aman
description: Kamu dan teman mendiskusikan rute cepat versus rute aman menuju stasiun.

npcLine.japanese: 駅まで行くのに、どっちのルートがいいと思う？
npcLine.romaji: Eki made iku no ni, docchi no ruuto ga ii to omou?
npcLine.translation: Untuk ke stasiun, menurutmu rute mana yang bagus?
npcLine.translationEn: To get to the station, which route do you think is good?

options.japanese: 大通りを通るルートのほうが、多少遠回りだけど安全だと思うよ。
options.romaji: Oodoori wo tooru ruuto no hou ga, tashou toomawari dakedo anzen da to omou yo.
options.translation: Kurasa rute lewat jalan besar sedikit memutar tapi lebih aman.
options.translationEn: I think the route via the main road is a bit of a detour but safer.

options.japanese: どちらも全く同じだと思うよ。
options.romaji: Dochira mo mattaku onaji da to omou yo.
options.translationEn: I think both are exactly the same.

npcLine.japanese: 裏道を使えば、もっと早く着けるんじゃない？
npcLine.romaji: Uramichi wo tsukaeba, motto hayaku tsukeru n janai?
npcLine.translation: Kalau pakai jalan belakang, bukankah bisa lebih cepat sampai?
npcLine.translationEn: If you use the back road, wouldn't you arrive faster?

options.japanese: 早く着けるのは確かだけど、暗いから少し心配なんだ。
options.romaji: Hayaku tsukeru no wa tashika dakedo, kurai kara sukoshi shinpai nan da.
options.translation: Memang benar bisa lebih cepat sampai, tapi karena gelap jadi agak mencemaskan.
options.translationEn: It's true you can arrive faster, but since it's dark it's a bit worrying.

options.japanese: 裏道のほうが明るくて安全だよ。
options.romaji: Uramichi no hou ga akarukute anzen da yo.
options.translation: Jalan belakang justru lebih terang dan aman.
options.translationEn: The back street is actually brighter and safer.

npcLine.japanese: それなら、大通りにしたほうが安心だね。
npcLine.romaji: Sore nara, oodoori ni shita hou ga anshin da ne.
npcLine.translation: Kalau begitu, mungkin lebih tenang pilih jalan besar ya.
npcLine.translationEn: In that case, choosing the main road might be more relaxing.

options.japanese: うん、時間より安全を優先したいな。
options.romaji: Un, jikan yori anzen wo yuusen shitai na.
options.translation: Iya, aku ingin mengutamakan keamanan daripada waktu.
options.translationEn: Yeah, I want to prioritize safety over time.

options.japanese: 安全より時間を優先したいな。
options.romaji: Anzen yori jikan wo yuusen shitai na.
options.translation: Aku ingin mengutamakan waktu daripada keamanan.
options.translationEn: I want to prioritize time over safety.

npcLine.japanese: 一緒に大通りを通って行こうか。
npcLine.romaji: Issho ni oodoori wo tootte ikou ka.
npcLine.translation: Ayo kita lewat jalan besar bersama ya.
npcLine.translationEn: Let's take the main road together.

options.romaji: Uramichi no hou ga ii yo.

npcLine.japanese: 安全第一だね。
npcLine.romaji: Anzen daiichi da ne.
npcLine.translationEn: Safety comes first.

options.japanese: どうでもいいと思うよ。
options.romaji: Dou demo ii to omou yo.
options.translationEn: I think it's up to you.

titleEn: Explaining the Difference Between a Fast Route and a Safe Route
descriptionEn: You and a friend discuss the fast route versus the safe route to the station.

title: Menanyakan Akses Menuju Tempat Terpencil
description: Kamu menanyakan akses menuju kuil di pegunungan yang terpencil.

npcLine.japanese: すみません、あの山奥にある神社まで、車で行けますか。
npcLine.romaji: Sumimasen, ano yamaoku ni aru jinja made, kuruma de ikemasu ka.
npcLine.translation: Maaf, kuil di pegunungan itu, bisa pergi naik mobil?
npcLine.translationEn: Sorry, that mountain temple, can you get there by car?

options.japanese: 途中までは車で行けますが、その先は歩くしかないんです。
options.romaji: Tochuu made wa kuruma de ikemasu ga, sono saki wa aruku shika nai n desu.
options.translation: Sampai setengah jalan bisa naik mobil, tapi setelahnya harus jalan kaki.
options.translationEn: You can go by car halfway, but after that you have to walk.

npcLine.japanese: 歩く距離はどのくらいですか。
npcLine.romaji: Aruku kyori wa dono kurai desu ka.
npcLine.translationEn: How far is the walk?

options.japanese: 一時間ほど歩く覚悟が必要かもしれません。
options.romaji: Ichijikan hodo aruku kakugo ga hitsuyou kamoshiremasen.
options.translation: Mungkin perlu siap-siap jalan sekitar satu jam.
options.translationEn: You'll probably need to prepare to walk about an hour.

options.japanese: 五分も歩けば着きます。
options.translation: Cukup jalan lima menit sudah sampai.
options.translationEn: Just a five-minute walk and you're there.

npcLine.japanese: それは大変そうですね。装備は何か必要ですか。
npcLine.romaji: Sore wa taihen sou desu ne. Souhi wa nanika hitsuyou desu ka.
npcLine.translation: Itu kelihatannya berat ya. Ada perlengkapan yang diperlukan?
npcLine.translationEn: That looks tough. Is there any equipment needed?

options.japanese: 歩きやすい靴だけは、必ず用意したほうがいいですよ。
options.romaji: Arukiyasui kutsu dake wa, kanarazu youi shita hou ga ii desu yo.
options.translation: Setidaknya sepatu yang nyaman untuk jalan, sebaiknya pasti disiapkan.
options.translationEn: At the very least, comfortable walking shoes should definitely be prepared.

options.japanese: 特に何も要らないと思います。
options.romaji: Toku ni nanimo iranai to omoimasu.
options.translationEn: I don't think anything in particular is needed.

npcLine.japanese: 途中に休憩できる場所はありますか。
npcLine.romaji: Tochuu ni kyuukei dekiru basho wa arimasu ka.
npcLine.translation: Di tengah jalan ada tempat istirahat?
npcLine.translationEn: Is there a rest stop along the way?

options.japanese: はい、中腹に休憩所が設けられています。
options.romaji: Hai, chuufuku ni kyuukeisho ga mouke rarete imasu.
options.translation: Iya, di lereng tengah ada tempat istirahat yang disediakan.
options.translationEn: Yeah, there's a rest area provided halfway up the slope.

options.japanese: 休憩できる場所は一切ありません。
options.romaji: Kyuukei dekiru basho wa issai arimasen.
options.translation: Tidak ada tempat istirahat sama sekali.
options.translationEn: There's no rest area at all.

npcLine.japanese: 詳しく教えていただき、助かります。
npcLine.romaji: Kuwashiku oshiete itadaki, tasukarimasu.
npcLine.translation: Terima kasih sudah menjelaskan detail, sangat membantu.
npcLine.translationEn: Thanks for explaining in detail, that's really helpful.

options.japanese: いえいえ、気をつけて行ってきてください。
options.romaji: Ieie, ki wo tsukete itte kite kudasai.
options.translationEn: It's fine, be careful on your way.

titleEn: Asking About Access to a Remote Location
descriptionEn: You ask about access to a remote mountain temple.

title: Menjelaskan Kenapa Rute Biasa Ditutup
description: Kamu menjelaskan ke teman kenapa jalan yang biasa dilewati sedang ditutup.

npcLine.japanese: いつもの道、なんか工事してるみたいだけど。
npcLine.romaji: Itsumo no michi, nanka kouji shiteru mitai da kedo.
npcLine.translation: Jalan yang biasa, sepertinya sedang ada konstruksi ya.
npcLine.translationEn: The usual road seems to have construction going on.

options.japanese: うん、水道工事の影響で、しばらく通行止めになっているんだ。
options.romaji: Un, suidou kouji no eikyou de, shibaraku tsuukoudome ni natte iru n da.
options.translation: Iya, karena pengaruh perbaikan saluran air, sementara jadi ditutup untuk lalu lintas.
options.translationEn: Yeah, because of the water pipe repairs, it's temporarily closed to traffic.

options.japanese: 工事なんてしていないよ。
options.translation: Tidak sedang ada konstruksi apa pun.
options.translationEn: There's no construction going on at all.

npcLine.japanese: いつまで続くか分かる？
npcLine.romaji: Itsu made tsuzuku ka wakaru?
npcLine.translationEn: Do you know how long it lasts?

options.japanese: 来月の半ばまでかかると聞いたよ。
options.romaji: Raigetsu no nakaba made kakaru to kiita yo.
options.translation: Kudengar akan sampai pertengahan bulan depan.
options.translationEn: I heard it'll arrive by the middle of next month.

options.japanese: 今日で終わると思うよ。
options.romaji: Kyou de owaru to omou yo.
options.translationEn: I think it'll be finished today.

npcLine.japanese: それまでは迂回するしかないね。
npcLine.romaji: Sore made wa ukai suru shika nai ne.
npcLine.translation: Sampai saat itu terpaksa memutar ya.
npcLine.translationEn: Had to take a detour until then.

options.japanese: そうだね、少し遠回りになるけど仕方ないよ。
options.romaji: Sou da ne, sukoshi toomawari ni naru kedo shikatanai yo.
options.translation: Betul, jadi agak memutar tapi tidak bisa dihindari.
options.translationEn: Right, it's a bit of a detour but it can't be avoided.

options.japanese: 迂回する必要はないよ。
options.romaji: Ukai suru hitsuyou wa nai yo.
options.translationEn: No need to take a detour.

npcLine.japanese: 代わりのルートは分かってる？
npcLine.romaji: Kawari no ruuto wa wakatteru?
npcLine.translationEn: Do you know the alternate route?

options.japanese: うん、大通りを使えば問題ないと思うよ。
options.romaji: Un, oodoori wo tsukaeba mondai nai to omou yo.
options.translation: Iya, kalau pakai jalan besar kurasa tidak masalah.
options.translationEn: Yeah, if you use the main road I think it's fine.

options.japanese: 代わりのルートは全く分からないよ。
options.romaji: Kawari no ruuto wa mattaku wakaranai yo.
options.translation: Sama sekali tidak tahu rute penggantinya.
options.translationEn: Don't know the alternative route at all.

npcLine.japanese: 教えてくれてありがとう。
npcLine.romaji: Oshiete kurete arigatou.
npcLine.translationEn: Thanks for letting me know.

titleEn: Explaining Why the Usual Route Is Closed
descriptionEn: You explain to a friend why the road you usually take is closed.

title: Mendiskusikan Cara Membaca Peta yang Membingungkan
description: Kamu dan teman kesulitan membaca peta yang membingungkan.

npcLine.japanese: この地図、正直言って読みにくくない？
npcLine.romaji: Kono chizu, shoujiki itte yominikukunai?
npcLine.translation: Peta ini, jujur saja susah dibaca kan?
npcLine.translationEn: Honestly, this map is hard to read, isn't it?

options.japanese: うん、縮尺がおかしいのか、距離感がつかみにくいんだ。
options.romaji: Un, shukushaku ga okashii no ka, kyorikan ga tsukaminikui n da.
options.translation: Iya, entah skalanya aneh, jadi susah menangkap perasaan jaraknya.
options.translationEn: Yeah, the scale felt off somehow, so it was hard to get a sense of distance.

options.japanese: すごく読みやすいと思うよ。
options.translationEn: I think it's really easy to read.

npcLine.japanese: どこが一番分かりにくい？
npcLine.romaji: Doko ga ichiban wakarinikui?
npcLine.translation: Bagian mana yang paling susah dipahami?
npcLine.translationEn: Which part is hardest to understand?

options.japanese: 道の名前が省略されているところが分かりにくいんだ。
options.romaji: Michi no namae ga shouryaku sarete iru tokoro ga wakarinikui n da.
options.translation: Bagian yang nama jalannya dihilangkan itu yang susah dipahami.
options.translationEn: The part where the street name is left out is what's hard to understand.

options.japanese: 全部完璧に分かりやすいよ。
options.translationEn: Everything is perfectly easy to understand.

npcLine.japanese: アプリの地図のほうがいいかもね。
npcLine.romaji: Apuri no chizu no hou ga ii kamo ne.
npcLine.translation: Mungkin peta di aplikasi lebih bagus ya.
npcLine.translationEn: The map in the app might be better.

options.japanese: そうだね、切り替えたほうが良さそうだ。
options.romaji: Sou da ne, kirikaeta hou ga yosasou da.
options.translation: Betul juga, sepertinya lebih baik beralih.
options.translationEn: True, it seems better to switch.

options.japanese: 紙の地図のほうが絶対いいよ。
options.romaji: Kami no chizu no hou ga zettai ii yo.
options.translation: Peta kertas pasti jauh lebih bagus.
options.translationEn: A paper map is definitely much better.

npcLine.japanese: 現在地さえ分かれば、何とかなりそうだけどね。
npcLine.romaji: Genzaichi sae wakareba, nantoka narisou dakedo ne.
npcLine.translation: Kalau lokasi sekarang saja diketahui, sepertinya akan ada jalan keluar.
npcLine.translationEn: If just the current location is known, there should be a way forward.

options.japanese: それもそうだね、まず現在地を確認しよう。
options.romaji: Sore mo sou da ne, mazu genzaichi wo kakunin shiyou.
options.translation: Betul juga, ayo cek dulu lokasi sekarang.
options.translationEn: True, let's check our current location first.

options.japanese: 現在地なんてどうでもいいよ。
options.romaji: Genzaichi nante dou demo ii yo.
options.translationEn: The current location is up to you.

npcLine.japanese: 一緒に確認していこう。
npcLine.romaji: Issho ni kakunin shite ikou.
npcLine.translationEn: Let's check it together.

titleEn: Discussing How to Read a Confusing Map
descriptionEn: You and a friend struggle to read a confusing map.

title: Menceritakan Pengalaman Nyasar di Kota Asing
description: Kamu bercerita ke teman tentang pengalaman tersesat waktu jalan-jalan ke luar negeri.

npcLine.japanese: 海外旅行で迷子になったことがあるって言ってたよね。
npcLine.romaji: Kaigai ryokou de maigo ni natta koto ga aru tte itteta yo ne.
npcLine.translation: Katanya pernah tersesat waktu jalan-jalan ke luar negeri ya.
npcLine.translationEn: I heard you once got lost while traveling abroad.

options.japanese: うん、言葉が通じない中で迷って、本当に焦ったよ。
options.romaji: Un, kotoba ga tsuujinai naka de mayotte, hontou ni aseta yo.
options.translation: Iya, tersesat di tengah bahasa yang tidak nyambung, benar-benar panik.
options.translationEn: Yeah, getting lost amid a language barrier, I really panicked.

options.japanese: 一度も迷ったことないよ。
options.romaji: Ichido mo mayotta koto nai yo.

npcLine.japanese: どうやって切り抜けたの？
npcLine.romaji: Dou yatte kirinuketa no?
npcLine.translationEn: How did you get through it?

options.japanese: 身振り手振りで、なんとか道を聞くことができたんだ。
options.romaji: Miburi teburi de, nantoka michi wo kiku koto ga dekita n da.
options.translation: Dengan gerak tubuh, entah bagaimana bisa bertanya jalan.
options.translationEn: Somehow, with body gestures, I managed to ask for directions.

options.japanese: 誰にも聞かずに、自力で戻れたよ。
options.romaji: Dare ni mo kikazu ni, jiriki de modoreta yo.
options.translation: Bisa kembali sendiri tanpa tanya siapa pun.
options.translationEn: Could get back on my own without asking anyone.

npcLine.japanese: 怖かったでしょう。
npcLine.romaji: Kowakatta deshou.
npcLine.translationEn: That must be scary.

options.japanese: うん、涙が出そうになるくらい怖かったよ。
options.romaji: Un, namida ga desou ni naru kurai kowakatta yo.
options.translationEn: Yeah, I was so scared I almost cried.

npcLine.japanese: その経験から何か学んだ？
npcLine.romaji: Sono keiken kara nanika mananda?
npcLine.translation: Ada yang dipelajari dari pengalaman itu?
npcLine.translationEn: Did you learn anything from that experience?

options.japanese: 事前の準備がどれだけ大切か、身にしみて分かったよ。
options.romaji: Jizen no junbi ga dore dake taisetsu ka, mi ni shimite wakatta yo.
options.translation: Aku sungguh-sungguh paham betapa pentingnya persiapan sebelumnya.
options.translationEn: I truly understand how important preparing beforehand is.

options.japanese: 特に何も学ばなかったよ。

npcLine.japanese: 今度からは気をつけようね。
npcLine.romaji: Kondo kara wa ki wo tsukeyou ne.
npcLine.translation: Mulai lain kali harus hati-hati ya.
npcLine.translationEn: Need to be careful from next time on.

options.japanese: うん、絶対に気をつける。
options.romaji: Un, zettai ni ki wo tsukeru.

options.japanese: 別に気をつけなくてもいいよ。
options.romaji: Betsu ni ki wo tsukenakutemo ii yo.
options.translation: Tidak usah hati-hati juga tidak apa-apa.
options.translationEn: It's fine even without being careful.

titleEn: Talking About Getting Lost in an Unfamiliar City
descriptionEn: You tell a friend about getting lost while traveling abroad.

title: Menjelaskan Rute Alternatif Saat Macet
description: Kamu menjelaskan rute alternatif ke teman untuk menghindari jalan macet.

npcLine.japanese: この道、いつも渋滞してるよね。
npcLine.romaji: Kono michi, itsumo juutai shiteru yo ne.
npcLine.translationEn: This road is always jammed.

options.japanese: うん、時間帯によっては、全く動かなくなることもあるよ。
options.romaji: Un, jikantai ni yotte wa, mattaku ugokanaku naru koto mo aru yo.
options.translation: Iya, tergantung waktunya, kadang jadi sama sekali tidak bergerak.
options.translationEn: Yeah, depending on the time, it sometimes doesn't move at all.

options.japanese: いつもスムーズに流れているよ。
options.romaji: Itsumo sumuuzu ni nagarete iru yo.

npcLine.japanese: 何か避ける方法はないの？
npcLine.romaji: Nanika sakeru houhou wa nai no?
npcLine.translationEn: Is there a way to avoid it?

options.japanese: 川沿いの道を使えば、渋滞を避けられるはずだよ。
options.romaji: Kawazoi no michi wo tsukaeba, juutai wo sakerareru hazu da yo.
options.translation: Kalau pakai jalan tepi sungai, seharusnya bisa menghindari macet.
options.translationEn: If you take the road along the river, you should be able to avoid traffic.

options.japanese: 避ける方法は一切ないよ。
options.romaji: Sakeru houhou wa issai nai yo.
options.translation: Tidak ada cara menghindari sama sekali.
options.translationEn: There's no way to avoid it at all.

npcLine.japanese: そっちのほうが時間かかるんじゃない？
npcLine.romaji: Socchi no hou ga jikan kakaru n janai?
npcLine.translation: Bukankah jalan itu lebih makan waktu?
npcLine.translationEn: Doesn't that road take more time?

options.japanese: 距離は長くなるけど、結果的には早く着くことが多いよ。
options.romaji: Kyori wa nagaku naru kedo, kekkateki ni wa hayaku tsuku koto ga ooi yo.
options.translation: Jaraknya jadi lebih jauh, tapi hasilnya sering justru lebih cepat sampai.
options.translationEn: The distance becomes farther, but the result is often actually arriving faster.

options.japanese: 距離も時間も両方短くなるよ。
options.romaji: Kyori mo jikan mo ryouhou mijikaku naru yo.
options.translation: Jarak dan waktu keduanya jadi lebih pendek.
options.translationEn: Both the distance and the time became shorter.

npcLine.japanese: 今度試してみようかな。
npcLine.romaji: Kondo tameshite miyou ka na.
npcLine.translationEn: Maybe I'll try it next time.

options.japanese: うん、一度試す価値はあると思うよ。
options.romaji: Un, ichido tamesu kachi wa aru to omou yo.
options.translationEn: Yeah, I think it's worth trying once.

options.japanese: 試す価値なんてないと思うよ。
options.romaji: Tamesu kachi nante nai to omou yo.
options.translationEn: I don't think it's worth trying.

npcLine.japanese: 教えてくれてありがとう。
npcLine.romaji: Oshiete kurete arigatou.
npcLine.translationEn: Thanks for letting me know.

titleEn: Explaining an Alternate Route During Traffic
descriptionEn: You explain an alternate route to a friend to avoid traffic.

title: Menanyakan Cara Menuju Tempat yang Sulit Dijelaskan
description: Kamu bertanya cara menuju toko yang tidak ada di peta ke penduduk lokal.

npcLine.japanese: すみません、この店、地図に載っていなくて、行き方が分からないんです。
npcLine.romaji: Sumimasen, kono mise, chizu ni notte inakute, ikikata ga wakaranai n desu.
npcLine.translation: Maaf, toko ini tidak ada di peta, saya tidak tahu cara ke sana.
npcLine.translationEn: Sorry, this store isn't on the map, I don't know how to get there.

options.japanese: ああ、あの店ですね、口で説明するのが難しい場所なんです。
options.romaji: Aa, ano mise desu ne, kuchi de setsumei suru no ga muzukashii basho nan desu.
options.translation: Ah, toko itu ya, tempat yang susah dijelaskan dengan kata-kata.
options.translationEn: Ah, that shop, it's a place that's hard to explain in words.

options.japanese: その店は存在しないと思います。
options.romaji: Sono mise wa sonzai shinai to omoimasu.
options.translationEn: I don't think that shop exists.

npcLine.japanese: では、どうやって行けばいいでしょうか。
npcLine.romaji: Dewa, dou yatte ikeba ii deshou ka.
npcLine.translation: Kalau begitu, bagaimana caranya pergi ke sana?
npcLine.translationEn: In that case, how do I get there?

options.japanese: 実際に近くまで一緒に行ったほうが早いかもしれません。
options.romaji: Jissai ni chikaku made issho ni itta hou ga hayai kamoshiremasen.
options.translation: Mungkin lebih cepat kalau langsung pergi bersama sampai dekat sana.
options.translationEn: It's probably faster if we just go together all the way there.

options.japanese: 説明するだけで十分分かるはずです。
options.romaji: Setsumei suru dake de juubun wakaru hazu desu.
options.translation: Cukup dijelaskan saja seharusnya sudah cukup paham.
options.translationEn: Just explaining it should already be enough to understand.

npcLine.japanese: それは助かります、お願いしてもいいですか。
npcLine.romaji: Sore wa tasukarimasu, onegai shitemo ii desu ka.
npcLine.translation: Itu sangat membantu, boleh saya minta tolong?
npcLine.translationEn: That's really helpful, may I ask for your help?

options.japanese: もちろんです、ちょうど同じ方向なので。
options.romaji: Mochiron desu, choudo onaji houkou na node.
options.translationEn: Sure, it happens to be the same direction.

npcLine.japanese: ありがとうございます、本当に助かります。
npcLine.romaji: Arigatou gozaimasu, hontou ni tasukarimasu.
npcLine.translationEn: Thank you, that's really helpful.

options.japanese: いえいえ、こちらこそいい運動になります。
options.romaji: Ieie, kochira koso ii undou ni narimasu.
options.translation: Tidak apa-apa, malah jadi olahraga yang bagus bagi saya.
options.translationEn: It's fine, it's actually good exercise for me.

options.japanese: 面倒だと思っています。

npcLine.japanese: では、参りましょうか。
npcLine.romaji: Dewa, mairimashou ka.
npcLine.translationEn: In that case, let's go.

options.japanese: はい、よろしくお願いします。
options.translationEn: Okay, please help me with this.

options.japanese: やっぱり一人で探します。
options.translationEn: Better to just look for it myself.

titleEn: Asking How to Get to a Hard-to-Explain Place
descriptionEn: You ask a local how to get to a store that isn't on the map.

title: Membicarakan Perubahan Tata Kota yang Membingungkan
description: Kamu membicarakan perubahan tata kota yang membingungkan dengan teman.

npcLine.japanese: 久しぶりにこの辺来たけど、道がすっかり変わっていて驚いたよ。
npcLine.romaji: Hisashiburi ni kono hen kita kedo, michi ga sukkari kawatte ite odoroita yo.
npcLine.translation: Sudah lama tidak ke sini, kaget jalannya berubah total ya.
npcLine.translationEn: Haven't been here in a while, surprised the road has completely changed.

options.japanese: うん、再開発が進んだ影響で、景色が一変したんだ。
options.romaji: Un, saikaihatsu ga susunda eikyou de, keshiki ga ippen shita n da.
options.translation: Iya, karena pengaruh pembangunan ulang yang berkembang, pemandangannya berubah total.
options.translationEn: Yeah, because of the ongoing redevelopment, the scenery has completely changed.

options.japanese: 何も変わっていないと思うよ。
options.romaji: Nanimo kawatte inai to omou yo.
options.translationEn: I don't think anything has changed.

npcLine.japanese: 前はどんな道だったの？
npcLine.romaji: Mae wa donna michi datta no?
npcLine.translationEn: What was the road like before?

options.japanese: もっと狭くて、商店街が並んでいたんだ。
options.romaji: Motto semakute, shoutengai ga narande ita n da.
options.translation: Dulu lebih sempit, dan berjajar area toko.
options.translationEn: It used to be narrower, and lined with shops.

options.japanese: 今と全く同じだったよ。
options.romaji: Ima to mattaku onaji datta yo.

npcLine.japanese: それはだいぶ変わったね。
npcLine.romaji: Sore wa daibu kawatta ne.
npcLine.translationEn: So it's changed quite a bit.

options.japanese: うん、正直、少し寂しい気もするよ。
options.romaji: Un, shoujiki, sukoshi sabishii ki mo suru yo.
options.translation: Iya, jujur, rasanya juga agak sedih.
options.translationEn: Yeah, honestly, it feels a bit sad too.

npcLine.japanese: 新しい街並みは気に入った？
npcLine.romaji: Atarashii machinami wa ki ni itta?
npcLine.translation: Suka dengan suasana kota yang baru?
npcLine.translationEn: Do you like the new city's atmosphere?

options.japanese: 便利になった一方で、昔の雰囲気が恋しくもあるんだ。
options.romaji: Benri ni natta ippou de, mukashi no fun'iki ga koishiku mo aru n da.
options.translation: Di satu sisi jadi lebih praktis, tapi juga rindu suasana dulu.
options.translationEn: On one hand it's more practical, but I also miss the old atmosphere.

npcLine.japanese: 時代の流れだね。
npcLine.romaji: Jidai no nagare da ne.
npcLine.translationEn: That's the tide of the times.

options.japanese: うん、そう思うしかないね。
options.romaji: Un, sou omou shika nai ne.
options.translationEn: Yeah, that's the only way I can think of it.

options.japanese: そんなの認めたくないよ。
options.translation: Tidak mau mengakui hal seperti itu.
options.translationEn: Don't want to admit something like that.

titleEn: Talking About Confusing Changes to City Layout
descriptionEn: You talk about confusing changes to the city layout with a friend.

title: Menjelaskan Cara Menggunakan Aplikasi Peta dengan Benar
description: Kamu menjelaskan ke teman cara memakai aplikasi peta dengan benar.

npcLine.japanese: 地図アプリ、うまく使いこなせていない気がするんだけど。
npcLine.romaji: Chizu apuri, umaku tsukaikonasete inai ki ga suru n da kedo.
npcLine.translation: Rasanya aku tidak bisa memanfaatkan aplikasi peta dengan baik.
npcLine.translationEn: I feel like I can't make good use of map apps.

options.japanese: 現在地の設定さえ合っていれば、そこまで難しくないはずだよ。
options.romaji: Genzaichi no settei sae atte ireba, soko made muzukashikunai hazu da yo.
options.translation: Kalau pengaturan lokasi saja benar, seharusnya tidak terlalu sulit.
options.translationEn: As long as the location setting is right, it shouldn't be too difficult.

options.japanese: 地図アプリは誰にも使いこなせないよ。
options.romaji: Chizu apuri wa dare ni mo tsukaikonasenai yo.
options.translation: Aplikasi peta tidak bisa dimanfaatkan siapa pun.
options.translationEn: No one can make use of the map app.

npcLine.japanese: オフラインでも使えるようにしておくべきかな。
npcLine.romaji: Ofurain demo tsukaeru you ni shite oku beki ka na.
npcLine.translation: Mungkin sebaiknya disiapkan supaya bisa dipakai offline juga ya.
npcLine.translationEn: Maybe it's better prepared so it can be used offline too.

options.japanese: うん、電波が悪い場所もあるから、しておいたほうがいいよ。
options.romaji: Un, denpa ga warui basho mo aru kara, shite oita hou ga ii yo.
options.translation: Iya, karena ada juga tempat sinyalnya buruk, sebaiknya disiapkan.
options.translationEn: Yeah, since there are also spots with bad signal, it's best to prepare.

options.japanese: オフライン設定は全く必要ないよ。
options.romaji: Ofurain settei wa mattaku hitsuyou nai yo.
options.translation: Pengaturan offline sama sekali tidak perlu.
options.translationEn: Offline settings aren't necessary at all.

npcLine.japanese: 音声案内も使ったほうがいいのかな。
npcLine.romaji: Onsei annai mo tsukatta hou ga ii no ka na.
npcLine.translation: Mungkin sebaiknya juga pakai panduan suara ya.
npcLine.translationEn: Maybe it's also better to use voice guidance.

options.japanese: うん、画面を見ながら歩くと危ないから、使うといいよ。
options.romaji: Un, gamen wo minagara aruku to abunai kara, tsukau to ii yo.
options.translation: Iya, karena berbahaya kalau jalan sambil lihat layar, bagusnya dipakai.
options.translationEn: Yeah, since it's dangerous to walk while looking at the screen, it's good to use it.

options.japanese: 音声案内は邪魔になるだけだよ。
options.romaji: Onsei annai wa jama ni naru dake da yo.
options.translationEn: The voice guidance is just distracting.

npcLine.japanese: ルートが複数出た時は、どう選べばいいの？
npcLine.romaji: Ruuto ga fukusuu deta toki wa, dou erabeba ii no?
npcLine.translation: Waktu muncul beberapa rute, cara memilihnya gimana?
npcLine.translationEn: When several routes come up, how do you choose?

options.japanese: 一番早いものを選べば、基本的に問題ないと思うよ。
options.romaji: Ichiban hayai mono wo erabeba, kihonteki ni mondai nai to omou yo.
options.translation: Kalau pilih yang paling cepat, kurasa pada dasarnya tidak masalah.
options.translationEn: If you choose the fastest one, I think it's basically fine.

options.japanese: どれを選んでも全く同じだよ。
options.romaji: Dore wo erandemo mattaku onaji da yo.
options.translation: Pilih yang mana pun sama saja.
options.translationEn: Whichever you choose, it's the same.

npcLine.japanese: 分かりやすく教えてくれてありがとう。
npcLine.romaji: Wakariyasuku oshiete kurete arigatou.
npcLine.translation: Terima kasih sudah menjelaskan dengan mudah dipahami.
npcLine.translationEn: Thanks for explaining it in an easy-to-understand way.

options.japanese: どういたしまして、役に立てて嬉しいよ。
options.romaji: Dou itashimashite, yaku ni tatete ureshii yo.
options.translationEn: You're welcome, glad I could help.

options.japanese: 別に役に立ってないと思うよ。
options.romaji: Betsu ni yaku ni tattenai to omou yo.
options.translationEn: I don't think it helps at all.

titleEn: Explaining How to Use a Map App Correctly
descriptionEn: You explain to a friend how to use a map app correctly.

title: Mendiskusikan Etika Bertanya Arah ke Orang Asing
description: Kamu dan teman mendiskusikan etika yang benar saat bertanya arah ke orang asing.

npcLine.japanese: 知らない人に道を聞く時、気をつけていることある？
npcLine.romaji: Shiranai hito ni michi wo kiku toki, ki wo tsukete iru koto aru?
npcLine.translation: Waktu tanya jalan ke orang asing, ada yang diperhatikan?
npcLine.translationEn: When asking a stranger for directions, is there anything to be mindful of?

options.japanese: 忙しそうな人には、声をかけないようにしているよ。
options.romaji: Isogashisou na hito ni wa, koe wo kakenai you ni shite iru yo.
options.translation: Aku usahakan tidak menyapa orang yang kelihatan sibuk.
options.translationEn: I try not to approach people who look busy.

options.japanese: 誰にでも遠慮なく話しかけているよ。
options.romaji: Dare ni demo enryo naku hanashikakete iru yo.

npcLine.japanese: 声をかける前に、何か気をつけることは？
npcLine.romaji: Koe wo kakeru mae ni, nanika ki wo tsukeru koto wa?
npcLine.translation: Sebelum menyapa, ada yang harus diperhatikan?
npcLine.translationEn: Is there anything to be aware of before greeting someone?

options.japanese: すみませんと一言添えてから、話しかけるようにしているよ。
options.romaji: Sumimasen to hitokoto soete kara, hanashikakeru you ni shite iru yo.
options.translation: Aku usahakan menyapa setelah menambahkan kata 'permisi' dulu.
options.translationEn: I try to greet them after first saying 'excuse me'.

options.japanese: いきなり質問をぶつけるようにしているよ。
options.romaji: Ikinari shitsumon wo butsukeru you ni shite iru yo.
options.translationEn: Threw the question right at me without any small talk.

npcLine.japanese: 教えてもらったら、ちゃんとお礼を言う？
npcLine.romaji: Oshiete morattara, chanto orei wo iu?
npcLine.translation: Kalau sudah diberi tahu, bilang terima kasih dengan benar?
npcLine.translationEn: Once told, do you properly say thank you?

options.japanese: もちろん、丁寧にお礼を言うようにしているよ。
options.romaji: Mochiron, teinei ni orei wo iu you ni shite iru yo.
options.translation: Tentu, aku usahakan mengucapkan terima kasih dengan sopan.
options.translationEn: Of course, I try to say thank you politely.

options.japanese: お礼を言う必要はないと思っているよ。
options.romaji: Orei wo iu hitsuyou wa nai to omotte iru yo.
options.translation: Kupikir tidak perlu bilang terima kasih.
options.translationEn: I don't think you need to say thank you.

npcLine.japanese: 逆に道を聞かれた時はどうしてる？
npcLine.romaji: Gyaku ni michi wo kikareta toki wa dou shiteru?
npcLine.translationEn: Conversely, how is it when you're asked for directions?

options.japanese: 分かる範囲で、できるだけ丁寧に教えるようにしているよ。
options.romaji: Wakaru han'i de, dekiru dake teinei ni oshieru you ni shite iru yo.
options.translation: Aku usahakan menjelaskan sesopan mungkin sebatas yang aku tahu.
options.translationEn: I try to explain as politely as possible to the extent that I know.

options.japanese: 面倒なので無視するようにしているよ。
options.romaji: Mendou na node mushi suru you ni shite iru yo.
options.translationEn: Since it's a hassle, I just ignored it.

npcLine.japanese: お互い様の気持ちが大事だね。
npcLine.romaji: Otagaisama no kimochi ga daiji da ne.
npcLine.translation: Perasaan saling membantu itu penting ya.
npcLine.translationEn: A spirit of mutual help matters.

options.japanese: 別に大事だとは思わないよ。
options.romaji: Betsu ni daiji da to wa omowanai yo.

titleEn: Discussing the Etiquette of Asking Strangers for Directions
descriptionEn: You and a friend discuss proper etiquette when asking a stranger for directions.

title: Menceritakan Pengalaman Menjadi Penunjuk Jalan bagi Orang Lain
description: Kamu bercerita ke teman tentang pengalaman membimbing turis asing yang tersesat.

npcLine.japanese: 誰かに道を教えてあげたことある？
npcLine.romaji: Dareka ni michi wo oshiete ageta koto aru?
npcLine.translation: Pernah kasih tahu jalan ke seseorang?
npcLine.translationEn: Ever given someone directions?

options.japanese: うん、先週、道に迷っている外国人観光客を案内したよ。
options.romaji: Un, senshuu, michi ni mayotte iru gaikokujin kankoukyaku wo annai shita yo.
options.translation: Iya, minggu lalu, aku bimbing turis asing yang tersesat.
options.translationEn: Yeah, last week, I guided a lost foreign tourist.

options.japanese: 一度も教えてあげたことないよ。
options.romaji: Ichido mo oshiete ageta koto nai yo.
options.translation: Belum pernah kasih tahu sama sekali.

npcLine.japanese: 言葉は通じたの？
npcLine.romaji: Kotoba wa tsuujita no?
npcLine.translationEn: Did the language work out?

options.japanese: あまり通じなかったけど、身振りでなんとか伝えられたよ。
options.romaji: Amari tsuujinakatta kedo, miburi de nantoka tsutaerareta yo.
options.translation: Kurang nyambung, tapi entah bagaimana bisa tersampaikan dengan gerak tubuh.
options.translationEn: It didn't quite connect, but somehow it got across through body gestures.

npcLine.japanese: 最後まで案内してあげたの？
npcLine.romaji: Saigo made annai shite ageta no?
npcLine.translationEn: Guiding it to the end?

options.japanese: うん、目的地まで一緒に歩いていったよ。
options.romaji: Un, mokutekichi made issho ni aruite itta yo.
options.translation: Iya, aku jalan bersama sampai tujuan.
options.translationEn: Yeah, I walked with them all the way to the destination.

options.japanese: 途中で放置してしまったよ。
options.romaji: Tochuu de houchi shite shimatta yo.

npcLine.japanese: 感謝されたでしょう。
npcLine.romaji: Kansha sareta deshou.
npcLine.translationEn: You surely got thanked.

options.japanese: うん、何度もお礼を言われて、こっちが照れちゃったよ。
options.romaji: Un, nandomo orei wo iwarete, kocchi ga terechatta yo.
options.translation: Iya, diucapkan terima kasih berkali-kali, sampai aku jadi malu sendiri.
options.translationEn: Yeah, I was thanked over and over, until I felt embarrassed myself.

options.japanese: 特に何も言われなかったよ。

npcLine.japanese: いい経験だったね。
npcLine.romaji: Ii keiken datta ne.
npcLine.translationEn: That's a good experience.

options.japanese: うん、また誰か困っていたら助けたいな。
options.romaji: Un, mata dareka komatte itara tasuketai na.
options.translation: Iya, kalau ada orang lain yang kesulitan, aku ingin menolong lagi.
options.translationEn: Yeah, if someone else is struggling, I want to help again.

options.japanese: もう二度と手伝わないよ。

titleEn: Talking About Giving Someone Directions
descriptionEn: You tell a friend about the experience of guiding a lost foreign tourist.

title: Mendiskusikan Tekanan Nilai Akademis
description: Kamu dan teman mendiskusikan tekanan soal nilai akademis.

npcLine.japanese: 最近、成績のことで悩んでるみたいだね。
npcLine.romaji: Saikin, seiseki no koto de nayanderu mitai da ne.
npcLine.translation: Belakangan sepertinya kamu galau soal nilai ya.
npcLine.translationEn: You've seemed troubled about your grades lately.

options.japanese: うん、周りと比べてしまって、プレッシャーを感じているんだ。
options.romaji: Un, mawari to kurabete shimatte, puresshaa wo kanjite iru n da.
options.translation: Iya, karena membandingkan dengan orang sekitar, aku merasa tertekan.
options.translationEn: Yeah, comparing myself to those around me, I feel pressured.

npcLine.japanese: 誰かと比べる必要はないと思うよ。
npcLine.romaji: Dareka to kuraberu hitsuyou wa nai to omou yo.
npcLine.translation: Kupikir tidak perlu membandingkan dengan siapa pun.
npcLine.translationEn: I don't think there's a need to compare with anyone.

options.japanese: 頭では分かっているんだけど、つい比べてしまうんだ。
options.romaji: Atama dewa wakatte iru n da kedo, tsui kurabete shimau n da.
options.translation: Secara pikiran aku paham, tapi keceplosan tetap membandingkan.
options.translationEn: In my mind I understand, but I still slip up and compare anyway.

options.japanese: 全く分かっていないよ。

npcLine.japanese: 完璧を求めすぎているんじゃない？
npcLine.romaji: Kanpeki wo motomesugite iru n janai?
npcLine.translationEn: Aren't you demanding too much perfection?

options.japanese: そうかもしれない、少し力を抜いたほうがいいのかも。
options.romaji: Sou kamoshirenai, sukoshi chikara wo nuita hou ga ii no kamo.
options.translation: Mungkin begitu, mungkin lebih baik agak melonggarkan diri.
options.translationEn: Maybe so, maybe it's better to ease up a bit.

options.japanese: 完璧を求めるのは当然だと思うよ。
options.romaji: Kanpeki wo motomeru no wa touzen da to omou yo.
options.translationEn: I think it's natural to demand perfection.

npcLine.japanese: 息抜きも大切だと思うよ。
npcLine.romaji: Ikinuki mo taisetsu da to omou yo.
npcLine.translationEn: I think refreshing your mind matters too.

options.japanese: うん、たまには自分を休ませてあげようと思う。
options.romaji: Un, tamani wa jibun wo yasumasete ageyou to omou.
options.translation: Iya, aku berpikir sesekali mau memberi diri sendiri istirahat.
options.translationEn: Yeah, I'm thinking of occasionally giving myself a break.

options.japanese: 休む時間なんて要らないと思う。
options.romaji: Yasumu jikan nante iranai to omou.
options.translationEn: I don't think rest time is necessary.

npcLine.japanese: 無理しすぎないでね。
npcLine.romaji: Muri shisuginaide ne.
npcLine.translationEn: Don't push yourself too hard.

options.japanese: 無理するのが好きなんだ。
options.romaji: Muri suru no ga suki nan da.

titleEn: Discussing Academic Grade Pressure
descriptionEn: You and a friend discuss the pressure of academic grades.

title: Menjelaskan Alasan Pindah Jurusan
description: Kamu menjelaskan ke teman alasan mau pindah jurusan kuliah.

npcLine.japanese: 学部を変えるって聞いたけど、本当？
npcLine.romaji: Gakubu wo kaeru tte kiita kedo, hontou?
npcLine.translationEn: I heard you're switching faculties, is that right?

options.japanese: うん、自分に向いていないと感じるようになったんだ。
options.romaji: Un, jibun ni muite inai to kanjiru you ni natta n da.
options.translation: Iya, aku jadi merasa tidak cocok dengan diriku.
options.translationEn: Yeah, it made me feel like it doesn't suit me.

options.japanese: そんなことは考えていないよ。
options.romaji: Sonna koto wa kangaete inai yo.
options.translationEn: Not thinking about something like that.

npcLine.japanese: どうしてそう感じるようになったの？
npcLine.romaji: Doushite sou kanjiru you ni natta no?
npcLine.translationEn: Why do you feel that way?

options.japanese: 授業を受けるたびに、興味が持てないことに気づいたんだ。
options.romaji: Jugyou wo ukeru tabi ni, kyoumi ga motenai koto ni kizuita n da.
options.translation: Setiap kali ikut kelas, aku sadar tidak bisa tertarik.
options.translationEn: Every time I take the class, I realize I can't get interested.

options.japanese: 授業はいつも楽しいと感じているよ。
options.romaji: Jugyou wa itsumo tanoshii to kanjite iru yo.

npcLine.japanese: 新しい学部では、何を学びたいの？
npcLine.romaji: Atarashii gakubu dewa, nani wo manabitai no?
npcLine.translation: Di fakultas baru, mau belajar apa?
npcLine.translationEn: What do you want to study at the new faculty?

options.japanese: 心理学に興味があって、そちらに進もうと思っているんだ。
options.romaji: Shinrigaku ni kyoumi ga atte, sochira ni susumou to omotte iru n da.
options.translation: Aku tertarik dengan psikologi, dan berpikir mau maju ke sana.
options.translationEn: I'm interested in psychology, and I'm thinking of pursuing it.

options.japanese: 特に学びたいことはないよ。
options.romaji: Toku ni manabitai koto wa nai yo.
options.translation: Tidak ada yang ingin dipelajari khususnya.
options.translationEn: There's nothing in particular I want to learn.

npcLine.japanese: 親には話したの？
npcLine.romaji: Oya ni wa hanashita no?
npcLine.translationEn: Have you told your parents?

options.japanese: うん、時間をかけて説得したんだ。
options.romaji: Un, jikan wo kakete settoku shita n da.
options.translation: Iya, aku bujuk dengan meluangkan waktu.
options.translationEn: Yeah, I persuaded them by taking the time.

options.japanese: まだ何も話していないよ。

npcLine.japanese: 応援してるよ。
npcLine.romaji: Ouen shiteru yo.
npcLine.translationEn: I support you.

titleEn: Explaining Your Reason for Switching Majors
descriptionEn: You explain to a friend your reason for wanting to switch college majors.

title: Membicarakan Hubungan dengan Dosen Pembimbing
description: Kamu membicarakan hubungan dengan dosen pembimbing skripsi.

npcLine.japanese: 指導教官とは、うまくやれてる？
npcLine.romaji: Shidou kyoukan to wa, umaku yareteru?
npcLine.translationEn: Getting along with your advisor?

options.japanese: うん、研究の相談に乗ってもらえて、感謝しているよ。
options.romaji: Un, kenkyuu no soudan ni notte moraete, kansha shite iru yo.
options.translation: Iya, dibantu konsultasi riset, aku bersyukur.
options.translationEn: Yeah, I'm grateful to have gotten help consulting on the research.

options.japanese: 全く話したことがないよ。
options.romaji: Mattaku hanashita koto ga nai yo.

npcLine.japanese: 厳しい先生なの？
npcLine.romaji: Kibishii sensei na no?
npcLine.translationEn: A strict professor?

options.japanese: 厳しいと言うより、的確なアドバイスをくれる先生なんだ。
options.romaji: Kibishii to iu yori, tekikaku na adobaisu wo kureru sensei nan da.
options.translation: Bukannya ketat, lebih ke dosen yang memberi saran yang tepat.
options.translationEn: It's not strict, more like a professor who gives the right advice.

options.japanese: すごく優しいだけの先生だよ。
options.romaji: Sugoku yasashii dake no sensei da yo.
options.translationEn: A professor who's just kind, nothing more.

npcLine.japanese: 研究テーマは決まったの？
npcLine.romaji: Kenkyuu teema wa kimatta no?
npcLine.translationEn: Has the research topic been decided?

options.japanese: 先生と話し合いながら、少しずつ絞り込んでいるところなんだ。
options.romaji: Sensei to hanashiainagara, sukoshi zutsu shiborikonde iru tokoro nan da.
options.translation: Sedang perlahan menyempitkan sambil berdiskusi dengan dosen.
options.translationEn: Gradually narrowing it down while discussing with the professor.

npcLine.japanese: 卒業までにどんな成果を出したい？
npcLine.romaji: Sotsugyou made ni donna seika wo dashitai?
npcLine.translation: Sampai lulus mau menghasilkan pencapaian seperti apa?
npcLine.translationEn: What kind of achievement do you want to have by graduation?

options.japanese: 学会で発表できるレベルの研究をしたいと思っているよ。
options.romaji: Gakkai de happyou dekiru reberu no kenkyuu wo shitai to omotte iru yo.
options.translation: Aku berpikir mau melakukan riset setingkat bisa dipresentasikan di konferensi.
options.translationEn: I've been thinking of doing research good enough to present at a conference.

options.japanese: 特に何も達成したくないよ。
options.romaji: Toku ni nanimo tassei shitakunai yo.
options.translation: Tidak ingin mencapai apa pun khususnya.
options.translationEn: Not wanting to achieve anything in particular.

npcLine.japanese: 目標があっていいね。
npcLine.romaji: Mokuhyou ga atte ii ne.
npcLine.translationEn: It's good to have a target.

options.japanese: 目標なんてどうでもいいよ。
options.romaji: Mokuhyou nante dou demo ii yo.
options.translationEn: The target is up to you.

titleEn: Talking About Your Relationship With Your Academic Advisor
descriptionEn: You talk about your relationship with your thesis advisor.

title: Menceritakan Pengalaman Presentasi di Depan Kelas
description: Kamu bercerita ke teman tentang pengalaman presentasi di depan kelas kemarin.

npcLine.japanese: 昨日のプレゼン、緊張した？
npcLine.romaji: Kinou no purezen, kinchou shita?
npcLine.translationEn: The presentation yesterday, were you nervous?

options.japanese: うん、始まる前は手が震えるくらい緊張したよ。
options.romaji: Un, hajimaru mae wa te ga furueru kurai kinchou shita yo.
options.translation: Iya, sebelum mulai sampai tangan gemetar saking gugupnya.
options.translationEn: Yeah, before starting, my hands were even shaking from being so nervous.

options.japanese: 全然緊張しなかったよ。

npcLine.japanese: 本番はどうだった？
npcLine.romaji: Honban wa dou datta?
npcLine.translationEn: How was it when you performed?

options.japanese: 話し始めたら、意外と落ち着いてできたよ。
options.romaji: Hanashi hajimetara, igai to ochitsuite dekita yo.
options.translation: Setelah mulai bicara, ternyata bisa dengan tenang di luar dugaan.
options.translationEn: After starting to talk, it turned out I could stay calm, unexpectedly.

options.japanese: 最初から最後まで頭が真っ白だったよ。
options.romaji: Saisho kara saigo made atama ga masshiro datta yo.
options.translation: Dari awal sampai akhir pikiran kosong.
options.translationEn: My mind was blank from start to finish.

npcLine.japanese: 質問とかされた？
npcLine.romaji: Shitsumon toka sareta?
npcLine.translationEn: Does anyone have any questions?

options.japanese: うん、鋭い質問をされて、少し焦ったよ。
options.romaji: Un, surudoi shitsumon wo sarete, sukoshi aseta yo.
options.translation: Iya, ditanya pertanyaan tajam, sampai agak panik.
options.translationEn: Yeah, I was asked a sharp question, I got a bit flustered.

options.japanese: 誰にも何も聞かれなかったよ。
options.romaji: Dare ni mo nanimo kikarenakatta yo.
options.translation: Tidak ditanya apa-apa oleh siapa pun.

npcLine.japanese: どう答えたの？
npcLine.romaji: Dou kotaeta no?
npcLine.translationEn: How do you answer it?

options.japanese: 分かる範囲で、正直に答えるようにしたよ。
options.romaji: Wakaru han'i de, shoujiki ni kotaeru you ni shita yo.
options.translation: Aku usahakan menjawab dengan jujur sebatas yang aku tahu.
options.translationEn: I try to answer honestly to the extent that I know.

options.japanese: 何も答えられなかったよ。

npcLine.japanese: よく頑張ったね。
npcLine.romaji: Yoku ganbatta ne.
npcLine.translation: Kamu sudah berjuang dengan baik ya.
npcLine.translationEn: You've worked really hard.

options.japanese: ありがとう、次はもっと自信を持ってやりたいな。
options.romaji: Arigatou, tsugi wa motto jishin wo motte yaritai na.
options.translation: Terima kasih, lain kali ingin lakukan dengan lebih percaya diri.
options.translationEn: Thank you, next time I want to do it with more confidence.

options.japanese: もう二度とやりたくないよ。
options.translationEn: Never want to do it again.

titleEn: Talking About Giving a Presentation in Front of the Class
descriptionEn: You tell a friend about giving a presentation in front of the class yesterday.

title: Mendiskusikan Sistem Pendidikan yang Berbeda
description: Kamu dan teman mendiskusikan perbedaan sistem pendidikan Jepang dan Indonesia.

npcLine.japanese: 日本とインドネシアの教育制度って、結構違うんでしょう？
npcLine.romaji: Nihon to Indoneshia no kyouiku seido tte, kekkou chigau n deshou?
npcLine.translation: Sistem pendidikan Jepang dan Indonesia, cukup beda ya?
npcLine.translationEn: Japan's and Indonesia's education systems are quite different, huh?

options.japanese: うん、学年の始まる時期からして違うんだ。
options.romaji: Un, gakunen no hajimaru jiki kara shite chigau n da.
options.translation: Iya, dari waktu mulai tahun ajaran saja sudah beda.
options.translationEn: Yeah, even the start of the school year is different.

options.japanese: ほとんど全く同じだよ。

npcLine.japanese: 他にはどんな違いがあるの？
npcLine.romaji: Hoka ni wa donna chigai ga aru no?
npcLine.translationEn: What other differences are there?

options.japanese: 部活動の位置づけも、だいぶ異なる気がするよ。
options.romaji: Bukatsudou no ichizuke mo, daibu kotonaru ki ga suru yo.
options.translation: Rasanya posisi kegiatan klub juga cukup berbeda.
options.translationEn: It feels like the position of club activities is also quite different.

options.japanese: 部活動という概念自体がないよ。
options.romaji: Bukatsudou to iu gainen jitai ga nai yo.
options.translation: Konsep kegiatan klub itu sendiri tidak ada.
options.translationEn: The concept of the club activity itself doesn't exist.

npcLine.japanese: どちらの制度が合っていると思う？
npcLine.romaji: Dochira no seido ga atte iru to omou?
npcLine.translation: Menurutmu sistem mana yang lebih cocok?
npcLine.translationEn: Which system do you think is more suitable?

options.japanese: 一概には言えないけど、それぞれ良さがあると思う。
options.romaji: Ichigai ni wa ienai kedo, sorezore yosa ga aru to omou.
options.translation: Tidak bisa dikatakan secara pasti, tapi kurasa masing-masing ada kelebihannya.
options.translationEn: Can't say for certain, but I think each has its own advantage.

options.japanese: 完全にどちらかが優れていると思う。
options.romaji: Kanzen ni dochira ka ga sugurete iru to omou.
options.translation: Kupikir salah satu jelas jauh lebih unggul.
options.translationEn: I think one is clearly far superior.

npcLine.japanese: 自分に合っていたのはどっち？
npcLine.romaji: Jibun ni atte ita no wa docchi?
npcLine.translation: Yang cocok untuk dirimu yang mana?
npcLine.translationEn: Which one suits you?

options.japanese: 正直、両方に良い面と大変な面があったな。
options.romaji: Shoujiki, ryouhou ni ii men to taihen na men ga atta na.
options.translation: Jujur, keduanya ada sisi bagus dan sisi beratnya.
options.translationEn: Honestly, both have their good sides and tough sides.

options.japanese: どちらにも全く良さがなかったな。
options.romaji: Dochira ni mo mattaku yosa ga nakatta na.
options.translation: Keduanya sama sekali tidak ada kelebihannya.
options.translationEn: Neither has any advantage at all.

npcLine.japanese: 面白い視点だね。
npcLine.romaji: Omoshiroi shiten da ne.
npcLine.translationEn: That's an interesting perspective.

options.japanese: そう言ってもらえると嬉しいよ。
options.romaji: Sou itte moraeru to ureshii yo.

options.japanese: 別に面白くないと思うよ。
options.romaji: Betsu ni omoshirokunai to omou yo.
options.translationEn: I don't think it's interesting at all.

titleEn: Discussing Different Education Systems
descriptionEn: You and a friend discuss the differences between the Japanese and Indonesian education systems.

title: Menjelaskan Kesulitan Mengatur Waktu Kuliah dan Kerja
description: Kamu menjelaskan ke teman kesulitan menyeimbangkan kuliah dan kerja paruh waktu.

npcLine.japanese: バイトと授業の両立、大変そうだね。
npcLine.romaji: Baito to jugyou no ryouritsu, taihen sou da ne.
npcLine.translation: Kelihatannya berat menyeimbangkan kerja paruh waktu dan kuliah ya.
npcLine.translationEn: Balancing a part-time job and college looks tough.

options.japanese: うん、正直、時間に追われている感覚があるよ。
options.romaji: Un, shoujiki, jikan ni owarete iru kankaku ga aru yo.
options.translation: Iya, jujur, aku punya perasaan dikejar-kejar waktu.
options.translationEn: Yeah, honestly, I feel like I'm being chased by time.

npcLine.japanese: どうやって両立させているの？
npcLine.romaji: Dou yatte ryouritsu sasete iru no?
npcLine.translationEn: How do you balance it?

options.japanese: スケジュールを細かく管理することで、なんとか対応しているよ。
options.romaji: Sukejuuru wo komakaku kanri suru koto de, nantoka taiou shite iru yo.
options.translation: Entah bagaimana bisa menangani dengan mengatur jadwal secara rinci.
options.translationEn: Somehow I managed to handle it by arranging a detailed schedule.

options.japanese: 特に何も管理していないよ。
options.romaji: Toku ni nanimo kanri shite inai yo.

npcLine.japanese: 睡眠時間は足りているの？
npcLine.romaji: Suimin jikan wa tarite iru no?
npcLine.translationEn: Is your sleep time enough?

options.japanese: 正直、足りているとは言えないんだ。
options.romaji: Shoujiki, tarite iru to wa ienai n da.
options.translationEn: Honestly, I can't say it's enough.

options.japanese: 十分すぎるくらい足りているよ。
options.romaji: Juubun sugiru kurai tarite iru yo.

npcLine.japanese: 無理しすぎないでね。
npcLine.romaji: Muri shisuginaide ne.
npcLine.translationEn: Don't push yourself too hard.

options.japanese: うん、体を壊さない程度にしようと思っているよ。
options.romaji: Un, karada wo kowasanai teido ni shiyou to omotte iru yo.
options.translation: Iya, aku berpikir mau jaga sebatas tidak sampai jatuh sakit.
options.translationEn: Yeah, I'm thinking of pacing myself so I don't get sick.

options.japanese: 体調を崩しても続けるつもりだよ。
options.romaji: Taichou wo kuzushitemo tsuzukeru tsumori da yo.
options.translationEn: Intending to keep going even if sick.

npcLine.japanese: 何かあったら相談してね。
npcLine.romaji: Nanika attara soudan shite ne.
npcLine.translationEn: If anything comes up, consult me.

titleEn: Explaining the Difficulty of Balancing College and Work
descriptionEn: You explain to a friend the difficulty of balancing college and a part-time job.

title: Membicarakan Rencana Melanjutkan Studi ke Luar Negeri
description: Kamu membicarakan rencana melanjutkan studi ke luar negeri dengan teman.

npcLine.japanese: 留学すること、本気で考えてるんだって？
npcLine.romaji: Ryuugaku suru koto, honki de kangaeteru n datte?
npcLine.translation: Katanya serius mempertimbangkan studi ke luar negeri?
npcLine.translationEn: I heard you're seriously considering studying abroad?

options.japanese: うん、視野を広げたいという思いが強くなってきたんだ。
options.romaji: Un, shiya wo hirogetai to iu omoi ga tsuyoku natte kita n da.
options.translation: Iya, keinginan untuk memperluas wawasan makin kuat.
options.translationEn: Yeah, my desire to broaden my horizons is growing stronger.

npcLine.japanese: どこの国を考えているの？
npcLine.romaji: Doko no kuni wo kangaete iru no?
npcLine.translationEn: Which country are you considering?

options.japanese: まだ絞り切れていないけど、いくつか候補があるよ。
options.romaji: Mada shiborikirete inai kedo, ikutsuka kouho ga aru yo.
options.translation: Belum benar-benar tersempit, tapi ada beberapa kandidat.
options.translationEn: Not really narrowed down yet, but there are a few candidates.

options.japanese: どこにも興味がないよ。
options.romaji: Doko ni mo kyoumi ga nai yo.

npcLine.japanese: 費用の面はどうするの？
npcLine.romaji: Hiyou no men wa dou suru no?
npcLine.translationEn: What about the cost?

options.japanese: 奨学金を得られるように、今から準備しているところなんだ。
options.romaji: Shougakukin wo erareru you ni, ima kara junbi shite iru tokoro nan da.
options.translation: Sedang mempersiapkan dari sekarang supaya bisa dapat beasiswa.
options.translationEn: Preparing from now so I can get a scholarship.

options.japanese: 費用については何も考えていないよ。
options.romaji: Hiyou ni tsuite wa nanimo kangaete inai yo.
options.translation: Soal biaya tidak dipikirkan apa pun.
options.translationEn: Nothing was thought about regarding the cost.

npcLine.japanese: 家族は何て言ってる？
npcLine.romaji: Kazoku wa nante itteru?
npcLine.translationEn: What did your family say?

options.japanese: 最初は心配していたけど、今は応援してくれているよ。
options.romaji: Saisho wa shinpai shite ita kedo, ima wa ouen shite kurete iru yo.
options.translationEn: At first they were worried, but now they support me.

options.japanese: 絶対に反対されているよ。
options.romaji: Zettai ni hantai sarete iru yo.

npcLine.japanese: 実現するといいね。
npcLine.romaji: Jitsugen suru to ii ne.
npcLine.translationEn: Hope it comes true.

options.japanese: うん、頑張って準備するよ。
options.translation: Iya, akan aku usahakan persiapkan dengan giat.
options.translationEn: Yeah, I'll try to prepare diligently.

options.japanese: どうせ無理だと思っているよ。
options.romaji: Douse muri da to omotte iru yo.
options.translationEn: I think it's not possible anyway.

titleEn: Talking About Plans to Study Abroad
descriptionEn: You talk about plans to continue your studies abroad with a friend.

title: Menceritakan Pengalaman Diskriminasi di Sekolah
description: Kamu bercerita ke teman tentang pengalaman diskriminasi di masa sekolah.

npcLine.japanese: 昔、学校で嫌な経験をしたって言ってたよね。
npcLine.romaji: Mukashi, gakkou de iya na keiken wo shita tte itteta yo ne.
npcLine.translation: Katanya dulu pernah punya pengalaman tidak enak di sekolah ya.
npcLine.translationEn: I heard you had an unpleasant experience at school before.

options.japanese: うん、出身のことで、からかわれたことがあったんだ。
options.romaji: Un, shusshin no koto de, karakawareta koto ga atta n da.
options.translation: Iya, pernah diejek soal asal daerahku.
options.translationEn: Yeah, I've been teased about where I'm from before.

options.japanese: 一度もそういう経験はないよ。
options.romaji: Ichido mo sou iu keiken wa nai yo.
options.translation: Tidak pernah punya pengalaman seperti itu sama sekali.
options.translationEn: Never had that kind of experience at all.

npcLine.japanese: どうやって乗り越えたの？
npcLine.romaji: Dou yatte norikoeta no?
npcLine.translationEn: How did you get through it?

options.japanese: 信頼できる友達に相談することで、少しずつ乗り越えられたんだ。
options.romaji: Shinrai dekiru tomodachi ni soudan suru koto de, sukoshi zutsu norikoerareta n da.
options.translation: Bisa melewatinya sedikit demi sedikit dengan konsultasi ke teman yang dipercaya.
options.translationEn: I was able to get through it little by little by talking to a trusted friend.

options.japanese: 誰にも相談せずに我慢し続けたよ。
options.romaji: Dare ni mo soudan sezu ni gaman shitsuzuketa yo.
options.translation: Terus bertahan tanpa konsultasi ke siapa pun.
options.translationEn: Kept holding on without consulting anyone.

npcLine.japanese: 先生には言わなかったの？
npcLine.romaji: Sensei ni wa iwanakatta no?
npcLine.translationEn: Not telling the teacher?

options.japanese: 最初は言えなかったけど、後で勇気を出して相談したんだ。
options.romaji: Saisho wa ienakatta kedo, ato de yuuki wo dashite soudan shita n da.
options.translation: Awalnya tidak bisa bilang, tapi kemudian aku berani konsultasi.
options.translationEn: At first I couldn't say it, but then I mustered the courage to talk about it.

options.japanese: すぐに先生に言いに行ったよ。
options.romaji: Sugu ni sensei ni ii ni itta yo.
options.translationEn: Went straight to tell the teacher.

npcLine.japanese: その経験から何を学んだ？
npcLine.romaji: Sono keiken kara nani wo mananda?
npcLine.translation: Apa yang dipelajari dari pengalaman itu?
npcLine.translationEn: What did you learn from that experience?

options.japanese: 一人で抱え込まないことの大切さを学んだよ。
options.romaji: Hitori de kakaekomanai koto no taisetsusa wo mananda yo.
options.translation: Aku belajar pentingnya tidak memendam sendirian.
options.translationEn: I learned the importance of not bottling things up alone.

npcLine.japanese: 今は元気そうで良かった。
npcLine.romaji: Ima wa genki sou de yokatta.
npcLine.translationEn: Looks fine now, what a relief.

titleEn: Talking About Experiencing Discrimination at School
descriptionEn: You tell a friend about experiencing discrimination during your school years.

title: Mendiskusikan Pentingnya Kegiatan Ekstrakurikuler
description: Kamu dan teman mendiskusikan pentingnya kegiatan klub sekolah.

npcLine.japanese: 部活って、そんなに大事なものかな。
npcLine.romaji: Bukatsu tte, sonna ni daiji na mono ka na.
npcLine.translation: Kegiatan klub itu, sepenting itu kah ya.
npcLine.translationEn: Is club activity really that important, huh.

options.japanese: 勉強だけでは得られない経験ができると思うよ。
options.romaji: Benkyou dake dewa erarenai keiken ga dekiru to omou yo.
options.translation: Kurasa bisa dapat pengalaman yang tidak didapat hanya dari belajar.
options.translationEn: I think you can gain experience that studying alone can't give you.

options.japanese: 勉強以外は全部無駄だと思うよ。
options.romaji: Benkyou igai wa zenbu muda da to omou yo.
options.translationEn: I think everything except studying is pointless.

npcLine.japanese: 具体的にはどんな経験？
npcLine.romaji: Gutaiteki ni wa donna keiken?
npcLine.translationEn: Specifically, what kind of experience?

options.japanese: チームで何かを成し遂げる達成感を味わえるところだと思う。
options.romaji: Chiimu de nanika wo nashitogeru tasseikan wo ajiwaeru tokoro da to omou.
options.translation: Kurasa itu bagian di mana bisa merasakan pencapaian menyelesaikan sesuatu bersama tim.
options.translationEn: I think that's the part where you feel the accomplishment of finishing something as a team.

options.japanese: 特に何も得られないと思う。
options.romaji: Toku ni nanimo erarenai to omou.
options.translationEn: I don't think I got anything in particular.

npcLine.japanese: 時間を取られすぎるのは心配じゃない？
npcLine.romaji: Jikan wo toraresugiru no wa shinpai janai?
npcLine.translation: Tidak khawatir waktunya tersita terlalu banyak?
npcLine.translationEn: Not worried it takes up too much time?

options.japanese: そこはバランスを取ることが大事だと思うよ。
options.romaji: Soko wa baransu wo toru koto ga daiji da to omou yo.
options.translation: Menurutku bagian itu pentingnya menjaga keseimbangan.
options.translationEn: I think that part is about the importance of keeping balance.

options.japanese: 時間なんていくら取られてもいいと思うよ。
options.romaji: Jikan nante ikura toraretemo ii to omou yo.
options.translation: Waktu tersita berapa pun tidak apa-apa.
options.translationEn: It's fine no matter how much time it takes.

npcLine.japanese: 自分は何か部活に入ってたの？
npcLine.romaji: Jibun wa nanika bukatsu ni haitteta no?
npcLine.translation: Kamu sendiri dulu ikut klub apa?
npcLine.translationEn: Which club were you in?

options.japanese: うん、吹奏楽部に入っていて、いい思い出がたくさんあるよ。
options.romaji: Un, suisougakubu ni haitte ite, ii omoide ga takusan aru yo.
options.translation: Iya, ikut klub musik tiup, banyak kenangan bagus.
options.translationEn: Yeah, I joined the brass band club, lots of great memories.

options.japanese: 何の部活にも入っていなかったよ。
options.romaji: Nan no bukatsu ni mo haitte inakatta yo.

npcLine.japanese: それはいい経験だったね。
npcLine.romaji: Sore wa ii keiken datta ne.
npcLine.translationEn: That's a good experience.

options.japanese: うん、今でも役立っていると思う。
options.romaji: Un, ima demo yakudatte iru to omou.
options.translation: Iya, kurasa masih berguna sampai sekarang.
options.translationEn: Yeah, I think it's still useful to this day.

options.japanese: 全く役に立っていないと思う。
options.romaji: Mattaku yaku ni tatte inai to omou.
options.translationEn: I don't think it's useful at all.

titleEn: Discussing the Importance of Extracurricular Activities
descriptionEn: You and a friend discuss the importance of school club activities.

title: Menjelaskan Alasan Mengambil Cuti Kuliah
description: Kamu menjelaskan ke teman alasan mengambil cuti kuliah.

npcLine.japanese: 休学するって聞いたけど、本当？
npcLine.romaji: Kyuugaku suru tte kiita kedo, hontou?
npcLine.translationEn: I heard you're taking a leave from college, is that right?

options.japanese: うん、一度立ち止まって考えたいことがあってね。
options.romaji: Un, ichido tachidomatte kangaetai koto ga atte ne.
options.translation: Iya, ada hal yang ingin aku pikirkan dengan berhenti sejenak.
options.translationEn: Yeah, there's something I want to think about by pausing for a moment.

options.japanese: そんなことは全く考えていないよ。
options.romaji: Sonna koto wa mattaku kangaete inai yo.
options.translation: Sama sekali tidak dipikirkan hal seperti itu.
options.translationEn: That kind of thing wasn't thought about at all.

npcLine.japanese: 何かあったの？
npcLine.romaji: Nanika atta no?
npcLine.translationEn: What's going on, exactly?

options.japanese: 将来やりたいことが分からなくなってしまったんだ。
options.romaji: Shourai yaritai koto ga wakaranaku natte shimatta n da.
options.translation: Aku jadi tidak tahu apa yang ingin dilakukan di masa depan.
options.translationEn: I've become unsure what I want to do in the future.

options.japanese: 将来のことはもう全部決まっているよ。
options.romaji: Shourai no koto wa mou zenbu kimatte iru yo.
options.translation: Soal masa depan sudah semuanya ditentukan.
options.translationEn: Everything about the future has already been decided.

npcLine.japanese: 休学中は何をするつもり？
npcLine.romaji: Kyuugakuchuu wa nani wo suru tsumori?
npcLine.translationEn: What do you want to do during your leave?

options.japanese: いろんな経験を積みながら、自分を見つめ直そうと思っているんだ。
options.romaji: Iroiro na keiken wo tsuminagara, jibun wo mitsumenaosou to omotte iru n da.
options.translation: Aku berpikir mau menata ulang diri sambil menambah berbagai pengalaman.
options.translationEn: I've been thinking of reorganizing myself while gaining various experiences.

options.japanese: 何もしないでずっと寝ているつもりだよ。
options.romaji: Nanimo shinaide zutto nete iru tsumori da yo.
options.translation: Berniat tidur terus tanpa melakukan apa-apa.
options.translationEn: Intending to just keep sleeping without doing anything.

npcLine.japanese: 復学する予定はあるの？
npcLine.romaji: Fukugaku suru yotei wa aru no?
npcLine.translationEn: Any plans to go back to college?

options.japanese: うん、一年後には戻るつもりでいるよ。
options.romaji: Un, ichinengo ni wa modoru tsumori de iru yo.
options.translation: Iya, aku berencana kembali dalam satu tahun.
options.translationEn: Yeah, I'm planning to come back within a year.

options.japanese: もう二度と戻らないつもりだよ。
options.romaji: Mou nidoto modoranai tsumori da yo.
options.translation: Berniat tidak akan kembali lagi selamanya.
options.translationEn: Intending to never come back again.

npcLine.japanese: 応援してるよ、自分を大切にしてね。
npcLine.romaji: Ouen shiteru yo, jibun wo taisetsu ni shite ne.
npcLine.translation: Aku dukung, sayangi dirimu sendiri ya.
npcLine.translationEn: I support you, take care of yourself.

options.japanese: ありがとう、そうするよ。
options.translation: Terima kasih, akan aku lakukan begitu.

options.japanese: 自分を大切にする気はないよ。
options.romaji: Jibun wo taisetsu ni suru ki wa nai yo.
options.translationEn: Not intending to go easy on myself.

titleEn: Explaining Your Reason for Taking a Leave of Absence From College
descriptionEn: You explain to a friend your reason for taking a leave of absence from college.

title: Membicarakan Tekanan dari Orang Tua soal Pendidikan
description: Kamu membicarakan tekanan dari orang tua soal jalur pendidikan dengan teman.

npcLine.japanese: 親から進路のことでプレッシャーかけられてない？
npcLine.romaji: Oya kara shinro no koto de puresshaa kakerarete nai?
npcLine.translation: Tidak ditekan orang tua soal jalur pendidikan?
npcLine.translationEn: Not being pressured by your parents about your education path?

options.japanese: 正直、医学部を目指してほしいと言われ続けているんだ。
options.romaji: Shoujiki, igakubu wo mezashite hoshii to iware tsuzukete iru n da.
options.translation: Jujur, terus dibilang supaya menargetkan fakultas kedokteran.
options.translationEn: Honestly, I keep being told to aim for medical school.

options.japanese: 全く何も言われていないよ。

npcLine.japanese: 自分はどうしたいの？
npcLine.romaji: Jibun wa dou shitai no?
npcLine.translationEn: What do you yourself want?

options.japanese: 正直、別の分野に興味があるんだけど、言い出せずにいるんだ。
options.romaji: Shoujiki, betsu no bun'ya ni kyoumi ga aru n da kedo, iidasezu ni iru n da.
options.translation: Jujur, aku tertarik dengan bidang lain, tapi belum bisa mengungkapkannya.
options.translationEn: Honestly, I'm interested in another field, but I haven't been able to express it.

options.japanese: 医学部に行きたいと心から思っているよ。
options.romaji: Igakubu ni ikitai to kokoro kara omotte iru yo.
options.translation: Dari lubuk hati ingin masuk fakultas kedokteran.
options.translationEn: Deep down I want to get into medical school.

npcLine.japanese: 一度、きちんと話し合ったほうがいいんじゃない？
npcLine.romaji: Ichido, kichinto hanashiatta hou ga ii n janai?
npcLine.translation: Bukankah lebih baik sekali bicara dengan baik-baik?
npcLine.translationEn: Wouldn't it be better to talk it through properly once?

options.japanese: そうだね、勇気を出して話してみようと思う。
options.romaji: Sou da ne, yuuki wo dashite hanashite miyou to omou.
options.translation: Betul juga, aku berpikir mau coba bicara dengan berani.
options.translationEn: True, I've been thinking of trying to speak up bravely.

options.japanese: 話し合う必要はないと思うよ。
options.romaji: Hanashiau hitsuyou wa nai to omou yo.
options.translationEn: I don't think it needs to be discussed.

npcLine.japanese: 分かってもらえるといいね。
npcLine.romaji: Wakatte moraeru to ii ne.
npcLine.translationEn: Hope it can be understood.

options.japanese: うん、理解してもらえることを願っているよ。
options.romaji: Un, rikai shite moraeru koto wo negatte iru yo.
options.translationEn: Yeah, I hope it can be understood.

options.japanese: 理解してもらう必要はないよ。
options.romaji: Rikai shite morau hitsuyou wa nai yo.

npcLine.japanese: 自分の人生だもんね。
npcLine.romaji: Jibun no jinsei da mon ne.
npcLine.translationEn: After all, this is your own life.

options.japanese: うん、その通りだと思う。
options.romaji: Un, sono toori da to omou.

options.japanese: 別にそうは思わないよ。
options.romaji: Betsu ni sou wa omowanai yo.
options.translationEn: I don't think it's like that.

titleEn: Talking About Pressure From Parents About Education
descriptionEn: You talk about pressure from your parents regarding your educational path with a friend.

title: Menceritakan Pengalaman Menjadi Ketua Kelas
description: Kamu bercerita ke teman tentang pengalaman dulu menjadi ketua kelas.

npcLine.japanese: 学級委員をやってたんだって？大変だった？
npcLine.romaji: Gakkyuu iin wo yatteta n datte? Taihen datta?
npcLine.translation: Katanya dulu jadi ketua kelas ya? Berat?
npcLine.translationEn: I heard you were class president before? Was it tough?

options.japanese: うん、みんなの意見をまとめるのが、意外と難しかったよ。
options.romaji: Un, minna no iken wo matomeru no ga, igai to muzukashikatta yo.
options.translation: Iya, ternyata susah menyatukan pendapat semua orang.
options.translationEn: Yeah, it turned out to be hard to bring everyone's opinions together.

options.japanese: 全然大変じゃなかったよ。

npcLine.japanese: 具体的にどんなことで苦労したの？
npcLine.romaji: Gutaiteki ni donna koto de kurou shita no?
npcLine.translationEn: Specifically, what's the difficulty about?

options.japanese: クラス全体をまとめようとするたびに、意見が割れてしまうんだ。
options.romaji: Kurasu zentai wo matomeyou to suru tabi ni, iken ga warete shimau n da.
options.translation: Setiap kali mencoba menyatukan seluruh kelas, pendapat jadi terpecah.
options.translationEn: Every time we try to bring the whole class together, opinions get divided.

options.japanese: いつも全員がすぐに賛成してくれたよ。
options.romaji: Itsumo zen'in ga sugu ni sansei shite kureta yo.
options.translationEn: Everyone agrees right away every time.

npcLine.japanese: どうやって解決していたの？
npcLine.romaji: Dou yatte kaiketsu shite ita no?
npcLine.translationEn: How do you resolve it?

options.japanese: 一人ひとりの意見を丁寧に聞くようにしていたんだ。
options.romaji: Hitori hitori no iken wo teinei ni kiku you ni shite ita n da.
options.translation: Aku usahakan mendengarkan pendapat setiap orang dengan teliti.
options.translationEn: I try to listen carefully to everyone's opinion.

options.japanese: 多数決だけで全部決めていたよ。
options.romaji: Tasuuketsu dake de zenbu kimete ita yo.
options.translation: Semuanya diputuskan hanya dengan voting mayoritas saja.
options.translationEn: Everything is decided just by majority vote.

npcLine.japanese: その経験は今にも活かされてる？
npcLine.romaji: Sono keiken wa ima ni mo ikasarete ru?
npcLine.translation: Pengalaman itu masih terpakai sampai sekarang?
npcLine.translationEn: Is that experience still useful today?

options.japanese: うん、リーダーシップの基礎になっていると思う。
options.romaji: Un, riidaashippu no kiso ni natte iru to omou.
options.translationEn: Yeah, I think it becomes a foundation for leadership.

options.japanese: 全く活かされていないと思う。
options.translationEn: I don't think it's used at all.

npcLine.japanese: いい経験だったんだね。
npcLine.romaji: Ii keiken datta n da ne.
npcLine.translationEn: That became a good experience.

options.japanese: あまりいい経験じゃなかったな。
options.translationEn: Not that great of an experience.

titleEn: Talking About Your Experience as Class President
descriptionEn: You tell a friend about your past experience as class president.

title: Mendiskusikan Perbedaan Belajar Mandiri dan di Kelas
description: Kamu dan teman mendiskusikan perbedaan belajar mandiri dan belajar di kelas.

npcLine.japanese: 独学と学校の授業、どっちが向いてると思う？
npcLine.romaji: Dokugaku to gakkou no jugyou, docchi ga muiteru to omou?
npcLine.translation: Belajar mandiri dan kelas sekolah, menurutmu mana yang cocok?
npcLine.translationEn: Self-study or a school class, which do you think suits you?

options.japanese: 自分のペースで進められる分、独学のほうが向いていると思う。
options.romaji: Jibun no peesu de susumerareru bun, dokugaku no hou ga muite iru to omou.
options.translation: Karena bisa maju sesuai kecepatan sendiri, kurasa belajar mandiri lebih cocok.
options.translationEn: Since I can go at my own pace, I think self-study suits me better.

options.japanese: どちらも全く同じだと思うよ。
options.romaji: Dochira mo mattaku onaji da to omou yo.
options.translationEn: I think both are exactly the same.

npcLine.japanese: でも、分からない時に聞ける人がいないんじゃない？
npcLine.romaji: Demo, wakaranai toki ni kikeru hito ga inai n janai?
npcLine.translation: Tapi, bukankah tidak ada orang untuk ditanya waktu tidak paham?
npcLine.translationEn: But isn't there no one to ask when you don't understand?

options.japanese: そこは弱点だと自分でも分かっているよ。
options.romaji: Soko wa jakuten da to jibun demo wakatte iru yo.
options.translation: Bagian itu memang kelemahan, aku juga sadar sendiri.
options.translationEn: That part really is a weakness, I'm aware of it myself too.

options.japanese: それは全く問題にならないよ。
options.romaji: Sore wa mattaku mondai ni naranai yo.
options.translation: Itu sama sekali tidak jadi masalah.
options.translationEn: That's not a problem at all.

npcLine.japanese: モチベーションを保つのも大変そうだね。
npcLine.romaji: Mochibeeshon wo tamotsu no mo taihen sou da ne.
npcLine.translation: Menjaga motivasi juga kelihatannya berat ya.
npcLine.translationEn: Keeping motivated looks tough too.

options.japanese: うん、そこが独学の一番の課題だと思う。
options.romaji: Un, soko ga dokugaku no ichiban no kadai da to omou.
options.translation: Iya, kurasa itu masalah terbesar belajar mandiri.
options.translationEn: Yeah, I think that's the biggest problem with self-study.

options.japanese: モチベーションは常に完璧に保てているよ。
options.romaji: Mochibeeshon wa tsuneni kanpeki ni tamotete iru yo.

npcLine.japanese: 学校の良さはどこにあると思う？
npcLine.romaji: Gakkou no yosa wa doko ni aru to omou?
npcLine.translation: Menurutmu kelebihan sekolah ada di mana?
npcLine.translationEn: Where do you think school's strengths lie?

options.japanese: 仲間と一緒に学べるところが、学校ならではの良さだと思う。
options.romaji: Nakama to issho ni manaberu tokoro ga, gakkou narade wa no yosa da to omou.
options.translation: Bagian bisa belajar bersama teman-teman, itu kelebihan khas sekolah.
options.translationEn: Being able to study together with friends, that's a unique advantage of school.

options.japanese: 学校には全く良さがないと思う。
options.romaji: Gakkou ni wa mattaku yosa ga nai to omou.
