npcLine.translation: Tapi kalau ternyata urusan penting gimana?
npcLine.translationEn: But what if it turns out to be something important?

options.japanese: 留守番電話を確認するようにしているよ。
options.romaji: Rusuban denwa wo kakunin suru you ni shite iru yo.
options.translationEn: I try to check my voicemail.

options.japanese: 留守番電話も確認しないよ。
options.romaji: Rusuban denwa mo kakunin shinai yo.

npcLine.japanese: 迷惑電話対策のアプリとか使ってる？
npcLine.romaji: Meiwaku denwa taisaku no apuri toka tsukatteru?
npcLine.translationEn: Using a spam call blocker app?

options.japanese: うん、番号を自動で判別してくれるアプリを使っているよ。
options.romaji: Un, bangou wo jidou de hanbetsu shite kureru apuri wo tsukatte iru yo.
options.translation: Iya, aku pakai aplikasi yang secara otomatis mengidentifikasi nomor.
options.translationEn: Yeah, I use an app that automatically identifies the number.

options.japanese: そういうアプリは一切使っていないよ。
options.romaji: Sou iu apuri wa issai tsukatte inai yo.
options.translation: Sama sekali tidak pakai aplikasi seperti itu.
options.translationEn: Not using that kind of app at all.

npcLine.japanese: それは安心だね。
npcLine.romaji: Sore wa anshin da ne.
npcLine.translationEn: That's reassuring.

options.japanese: うん、おかげでだいぶ減ったよ。
options.romaji: Un, okage de daibu hetta yo.
options.translation: Iya, berkat itu jadi berkurang cukup banyak.
options.translationEn: Yeah, thanks to that it's decreased quite a lot.

titleEn: Explaining How to Handle Calls From Unknown Numbers
descriptionEn: You explain to a friend how to handle calls from unknown numbers.

title: Membicarakan Perbedaan Menelepon dan Mengirim Pesan
description: Kamu membicarakan perbedaan pilihan antara menelepon dan mengirim pesan dengan teman.

npcLine.japanese: 用件があったら、電話とメッセージ、どっちを使う？
npcLine.romaji: Youken ga attara, denwa to messeeji, docchi wo tsukau?
npcLine.translation: Kalau ada keperluan, pakai telepon atau pesan, mana yang dipilih?
npcLine.translationEn: When you need something, which do you choose, calling or texting?

options.japanese: 急ぎでない限り、メッセージで済ませることが多いかな。
options.romaji: Isogi de nai kagiri, messeeji de sumaseru koto ga ooi ka na.
options.translation: Selama tidak mendesak, mungkin lebih sering cukup dengan pesan.
options.translationEn: As long as it's not urgent, a message is probably enough more often.

options.japanese: どんな用件でも必ず電話するよ。
options.romaji: Donna youken demo kanarazu denwa suru yo.
options.translationEn: Whatever the matter, they always call.

npcLine.japanese: 電話のほうが早く伝わるのに？
npcLine.romaji: Denwa no hou ga hayaku tsutawaru noni?
npcLine.translationEn: A call would get across faster though, wouldn't it?

options.japanese: それはそうなんだけど、相手の都合を考えると、メッセージのほうが気楽なんだ。
options.romaji: Sore wa sou nan dakedo, aite no tsugou wo kangaeru to, messeeji no hou ga kiraku nan da.
options.translation: Memang begitu, tapi kalau memikirkan kesibukan lawan bicara, pesan lebih santai.
options.translationEn: That's true, but considering how busy the other person is, a message is more relaxed.

options.japanese: 電話は誰にとっても迷惑だと思っているよ。
options.romaji: Denwa wa dare ni totte mo meiwaku da to omotte iru yo.
options.translation: Kupikir telepon merepotkan bagi siapa pun.
options.translationEn: I think a phone call is a hassle for anyone.

npcLine.japanese: 声で伝えたいこともあるんじゃない？
npcLine.romaji: Koe de tsutaetai koto mo aru n janai?
npcLine.translation: Bukankah ada juga hal yang ingin disampaikan lewat suara?
npcLine.translationEn: Isn't there also something you want to convey through your voice?

options.japanese: うん、複雑な話や、気持ちを伝えたい時は電話にしているよ。
options.romaji: Un, fukuzatsu na hanashi ya, kimochi wo tsutaetai toki wa denwa ni shite iru yo.
options.translation: Iya, kalau ceritanya rumit atau ingin menyampaikan perasaan, aku pilih telepon.
options.translationEn: Yeah, if the story is complicated or I want to convey feelings, I choose to call.

options.japanese: どんな時も文字だけで十分だと思っているよ。
options.romaji: Donna toki mo moji dake de juubun da to omotte iru yo.
options.translation: Kapan pun kupikir cukup dengan teks saja.
options.translationEn: I think a text message is enough anytime.

npcLine.japanese: 使い分けが上手だね。
npcLine.romaji: Tsukaiwake ga jouzu da ne.
npcLine.translationEn: Good at telling when to use which.

options.japanese: そう言われると嬉しいな。
別に使い分けているつもりはないよ。
options.romaji: Betsu ni tsukaiwakete iru tsumori wa nai yo.
options.translation: Tidak berniat membedakan penggunaannya sama sekali.
options.translationEn: Not intending to differentiate its use at all.

npcLine.japanese: 私も見習おうかな。
npcLine.romaji: Watashi mo minaraou ka na.
npcLine.translationEn: Maybe I'll follow your example too.

options.japanese: 真似しないほうがいいよ。
options.romaji: Mane shinai hou ga ii yo.

titleEn: Talking About Calling vs. Texting
descriptionEn: You talk about choosing between calling and texting with a friend.

title: Menceritakan Pengalaman Wawancara Kerja via Telepon
description: Kamu bercerita ke teman tentang pengalaman menjalani wawancara kerja lewat telepon.

npcLine.japanese: 電話面接を受けたことがあるって聞いたよ。
npcLine.romaji: Denwa mensetsu wo uketa koto ga aru tte kiita yo.
npcLine.translation: Kudengar pernah menjalani wawancara lewat telepon ya.
npcLine.translationEn: I heard you once did a phone interview.

options.japanese: うん、対面より緊張しなかったけど、表情が見えない分、難しかったな。
options.romaji: Un, taimen yori kinchou shinakatta kedo, hyoujou ga mienai bun, muzukashikatta na.
options.translation: Iya, tidak segugup tatap muka, tapi karena tidak bisa lihat ekspresi jadi susah.
options.translationEn: Yeah, not as nervous as face-to-face, but since I can't see their expression it's tough.

options.japanese: 対面よりずっと緊張したよ。
options.romaji: Taimen yori zutto kinchou shita yo.
options.translation: Jauh lebih gugup dari tatap muka.

npcLine.japanese: 声のトーンには気をつけた？
npcLine.romaji: Koe no toon ni wa ki wo tsuketa?
npcLine.translationEn: Do you pay attention to tone of voice?

options.japanese: うん、明るく聞こえるように、意識して話したよ。
options.romaji: Un, akaruku kikoeru you ni, ishiki shite hanashita yo.
options.translation: Iya, aku bicara dengan sengaja supaya terdengar ceria.
options.translationEn: Yeah, I deliberately talk so it sounds cheerful.

options.japanese: トーンなんて全く気にしなかったよ。
options.romaji: Toon nante mattaku ki ni shinakatta yo.
options.translationEn: The tone isn't cared about at all.

npcLine.japanese: 電波が切れたりしなかった？
npcLine.romaji: Denpa ga kiretari shinakatta?
npcLine.translationEn: Is the signal not cutting out?

options.japanese: 一度だけ切れてしまって、焦ったよ。
options.romaji: Ichido dake kirete shimatte, aseta yo.
options.translationEn: Once it cut off, I panicked.

options.japanese: 一度も切れなかったよ。

npcLine.japanese: 結果はどうだった？
npcLine.romaji: Kekka wa dou datta?
npcLine.translationEn: How were the results?

options.japanese: おかげさまで、次の選考に進むことができたよ。
options.romaji: Okagesama de, tsugi no senkou ni susumu koto ga dekita yo.
options.translation: Berkat itu, bisa lanjut ke seleksi berikutnya.
options.translationEn: Thanks to that, I could move on to the next selection round.

options.japanese: 残念ながら、その場で不合格になったよ。
options.romaji: Zannen nagara, sono ba de fugoukaku ni natta yo.
options.translation: Sayangnya, langsung tidak lolos di tempat.
options.translationEn: Unfortunately, I didn't pass right there on the spot.

npcLine.japanese: それは良かったね。
npcLine.romaji: Sore wa yokatta ne.
npcLine.translationEn: That's good.

options.japanese: 全然嬉しくなかったよ。

titleEn: Talking About a Phone Job Interview
descriptionEn: You tell a friend about having a job interview over the phone.

title: Menjelaskan Alasan Lebih Suka Video Call daripada Telepon Biasa
description: Kamu menjelaskan ke teman kenapa lebih suka video call daripada telepon biasa.

npcLine.japanese: 電話よりビデオ通話派なんだよね。
npcLine.romaji: Denwa yori bideo tsuuwa ha nan da yo ne.
npcLine.translation: Lebih tipe video call daripada telepon ya.
npcLine.translationEn: More the video-call type than the phone-call type, huh.

options.japanese: うん、相手の表情が見えるだけで、安心感が違うんだ。
options.romaji: Un, aite no hyoujou ga mieru dake de, anshinkan ga chigau n da.
options.translation: Iya, cukup dengan bisa melihat ekspresi lawan bicara, rasa tenangnya beda.
options.translationEn: Yeah, just being able to see the other person's expression makes a difference in how reassured you feel.

options.japanese: ビデオ通話は苦手で、あまり使わないよ。
options.romaji: Bideo tsuuwa wa nigate de, amari tsukawanai yo.
options.translation: Kurang suka video call, jadi jarang dipakai.
options.translationEn: Not too fond of video calls, so I rarely use them.

npcLine.japanese: 逆に面倒だと感じることはない？
npcLine.romaji: Gyaku ni mendou da to kanjiru koto wa nai?
npcLine.translationEn: On the other hand, have you never felt it was a hassle?

options.japanese: 身だしなみを整える必要があるところは、少し面倒に感じるかな。
options.romaji: Midashinami wo totonoeru hitsuyou ga aru tokoro wa, sukoshi mendou ni kanjiru ka na.
options.translation: Bagian harus merapikan penampilan, mungkin agak terasa merepotkan.
options.translationEn: The part about having to tidy up your appearance might feel like a bit of a hassle.

options.japanese: 全く面倒だと感じたことないよ。
options.romaji: Mattaku mendou da to kanjita koto nai yo.
options.translation: Sama sekali tidak pernah merasa merepotkan.
options.translationEn: Never felt it was a hassle at all.

npcLine.japanese: どんな時に特にビデオ通話を使うの？
npcLine.romaji: Donna toki ni toku ni bideo tsuuwa wo tsukau no?
npcLine.translationEn: When specifically do you use video calls?

options.japanese: 遠く離れた家族と話す時は、必ずビデオ通話にしているよ。
options.romaji: Tooku hanareta kazoku to hanasu toki wa, kanarazu bideo tsuuwa ni shite iru yo.
options.translation: Waktu bicara dengan keluarga yang jauh, aku selalu pilih video call.
options.translationEn: When talking with distant family, I always choose video call.

options.japanese: 家族と話す時は絶対に音声通話にしているよ。
options.romaji: Kazoku to hanasu toki wa zettai ni onsei tsuuwa ni shite iru yo.
options.translation: Waktu bicara dengan keluarga selalu pilih panggilan suara.
options.translationEn: When talking with family, always choose a voice call.

npcLine.japanese: 通信量が気になったりしない？
npcLine.romaji: Tsuushinryou ga ki ni nattari shinai?
npcLine.translationEn: Not worried about data quota?

options.japanese: 正直、そこは少し気になるところではあるよ。
options.romaji: Shoujiki, soko wa sukoshi ki ni naru tokoro de wa aru yo.
options.translation: Jujur, itu memang jadi bagian yang agak dikhawatirkan.
options.translationEn: Honestly, that really is a part that's a bit worrying.

options.japanese: 通信量なんて全く気にしていないよ。
options.romaji: Tsuushinryou nante mattaku ki ni shite inai yo.
options.translation: Sama sekali tidak dipedulikan soal kuota.
options.translationEn: Data quota isn't a concern at all.

npcLine.japanese: 便利な時代になったよね。
npcLine.romaji: Benri na jidai ni natta yo ne.
npcLine.translation: Sudah jadi zaman yang praktis ya.
npcLine.translationEn: It's become a convenient era, huh.

titleEn: Explaining Why You Prefer Video Calls Over Regular Calls
descriptionEn: You explain to a friend why you prefer video calls to regular phone calls.

title: Mendiskusikan Cara Menyampaikan Kabar Buruk lewat Telepon
description: Kamu dan teman mendiskusikan cara terbaik menyampaikan kabar buruk lewat telepon.

npcLine.japanese: 悪い知らせって、電話で伝えるべきだと思う？
npcLine.romaji: Warui shirase tte, denwa de tsutaeru beki da to omou?
npcLine.translation: Kabar buruk itu, menurutmu harus disampaikan lewat telepon?
npcLine.translationEn: That bad news, do you think it should be conveyed by phone?

options.japanese: 内容にもよるけど、直接声で伝えたほうがいい場合もあると思う。
options.romaji: Naiyou ni mo yoru kedo, chokusetsu koe de tsutaeta hou ga ii baai mo aru to omou.
options.translation: Tergantung isinya, tapi kurasa ada juga kasus di mana lebih baik disampaikan langsung lewat suara.
options.translationEn: It depends on the content, but I think there are also cases where it's better to convey it directly by voice.

options.japanese: どんな知らせもメッセージで十分だと思うよ。
options.romaji: Donna shirase mo messeeji de juubun da to omou yo.
options.translation: Kupikir kabar apa pun cukup dengan pesan.
options.translationEn: I think any news is fine just with a message.

npcLine.japanese: どうやって切り出せばいいと思う？
npcLine.romaji: Dou yatte kiridaseba ii to omou?
npcLine.translationEn: How do you think you should start it?

options.japanese: いきなり結論を言うのではなく、状況から丁寧に説明するべきだと思う。
options.romaji: Ikinari ketsuron wo iu no dewa naku, joukyou kara teinei ni setsumei suru beki da to omou.
options.translation: Kurasa harus menjelaskan dari situasinya dengan hati-hati, bukan langsung ke kesimpulan.
options.translationEn: I think you should explain the situation carefully, not jump straight to the conclusion.

options.japanese: 前置きなしに結論だけ伝えればいいと思うよ。
options.romaji: Maeoki nashi ni ketsuron dake tsutaereba ii to omou yo.
options.translation: Kupikir cukup langsung sampaikan kesimpulannya saja tanpa pengantar.
options.translationEn: I think it's enough to just state the conclusion directly without an introduction.

npcLine.japanese: 相手の反応が怖くない？
npcLine.romaji: Aite no hannou ga kowakunai?
npcLine.translationEn: Not afraid of the other person's reaction?

options.japanese: 正直、伝える前は毎回緊張するよ。
options.romaji: Shoujiki, tsutaeru mae wa maikai kinchou suru yo.
options.translation: Jujur, tiap kali sebelum menyampaikan aku selalu gugup.
options.translationEn: Honestly, every time before telling someone, I always get nervous.

npcLine.japanese: 伝えた後はどうフォローするの？
npcLine.romaji: Tsutaeta ato wa dou forou suru no?
npcLine.translationEn: After conveying it, how do you follow up?

options.japanese: しばらく時間を置いてから、様子を聞くようにしているよ。
options.romaji: Shibaraku jikan wo oite kara, yousu wo kiku you ni shite iru yo.
options.translation: Aku usahakan setelah memberi jeda waktu, baru tanya kabar.
options.translationEn: I try to give it some time before asking how they're doing.

options.japanese: 伝えたら、それで終わりだと思っているよ。
options.romaji: Tsutaetara, sore de owari da to omotte iru yo.
options.translationEn: I think it's done once it's been said.

npcLine.japanese: 気を遣うことが多いんだね。
npcLine.romaji: Ki wo tsukau koto ga ooi n da ne.
npcLine.translation: Ternyata banyak yang harus diperhatikan ya.
npcLine.translationEn: Turns out there's a lot to pay attention to.

options.japanese: 別に気を遣う必要はないと思うよ。
options.romaji: Betsu ni ki wo tsukau hitsuyou wa nai to omou yo.
options.translationEn: I don't think it needs to be paid attention to.

titleEn: Discussing How to Deliver Bad News by Phone
descriptionEn: You and a friend discuss the best way to deliver bad news over the phone.

title: Menceritakan Pengalaman Ditelepon Telemarketing
description: Kamu bercerita ke teman tentang pengalaman sering ditelepon telemarketing.

npcLine.japanese: 最近、営業の電話がよくかかってくるって言ってたよね。
npcLine.romaji: Saikin, eigyou no denwa ga yoku kakatte kuru tte itteta yo ne.
npcLine.translation: Katanya belakangan sering dapat telepon promosi ya.
npcLine.translationEn: I heard you've been getting promotional calls often lately.

options.japanese: うん、断っても断っても、しつこくかかってくるんだ。
options.romaji: Un, kotowattemo kotowattemo, shitsukoku kakatte kuru n da.
options.translation: Iya, meski sudah ditolak berkali-kali, terus-terusan datang lagi.
options.translationEn: Yeah, even after being rejected many times, they kept coming back.

options.japanese: 一度もかかってきたことないよ。
options.romaji: Ichido mo kakatte kita koto nai yo.
options.translation: Belum pernah dapat telepon seperti itu sama sekali.
options.translationEn: Never gotten a call like that at all.

npcLine.japanese: どうやって対応してるの？
npcLine.romaji: Dou yatte taiou shiteru no?
npcLine.translationEn: How do you handle it?

options.japanese: 必要ありませんと、はっきり伝えるようにしているよ。
options.romaji: Hitsuyou arimasen to, hakkiri tsutaeru you ni shite iru yo.
options.translation: Aku usahakan sampaikan dengan jelas bahwa tidak perlu.
options.translationEn: I try to clearly convey that it's not necessary.

options.japanese: いつも興味があるふりをしてしまうよ。
options.romaji: Itsumo kyoumi ga aru furi wo shite shimau yo.
options.translationEn: Always end up pretending to be interested.

npcLine.japanese: それでも食い下がってくることある？
npcLine.romaji: Sore demo kuisagatte kuru koto aru?
npcLine.translation: Meski begitu masih ada yang gigih memaksa?
npcLine.translationEn: Even so, is anyone still persistently pushing?

options.japanese: たまにあるけど、そういう時はすぐに切るようにしているよ。
options.romaji: Tamani aru kedo, sou iu toki wa sugu ni kiru you ni shite iru yo.
options.translation: Kadang ada, tapi waktu begitu aku usahakan langsung tutup.
options.translationEn: It happens sometimes, but when it does I try to hang up right away.

options.japanese: そういう時は最後まで話を聞くようにしているよ。
options.romaji: Sou iu toki wa saigo made hanashi wo kiku you ni shite iru yo.
options.translation: Waktu begitu aku usahakan dengar sampai selesai.
options.translationEn: When that happens I try to listen until it's finished.

npcLine.japanese: 迷惑電話に登録することはできないの？
npcLine.romaji: Meiwaku denwa ni touroku suru koto wa dekinai no?
npcLine.translation: Tidak bisa daftarkan sebagai telepon spam?
npcLine.translationEn: Can't it be registered as a spam call?

options.japanese: できるらしいけど、まだ試したことはないんだ。
options.romaji: Dekiru rashii kedo, mada tameshita koto wa nai n da.
options.translation: Katanya bisa, tapi belum pernah aku coba.
options.translationEn: They say it's possible, but I've never tried it.

options.japanese: そんな機能は存在しないよ。
options.romaji: Sonna kinou wa sonzai shinai yo.

npcLine.japanese: 今度試してみたら？
npcLine.romaji: Kondo tameshite mitara?
npcLine.translationEn: How about trying it next time?

options.japanese: 別に試さなくていいよ。
options.translation: Tidak usah dicoba juga tidak apa-apa.
options.translationEn: It's fine even without trying it.

titleEn: Talking About Getting Telemarketing Calls
descriptionEn: You tell a friend about frequently getting telemarketing calls.

title: Menjelaskan Cara Menolak Ajakan lewat Telepon dengan Sopan
description: Kamu menjelaskan ke teman cara menolak ajakan minum-minum lewat telepon dengan sopan.

npcLine.japanese: 飲み会の誘い、電話で断ったって聞いたけど、どう言ったの？
npcLine.romaji: Nomikai no sasoi, denwa de kotowatta tte kiita kedo, dou itta no?
npcLine.translation: Kudengar menolak ajakan minum-minum lewat telepon ya, bilang apa?
npcLine.translationEn: I heard you turned down a drinking invite over the phone, what did you say?

options.japanese: せっかく誘ってもらったのに申し訳ないと、まず謝ったんだ。
options.romaji: Sekkaku sasotte moratta noni moushiwakenai to, mazu ayamatta n da.
options.translation: Aku minta maaf dulu bahwa sudah diajak susah-susah tapi tidak enak.
options.translationEn: I'll apologize first for putting you to the trouble of inviting me but it didn't work out.

options.japanese: 行きたくないと、そっけなく言っただけだよ。
options.romaji: Ikitakunai to, sokkenaku itta dake da yo.
options.translation: Hanya bilang tidak mau dengan dingin.

npcLine.japanese: 理由も伝えたの？
npcLine.romaji: Riyuu mo tsutaeta no?
npcLine.translationEn: Was the reason also conveyed?

options.japanese: うん、体調があまり良くなくてと、正直に伝えたよ。
options.romaji: Un, taichou ga amari yokunakute to, shoujiki ni tsutaeta yo.
options.translation: Iya, aku sampaikan dengan jujur bahwa kondisi tubuh kurang baik.
options.translationEn: Yeah, I honestly told them my physical condition wasn't great.

options.japanese: 理由は一切言わなかったよ。
options.translation: Sama sekali tidak bilang alasan apa pun.
options.translationEn: Didn't say any reason at all.

npcLine.japanese: 相手は理解してくれた？
npcLine.romaji: Aite wa rikai shite kureta?
npcLine.translationEn: Could the other person understand?

options.japanese: うん、無理しないでねと、優しく言ってくれたよ。
options.romaji: Un, muri shinaide ne to, yasashiku itte kureta yo.
options.translation: Iya, dia bilang dengan baik supaya jangan memaksakan diri.
options.translationEn: Yeah, they kindly told me not to push myself too hard.

options.japanese: 全く理解してもらえなかったよ。

npcLine.japanese: 次は参加できそう？
npcLine.romaji: Tsugi wa sanka dekisou?
npcLine.translationEn: Seems like you can join next time?

options.japanese: うん、機会があれば、ぜひ参加したいと伝えておいたよ。
options.romaji: Un, kikai ga areba, zehi sanka shitai to tsutaete oita yo.
options.translation: Iya, aku sudah sampaikan kalau ada kesempatan, ingin ikut.
options.translationEn: Yeah, I've said that if there's a chance, I'd like to join.

options.japanese: もう二度と誘わないでほしいと伝えたよ。
options.romaji: Mou nidoto sasowanaide hoshii to tsutaeta yo.
options.translation: Aku sampaikan supaya tidak diajak lagi selamanya.
options.translationEn: I told them not to invite me again ever.

npcLine.japanese: 丁寧な断り方だね。
npcLine.romaji: Teinei na kotowarikata da ne.
npcLine.translationEn: That's a polite way to refuse.

options.japanese: そう言ってもらえて嬉しいよ。
別に丁寧じゃなかったと思うよ。
options.romaji: Betsu ni teinei janakatta to omou yo.
options.translationEn: I don't think it's rude at all.

titleEn: Explaining How to Politely Decline an Invitation by Phone
descriptionEn: You explain to a friend how to politely decline a drinking invitation over the phone.

title: Membicarakan Kecemasan Menelepon dalam Bahasa Asing
description: Kamu membicarakan kecemasan menelepon dalam bahasa Jepang dengan teman.

npcLine.japanese: 日本語で電話するの、まだ緊張する？
npcLine.romaji: Nihongo de denwa suru no, mada kinchou suru?
npcLine.translation: Telepon pakai bahasa Jepang, masih gugup?
npcLine.translationEn: Calling in Japanese, still nervous?

options.japanese: うん、相手の表情が見えない分、聞き取れないと不安になるんだ。
options.romaji: Un, aite no hyoujou ga mienai bun, kikitorenai to fuan ni naru n da.
options.translation: Iya, karena tidak bisa lihat ekspresi lawan bicara, jadi cemas kalau tidak bisa mendengar dengan jelas.
options.translationEn: Yeah, since I can't see the other person's expression, I get anxious about not being able to hear clearly.

options.japanese: もう全然緊張しなくなったよ。
options.romaji: Mou zenzen kinchou shinaku natta yo.
options.translation: Sudah sama sekali tidak gugup lagi.

npcLine.japanese: 何が一番怖いの？
npcLine.romaji: Nani ga ichiban kowai no?
npcLine.translationEn: What was the scariest part?

options.japanese: 早口で話されると、ついていけなくなることが一番怖いな。
options.romaji: Hayakuchi de hanasareru to, tsuite ikenaku naru koto ga ichiban kowai na.
options.translation: Yang paling menakutkan adalah kalau lawan bicara ngomong cepat, jadi tidak bisa mengikuti.
options.translationEn: The scariest thing is when the other person talks fast, so I can't keep up.

options.japanese: 特に怖いことはないよ。
options.romaji: Toku ni kowai koto wa nai yo.

npcLine.japanese: 何か対策はしてる？
npcLine.romaji: Nanika taisaku wa shiteru?
npcLine.translationEn: Was any particular action taken?

options.japanese: 事前に話す内容をメモしておくようにしているよ。
options.romaji: Jizen ni hanasu naiyou wo memo shite oku you ni shite iru yo.
options.translation: Aku usahakan catat dulu isi yang mau dibicarakan.
options.translationEn: I try to write down beforehand what I want to talk about.

options.japanese: 特に何も準備せずに電話しているよ。
options.romaji: Toku ni nanimo junbi sezu ni denwa shite iru yo.
options.translation: Telepon tanpa persiapan apa pun khususnya.

npcLine.japanese: それはいい方法だね。
npcLine.romaji: Sore wa ii houhou da ne.
npcLine.translationEn: That's a good method.

options.japanese: うん、おかげでだいぶ楽になったよ。
options.romaji: Un, okage de daibu raku ni natta yo.
options.translation: Iya, berkat itu jadi cukup lebih ringan.
options.translationEn: Yeah, thanks to that it's become quite a bit lighter.

options.japanese: それでも全く楽にならなかったよ。
options.romaji: Sore demo mattaku raku ni naranakatta yo.
options.translation: Meski begitu sama sekali tidak jadi ringan.
options.translationEn: Even so, it didn't get any lighter at all.

npcLine.japanese: 練習あるのみだね。
npcLine.romaji: Renshuu aru nomi da ne.
npcLine.translationEn: Just left to practice now.

options.japanese: うん、少しずつ慣れていきたい。
options.translation: Iya, ingin terbiasa sedikit demi sedikit.
options.translationEn: Yeah, want to get used to it little by little.

options.japanese: もう練習する気はないよ。
options.romaji: Mou renshuu suru ki wa nai yo.

titleEn: Talking About Anxiety Making Phone Calls in a Foreign Language
descriptionEn: You talk about your anxiety making phone calls in Japanese with a friend.

title: Menceritakan Pengalaman Telepon Darurat
description: Kamu bercerita ke teman tentang pengalaman menelepon ambulans dalam keadaan darurat.

npcLine.japanese: 前に救急車を呼んだことがあるって言ってたよね。
npcLine.romaji: Mae ni kyuukyuusha wo yonda koto ga aru tte itteta yo ne.
npcLine.translation: Katanya dulu pernah menelepon ambulans ya.
npcLine.translationEn: I heard you called an ambulance once.

options.japanese: うん、頭が真っ白になりながらも、なんとか状況を説明したよ。
options.romaji: Un, atama ga masshiro ni narinagara mo, nantoka joukyou wo setsumei shita yo.
options.translation: Iya, meski pikiran kosong, entah bagaimana bisa jelaskan situasinya.
options.translationEn: Yeah, even with my mind blank, I somehow managed to explain the situation.

options.japanese: 落ち着いて完璧に説明できたよ。
options.romaji: Ochitsuite kanpeki ni setsumei dekita yo.

npcLine.japanese: オペレーターは何を聞いてきたの？
npcLine.romaji: Opereetaa wa nani wo kiite kita no?
npcLine.translationEn: What did the operator ask?

options.japanese: 住所や症状を、順番に確認されたよ。
options.romaji: Juusho ya shoujou wo, junban ni kakunin sareta yo.
options.translation: Alamat dan gejala, ditanyakan secara berurutan.
options.translationEn: The address and symptoms were asked one after another.

options.japanese: 何も聞かれなかったよ。

npcLine.japanese: 救急車はすぐ来た？
npcLine.romaji: Kyuukyuusha wa sugu kita?
npcLine.translationEn: Did the ambulance arrive quickly?

options.japanese: うん、思っていたより早く到着してくれたよ。
options.romaji: Un, omotte ita yori hayaku touchaku shite kureta yo.
options.translation: Iya, datang lebih cepat dari perkiraan.
options.translationEn: Yeah, it arrived earlier than expected.

options.japanese: なかなか来なくて、すごく不安だったよ。
options.romaji: Nakanaka konakute, sugoku fuan datta yo.

npcLine.japanese: 落ち着いて対応できたんだね。
npcLine.romaji: Ochitsuite taiou dekita n da ne.
npcLine.translation: Berarti bisa menangani dengan tenang ya.
npcLine.translationEn: So you could handle it calmly.

options.japanese: いや、正直パニックになりながらだったよ。
options.romaji: Iya, shoujiki panikku ni narinagara datta yo.

options.japanese: うん、全く動揺しなかったよ。

npcLine.japanese: 大変な経験だったね。
npcLine.romaji: Taihen na keiken datta ne.
npcLine.translationEn: That's a tough experience.

options.japanese: うん、二度と経験したくないな。
options.translationEn: Yeah, don't want to experience it again.

options.japanese: また経験してみたいな。

titleEn: Talking About Making an Emergency Call
descriptionEn: You tell a friend about calling an ambulance in an emergency.

title: Mendiskusikan Kebiasaan Menelepon Keluarga secara Rutin
description: Kamu dan teman mendiskusikan kebiasaan menelepon keluarga secara rutin.

npcLine.japanese: 実家には、よく電話してる？
npcLine.romaji: Jikka ni wa, yoku denwa shiteru?
npcLine.translation: Sering telepon ke rumah orang tua?
npcLine.translationEn: Do you call your parents' house often?

options.japanese: うん、週に一度は電話するように心がけているよ。
options.romaji: Un, shuu ni ichido wa denwa suru you ni kokorogakete iru yo.
options.translation: Iya, aku usahakan sekali seminggu telepon.
options.translationEn: Yeah, I try to call once a week.

options.japanese: 全く電話していないよ。

npcLine.japanese: どんな話をするの？
npcLine.romaji: Donna hanashi wo suru no?
npcLine.translationEn: What do you chat about?

options.japanese: 特に大した内容じゃなくて、他愛のない話が多いかな。
options.romaji: Toku ni taishita naiyou janakute, tawai no nai hanashi ga ooi ka na.
options.translation: Bukan hal yang besar khususnya, mungkin sering ngobrol ringan.
options.translationEn: Not anything particularly big, probably just casual chats often.

options.japanese: いつも深刻な話ばかりしているよ。
options.romaji: Itsumo shinkoku na hanashi bakari shite iru yo.
options.translation: Selalu ngobrol hal yang serius saja.
options.translationEn: Always only talking about serious things.

npcLine.japanese: 親も楽しみにしてる？
npcLine.romaji: Oya mo tanoshimi ni shiteru?
npcLine.translationEn: Are your parents looking forward to it too?

options.japanese: うん、電話するたびに嬉しそうにしてくれるよ。
options.romaji: Un, denwa suru tabi ni ureshisou ni shite kureru yo.
options.translation: Iya, tiap kali telepon mereka kelihatan senang.
options.translationEn: Yeah, they seem happy every time I call.

options.japanese: あまり喜んでいないみたいだよ。
options.romaji: Amari yorokonde inai mitai da yo.

npcLine.japanese: いい習慣だね。
npcLine.romaji: Ii shuukan da ne.
npcLine.translationEn: That's a good habit.

options.japanese: うん、これからも続けていきたいな。
options.romaji: Un, kore kara mo tsuzukete ikitai na.
options.translation: Iya, ingin terus dilanjutkan ke depannya.
options.translationEn: Yeah, want to keep it up going forward.

options.japanese: もうやめようと思っているよ。
options.romaji: Mou yameyou to omotte iru yo.

npcLine.japanese: 私も見習おうかな。
npcLine.romaji: Watashi mo minaraou ka na.
npcLine.translationEn: Maybe I'll follow your example too.

options.japanese: あまりおすすめしないよ。

titleEn: Discussing the Habit of Calling Family Regularly
descriptionEn: You and a friend discuss the habit of regularly calling family.

title: Menjelaskan Alasan Beralih ke Transportasi Umum
description: Kamu menjelaskan ke teman alasan beralih dari mobil ke transportasi umum.

npcLine.japanese: 車、手放したって聞いたけど、本当？
npcLine.romaji: Kuruma, tebanashita tte kiita kedo, hontou?
npcLine.translationEn: I heard you sold the car, is that right?

options.japanese: うん、維持費を考えると、電車のほうが合理的だと気づいたんだ。
options.romaji: Un, ijihi wo kangaeru to, densha no hou ga gouriteki da to kizuita n da.
options.translation: Iya, kalau memikirkan biaya perawatan, aku sadar kereta lebih masuk akal.
options.translationEn: Yeah, considering maintenance costs, I realize the train makes more sense.

options.japanese: 車はまだ手放していないよ。
options.romaji: Kuruma wa mada tebanashite inai yo.
options.translationEn: The car hasn't been given up yet.

npcLine.japanese: 不便に感じることはない？
npcLine.romaji: Fuben ni kanjiru koto wa nai?
npcLine.translationEn: Have you never felt it's inconvenient?

options.japanese: 正直、荷物が多い時は少し不便に感じることもあるよ。
options.romaji: Shoujiki, nimotsu ga ooi toki wa sukoshi fuben ni kanjiru koto mo aru yo.
options.translation: Jujur, waktu barang banyak kadang terasa agak kurang praktis.
options.translationEn: Honestly, when there's a lot of luggage it sometimes feels a bit impractical.

options.japanese: 全く不便に感じたことないよ。
options.romaji: Mattaku fuben ni kanjita koto nai yo.
options.translation: Sama sekali tidak pernah merasa kurang praktis.
options.translationEn: Never felt it was impractical at all.

npcLine.japanese: 節約にはなってる？
npcLine.romaji: Setsuyaku ni wa natteru?
npcLine.translationEn: Saves money?

options.japanese: うん、ガソリン代や駐車場代を考えると、かなり浮いているよ。
options.romaji: Un, gasorin dai ya chuushajou dai wo kangaeru to, kanari uite iru yo.
options.translation: Iya, kalau memikirkan biaya bensin dan parkir, jadi hemat cukup banyak.
options.translationEn: Yeah, considering gas and parking costs, it saves quite a lot.

options.japanese: 全然節約になっていないよ。
options.romaji: Zenzen setsuyaku ni natte inai yo.

npcLine.japanese: 環境にもいいよね。
npcLine.romaji: Kankyou ni mo ii yo ne.
npcLine.translationEn: It's good for the environment too.

options.japanese: うん、それも大きな理由の一つなんだ。
options.romaji: Un, sore mo ookina riyuu no hitotsu nan da.
options.translation: Iya, itu juga salah satu alasan besar.
options.translationEn: Yeah, that's one of the big reasons too.

options.japanese: 環境のことは特に考えていないよ。
options.romaji: Kankyou no koto wa toku ni kangaete inai yo.
options.translationEn: The environment isn't particularly thought about.

npcLine.japanese: いい選択だと思うよ。
npcLine.romaji: Ii sentaku da to omou yo.
npcLine.translationEn: I think that's a good choice.

options.japanese: ありがとう、そう言ってもらえると嬉しい。
options.romaji: Arigatou, sou itte moraeru to ureshii.
options.translation: Terima kasih, kalau dikatakan begitu aku senang.
options.translationEn: Thank you, hearing that makes me happy.

options.japanese: 別にいい選択だとは思わないよ。
options.romaji: Betsu ni ii sentaku da to wa omowanai yo.
options.translationEn: I don't think it's a good choice.

titleEn: Explaining Why You Switched to Public Transport
descriptionEn: You explain to a friend your reason for switching from a car to public transport.

title: Mendiskusikan Dampak Lingkungan dari Kendaraan Pribadi
description: Kamu dan teman mendiskusikan dampak lingkungan dari kendaraan pribadi.

npcLine.japanese: 自家用車が環境に与える影響、意外と大きいらしいね。
npcLine.romaji: Jikayousha ga kankyou ni ataeru eikyou, igai to ookii rashii ne.
npcLine.translation: Katanya dampak mobil pribadi terhadap lingkungan ternyata besar ya.
npcLine.translationEn: I heard the environmental impact of private cars is actually significant.

options.japanese: うん、排気ガスの問題は無視できないと思うよ。
options.romaji: Un, haiki gasu no mondai wa mushi dekinai to omou yo.
options.translation: Iya, kurasa masalah gas buangnya tidak bisa diabaikan.
options.translationEn: Yeah, I think the exhaust gas issue can't be ignored.

options.japanese: 全く影響はないと思うよ。
options.romaji: Mattaku eikyou wa nai to omou yo.
options.translation: Kupikir sama sekali tidak ada dampak.
options.translationEn: I don't think there's any impact at all.

npcLine.japanese: 個人でできる対策ってあるのかな。
npcLine.romaji: Kojin de dekiru taisaku tte aru no ka na.
npcLine.translation: Ada tindakan yang bisa dilakukan secara individu ya kali.
npcLine.translationEn: There's probably something that can be done individually.

options.japanese: 公共交通機関を利用するだけでも、違いは出てくると思う。
options.romaji: Koukyou koutsuu kikan wo riyou suru dake demo, chigai wa dete kuru to omou.
options.translation: Kurasa cukup pakai transportasi umum saja sudah membuat perbedaan.
options.translationEn: I think just using public transportation alone already makes a difference.

options.japanese: 個人には何もできないと思う。
options.romaji: Kojin ni wa nanimo dekinai to omou.
options.translation: Kupikir individu tidak bisa melakukan apa pun.
options.translationEn: I don't think an individual can do anything.

npcLine.japanese: 電気自動車についてはどう思う？
npcLine.romaji: Denki jidousha ni tsuite wa dou omou?
npcLine.translationEn: What's your opinion on electric cars?

options.japanese: 有効な手段の一つだとは思うけど、まだ課題も多いと思う。
options.romaji: Yuukou na shudan no hitotsu da to wa omou kedo, mada kadai mo ooi to omou.
options.translation: Kupikir itu salah satu cara yang efektif, tapi kurasa masih banyak tantangan.
options.translationEn: I think that's one effective way, but I think there are still many challenges.

options.japanese: 完璧な解決策だと思っているよ。
options.romaji: Kanpeki na kaiketsusaku da to omotte iru yo.
options.translationEn: I think that's a perfect solution.

npcLine.japanese: 自分は何か実践していることある？
npcLine.romaji: Jibun wa nanika jissen shite iru koto aru?
npcLine.translationEn: Is there anything you practice yourself?

options.japanese: 近い距離なら、歩くようにしているよ。
options.romaji: Chikai kyori nara, aruku you ni shite iru yo.
options.translation: Kalau jaraknya dekat, aku usahakan jalan kaki.
options.translationEn: If it's close by, I try to walk.

options.japanese: 特に何も実践していないよ。
options.romaji: Toku ni nanimo jissen shite inai yo.

npcLine.japanese: いい心がけだね。
npcLine.romaji: Ii kokorogake da ne.
npcLine.translationEn: That's a good attitude.

options.japanese: 別に大したことじゃないよ。
options.romaji: Betsu ni taishita koto janai yo.

titleEn: Discussing the Environmental Impact of Private Vehicles
descriptionEn: You and a friend discuss the environmental impact of private vehicles.

title: Menceritakan Pengalaman Mengemudi Jarak Jauh
description: Kamu bercerita ke teman tentang pengalaman nyetir jarak jauh sendirian.

npcLine.japanese: 一人で長距離運転したことがあるって言ってたよね。
npcLine.romaji: Hitori de choukyori unten shita koto ga aru tte itteta yo ne.
npcLine.translation: Katanya pernah nyetir jarak jauh sendirian ya.
npcLine.translationEn: I heard you once drove a long distance alone.

options.japanese: うん、八時間ぶっ通しで運転したことがあるよ。
options.romaji: Un, hachijikan buttoushi de unten shita koto ga aru yo.
options.translation: Iya, pernah nyetir terus-menerus delapan jam tanpa henti.
options.translationEn: Yeah, I've driven continuously for eight hours straight before.

options.japanese: 一度も長距離運転したことないよ。
options.romaji: Ichido mo choukyori unten shita koto nai yo.
options.translation: Belum pernah nyetir jarak jauh sama sekali.
options.translationEn: Never driven long distance at all.

npcLine.japanese: 眠気とか大丈夫だった？
npcLine.romaji: Nemuke toka daijoubu datta?
npcLine.translationEn: Is the drowsiness okay?

options.japanese: 途中で何度も休憩を挟むようにしたよ。
options.romaji: Tochuu de nandomo kyuukei wo hasamu you ni shita yo.
options.translation: Aku usahakan berhenti istirahat berkali-kali di tengah jalan.
options.translationEn: I try to stop and rest several times along the way.

options.japanese: 一度も休憩せずに走り続けたよ。
options.romaji: Ichido mo kyuukei sezu ni hashiritsuzuketa yo.
options.translation: Terus jalan tanpa istirahat sama sekali.
options.translationEn: Kept walking without resting at all.

npcLine.japanese: 一人だと心細くなかった？
npcLine.romaji: Hitori da to kokorobosokunakatta?
npcLine.translationEn: Doesn't it get lonely by yourself?

options.japanese: 正直、途中で少し心細くなったよ。
options.romaji: Shoujiki, tochuu de sukoshi kokorobosoku natta yo.
options.translation: Jujur, di tengah jalan jadi agak kesepian.
options.translationEn: Honestly, partway through it got a bit lonely.

options.japanese: 全く心細くならなかったよ。

npcLine.japanese: 音楽とか聴いてた？
npcLine.romaji: Ongaku toka kiiteta?
npcLine.translationEn: Listen to music or something like that?

options.japanese: うん、好きな曲を流して、眠気覚ましにしていたよ。
options.romaji: Un, suki na kyoku wo nagashite, nemukezamashi ni shite ita yo.
options.translation: Iya, aku putar lagu kesukaan untuk mengusir kantuk.
options.translationEn: Yeah, I play my favorite songs to fight off sleepiness.

options.japanese: 音楽は一切聴かなかったよ。
options.translationEn: Not listening to music at all.

npcLine.japanese: お疲れ様だったね。
npcLine.romaji: Otsukaresama datta ne.
npcLine.translationEn: Great work.

options.japanese: ありがとう、いい経験になったよ。
options.romaji: Arigatou, ii keiken ni natta yo.
options.translation: Terima kasih, jadi pengalaman yang bagus.
options.translationEn: Thank you, it became a good experience.

options.japanese: あまりいい経験じゃなかったな。
options.translationEn: Not that great of an experience.

titleEn: Talking About a Long-Distance Driving Experience
descriptionEn: You tell a friend about driving a long distance alone.

title: Menjelaskan Kesulitan Mendapatkan SIM di Negara Asing
description: Kamu menjelaskan ke teman kesulitan mendapatkan SIM Jepang.

npcLine.japanese: 日本の運転免許を取るの、大変だったって聞いたよ。
npcLine.romaji: Nihon no unten menkyo wo toru no, taihen datta tte kiita yo.
npcLine.translation: Kudengar dapat SIM Jepang itu berat ya.
npcLine.translationEn: I heard getting a Japanese driver's license is tough.

options.japanese: うん、外国の免許を切り替えるだけでも、想像以上に手続きが多かったよ。
options.romaji: Un, gaikoku no menkyo wo kirikaeru dake demo, souzou ijou ni tetsuzuki ga ookatta yo.
options.translation: Iya, cuma untuk konversi SIM luar negeri saja, prosesnya banyak di luar bayangan.
options.translationEn: Yeah, just for converting a foreign license, the process was way more than I imagined.

options.japanese: 免許の切り替えは全く簡単だったよ。
options.romaji: Menkyo no kirikae wa mattaku kantan datta yo.
options.translationEn: Converting the driver's license was really easy.

npcLine.japanese: 学科試験もあったの？
npcLine.romaji: Gakka shiken mo atta no?
npcLine.translationEn: Is there also a written exam?

options.japanese: うん、交通ルールの違いについて、細かく問われたよ。
options.romaji: Un, koutsuu ruuru no chigai ni tsuite, komakaku towareta yo.
options.translation: Iya, ditanyakan secara detail soal perbedaan aturan lalu lintas.
options.translationEn: Yeah, I was asked in detail about the differences in traffic rules.

options.japanese: 学科試験は一切なかったよ。
options.romaji: Gakka shiken wa issai nakatta yo.
options.translation: Sama sekali tidak ada ujian teori.

npcLine.japanese: 実技試験は難しかった？
npcLine.romaji: Jitsugi shiken wa muzukashikatta?
npcLine.translationEn: Is the practical exam hard?

options.japanese: 日本独特の運転マナーに慣れるまで、少し苦労したよ。
options.romaji: Nihon dokutoku no unten manaa ni nareru made, sukoshi kurou shita yo.
options.translation: Sampai terbiasa dengan etika mengemudi khas Jepang, agak kesulitan.
options.translationEn: It was a bit tough until I got used to distinctly Japanese driving etiquette.

options.japanese: 実技試験は全く問題なかったよ。
options.romaji: Jitsugi shiken wa mattaku mondai nakatta yo.
options.translation: Ujian praktik sama sekali tidak masalah.
options.translationEn: The practical test wasn't a problem at all.

npcLine.japanese: 何回目で合格したの？
npcLine.romaji: Nankaime de goukaku shita no?
npcLine.translationEn: Which attempt did you pass on?

options.japanese: 三回目でなんとか合格できたよ。
options.romaji: Sankaime de nantoka goukaku dekita yo.
options.translation: Di percobaan ketiga akhirnya bisa lulus.
options.translationEn: On the third attempt I finally passed.

options.japanese: 一回で余裕で合格したよ。
options.romaji: Ikkai de yoyuu de goukaku shita yo.
options.translation: Langsung lulus dengan mudah sekali coba.
options.translationEn: Passed easily on the first try.

npcLine.japanese: 頑張ったね。
npcLine.romaji: Ganbatta ne.
npcLine.translationEn: You've worked hard.

options.japanese: ありがとう、本当に大変だったよ。
options.romaji: Arigatou, hontou ni taihen datta yo.

options.japanese: 別に大変じゃなかったよ。

titleEn: Explaining the Difficulty of Getting a License in a Foreign Country
descriptionEn: You explain to a friend the difficulty of getting a Japanese driver's license.

title: Membicarakan Perbedaan Budaya Berkendara Antar Negara
description: Kamu membicarakan perbedaan budaya mengemudi Jepang dan Indonesia dengan teman.

npcLine.japanese: 日本とインドネシアの運転文化、結構違うんでしょう？
npcLine.romaji: Nihon to Indoneshia no unten bunka, kekkou chigau n deshou?
npcLine.translation: Budaya mengemudi Jepang dan Indonesia, cukup beda ya?
npcLine.translationEn: Driving culture in Japan and Indonesia is quite different, huh?

options.japanese: うん、クラクションの使い方からして違う気がするよ。
options.romaji: Un, kurakushon no tsukaikata kara shite chigau ki ga suru yo.
options.translation: Iya, dari cara pakai klakson saja sudah beda rasanya.
options.translationEn: Yeah, even just how the horn is used feels different.

options.romaji: Mattaku onaji da to omou yo.
options.translationEn: I think it's exactly the same.

npcLine.japanese: どんなところが違うの？
npcLine.romaji: Donna tokoro ga chigau no?
npcLine.translationEn: Which part is different?

options.japanese: 日本ではあまり鳴らさないけど、こっちは頻繁に使う印象があるよ。
options.romaji: Nihon dewa amari narasanai kedo, kocchi wa hinpan ni tsukau inshou ga aru yo.
options.translation: Di Jepang jarang dibunyikan, tapi di sini kesannya sering dipakai.
options.translationEn: In Japan it's rarely honked, but here it seems to be used often.

options.japanese: どちらの国でも全く鳴らさないよ。
options.romaji: Dochira no kuni demo mattaku narasanai yo.
options.translation: Di negara mana pun sama sekali tidak dibunyikan.
options.translationEn: Never honked in any country at all.

npcLine.japanese: 交通ルールへの意識も違うと思う？
npcLine.romaji: Koutsuu ruuru e no ishiki mo chigau to omou?
npcLine.translation: Menurutmu kesadaran akan aturan lalu lintas juga beda?
npcLine.translationEn: Do you think traffic-rule awareness differs too?

options.japanese: 正直、地域によって、意識の差はあると思う。
options.romaji: Shoujiki, chiiki ni yotte, ishiki no sa wa aru to omou.
options.translation: Jujur, kurasa ada perbedaan kesadaran tergantung daerahnya.
options.translationEn: Honestly, I think there's a difference in awareness depending on the region.

options.japanese: どこでも全く同じ意識だと思う。
options.romaji: Doko demo mattaku onaji ishiki da to omou.
options.translation: Kupikir kesadarannya sama persis di mana-mana.
options.translationEn: I think the awareness is exactly the same everywhere.

npcLine.japanese: 慣れるまで大変だった？
npcLine.romaji: Nareru made taihen datta?
npcLine.translationEn: Is it hard until you get used to it?

options.japanese: うん、最初は戸惑うことが多かったな。
options.romaji: Un, saisho wa tomadou koto ga ookatta na.
options.translationEn: Yeah, at first I was often confused.

options.japanese: 全然戸惑わなかったな。

npcLine.japanese: それぞれの文化があるんだね。
npcLine.romaji: Sorezore no bunka ga aru n da ne.
npcLine.translationEn: Each has its own culture.

titleEn: Talking About Driving Culture Differences Between Countries
descriptionEn: You talk about driving culture differences between Japan and Indonesia with a friend.

title: Menceritakan Pengalaman Kecelakaan Kecil di Jalan
description: Kamu bercerita ke teman tentang pengalaman menggores mobil di parkiran.

npcLine.japanese: 車、こすったって聞いたけど、大丈夫だった？
npcLine.romaji: Kuruma, kosutta tte kiita kedo, daijoubu datta?
npcLine.translationEn: I heard the car got scratched, are you okay?

options.japanese: うん、幸い、大した怪我もなく済んだよ。
options.romaji: Un, saiwai, taishita kega mo naku sunda yo.
options.translation: Iya, untungnya tidak sampai cedera parah.
options.translationEn: Yeah, luckily it wasn't a serious injury.

options.japanese: すごく大きな怪我をしてしまったよ。
options.romaji: Sugoku ookina kega wo shite shimatta yo.

npcLine.japanese: どうしてぶつけちゃったの？
npcLine.romaji: Doushite butsukechatta no?
npcLine.translationEn: Why did you end up crashing?

options.japanese: 駐車場でバックする時に、確認不足だったんだ。
options.romaji: Chuushajou de bakku suru toki ni, kakunin busoku datta n da.
options.translation: Waktu mundur di tempat parkir, kurang teliti mengecek.
options.translationEn: While backing up in the parking lot, wasn't careful enough checking.

options.japanese: 前をよく見ていたのに、突然ぶつかってきたんだ。
options.romaji: Mae wo yoku mite ita noni, totsuzen butsukatte kita n da.
options.translation: Padahal sudah lihat depan dengan baik, tiba-tiba ditabrak.
options.translationEn: Even though I was watching the road ahead carefully, I suddenly got hit.

npcLine.japanese: 相手とはどう話をつけたの？
npcLine.romaji: Aite to wa dou hanashi wo tsuketa no?
npcLine.translationEn: How was it resolved with the other party?

options.japanese: 保険会社を通して、円満に解決したよ。
options.romaji: Hoken gaisha wo tooshite, enman ni kaiketsu shita yo.
options.translation: Diselesaikan dengan baik melalui perusahaan asuransi.
options.translationEn: Resolved properly through the insurance company.

options.japanese: 相手とは全く話し合わなかったよ。
options.romaji: Aite to wa mattaku hanashiawanakatta yo.
options.translation: Sama sekali tidak dibicarakan dengan pihak lain.
options.translationEn: Not discussed with the other party at all.

npcLine.japanese: 修理代は高くついた？
npcLine.romaji: Shuuridai wa takaku tsuita?
npcLine.translationEn: Did the repair cost get expensive?

options.japanese: 思っていたより高くついて、驚いたよ。
options.romaji: Omotte ita yori takaku tsuite, odoroita yo.
options.translation: Ternyata lebih mahal dari perkiraan, sampai kaget.
options.translationEn: It turned out more expensive than expected, I was surprised.

options.japanese: 予想よりずっと安く済んだよ。
options.romaji: Yosou yori zutto yasuku sunda yo.

npcLine.japanese: 今後は気をつけないとね。
npcLine.romaji: Kongo wa ki wo tsukenai to ne.
npcLine.translation: Ke depannya harus lebih hati-hati ya.
npcLine.translationEn: Need to be more careful going forward.

options.japanese: 別に気をつけなくていいと思うよ。
options.romaji: Betsu ni ki wo tsukenakute ii to omou yo.
options.translation: Tidak usah hati-hati juga tidak apa-apa.
options.translationEn: It's fine even without being careful.

titleEn: Talking About a Minor Road Accident
descriptionEn: You tell a friend about scratching your car in a parking lot.

title: Mendiskusikan Masa Depan Kendaraan Otonom
description: Kamu dan teman mendiskusikan masa depan mobil self-driving.

npcLine.japanese: 自動運転の車、将来当たり前になると思う？
npcLine.romaji: Jidou unten no kuruma, shourai atarimae ni naru to omou?
npcLine.translation: Mobil self-driving, menurutmu akan jadi hal biasa di masa depan?
npcLine.translationEn: Self-driving cars, do you think they'll become common in the future?

options.japanese: うん、技術の進歩を考えると、そう遠くない未来に実現すると思うよ。
options.romaji: Un, gijutsu no shinpo wo kangaeru to, sou tookunai mirai ni jitsugen suru to omou yo.
options.translation: Iya, kalau memikirkan kemajuan teknologi, kurasa akan terwujud dalam waktu tidak lama lagi.
options.translationEn: Yeah, considering technological progress, I think it'll come true before too long.

options.japanese: そんな技術は絶対に実現しないと思うよ。
options.romaji: Sonna gijutsu wa zettai ni jitsugen shinai to omou yo.
options.translation: Kupikir teknologi seperti itu pasti tidak akan terwujud.
options.translationEn: I think that kind of technology definitely won't come true.

npcLine.japanese: 不安に思うことはない？
npcLine.romaji: Fuan ni omou koto wa nai?
npcLine.translationEn: Nothing to worry about?

options.japanese: 事故の責任の所在が、あいまいになりそうで不安だな。
options.romaji: Jiko no sekinin no shozai ga, aimai ni narisou de fuan da na.
options.translation: Aku khawatir soal siapa yang bertanggung jawab saat kecelakaan jadi kabur.
options.translationEn: I'm worried about who's responsible becoming unclear in an accident.

options.japanese: 全く不安に思うことはないよ。
options.romaji: Mattaku fuan ni omou koto wa nai yo.
options.translation: Sama sekali tidak ada yang dikhawatirkan.
options.translationEn: Nothing to worry about at all.

npcLine.japanese: 便利になる面もあるよね。
npcLine.romaji: Benri ni naru men mo aru yo ne.
npcLine.translation: Ada juga sisi yang jadi lebih praktis ya.
npcLine.translationEn: There's also a side that's become more convenient.

options.japanese: うん、高齢者の移動手段としては、期待できると思う。
options.romaji: Un, koureisha no idou shudan toshite wa, kitai dekiru to omou.
options.translation: Iya, kurasa bisa diharapkan sebagai sarana transportasi untuk lansia.
options.translationEn: Yeah, I think it can be expected as a means of transportation for the elderly.

options.japanese: 便利になる面は特にないと思う。
options.romaji: Benri ni naru men wa toku ni nai to omou.
options.translation: Kupikir tidak ada sisi yang jadi lebih praktis khususnya.
options.translationEn: I don't think there's a particular side that's more practical.

npcLine.japanese: 自分で乗ってみたいと思う？
npcLine.romaji: Jibun de notte mitai to omou?
npcLine.translationEn: Want to try riding it yourself?

options.japanese: 興味はあるけど、まだ少し怖い気もするな。
options.romaji: Kyoumi wa aru kedo, mada sukoshi kowai ki mo suru na.
options.translation: Tertarik sih, tapi rasanya masih agak takut juga.
options.translationEn: I'm interested, but I still feel a bit scared too.

npcLine.japanese: 技術の発展が楽しみだね。
npcLine.romaji: Gijutsu no hatten ga tanoshimi da ne.
npcLine.translationEn: Can't wait for the technological development.

options.japanese: 別に楽しみじゃないよ。

titleEn: Discussing the Future of Autonomous Vehicles
descriptionEn: You and a friend discuss the future of self-driving cars.

title: Menjelaskan Alasan Memilih Sepeda sebagai Transportasi Utama
description: Kamu menjelaskan ke teman kenapa memilih sepeda sebagai sarana transportasi utama ke kantor.

npcLine.japanese: 通勤、自転車にしたんだって？
npcLine.romaji: Tsuukin, jitensha ni shita n datte?
npcLine.translation: Katanya pergi kerja pakai sepeda ya?
npcLine.translationEn: I heard you commute to work by bike?

options.japanese: うん、健康維持も兼ねて、自転車通勤に切り替えたんだ。
options.romaji: Un, kenkou iji mo kanete, jitensha tsuukin ni kirikaeta n da.
options.translation: Iya, sambil menjaga kesehatan juga, aku beralih ke bersepeda ke kantor.
options.translationEn: Yeah, while also taking care of my health, I switched to biking to the office.

options.japanese: 自転車には全く興味ないよ。
options.romaji: Jitensha ni wa mattaku kyoumi nai yo.
options.translationEn: Not interested in bicycles at all.

npcLine.japanese: 雨の日はどうしてるの？
npcLine.romaji: Ame no hi wa dou shiteru no?
npcLine.translationEn: What about when it rains?

options.japanese: 雨の日だけは、諦めて電車を使うようにしているよ。
options.romaji: Ame no hi dake wa, akiramete densha wo tsukau you ni shite iru yo.
options.translation: Khusus hari hujan, aku menyerah dan pakai kereta.
options.translationEn: Specifically on rainy days, I give up and take the train.

options.japanese: 雨の日でも自転車で通勤しているよ。
options.romaji: Ame no hi demo jitensha de tsuukin shite iru yo.
options.translation: Hari hujan pun tetap bersepeda ke kantor.
options.translationEn: Even on rainy days, still bike to the office.

npcLine.japanese: 体力的にきつくない？
npcLine.romaji: Tairyokuteki ni kitsukunai?
npcLine.translationEn: Not physically tough?

options.japanese: 最初はきつかったけど、今ではすっかり慣れたよ。
options.romaji: Saisho wa kitsukatta kedo, ima dewa sukkari nareta yo.
options.translation: Awalnya berat, tapi sekarang sudah benar-benar terbiasa.
options.translationEn: It was tough at first, but now I'm completely used to it.

options.japanese: 全く体力的に問題ないよ。
options.romaji: Mattaku tairyokuteki ni mondai nai yo.
options.translation: Sama sekali tidak masalah secara fisik.

npcLine.japanese: 交通費の節約にもなるよね。
npcLine.romaji: Koutsuuhi no setsuyaku ni mo naru yo ne.
npcLine.translationEn: It saves on fare too.

options.japanese: うん、それも大きなメリットの一つだと思っているよ。
options.romaji: Un, sore mo ookina meritto no hitotsu da to omotte iru yo.
options.translation: Iya, kupikir itu juga salah satu keuntungan besar.
options.translationEn: Yeah, I think that's one of the big advantages too.

options.japanese: 交通費は全く変わらないよ。
options.translation: Ongkos transportasi sama sekali tidak berubah.
options.translationEn: Transportation costs haven't changed at all.

npcLine.japanese: 体調も良くなったんじゃない？
npcLine.romaji: Taichou mo yoku natta n janai?
npcLine.translation: Kondisi tubuh juga jadi lebih baik kan?
npcLine.translationEn: Your physical condition has gotten better too, right?

options.japanese: うん、体が軽くなった気がするよ。
options.romaji: Un, karada ga karuku natta ki ga suru yo.
options.translation: Iya, rasanya badan jadi lebih ringan.

options.japanese: 全然変わっていないよ。

titleEn: Explaining Why You Chose a Bicycle as Your Main Transport
descriptionEn: You explain to a friend why you chose a bicycle as your main way of commuting to the office.

title: Membicarakan Kemacetan yang Semakin Parah
description: Kamu membicarakan kemacetan yang semakin parah tiap tahun dengan teman.

npcLine.japanese: この辺の渋滞、年々ひどくなってる気がする。
npcLine.romaji: Kono hen no juutai, nennen hidoku natteru ki ga suru.
npcLine.translation: Kemacetan di sekitar sini, rasanya makin parah tiap tahun.
npcLine.translationEn: Traffic around here feels like it's getting worse every year.

options.japanese: うん、人口が増えている影響もあると思う。
options.romaji: Un, jinkou ga fuete iru eikyou mo aru to omou.
options.translation: Iya, kurasa juga ada pengaruh populasi yang bertambah.
options.translationEn: Yeah, I think there's also the influence of a growing population.

options.japanese: 全く変わっていないと思うよ。
options.romaji: Mattaku kawatte inai to omou yo.
options.translationEn: I don't think it's changed at all.

npcLine.japanese: 通勤時間、どのくらい変わった？
npcLine.romaji: Tsuukin jikan, dono kurai kawatta?
npcLine.translation: Waktu berangkat kerja, berubah berapa banyak?
npcLine.translationEn: How much did your commute time change?

options.japanese: 以前より三十分は余分にかかるようになったよ。
options.romaji: Izen yori sanjuppun wa yobun ni kakaru you ni natta yo.
options.translation: Jadi butuh tambahan setidaknya tiga puluh menit dari sebelumnya.
options.translationEn: So it needs at least thirty more minutes than before.

options.japanese: 以前と全く変わらないよ。
options.translation: Sama sekali tidak berubah dari sebelumnya.
options.translationEn: Hasn't changed from before at all.

npcLine.japanese: 対策は考えてる？
npcLine.romaji: Taisaku wa kangaeteru?
npcLine.translationEn: Do you have an action plan?

options.japanese: 出発時間を早めることで、対応しようと考えているよ。
options.romaji: Shuppatsu jikan wo hayameru koto de, taiou shiyou to kangaete iru yo.
options.translation: Aku berpikir mau menangani dengan mempercepat waktu berangkat.
options.translationEn: I'm thinking of handling it by leaving earlier.

options.japanese: 特に対策は考えていないよ。
options.romaji: Toku ni taisaku wa kangaete inai yo.
options.translation: Tidak memikirkan tindakan apa pun khususnya.
options.translationEn: Not thinking of any particular action.

npcLine.japanese: 行政の対応にも期待したいよね。
npcLine.romaji: Gyousei no taiou ni mo kitai shitai yo ne.
npcLine.translation: Ingin berharap juga pada tindakan pemerintah ya.
npcLine.translationEn: You'd also want to hope for government action.

options.japanese: うん、道路整備とか、根本的な対策が必要だと思う。
options.romaji: Un, douro seibi toka, konponteki na taisaku ga hitsuyou da to omou.
options.translation: Iya, kurasa perlu tindakan fundamental seperti perbaikan jalan.
options.translationEn: Yeah, I think fundamental measures like road repairs are needed.

options.japanese: 行政には何も期待していないよ。
options.romaji: Gyousei ni wa nanimo kitai shite inai yo.
options.translation: Tidak berharap apa pun pada pemerintah.
options.translationEn: Not expecting anything from the government.

npcLine.japanese: 早く改善するといいね。
npcLine.romaji: Hayaku kaizen suru to ii ne.
npcLine.translationEn: Hope it gets better soon.

options.japanese: うん、本当にそう願うよ。
options.romaji: Un, hontou ni sou negau yo.

titleEn: Talking About Worsening Traffic Congestion
descriptionEn: You talk about traffic getting worse every year with a friend.

title: Menceritakan Pengalaman Naik Transportasi Umum di Negara Lain
description: Kamu bercerita ke teman tentang pengalaman naik transportasi umum di luar negeri.

npcLine.japanese: 海外で公共交通機関を使ったことある？
npcLine.romaji: Kaigai de koukyou koutsuu kikan wo tsukatta koto aru?
npcLine.translation: Pernah pakai transportasi umum di luar negeri?
npcLine.translationEn: Ever used public transportation abroad?

options.japanese: うん、路線図が全く読めなくて、苦労したことがあるよ。
options.romaji: Un, rosenzu ga mattaku yomenakute, kurou shita koto ga aru yo.
options.translation: Iya, pernah kesulitan karena sama sekali tidak bisa baca peta rutenya.
options.translationEn: Yeah, I've had trouble before because I couldn't read the route map at all.

options.japanese: 一度も使ったことないよ。
options.romaji: Ichido mo tsukatta koto nai yo.

npcLine.japanese: どうやって乗り越えたの？
npcLine.romaji: Dou yatte norikoeta no?
npcLine.translationEn: How did you get through it?

options.japanese: 現地の人に助けてもらいながら、なんとか目的地に着いたよ。
options.romaji: Genchi no hito ni tasukete morainagara, nantoka mokutekichi ni tsuita yo.
options.translation: Entah bagaimana bisa sampai tujuan dengan dibantu penduduk lokal.
options.translationEn: Somehow managed to reach the destination with the help of locals.

options.japanese: 誰にも頼らずに一人で解決したよ。
options.romaji: Dare ni mo tayorazu ni hitori de kaiketsu shita yo.
options.translation: Menyelesaikan sendiri tanpa bergantung siapa pun.
options.translationEn: Resolved it myself without depending on anyone.

npcLine.japanese: 料金システムも違ったでしょう？
npcLine.romaji: Ryoukin shisutemu mo chigatta deshou?
npcLine.translationEn: The fare system is different too, right?

options.japanese: うん、日本とはだいぶ異なる仕組みで、最初は戸惑ったよ。
options.romaji: Un, Nihon to wa daibu kotonaru shikumi de, saisho wa tomadotta yo.
options.translation: Iya, mekanismenya cukup berbeda dari Jepang, awalnya kebingungan.
options.translationEn: Yeah, the mechanism is quite different from Japan, I was confused at first.

options.japanese: 日本と全く同じ仕組みだったよ。
options.romaji: Nihon to mattaku onaji shikumi datta yo.
options.translationEn: The mechanism is exactly the same as Japan.

npcLine.japanese: それでも楽しかった？
npcLine.romaji: Sore demo tanoshikatta?
npcLine.translationEn: Even so, still fun?

options.japanese: うん、迷いながらも、いい思い出になったよ。
options.romaji: Un, mayoinagara mo, ii omoide ni natta yo.
options.translation: Iya, meski sambil tersesat, jadi kenangan yang bagus.
options.translationEn: Yeah, even while getting lost, it became a good memory.

options.japanese: 全く楽しくなかったよ。

npcLine.japanese: いい経験だったね。
npcLine.romaji: Ii keiken datta ne.
npcLine.translationEn: That's a good experience.

options.japanese: うん、また海外に行った時は挑戦したいな。
options.romaji: Un, mata kaigai ni itta toki wa chousen shitai na.
options.translation: Iya, kalau pergi ke luar negeri lagi ingin coba lagi.
options.translationEn: Yeah, if I go abroad again I want to try it again.

options.japanese: もう二度と使いたくないな。
options.translationEn: Never want to use it again.

titleEn: Talking About Using Public Transport in Another Country
descriptionEn: You tell a friend about using public transport abroad.

title: Menjelaskan Cara Menghemat Biaya Transportasi
description: Kamu menjelaskan ke teman cara menghemat biaya transportasi.

npcLine.japanese: 交通費、どうやって節約してるの？
npcLine.romaji: Koutsuuhi, dou yatte setsuyaku shiteru no?
npcLine.translationEn: How do you save on transportation costs?

options.japanese: 定期券を活用することで、かなり抑えられているよ。
options.romaji: Teikiken wo katsuyou suru koto de, kanari osaerarete iru yo.
options.translation: Bisa ditekan cukup banyak dengan memanfaatkan tiket berlangganan.
options.translationEn: It can be cut down quite a lot by using a subscription pass.

options.japanese: 特に何も節約していないよ。
options.romaji: Toku ni nanimo setsuyaku shite inai yo.

npcLine.japanese: 他にも工夫してることある？
npcLine.romaji: Hoka ni mo kufuu shite iru koto aru?
npcLine.translationEn: Any other adjustments made?

options.japanese: できるだけ歩くようにして、交通費を減らしているよ。
options.romaji: Dekiru dake aruku you ni shite, koutsuuhi wo herashite iru yo.
options.translation: Aku usahakan jalan kaki sebisa mungkin untuk mengurangi biaya transportasi.
options.translationEn: I try to walk as much as possible to cut transportation costs.

options.japanese: 近い距離でも必ずタクシーを使っているよ。
options.romaji: Chikai kyori demo kanarazu takushii wo tsukatte iru yo.
options.translation: Jarak dekat pun selalu pakai taksi.
options.translationEn: Even for short distances, always take a taxi.

npcLine.japanese: ポイント還元とかも活用してる？
npcLine.romaji: Pointo kangen toka mo katsuyou shiteru?
npcLine.translationEn: Making use of cashback points too?

options.japanese: うん、還元率が高いカードを選ぶようにしているよ。
options.romaji: Un, kangenritsu ga takai kaado wo erabu you ni shite iru yo.
options.translation: Iya, aku usahakan pilih kartu dengan tingkat pengembalian tinggi.
options.translationEn: Yeah, I try to choose a card with a high return rate.

options.japanese: ポイントには全く興味ないよ。
options.romaji: Pointo ni wa mattaku kyoumi nai yo.
options.translationEn: Not interested in points at all.

npcLine.japanese: 効果は出てる？
npcLine.romaji: Kouka wa deteru?
npcLine.translationEn: Any results?

options.japanese: うん、月々の出費がだいぶ減ったよ。
options.romaji: Un, tsukizuki no shuppi ga daibu hetta yo.
options.translation: Iya, pengeluaran bulanan berkurang cukup banyak.
options.translationEn: Yeah, monthly expenses decreased quite a lot.

options.japanese: 全く効果を感じていないよ。
options.romaji: Mattaku kouka wo kanjite inai yo.
options.translationEn: Don't feel the effect at all.

npcLine.japanese: 私も見習おうかな。
npcLine.romaji: Watashi mo minaraou ka na.
npcLine.translationEn: Maybe I'll follow your example too.

options.japanese: あまりおすすめしないよ。

titleEn: Explaining How to Save on Transportation Costs
descriptionEn: You explain to a friend how to save on transportation costs.

title: Mendiskusikan Keselamatan Berkendara Motor
description: Kamu dan teman mendiskusikan keselamatan berkendara motor.

npcLine.japanese: バイクの運転、危ないって言われない？
npcLine.romaji: Baiku no unten, abunai tte iwarenai?
npcLine.translationEn: Isn't riding a motorcycle called dangerous?

options.japanese: うん、よく心配されるけど、安全運転を心がけているよ。
options.romaji: Un, yoku shinpai sareru kedo, anzen unten wo kokorogakete iru yo.
options.translation: Iya, sering dikhawatirkan, tapi aku usahakan berkendara dengan aman.
options.translationEn: Yeah, it's often worried about, but I try to drive safely.

options.japanese: 危ないと言われたことは一度もないよ。
options.romaji: Abunai to iwareta koto wa ichido mo nai yo.
options.translation: Belum pernah dibilang berbahaya sama sekali.
options.translationEn: Never been told it's dangerous at all.

npcLine.japanese: どんなことに気をつけてるの？
npcLine.romaji: Donna koto ni ki wo tsuketeru no?
npcLine.translationEn: What things do you pay attention to?

options.japanese: 速度を出しすぎないことと、車間距離を保つことを意識しているよ。
options.romaji: Sokudo wo dashisuginai koto to, shakan kyori wo tamotsu koto wo ishiki shite iru yo.
options.translation: Aku memperhatikan untuk tidak terlalu ngebut dan menjaga jarak aman.
options.translationEn: I make sure not to speed too much and keep a safe distance.

options.japanese: 特に何も気をつけていないよ。
options.romaji: Toku ni nanimo ki wo tsukete inai yo.
options.translationEn: Nothing in particular was paid attention to.

npcLine.japanese: プロテクターとかも着けてる？
npcLine.romaji: Purotekutaa toka mo tsuketeru?
npcLine.translationEn: Wearing protection too?

options.japanese: うん、万が一に備えて、必ず着用しているよ。
options.romaji: Un, man ga ichi ni sonaete, kanarazu chakuyou shite iru yo.
options.translation: Iya, aku selalu pakai untuk berjaga-jaga kalau terjadi apa-apa.
options.translationEn: Yeah, I always use it just in case something happens.

options.japanese: プロテクターは面倒だから着けていないよ。
options.romaji: Purotekutaa wa mendou dakara tsukete inai yo.
options.translationEn: Since it's a hassle, not used.

npcLine.japanese: 事故に遭ったことはある？
npcLine.romaji: Jiko ni atta koto wa aru?
npcLine.translationEn: Ever been in an accident?

options.japanese: 幸い、大きな事故には遭ったことがないよ。
options.romaji: Saiwai, ookina jiko ni wa atta koto ga nai yo.
options.translation: Untungnya, belum pernah mengalami kecelakaan besar.
options.translationEn: Luckily, never had a major accident.

options.japanese: 何度も大きな事故に遭っているよ。
options.romaji: Nandomo ookina jiko ni atte iru yo.
options.translation: Sudah beberapa kali mengalami kecelakaan besar.
options.translationEn: Already experienced major accidents several times.

npcLine.japanese: これからも安全運転でね。
npcLine.romaji: Kore kara mo anzen unten de ne.
npcLine.translation: Ke depannya juga berkendara dengan aman ya.
npcLine.translationEn: Drive safely going forward too.

options.translationEn: Yeah, I'll keep an eye on it.

options.japanese: 別に気をつけなくていいよ。
options.romaji: Betsu ni ki wo tsukenakute ii yo.
options.translationEn: No need to pay attention to it.

titleEn: Discussing Motorcycle Safety
descriptionEn: You and a friend discuss motorcycle riding safety.

title: Menceritakan Pengalaman Ditilang Polisi
description: Kamu bercerita ke teman tentang pengalaman ditilang polisi karena melanggar batas kecepatan.

npcLine.japanese: この前、警察に捕まったって聞いたけど。
npcLine.romaji: Kono mae, keisatsu ni tsukamatta tte kiita kedo.
npcLine.translationEn: I heard you got stopped by the police yesterday.

options.japanese: うん、スピード違反で捕まってしまったんだ。
options.romaji: Un, supiido ihan de tsukamatte shimatta n da.
options.translation: Iya, ketangkap karena melanggar batas kecepatan.

options.japanese: 警察には一度も捕まったことないよ。
options.romaji: Keisatsu ni wa ichido mo tsukamatta koto nai yo.
options.translation: Belum pernah ditangkap polisi sama sekali.
options.translationEn: Never been caught by police at all.

npcLine.japanese: どんな状況だったの？
npcLine.romaji: Donna joukyou datta no?
npcLine.translationEn: What's the situation like?

options.japanese: 急いでいて、つい速度を上げすぎてしまったんだ。
options.romaji: Isoide ite, tsui sokudo wo agesugite shimatta n da.
options.translation: Karena buru-buru, tanpa sadar terlalu mempercepat kecepatan.
options.translationEn: Since I was in a rush, I unknowingly sped up too much.

options.japanese: いつも通りの速度で走っていただけなんだ。
options.romaji: Itsumo doori no sokudo de hashitte ita dake nan da.
options.translation: Cuma jalan dengan kecepatan seperti biasa.
options.translationEn: Just drove at the usual speed.

npcLine.japanese: 反則金は高かった？
npcLine.romaji: Hansokukin wa takakatta?
npcLine.translationEn: Is the traffic fine expensive?

options.japanese: 正直、痛い出費だったよ。
全く気にならない金額だったよ。
options.romaji: Mattaku ki ni naranai kingaku datta yo.
options.translationEn: The amount isn't cared about at all.

npcLine.japanese: それ以来、気をつけるようになった？
npcLine.romaji: Sore irai, ki wo tsukeru you ni natta?
npcLine.translationEn: Have you been more careful since then?

options.japanese: うん、スピードには特に敏感になったよ。
options.romaji: Un, supiido ni wa toku ni binkan ni natta yo.
options.translation: Iya, jadi lebih peka soal kecepatan khususnya.
options.translationEn: Yeah, I've become more aware about speed in particular.

options.japanese: 全く気をつけるようにならなかったよ。
options.romaji: Mattaku ki wo tsukeru you ni naranakatta yo.
options.translation: Sama sekali tidak jadi lebih hati-hati.

npcLine.japanese: いい教訓になったね。
npcLine.romaji: Ii kyoukun ni natta ne.
npcLine.translationEn: That became a good lesson.

options.japanese: 別に教訓にはならなかったよ。
options.romaji: Betsu ni kyoukun ni wa naranakatta yo.
options.translationEn: It wasn't really a lesson learned.

titleEn: Talking About Getting a Traffic Ticket
descriptionEn: You tell a friend about getting a ticket for speeding.

title: Membicarakan Rencana Membeli Kendaraan Pertama
description: Kamu membicarakan rencana membeli mobil pertama dengan teman.

npcLine.japanese: 初めての車、そろそろ買うつもりなんだって？
npcLine.romaji: Hajimete no kuruma, sorosoro kau tsumori nan datte?
npcLine.translation: Katanya sebentar lagi mau beli mobil pertama ya?
npcLine.translationEn: I heard you're about to buy your first car?

options.japanese: うん、貯金がある程度貯まったから、本気で考え始めたんだ。
options.romaji: Un, chokin ga aru teido tamatta kara, honki de kangaehajimeta n da.
options.translation: Iya, karena tabungan sudah terkumpul cukup banyak, aku mulai memikirkannya dengan serius.
options.translationEn: Yeah, since I've saved up quite a bit, I've started thinking about it seriously.

options.japanese: 車を買うことは全く考えていないよ。
options.romaji: Kuruma wo kau koto wa mattaku kangaete inai yo.
options.translation: Sama sekali tidak dipikirkan soal beli mobil.
options.translationEn: Not thought about buying a car at all.

npcLine.japanese: どんな車を考えてるの？
npcLine.romaji: Donna kuruma wo kangaeteru no?
npcLine.translationEn: What kind of car are you considering?

options.japanese: 燃費のいいコンパクトカーにしようと思っているよ。
options.romaji: Nenpi no ii konpakuto kaa ni shiyou to omotte iru yo.
options.translation: Aku berpikir mau pilih mobil kompak yang irit bahan bakar.
options.translationEn: I'm thinking of choosing a fuel-efficient compact car.

options.japanese: 特にどんな車がいいか分からないよ。
options.romaji: Toku ni donna kuruma ga ii ka wakaranai yo.
options.translation: Sama sekali tidak tahu mobil seperti apa yang bagus.
options.translationEn: Have no idea what kind of car is good at all.

npcLine.japanese: 新車と中古車、どっちにするの？
npcLine.romaji: Shinsha to chuukosha, docchi ni suru no?
npcLine.translation: Mobil baru atau bekas, mana yang dipilih?
npcLine.translationEn: A new car or a used one, which would you choose?

options.japanese: 予算のことも考えて、中古車にする予定だよ。
options.romaji: Yosan no koto mo kangaete, chuukosha ni suru yotei da yo.
options.translation: Sambil mempertimbangkan anggaran juga, berencana pilih mobil bekas.
options.translationEn: While also considering the budget, planning to choose a used car.

options.japanese: 予算は全く気にせず、新車にするよ。
options.romaji: Yosan wa mattaku ki ni sezu, shinsha ni suru yo.
options.translation: Sama sekali tidak memperhatikan anggaran, akan pilih mobil baru.
options.translationEn: Not paying attention to the budget at all, going to choose a new car.

npcLine.japanese: ローンを組む予定？
npcLine.romaji: Roon wo kumu yotei?
npcLine.translationEn: Planning to pay in installments?

options.japanese: うん、無理のない範囲でローンを組もうと思っているよ。
options.romaji: Un, muri no nai han'i de roon wo kumou to omotte iru yo.
options.translation: Iya, aku berpikir mau ambil cicilan sebatas yang tidak memaksakan diri.
options.translationEn: Yeah, I'm thinking of taking installments only within what I can comfortably afford.

options.japanese: ローンは一切組まないつもりだよ。
options.romaji: Roon wa issai kumanai tsumori da yo.
options.translation: Sama sekali tidak berniat ambil cicilan.
options.translationEn: Not intending to take installments at all.

npcLine.japanese: 楽しみだね。
npcLine.romaji: Tanoshimi da ne.
npcLine.translationEn: Can't wait.

options.japanese: うん、すごく楽しみにしてる。
別に楽しみじゃないよ。

titleEn: Talking About Plans to Buy Your First Vehicle
descriptionEn: You talk about plans to buy your first car with a friend.

title: Mendiskusikan Etika Berbagi Tumpangan (Carpooling)
description: Kamu dan teman mendiskusikan etika berbagi tumpangan.

npcLine.japanese: カープーリングって、日本ではあまり一般的じゃないよね。
npcLine.romaji: Kaapuuringu tte, Nihon dewa amari ippanteki janai yo ne.
npcLine.translation: Carpooling itu, di Jepang belum begitu umum ya.
npcLine.translationEn: Carpooling isn't very common in Japan yet, huh.

options.japanese: うん、文化的にあまり浸透していない気がするよ。
options.romaji: Un, bunkateki ni amari shintou shite inai ki ga suru yo.
options.translation: Iya, rasanya secara budaya belum begitu menyebar.
options.translationEn: Yeah, it feels like it hasn't really spread culturally yet.

options.japanese: 日本でもすごく一般的だよ。
options.romaji: Nihon demo sugoku ippanteki da yo.
options.translationEn: It's also very common in Japan.

npcLine.japanese: どんなマナーが必要だと思う？
npcLine.romaji: Donna manaa ga hitsuyou da to omou?
npcLine.translation: Menurutmu etika seperti apa yang diperlukan?
npcLine.translationEn: What kind of etiquette do you think is needed?

options.japanese: 時間を守ることが、最低限のマナーだと思うよ。
options.romaji: Jikan wo mamoru koto ga, saiteigen no manaa da to omou yo.
options.translation: Kurasa menepati waktu itu etika minimal.
options.translationEn: I think being on time is basic etiquette.

options.japanese: マナーなんて特に必要ないと思うよ。
options.romaji: Manaa nante toku ni hitsuyou nai to omou yo.
options.translation: Kupikir etika tidak terlalu diperlukan khususnya.
options.translationEn: I don't think etiquette is particularly necessary.

npcLine.japanese: 費用の分担はどうすればいいと思う？
npcLine.romaji: Hiyou no buntan wa dou sureba ii to omou?
npcLine.translationEn: How do you think the cost should be split?

options.japanese: あらかじめ、はっきり決めておいたほうがトラブルにならないと思う。
options.romaji: Arakajime, hakkiri kimete oita hou ga toraburu ni naranai to omou.
options.translation: Kurasa lebih baik ditentukan dengan jelas sejak awal supaya tidak jadi masalah.
options.translationEn: I think it's better to clearly decide it from the start so it doesn't become a problem.

options.japanese: お金の話は避けたほうがいいと思うよ。
options.romaji: Okane no hanashi wa saketa hou ga ii to omou yo.
options.translation: Kupikir lebih baik menghindari bicara soal uang.
options.translationEn: I think it's better to avoid talking about money.

npcLine.japanese: 知らない人と乗るのは不安じゃない？
npcLine.romaji: Shiranai hito to noru no wa fuan janai?
npcLine.translation: Naik dengan orang tidak dikenal tidak cemas?
npcLine.translationEn: Aren't you anxious riding with a stranger?

options.japanese: 正直、最初は少し警戒してしまうかもしれない。
options.romaji: Shoujiki, saisho wa sukoshi keikai shite shimau kamoshirenai.
options.translationEn: Honestly, at first I was probably a bit cautious.

options.japanese: 全く不安にならないと思うよ。
options.romaji: Mattaku fuan ni naranai to omou yo.
options.translation: Kupikir sama sekali tidak akan cemas.
options.translationEn: I don't think I'll be anxious at all.

npcLine.japanese: 広まっていくといいね。
npcLine.romaji: Hiromatte iku to ii ne.
npcLine.translationEn: Hope it spreads even more.

options.japanese: 別に広まらなくていいと思うよ。
options.romaji: Betsu ni hiromaranakute ii to omou yo.
options.translation: Kupikir tidak usah menyebar juga tidak apa-apa.
options.translationEn: I think it's fine even if it doesn't need to spread.

titleEn: Discussing Carpooling Etiquette
descriptionEn: You and a friend discuss carpooling etiquette.

title: Menjelaskan Kerusakan Barang Saat Pengiriman
description: Kamu melaporkan barang yang rusak saat dikirim ke petugas pos.

npcLine.japanese: 本日はどのようなご用件でしょうか。
npcLine.romaji: Honjitsu wa dono you na goyouken deshou ka.
npcLine.translationEn: What do you need today?

options.japanese: 先日発送してもらった荷物が、破損した状態で届いたんです。
options.romaji: Senjitsu hassou shite moratta nimotsu ga, hason shita joutai de todoita n desu.
options.translation: Barang yang saya kirim kemarin sampai dalam keadaan rusak.
options.translationEn: The item I sent yesterday arrived damaged.

options.japanese: 荷物を送りに来ました。

npcLine.japanese: それは大変申し訳ございません。どのような破損状況でしょうか。
npcLine.romaji: Sore wa taihen moushiwake gozaimasen. Dono you na hason joukyou deshou ka.
npcLine.translation: Mohon maaf sekali. Kondisi kerusakannya seperti apa?
npcLine.translationEn: We're truly sorry. What's the extent of the damage?

options.japanese: 箱がつぶれていて、中身にひびが入っていました。
options.romaji: Hako ga tsubureteite, nakami ni hibi ga haitte imashita.
options.translationEn: The box is dented, and the contents are cracked.

options.japanese: 特に何も壊れていませんでした。
options.romaji: Toku ni nanimo kowarete imasen deshita.

npcLine.japanese: 写真は撮っていただけましたか。
npcLine.romaji: Shashin wa totte itadakemashita ka.
npcLine.translationEn: Have you taken a photo?

options.japanese: はい、届いた時にすぐ撮影しました。
options.romaji: Hai, todoita toki ni sugu satsuei shimashita.
options.translation: Iya, saya langsung ambil foto saat barang sampai.
options.translationEn: Yeah, I took a photo right away when the item arrived.

options.japanese: 写真は撮っていません。

npcLine.japanese: それでは、補償の手続きを進めさせていただきます。
npcLine.romaji: Soredewa, hoshou no tetsuzuki wo susumesasete itadakimasu.
npcLine.translation: Kalau begitu, akan kami proses ganti ruginya.
npcLine.translationEn: In that case, we'll process the compensation.

options.japanese: よろしくお願いします、助かります。
options.translationEn: Please help me with this, that's really helpful.

npcLine.japanese: 結果が分かり次第、ご連絡いたします。
npcLine.romaji: Kekka ga wakari shidai, gorenraku itashimasu.
npcLine.translation: Begitu hasilnya diketahui, akan kami hubungi.
npcLine.translationEn: Once the results are known, we'll contact you.

options.japanese: はい、よろしくお願いします。
options.translationEn: Okay, please help me with this.

options.japanese: もう連絡しなくていいです。
options.translationEn: No need to be contacted again.

titleEn: Explaining Damage to an Item During Shipping
descriptionEn: You report an item damaged during shipping to post office staff.

title: Menegosiasikan Pengembalian Dana Pengiriman yang Gagal
description: Kamu meminta pengembalian dana karena paket yang dikirim tidak pernah sampai.

npcLine.japanese: 本日はどのようなご用件でしょうか。
npcLine.romaji: Honjitsu wa dono you na goyouken deshou ka.
npcLine.translationEn: What do you need today?

options.japanese: 発送した荷物が、結局届かなかったので、返金をお願いしたいんです。
options.romaji: Hassou shita nimotsu ga, kekkyoku todokanakatta node, henkin wo onegaishitai n desu.
options.translation: Barang yang saya kirim akhirnya tidak sampai, jadi saya ingin minta pengembalian dana.
options.translationEn: The item I sent never arrived in the end, so I'd like to request a refund.

options.japanese: 発送状況を確認したいだけです。
options.romaji: Hassou joukyou wo kakunin shitai dake desu.
options.translation: Hanya ingin cek status pengiriman saja.
options.translationEn: Just want to check the shipping status.

npcLine.japanese: 追跡番号はお持ちですか。
npcLine.romaji: Tsuiseki bangou wa omochi desu ka.
npcLine.translationEn: Did you bring the tracking number?

options.japanese: はい、こちらにございます。
追跡番号は分かりません。

npcLine.japanese: 確認いたしますので、少々お待ちください。
npcLine.romaji: Kakunin itashimasu node, shoushou omachi kudasai.
npcLine.translation: Akan kami periksa, mohon tunggu sebentar.
npcLine.translationEn: We'll check it, please wait a moment.

npcLine.japanese: 確認できました。全額返金の対応をさせていただきます。
npcLine.romaji: Kakunin dekimashita. Zengaku henkin no taiou wo sasete itadakimasu.
npcLine.translation: Sudah terkonfirmasi. Akan kami proses pengembalian dana penuh.
npcLine.translationEn: It's been confirmed. We'll process a full refund.

options.japanese: ありがとうございます、助かります。

npcLine.japanese: ご迷惑をおかけして、申し訳ございませんでした。
npcLine.romaji: Gomeiwaku wo okake shite, moushiwake gozaimasen deshita.
npcLine.translationEn: Sorry for the inconvenience.

options.japanese: いえいえ、丁寧に対応していただき感謝しています。
options.romaji: Ieie, teinei ni taiou shite itadaki kansha shite imasu.
options.translation: Tidak apa-apa, saya berterima kasih atas respons yang teliti.
options.translationEn: It's fine, I'm grateful for the thorough response.

options.japanese: もう二度と利用しません。
options.translationEn: Never going to use it again.

titleEn: Negotiating a Refund for a Failed Delivery
descriptionEn: You ask for a refund because a package you sent never arrived.

title: Menanyakan Prosedur Pengiriman Barang Berharga
description: Kamu menanyakan prosedur pengiriman barang mahal ke petugas pos.

npcLine.japanese: 本日はどのようなご用件でしょうか。
npcLine.romaji: Honjitsu wa dono you na goyouken deshou ka.
npcLine.translationEn: What do you need today?

options.japanese: 高価な品物を送りたいのですが、どのような手続きが必要でしょうか。
options.romaji: Kouka na shinamono wo okuritai no desu ga, dono you na tetsuzuki ga hitsuyou deshou ka.
options.translation: Saya ingin mengirim barang mahal, prosedur apa yang diperlukan?
options.translationEn: I'd like to send an expensive item, what procedure is required?

options.japanese: 普通の荷物を送りたいだけです。
