options.romaji: Futsuu no nimotsu wo okuritai dake desu.
options.translation: Hanya ingin kirim barang biasa saja.
options.translationEn: Just want to send a regular package.

npcLine.japanese: 保険をおかけになることをおすすめします。
npcLine.romaji: Hoken wo okake ni naru koto wo osusume shimasu.
npcLine.translationEn: We recommend getting insurance.

options.japanese: それでは、保険をつけてお願いします。
options.translationEn: In that case, please include insurance.

npcLine.japanese: 中身の価格を申告していただく必要があります。
npcLine.romaji: Nakami no kakaku wo shinkoku shite itadaku hitsuyou ga arimasu.
npcLine.translationEn: You need to declare the value of the contents.

options.japanese: 分かりました、正確な金額を伝えます。
options.romaji: Wakarimashita, seikaku na kingaku wo tsutaemasu.
options.translation: Mengerti, akan saya sampaikan jumlah yang tepat.
options.translationEn: Understood, I'll convey the exact amount.

options.japanese: 金額は適当でいいですか。
options.romaji: Kingaku wa tekitou de ii desu ka.

npcLine.japanese: 梱包も厳重にしていただいたほうが安心です。
npcLine.romaji: Konpou mo genjuu ni shite itadaita hou ga anshin desu.
npcLine.translation: Sebaiknya pengemasannya juga dilakukan dengan ketat supaya lebih aman.
npcLine.translationEn: The packaging should also be done tightly for extra safety.

options.japanese: はい、しっかり梱包してきました。
options.translation: Iya, saya sudah kemas dengan kuat.

options.japanese: 梱包は特にしていません。
options.romaji: Konpou wa toku ni shite imasen.
options.translationEn: Not packed with anything in particular.

npcLine.japanese: それでは、こちらで承ります。
npcLine.romaji: Soredewa, kochira de uketamawarimasu.
npcLine.translation: Kalau begitu, kami terima di sini.
npcLine.translationEn: In that case, we'll accept it here.

options.japanese: よろしくお願いします。

titleEn: Asking About the Procedure for Shipping Valuables
descriptionEn: You ask post office staff about the procedure for shipping expensive items.

title: Menjelaskan Alasan Memilih Jasa Pengiriman Tertentu
description: Kamu menjelaskan ke teman kenapa selalu memakai perusahaan pengiriman tertentu.

npcLine.japanese: いつもこの配送会社を使ってるよね、何か理由があるの？
npcLine.romaji: Itsumo kono haisou gaisha wo tsukatteru yo ne, nanika riyuu ga aru no?
npcLine.translation: Selalu pakai perusahaan pengiriman ini ya, ada alasan tertentu?
npcLine.translationEn: You always use this shipping company, is there a particular reason?

options.japanese: うん、対応が丁寧で、信頼できると感じているんだ。
options.romaji: Un, taiou ga teinei de, shinrai dekiru to kanjite iru n da.
options.translation: Iya, karena responsnya teliti, aku merasa bisa dipercaya.
options.translationEn: Yeah, since the response was thorough, I felt I could trust them.

options.romaji: Toku ni riyuu wa nai yo.

npcLine.japanese: 値段も安いの？
npcLine.romaji: Nedan mo yasui no?
npcLine.translationEn: Is the price cheap too?

options.japanese: 他社と比べると、少し高めではあるよ。
options.romaji: Tasha to kuraberu to, sukoshi takame de wa aru yo.
options.translation: Dibandingkan perusahaan lain, memang sedikit lebih mahal.
options.translationEn: Compared to other companies, it really is a bit more expensive.

options.japanese: 一番安いから使っているよ。
options.romaji: Ichiban yasui kara tsukatte iru yo.
options.translationEn: Using it because it's the cheapest.

npcLine.japanese: それでも使い続けてるんだね。
npcLine.romaji: Sore demo tsukaitsuzuketeru n da ne.
npcLine.translation: Meski begitu tetap terus dipakai ya.
npcLine.translationEn: Even so, you kept using it.

options.japanese: うん、多少高くても、確実性を優先しているんだ。
options.romaji: Un, tashou takakutemo, kakujitsusei wo yuusen shite iru n da.
options.translation: Iya, meski agak mahal, aku mengutamakan kepastian.
options.translationEn: Yeah, even though it's a bit expensive, I prioritize certainty.

options.japanese: 高いから使うのをやめようと思っているよ。
options.romaji: Takai kara tsukau no wo yameyou to omotte iru yo.
options.translation: Karena mahal berpikir mau berhenti pakai.
options.translationEn: Since it's expensive, thinking of stopping using it.

npcLine.japanese: 過去にトラブルとかあった？
npcLine.romaji: Kako ni toraburu toka atta?
npcLine.translationEn: Were there ever problems before?

options.japanese: うん、他社で荷物が届かなかった経験があるんだ。
options.romaji: Un, tasha de nimotsu ga todokanakatta keiken ga aru n da.
options.translation: Iya, pernah ada pengalaman barang tidak sampai di perusahaan lain.
options.translationEn: Yeah, I've had an experience with another company where the item didn't arrive.

options.japanese: 一度もトラブルはなかったよ。
options.romaji: Ichido mo toraburu wa nakatta yo.
options.translation: Belum pernah ada masalah sama sekali.
options.translationEn: Never had a problem at all.

npcLine.japanese: それなら納得だね。
npcLine.romaji: Sore nara nattoku da ne.
npcLine.translationEn: That makes sense then.

titleEn: Explaining Why You Choose a Particular Shipping Service
descriptionEn: You explain to a friend why you always use a particular shipping company.

title: Mendiskusikan Perbedaan Layanan Pos Antar Negara
description: Kamu dan teman mendiskusikan perbedaan layanan pos Jepang dan negara lain.

npcLine.japanese: 日本の郵便サービスって、他の国と比べてどう思う？
npcLine.romaji: Nihon no yuubin saabisu tte, hoka no kuni to kurabete dou omou?
npcLine.translation: Layanan pos Jepang itu, menurutmu gimana dibandingkan negara lain?
npcLine.translationEn: How do you think Japan's postal service compares to other countries?

options.japanese: 正確さで言えば、日本はかなり優れていると思うよ。
options.romaji: Seikakusa de ieba, Nihon wa kanari sugurete iru to omou yo.
options.translation: Kalau bicara soal ketepatan, kurasa Jepang cukup unggul.
options.translationEn: Speaking of punctuality, I think Japan is quite superior.

options.japanese: 他の国と全く変わらないと思うよ。
options.romaji: Hoka no kuni to mattaku kawaranai to omou yo.
options.translation: Kupikir sama sekali tidak berbeda dari negara lain.
options.translationEn: I don't think it's different from other countries at all.

npcLine.japanese: インドネシアと比べたことある？
npcLine.romaji: Indoneshia to kurabeta koto aru?
npcLine.translationEn: Ever compared it with Indonesia?

options.japanese: うん、配達の速さには、正直驚かされたことがあるよ。
options.romaji: Un, haitatsu no hayasa ni wa, shoujiki odorokasareta koto ga aru yo.
options.translation: Iya, jujur pernah dibuat kagum dengan kecepatan pengirimannya.
options.translationEn: Yeah, honestly I've been impressed by the shipping speed before.

options.japanese: 全く違いを感じなかったよ。
options.translationEn: Don't feel any difference at all.

npcLine.japanese: 料金体系も違うの？
npcLine.romaji: Ryoukin taikei mo chigau no?
npcLine.translationEn: Is the fare system different too?

options.japanese: うん、距離や重さの計算方法からして異なる印象があるよ。
options.romaji: Un, kyori ya omosa no keisan houhou kara shite kotonaru inshou ga aru yo.
options.translation: Iya, kesannya berbeda dari cara menghitung jarak dan berat.
options.translationEn: Yeah, it feels different from how the distance and weight are calculated.

options.japanese: 料金体系は完全に同じだよ。
options.romaji: Ryoukin taikei wa kanzen ni onaji da yo.
options.translationEn: The fare system is exactly the same.

npcLine.japanese: どちらのサービスが好き？
npcLine.romaji: Dochira no saabisu ga suki?
npcLine.translationEn: Which service do you like?

options.japanese: 一概には言えないけど、それぞれ良さがあると思う。
options.romaji: Ichigai ni wa ienai kedo, sorezore yosa ga aru to omou.
options.translation: Tidak bisa dikatakan secara pasti, tapi kurasa masing-masing ada kelebihannya.
options.translationEn: Can't say for certain, but I think each has its own advantage.

options.japanese: 完全にどちらかが優れていると思う。
options.romaji: Kanzen ni dochira ka ga sugurete iru to omou.
options.translation: Kupikir salah satu jelas jauh lebih unggul.
options.translationEn: I think one is clearly far superior.

npcLine.japanese: 興味深い視点だね。
npcLine.romaji: Kyoumibukai shiten da ne.
npcLine.translationEn: That's an interesting perspective.

options.japanese: そう言ってもらえると嬉しいよ。
options.romaji: Sou itte moraeru to ureshii yo.

options.japanese: 別に面白くないと思うよ。
options.romaji: Betsu ni omoshirokunai to omou yo.
options.translationEn: I don't think it's interesting at all.

titleEn: Discussing Postal Service Differences Between Countries
descriptionEn: You and a friend discuss the differences between Japan's postal service and other countries'.

title: Menceritakan Pengalaman Kehilangan Paket
description: Kamu bercerita ke teman tentang pengalaman paket yang sempat hilang tak diketahui rimbanya.

npcLine.japanese: 荷物が行方不明になったことがあるって聞いたよ。
npcLine.romaji: Nimotsu ga yukuefumei ni natta koto ga aru tte kiita yo.
npcLine.translation: Kudengar pernah paketnya hilang tak diketahui rimbanya ya.
npcLine.translationEn: I heard your package once went missing without a trace.

options.japanese: うん、追跡情報が途中で止まってしまって、焦ったよ。
options.romaji: Un, tsuiseki jouhou ga tochuu de tomatte shimatte, aseta yo.
options.translation: Iya, info pelacakannya berhenti di tengah jalan, sampai panik.
options.translationEn: Yeah, the tracking info stopped halfway through, I panicked.

options.japanese: 一度も荷物をなくしたことないよ。
options.romaji: Ichido mo nimotsu wo nakushita koto nai yo.
options.translation: Belum pernah kehilangan paket sama sekali.
options.translationEn: Never lost a package at all.

npcLine.japanese: どうやって対処したの？
npcLine.romaji: Dou yatte taisho shita no?
npcLine.translationEn: How do you handle it?

options.japanese: すぐに配送会社に問い合わせることにしたんだ。
options.romaji: Sugu ni haisou gaisha ni toiawaseru koto ni shita n da.
options.translation: Aku memutuskan segera menanyakan ke perusahaan pengiriman.
options.translationEn: I decided to ask the shipping company right away.

options.japanese: 何もせずにただ待ち続けたよ。
options.romaji: Nanimo sezu ni tada machitsuzuketa yo.
options.translation: Hanya terus menunggu tanpa melakukan apa pun.
options.translationEn: Just kept waiting without doing anything.

npcLine.japanese: 結局見つかったの？
npcLine.romaji: Kekkyoku mitsukatta no?
npcLine.translationEn: Did you finally find it?

options.japanese: うん、別の配送センターに滞留していたことが分かったよ。
options.romaji: Un, betsu no haisou sentaa ni tairyuu shite ita koto ga wakatta yo.
options.translation: Iya, ternyata tertahan di pusat pengiriman lain.
options.translationEn: Yeah, it turned out to be held up at another distribution center.

options.japanese: 結局見つからず、諦めたよ。
options.translationEn: In the end I couldn't find it and gave up.

npcLine.japanese: 中身は無事だった？
npcLine.romaji: Nakami wa buji datta?
npcLine.translationEn: Did it arrive intact?

options.japanese: うん、幸い無事な状態で届いたよ。
options.romaji: Un, saiwai buji na joutai de todoita yo.
options.translation: Iya, untungnya sampai dalam kondisi selamat.

options.japanese: 中身は完全に壊れていたよ。
options.romaji: Nakami wa kanzen ni kowarete ita yo.

npcLine.japanese: 良かったね。
npcLine.romaji: Yokatta ne.
npcLine.translationEn: What a relief.

options.japanese: うん、本当に安心したよ。
options.romaji: Un, hontou ni anshin shita yo.

options.japanese: 全然安心できなかったよ。

titleEn: Talking About Losing a Package
descriptionEn: You tell a friend about a package that once went missing without a trace.

title: Menjelaskan Cara Mengurus Dokumen Pindah Alamat
description: Kamu menjelaskan ke teman cara mengurus penerusan surat setelah pindah rumah.

npcLine.japanese: 引っ越しの手続き、郵便局でも何かするの？
npcLine.romaji: Hikkoshi no tetsuzuki, yuubinkyoku demo nanika suru no?
npcLine.translation: Prosedur pindah rumah, ada juga yang diurus di kantor pos?
npcLine.translationEn: For moving procedures, is there also something handled at the post office?

options.japanese: うん、転送届を出しておくと、旧住所宛の郵便物も届くようになるよ。
options.romaji: Un, tensoutodoke wo dashite oku to, kyuujuusho ate no yuubinbutsu mo todoku you ni naru yo.
options.translation: Iya, kalau mengajukan formulir penerusan, surat yang dialamatkan ke alamat lama juga jadi bisa sampai.
options.translationEn: Yeah, if you submit a forwarding form, mail addressed to the old address can also be delivered.

options.japanese: 郵便局では特に何もしなくていいよ。
options.romaji: Yuubinkyoku dewa toku ni nanimo shinakute ii yo.
options.translation: Di kantor pos tidak perlu melakukan apa pun khususnya.
options.translationEn: Nothing in particular needs to be done at the post office.

npcLine.japanese: どのくらいの期間、有効なの？
npcLine.romaji: Dono kurai no kikan, yuukou na no?
npcLine.translationEn: How long is it valid for?

options.japanese: 一年間は有効だったと記憶しているよ。
options.romaji: Ichinenkan wa yuukou datta to kioku shite iru yo.
options.translation: Kalau tidak salah ingat, berlaku selama satu tahun.
options.translationEn: If I remember correctly, it's valid for one year.

options.japanese: 一週間しか有効じゃなかったよ。

npcLine.japanese: 手続きは簡単だった？
npcLine.romaji: Tetsuzuki wa kantan datta?
npcLine.translationEn: Is the process easy?

options.japanese: オンラインでも申請できて、意外と簡単だったよ。
options.romaji: Onrain demo shinsei dekite, igai to kantan datta yo.
options.translation: Bisa diajukan online juga, ternyata mudah di luar dugaan.
options.translationEn: It can also be applied for online, it turned out unexpectedly easy.

options.japanese: すごく複雑な手続きだったよ。
options.romaji: Sugoku fukuzatsu na tetsuzuki datta yo.

npcLine.japanese: 本人確認は必要だった？
npcLine.romaji: Honnin kakunin wa hitsuyou datta?
npcLine.translationEn: Need identity verification?

options.japanese: うん、身分証明書の提示を求められたよ。
options.romaji: Un, mibun shoumeisho no teiji wo motomerareta yo.
options.translationEn: Yeah, I was asked to show an ID card.

options.japanese: 本人確認は一切求められなかったよ。
options.romaji: Honnin kakunin wa issai motomerarenakatta yo.
options.translation: Sama sekali tidak diminta verifikasi identitas apa pun.
options.translationEn: Wasn't asked for any identity verification at all.

npcLine.japanese: 教えてくれてありがとう。
npcLine.romaji: Oshiete kurete arigatou.
npcLine.translationEn: Thanks for letting me know.

titleEn: Explaining How to Process a Change-of-Address Document
descriptionEn: You explain to a friend how to arrange mail forwarding after moving house.

title: Membicarakan Tren Belanja Online dan Dampaknya ke Jasa Kirim
description: Kamu membicarakan dampak tren belanja online terhadap industri pengiriman dengan teman.

npcLine.japanese: ネットショッピングの増加で、配送業界も大変そうだね。
npcLine.romaji: Netto shoppingu no zouka de, haisou gyoukai mo taihen sou da ne.
npcLine.translation: Karena belanja online makin banyak, industri pengiriman kelihatannya juga berat ya.
npcLine.translationEn: Since online shopping keeps increasing, the shipping industry looks tough too.

options.japanese: うん、配達員の人手不足が深刻になってきていると聞くよ。
options.romaji: Un, haitatsuin no hitode busoku ga shinkoku ni natte kite iru to kiku yo.
options.translation: Iya, kudengar kekurangan tenaga kurir jadi semakin parah.
options.translationEn: Yeah, I heard the courier staff shortage is getting worse.

options.japanese: 全く影響を受けていないと聞くよ。
options.romaji: Mattaku eikyou wo ukete inai to kiku yo.
options.translation: Kudengar sama sekali tidak terkena dampak.
options.translationEn: I heard it's not affected at all.

npcLine.japanese: 再配達の問題も大きいらしいね。
npcLine.romaji: Saihaitatsu no mondai mo ookii rashii ne.
npcLine.translation: Katanya masalah pengiriman ulang juga besar ya.
npcLine.translationEn: I heard the redelivery problem is significant too.

options.japanese: うん、不在による再配達が、業界の負担になっているみたいだよ。
options.romaji: Un, fuzai ni yoru saihaitatsu ga, gyoukai no futan ni natte iru mitai da yo.
options.translation: Iya, sepertinya pengiriman ulang karena tidak ada orang di rumah jadi beban bagi industri.
options.translationEn: Yeah, it seems redelivery due to no one being home has become a burden for the industry.

options.japanese: 再配達なんて一度も起きていないみたいだよ。
options.romaji: Saihaitatsu nante ichido mo okite inai mitai da yo.
options.translation: Sepertinya pengiriman ulang tidak pernah terjadi sama sekali.
options.translationEn: It seems redelivery never happens at all.

npcLine.japanese: 何か解決策はあるのかな。
npcLine.romaji: Nanika kaiketsusaku wa aru no ka na.
npcLine.translationEn: There's probably a solution.

options.japanese: 置き配を利用する人が、少しずつ増えているらしいよ。
options.romaji: Okihai wo riyou suru hito ga, sukoshi zutsu fuete iru rashii yo.
options.translation: Katanya orang yang memanfaatkan pengiriman tanpa kontak sedikit demi sedikit bertambah.
options.translationEn: They say people using contactless delivery are gradually increasing.

options.japanese: 解決策なんて存在しないと思うよ。
options.romaji: Kaiketsusaku nante sonzai shinai to omou yo.
options.translation: Kupikir tidak ada solusi apa pun.
options.translationEn: I don't think there's any solution.

npcLine.japanese: 自分も置き配を使ってる？
npcLine.romaji: Jibun mo okihai wo tsukatteru?
npcLine.translation: Kamu sendiri juga pakai pengiriman tanpa kontak?
npcLine.translationEn: Do you use contactless delivery too?

options.japanese: うん、在宅していない時は、よく利用しているよ。
options.romaji: Un, zaitaku shite inai toki wa, yoku riyou shite iru yo.
options.translation: Iya, waktu tidak di rumah, sering aku manfaatkan.
options.translationEn: Yeah, when I'm not home, I often make use of it.

options.japanese: 一度も利用したことないよ。
options.romaji: Ichido mo riyou shita koto nai yo.
options.translationEn: Never made use of it at all.

npcLine.japanese: 便利な時代になったよね。
npcLine.romaji: Benri na jidai ni natta yo ne.
npcLine.translation: Sudah jadi zaman yang praktis ya.
npcLine.translationEn: It's become a convenient era.

titleEn: Talking About the Online Shopping Trend and Its Impact on Shipping Services
descriptionEn: You talk about the impact of the online shopping trend on the shipping industry with a friend.

title: Menceritakan Pengalaman Bekerja Paruh Waktu sebagai Kurir
description: Kamu bercerita ke teman tentang pengalaman kerja paruh waktu sebagai kurir.

npcLine.japanese: 配達員のバイトしてたことあるって聞いたよ。
npcLine.romaji: Haitatsuin no baito shiteta koto aru tte kiita yo.
npcLine.translation: Kudengar pernah kerja paruh waktu sebagai kurir ya.
npcLine.translationEn: I heard you once worked part-time as a courier.

options.japanese: うん、大学生の頃、半年ほど働いていたことがあるよ。
options.romaji: Un, daigakusei no koro, hantoshi hodo hataraite ita koto ga aru yo.
options.translation: Iya, waktu kuliah, aku pernah kerja sekitar setengah tahun.
options.translationEn: Yeah, during college, I worked for about half a year.

options.japanese: 一度も働いたことないよ。
options.romaji: Ichido mo hataraita koto nai yo.

npcLine.japanese: どんなことが大変だった？
npcLine.romaji: Donna koto ga taihen datta?
npcLine.translationEn: What's tough?

options.japanese: 時間内に全て配り終えるのが、思っていた以上に大変だったよ。
options.romaji: Jikannai ni subete kubariowaru no ga, omotte ita ijou ni taihen datta yo.
options.translation: Menyelesaikan semua pengiriman dalam waktu yang ditentukan, ternyata lebih berat dari bayangan.
options.translationEn: Finishing all deliveries within the set time turned out to be tougher than imagined.

options.japanese: 全く大変じゃなかったよ。

npcLine.japanese: やりがいを感じることもあった？
npcLine.romaji: Yarigai wo kanjiru koto mo atta?
npcLine.translationEn: Ever felt job satisfaction too?

options.japanese: うん、お客さんに感謝された時は、やりがいを感じたよ。
options.romaji: Un, okyakusan ni kansha sareta toki wa, yarigai wo kanjita yo.
options.translation: Iya, waktu diucapkan terima kasih oleh pelanggan, merasakan kepuasan kerja.
options.translationEn: Yeah, when thanked by a customer, I feel job satisfaction.

options.japanese: やりがいなんて一度も感じたことないよ。
options.romaji: Yarigai nante ichido mo kanjita koto nai yo.
options.translation: Belum pernah merasakan kepuasan kerja sama sekali.
options.translationEn: Never felt job satisfaction at all.

npcLine.japanese: 天候にも左右されそうだね。
npcLine.romaji: Tenkou ni mo sayuu saresou da ne.
npcLine.translationEn: Seems like it's affected by the weather too.

options.japanese: うん、雨の日は特に大変だったな。
options.romaji: Un, ame no hi wa toku ni taihen datta na.
options.translation: Iya, hari hujan khususnya sangat berat.
options.translationEn: Yeah, rainy days especially are really tough.

options.japanese: 天候には全く左右されなかったよ。
options.romaji: Tenkou ni wa mattaku sayuu sarenakatta yo.
options.translationEn: Not affected by weather at all.

npcLine.japanese: いい経験になったんだね。
npcLine.romaji: Ii keiken ni natta n da ne.
npcLine.translationEn: That became a good experience.

options.japanese: うん、体力的にも精神的にも鍛えられたと思う。
options.romaji: Un, tairyokuteki ni mo seishinteki ni mo kitaerareta to omou.
options.translation: Iya, kurasa terlatih baik secara fisik maupun mental.
options.translationEn: Yeah, I think it trains you both physically and mentally.

options.japanese: あまり良くない経験だったな。
options.translationEn: Not that great of an experience.

titleEn: Talking About Working Part-Time as a Courier
descriptionEn: You tell a friend about your experience working part-time as a courier.

title: Menjelaskan Prosedur Klaim Asuransi Pengiriman
description: Kamu menjelaskan ke teman prosedur klaim asuransi untuk barang yang rusak saat dikirim.

npcLine.japanese: 送った荷物、保険で補償されたって聞いたけど、どんな手続きだったの？
npcLine.romaji: Okutta nimotsu, hoken de hoshou sareta tte kiita kedo, donna tetsuzuki datta no?
npcLine.translation: Kudengar barang yang dikirim diganti rugi lewat asuransi ya, prosedurnya seperti apa?
npcLine.translationEn: I heard the shipped item was compensated through insurance, what's the procedure like?

options.japanese: まず、破損状況を証明する書類を提出する必要があったんだ。
options.romaji: Mazu, hason joukyou wo shoumei suru shorui wo teishutsu suru hitsuyou ga atta n da.
options.translation: Pertama, harus mengajukan dokumen yang membuktikan kondisi kerusakan.
options.translationEn: First, you have to submit documents proving the damage.

options.japanese: 特に何も提出しなくて良かったよ。
options.romaji: Toku ni nanimo teishutsu shinakute yokatta yo.
options.translation: Tidak perlu mengajukan apa pun khususnya.
options.translationEn: Nothing in particular needs to be filed.

npcLine.japanese: 審査には時間がかかったの？
npcLine.romaji: Shinsa ni wa jikan ga kakatta no?
npcLine.translationEn: Does the process take time?

options.japanese: うん、結果が出るまで、二週間ほどかかったよ。
options.romaji: Un, kekka ga deru made, nishuukan hodo kakatta yo.
options.translation: Iya, sampai hasilnya keluar, perlu sekitar dua minggu.
options.translationEn: Yeah, it takes about two weeks until the results come out.

options.japanese: その場ですぐに結果が出たよ。
options.romaji: Sono ba de sugu ni kekka ga deta yo.
options.translationEn: The result came out right there on the spot.

npcLine.japanese: 補償額は満足いくものだった？
npcLine.romaji: Hoshougaku wa manzoku iku mono datta?
npcLine.translationEn: Was the compensation amount satisfactory?

options.japanese: 全額とまではいかなかったけど、納得できる金額だったよ。
options.romaji: Zengaku to made wa ikanakatta kedo, nattoku dekiru kingaku datta yo.
options.translation: Belum sampai penuh, tapi jumlahnya bisa diterima.
options.translationEn: Not quite full yet, but the amount is acceptable.

options.japanese: 全く納得できない金額だったよ。
options.romaji: Mattaku nattoku dekinai kingaku datta yo.
options.translation: Jumlahnya sama sekali tidak bisa diterima.
options.translationEn: The amount is not acceptable at all.

npcLine.japanese: 今後も保険をつけるつもり？
npcLine.romaji: Kongo mo hoken wo tsukeru tsumori?
npcLine.translation: Ke depannya juga berniat pasang asuransi?
npcLine.translationEn: Intending to get insurance going forward too?

options.japanese: うん、高価な物を送る時は、必ずつけるようにするよ。
options.romaji: Un, kouka na mono wo okuru toki wa, kanarazu tsukeru you ni suru yo.
options.translation: Iya, waktu kirim barang mahal, aku akan selalu pasangkan.
options.translationEn: Yeah, when sending an expensive item, I'll always add it.

options.japanese: もう保険には入らないつもりだよ。
options.romaji: Mou hoken ni wa hairanai tsumori da yo.
options.translation: Berniat tidak akan pakai asuransi lagi.
options.translationEn: Intending to never use insurance again.

npcLine.japanese: それがいいと思う。
npcLine.romaji: Sore ga ii to omou.
npcLine.translationEn: I think that's good.

options.japanese: どうでもいいと思うよ。
options.romaji: Dou demo ii to omou yo.
options.translationEn: I think it's up to you.

titleEn: Explaining the Shipping Insurance Claim Procedure
descriptionEn: You explain to a friend the insurance claim procedure for an item damaged during shipping.

title: Mendiskusikan Etika Menerima Paket Tetangga
description: Kamu bercerita ke teman tentang pengalaman menerima titipan paket tetangga.

npcLine.japanese: 隣の家の荷物、預かったことあるって言ってたよね。
npcLine.romaji: Tonari no ie no nimotsu, azukatta koto aru tte itteta yo ne.
npcLine.translation: Katanya pernah menerima titipan paket rumah sebelah ya.
npcLine.translationEn: I heard you once received a package on behalf of your next-door neighbor.

options.japanese: うん、留守だったみたいで、代わりに受け取ってあげたことがあるよ。
options.romaji: Un, rusu datta mitai de, kawari ni uketotte ageta koto ga aru yo.
options.translation: Iya, sepertinya sedang tidak ada orang, jadi aku terimakan sebagai gantinya.
options.translationEn: Yeah, it seemed no one was home, so I received it on their behalf.

options.japanese: そんなことは一度もしたことないよ。
options.romaji: Sonna koto wa ichido mo shita koto nai yo.
options.translation: Belum pernah melakukan hal seperti itu sama sekali.
options.translationEn: Never done anything like that at all.

npcLine.japanese: どんなことに気をつけた？
npcLine.romaji: Donna koto ni ki wo tsuketa?
npcLine.translationEn: What do you pay attention to?

options.japanese: できるだけ早く本人に渡すことを心がけたよ。
options.romaji: Dekiru dake hayaku honnin ni watasu koto wo kokorogaketa yo.
options.translation: Aku usahakan sebisa mungkin cepat menyerahkan langsung ke orangnya.
options.translationEn: I try to hand it directly to the person as quickly as possible.

options.japanese: 特に何も気をつけなかったよ。
options.romaji: Toku ni nanimo ki wo tsukenakatta yo.
options.translationEn: Nothing in particular was paid attention to.

npcLine.japanese: 相手は感謝してくれた？
npcLine.romaji: Aite wa kansha shite kureta?
npcLine.translationEn: Did the person involved say thanks?

options.japanese: うん、丁寧にお礼を言われて、こちらも嬉しくなったよ。
options.romaji: Un, teinei ni orei wo iwarete, kochira mo ureshiku natta yo.
options.translation: Iya, diucapkan terima kasih dengan sopan, aku juga jadi senang.
options.translationEn: Yeah, I was politely thanked, it made me happy too.

options.japanese: 特に何も言われなかったよ。

npcLine.japanese: 逆に頼むのは気が引ける？
npcLine.romaji: Gyaku ni tanomu no wa ki ga hikeru?
npcLine.translation: Sebaliknya kalau harus minta tolong jadi sungkan?
npcLine.translationEn: Conversely, do you feel awkward when you have to ask for help?

options.japanese: 正直、頼みごとをするのは少し気が引けるかな。
options.romaji: Shoujiki, tanomigoto wo suru no wa sukoshi ki ga hikeru ka na.
options.translation: Jujur, meminta tolong mungkin agak bikin sungkan.
options.translationEn: Honestly, asking for help might feel a bit awkward.

npcLine.japanese: いい関係を築けているんだね。
npcLine.romaji: Ii kankei wo kizukete iru n da ne.
npcLine.translation: Berarti sudah membangun hubungan yang baik ya.
npcLine.translationEn: So you've built a good relationship.

titleEn: Discussing the Etiquette of Receiving a Neighbor's Package
descriptionEn: You tell a friend about the experience of holding a package for a neighbor.

title: Menceritakan Pengalaman Mengirim Surat Penting
description: Kamu bercerita ke teman tentang pengalaman mengirim dokumen penting lewat pos tercatat.

npcLine.japanese: 大事な書類を郵送したことがあるって聞いたよ。
npcLine.romaji: Daiji na shorui wo yuusou shita koto ga aru tte kiita yo.
npcLine.translation: Kudengar pernah mengirim dokumen penting lewat pos ya.
npcLine.translationEn: I heard you once sent important documents by mail.

options.japanese: うん、絶対に紛失できないから、書留で送ったんだ。
options.romaji: Un, zettai ni funshitsu dekinai kara, kakitome de okutta n da.
options.translation: Iya, karena tidak boleh sampai hilang, aku kirim dengan pos tercatat.
options.translationEn: Yeah, since it can't be allowed to get lost, I sent it by registered mail.

options.japanese: 普通郵便で気軽に送ったよ。
options.romaji: Futsuu yuubin de kigaru ni okutta yo.
options.translationEn: Send it relaxed with regular mail.

npcLine.japanese: 追跡もできたの？
npcLine.romaji: Tsuiseki mo dekita no?
npcLine.translationEn: Can it be tracked too?

options.japanese: うん、配達状況をリアルタイムで確認できたよ。
options.romaji: Un, haitatsu joukyou wo riarutaimu de kakunin dekita yo.
options.translation: Iya, bisa cek status pengiriman secara real-time.
options.translationEn: Yeah, you can check the shipping status in real time.

options.japanese: 追跡は一切できなかったよ。

npcLine.japanese: 相手に無事届いた？
npcLine.romaji: Aite ni buji todoita?
npcLine.translation: Sampai dengan selamat ke pihak sana?
npcLine.translationEn: Did it arrive safely on their end?

options.japanese: うん、翌日には無事届いたと連絡が来たよ。
options.romaji: Un, yokujitsu ni wa buji todoita to renraku ga kita yo.
options.translation: Iya, keesokan harinya ada kabar sudah sampai dengan selamat.
options.translationEn: Yeah, the next day there was news it arrived safely.
In the end it didn't arrive.

npcLine.japanese: 安心したね。
npcLine.romaji: Anshin shita ne.
npcLine.translationEn: That's a relief.

options.japanese: うん、本当にほっとしたよ。
options.romaji: Un, hontou ni hotto shita yo.

options.japanese: 全然安心できなかったよ。

npcLine.japanese: 大事な物は書留に限るね。
npcLine.romaji: Daiji na mono wa kakitome ni kagiru ne.
npcLine.translation: Barang penting memang harus pos tercatat ya.
npcLine.translationEn: Important items really should be sent via registered mail.

titleEn: Talking About Sending an Important Letter
descriptionEn: You tell a friend about sending an important document via registered mail.

title: Menjelaskan Cara Melacak Paket yang Terlambat
description: Kamu menjelaskan ke teman cara melacak paket yang belum sampai padahal sudah lewat perkiraan.

npcLine.japanese: 荷物が届く予定日、もう過ぎてるんだけど、どうすればいい？
npcLine.romaji: Nimotsu ga todoku yoteibi, mou sugiteru n da kedo, dou sureba ii?
npcLine.translation: Tanggal perkiraan barang sampai, sudah lewat, harus bagaimana?
npcLine.translationEn: The estimated arrival date has passed, what should be done?

options.japanese: まず、追跡番号でサイトを確認してみるといいよ。
options.romaji: Mazu, tsuiseki bangou de saito wo kakunin shite miru to ii yo.
options.translation: Pertama, coba cek situsnya dengan nomor pelacakan dulu.
options.translationEn: First, try checking the website with the tracking number.

options.japanese: 何もせずにただ待てばいいよ。
options.romaji: Nanimo sezu ni tada mateba ii yo.
options.translation: Tinggal tunggu saja tanpa melakukan apa pun.
options.translationEn: Just have to wait without doing anything.

npcLine.japanese: それでも状況が分からない時は？
npcLine.romaji: Sore demo joukyou ga wakaranai toki wa?
npcLine.translation: Kalau tetap tidak jelas situasinya gimana?
npcLine.translationEn: What if the situation stays unclear?

options.japanese: 配送会社に直接問い合わせたほうが早いと思うよ。
options.romaji: Haisou gaisha ni chokusetsu toiawaseta hou ga hayai to omou yo.
options.translation: Kurasa lebih cepat kalau langsung tanya ke perusahaan pengiriman.
options.translationEn: I think it's faster to ask the shipping company directly.

options.japanese: 問い合わせても無駄だと思うよ。
options.romaji: Toiawasetemo muda da to omou yo.
options.translationEn: I think even asking is pointless.

npcLine.japanese: 問い合わせ先はどこで調べればいい？
npcLine.romaji: Toiawasesaki wa doko de shirabereba ii?
npcLine.translation: Kontak yang bisa dihubungi dicari di mana?
npcLine.translationEn: Where do you find a contact to reach?

options.japanese: 伝票に書いてある番号に連絡すればいいはずだよ。
options.romaji: Denpyou ni kaite aru bangou ni renraku sureba ii hazu da yo.
options.translation: Seharusnya cukup hubungi nomor yang tertulis di resi.
options.translationEn: Contacting the number written on the receipt should be enough.

options.japanese: 問い合わせ先なんて存在しないよ。
options.translation: Kontak yang bisa dihubungi tidak ada.
options.translationEn: There's no contact that can be reached.

npcLine.japanese: それでも見つからなかったら？
npcLine.romaji: Sore demo mitsukaranakattara?
npcLine.translationEn: What if it's still not found?

options.japanese: 最終的には、補償を申請することになると思う。
options.romaji: Saishuuteki ni wa, hoshou wo shinsei suru koto ni naru to omou.
options.translation: Pada akhirnya, kurasa akan mengajukan ganti rugi.
options.translationEn: In the end, I think I'll file for compensation.

options.japanese: その時は諦めるしかないと思う。
options.romaji: Sono toki wa akirameru shika nai to omou.
options.translation: Saat itu kurasa terpaksa merelakan saja.
options.translationEn: At that time, I think I just had to accept it.

npcLine.japanese: 教えてくれてありがとう。
npcLine.romaji: Oshiete kurete arigatou.
npcLine.translationEn: Thanks for letting me know.

titleEn: Explaining How to Track a Late Package
descriptionEn: You explain to a friend how to track a package that hasn't arrived despite being past its estimated date.

title: Membicarakan Masa Depan Layanan Pos di Era Digital
description: Kamu membicarakan masa depan layanan pos di era digital dengan teman.

npcLine.japanese: デジタル化が進んで、郵便局の役割も変わってきてるよね。
npcLine.romaji: Dejitaruka ga susunde, yuubinkyoku no yakuwari mo kawatte kiteru yo ne.
npcLine.translation: Digitalisasi berkembang, peran kantor pos juga berubah ya.
npcLine.translationEn: As digitalization advances, the post office's role is changing too.

options.japanese: うん、手紙より荷物の取り扱いが中心になってきている気がするよ。
options.romaji: Un, tegami yori nimotsu no toriatsukai ga chuushin ni natte kite iru ki ga suru yo.
options.translation: Iya, rasanya jadi lebih berfokus pada penanganan paket daripada surat.
options.translationEn: Yeah, it feels more focused on package handling than letters.

options.japanese: 全く変わっていないと思うよ。
options.romaji: Mattaku kawatte inai to omou yo.
options.translationEn: I don't think it's changed at all.

npcLine.japanese: 手紙を書く文化はなくなっていくと思う？
npcLine.romaji: Tegami wo kaku bunka wa nakunatte iku to omou?
npcLine.translation: Menurutmu budaya menulis surat akan hilang?
npcLine.translationEn: Do you think the culture of letter-writing will disappear?

options.japanese: 完全になくなることはないと思うけど、少なくなっていくとは思う。
options.romaji: Kanzen ni nakunaru koto wa nai to omou kedo, sukunaku natte iku to wa omou.
options.translation: Kupikir tidak akan sepenuhnya hilang, tapi kurasa akan berkurang.
options.translationEn: I don't think it'll disappear completely, but I think it'll decrease.

options.japanese: すぐに完全になくなると思うよ。
options.romaji: Sugu ni kanzen ni nakunaru to omou yo.
options.translationEn: I think it'll disappear completely soon.

npcLine.japanese: 郵便局はどう生き残っていくと思う？
npcLine.romaji: Yuubinkyoku wa dou ikinokotte iku to omou?
npcLine.translation: Menurutmu kantor pos akan bertahan bagaimana?
npcLine.translationEn: How do you think the post office will survive?

options.japanese: 物流の拠点としての役割を、強化していくんじゃないかな。
options.romaji: Butsuryuu no kyoten toshite no yakuwari wo, kyouka shite iku n janai ka na.
options.translation: Mungkin akan memperkuat perannya sebagai basis logistik.
options.translationEn: It'll probably strengthen its role as a logistics hub.

options.japanese: このまま何も変わらずに続くと思うよ。
options.romaji: Kono mama nanimo kawarazu ni tsuzuku to omou yo.
options.translation: Kupikir akan terus begitu saja tanpa berubah.
options.translationEn: I think it'll just keep going as is without changing.

npcLine.japanese: 新しいサービスとか始まりそうだね。
npcLine.romaji: Atarashii saabisu toka hajimarisou da ne.
npcLine.translation: Sepertinya akan mulai layanan baru juga ya.
npcLine.translationEn: Seems like a new service will start too.

options.japanese: うん、デジタルと連携したサービスが増えていくと思う。
options.romaji: Un, dejitaru to renkei shita saabisu ga fuete iku to omou.
options.translation: Iya, kurasa layanan yang terhubung dengan digital akan bertambah.
options.translationEn: Yeah, I think digitally connected services will increase.

options.japanese: 新しいサービスは一切増えないと思うよ。
options.romaji: Atarashii saabisu wa issai fuenai to omou yo.
options.translation: Kupikir layanan baru sama sekali tidak akan bertambah.
options.translationEn: I don't think new services will increase at all.

npcLine.japanese: 時代の変化は面白いね。
npcLine.romaji: Jidai no henka wa omoshiroi ne.
npcLine.translationEn: The changing times are interesting.

options.japanese: 別に面白くないと思うよ。
options.romaji: Betsu ni omoshirokunai to omou yo.
options.translationEn: I don't think it's interesting at all.

titleEn: Talking About the Future of Postal Services in the Digital Age
descriptionEn: You talk about the future of postal services in the digital age with a friend.

title: Mendiskusikan Cara Mengemas Barang Pecah Belah dengan Aman
description: Kamu dan teman mendiskusikan cara mengemas barang pecah belah dengan aman.

npcLine.japanese: 割れ物を送る時、どうやって梱包してる？
npcLine.romaji: Waremono wo okuru toki, dou yatte konpou shiteru?
npcLine.translation: Waktu kirim barang pecah belah, bagaimana cara mengemasnya?
npcLine.translationEn: When shipping fragile items, how do you package them?

options.japanese: まず、緩衝材でしっかり包むようにしているよ。
options.romaji: Mazu, kanshouzai de shikkari tsutsumu you ni shite iru yo.
options.translation: Pertama, aku usahakan bungkus dengan kuat menggunakan bahan peredam.
options.translationEn: First, I try to wrap it securely using cushioning material.

options.japanese: 特に何も気をつけずに、そのまま送っているよ。
options.romaji: Toku ni nanimo ki wo tsukezu ni, sono mama okutte iru yo.
options.translation: Tidak diperhatikan apa pun khususnya, dikirim begitu saja.
options.translationEn: Nothing in particular was paid attention to, just sent as is.

npcLine.japanese: 箱の中で動かないようにする工夫は？
npcLine.romaji: Hako no naka de ugokanai you ni suru kufuu wa?
npcLine.translation: Ada penyesuaian supaya tidak bergerak di dalam kotak?
npcLine.translationEn: Is there padding so it doesn't move around inside the box?

options.japanese: 隙間に新聞紙を詰めて、固定するようにしているよ。
options.romaji: Sukima ni shinbunshi wo tsumete, kotei suru you ni shite iru yo.
options.translation: Aku usahakan mengisi celah dengan kertas koran untuk mengamankannya.
options.translationEn: I try to fill the gaps with newspaper to secure it.

options.japanese: 隙間はそのままにしているよ。
options.romaji: Sukima wa sono mama ni shite iru yo.
options.translationEn: The gap was just left as is.

npcLine.japanese: 「割れ物注意」のシールは貼ってる？
npcLine.romaji: "Waremono chuui" no shiiru wa hatteru?
npcLine.translationEn: Was a 'fragile' sticker attached?

options.japanese: うん、必ず目立つところに貼るようにしているよ。
options.romaji: Un, kanarazu medatsu tokoro ni haru you ni shite iru yo.
options.translation: Iya, aku usahakan selalu tempel di tempat yang mencolok.
options.translationEn: Yeah, I always try to stick it somewhere visible.

options.japanese: シールは一度も貼ったことないよ。
options.romaji: Shiiru wa ichido mo hatta koto nai yo.
options.translation: Belum pernah menempel stiker sama sekali.
options.translationEn: Never put a sticker on it at all.

npcLine.japanese: それでも割れてしまったことある？
npcLine.romaji: Sore demo warete shimatta koto aru?
npcLine.translationEn: Even so, did it ever break anyway?

options.japanese: 正直、一度だけ割れてしまった経験があるよ。
options.romaji: Shoujiki, ichido dake warete shimatta keiken ga aru yo.
options.translation: Jujur, pernah sekali ada pengalaman sampai pecah.
options.translationEn: Honestly, I've had an experience once where it broke.

options.japanese: 一度も割れたことないよ。
options.romaji: Ichido mo wareta koto nai yo.

npcLine.japanese: それは残念だったね。
npcLine.romaji: Sore wa zannen datta ne.
npcLine.translationEn: That's unfortunate.

options.japanese: うん、それ以来もっと丁寧に梱包するようにしているよ。
options.romaji: Un, sore irai motto teinei ni konpou suru you ni shite iru yo.
options.translation: Iya, sejak itu aku usahakan kemas lebih hati-hati lagi.
options.translationEn: Yeah, since then I try to pack more carefully.

options.japanese: それでも特に気をつけていないよ。
options.romaji: Sore demo toku ni ki wo tsukete inai yo.
options.translation: Meski begitu tetap tidak diperhatikan apa pun.
options.translationEn: Even so, still nothing was paid attention to.

titleEn: Discussing How to Safely Pack Fragile Items
descriptionEn: You and a friend discuss how to safely pack fragile items.

title: Menjelaskan Alasan Membatalkan Rencana Liburan
description: Kamu menjelaskan ke teman kenapa membatalkan rencana liburan bulan depan.

npcLine.japanese: 来月の旅行、楽しみにしてたのに、キャンセルするって本当？
npcLine.romaji: Raigetsu no ryokou, tanoshimi ni shiteta noni, kyanseru suru tte hontou?
npcLine.translation: Liburan bulan depan, padahal ditunggu-tunggu, katanya batal, benar?
npcLine.translationEn: The vacation next month, even though you were looking forward to it, I heard it's canceled, is that right?

options.japanese: うん、急な仕事が入ってしまって、行けなくなったんだ。
options.romaji: Un, kyuu na shigoto ga haitte shimatte, ikenaku natta n da.
options.translation: Iya, ada kerjaan mendadak masuk, jadi tidak bisa pergi.
options.translationEn: Yeah, some urgent work came in, so I couldn't go.

options.japanese: いや、予定通り行くつもりだよ。
options.romaji: Iya, yotei doori iku tsumori da yo.
options.translation: Tidak, tetap berencana pergi sesuai jadwal.
options.translationEn: No, still planning to go as scheduled.

npcLine.japanese: キャンセル料とかかからなかった？
npcLine.romaji: Kyanseru ryou toka kakaranakatta?
npcLine.translationEn: No cancellation fee?

options.japanese: 結構な額を取られてしまったよ。
options.romaji: Kekkou na gaku wo torarete shimatta yo.
options.translationEn: Incurred quite a lot of cost.

options.japanese: 全くかからなかったよ。

npcLine.japanese: 悔しくない？
npcLine.romaji: Kuyashikunai?
npcLine.translationEn: Not annoyed?

options.japanese: 正直、すごく悔しいけど、仕方ないよね。
options.romaji: Shoujiki, sugoku kuyashii kedo, shikatanai yo ne.
options.translation: Jujur, sangat kesal, tapi tidak bisa dihindari ya.
options.translationEn: Honestly, really frustrating, but it can't be helped.

npcLine.japanese: また次の機会に行けるといいね。
npcLine.romaji: Mata tsugi no kikai ni ikeru to ii ne.
npcLine.translation: Semoga bisa pergi di kesempatan berikutnya ya.
npcLine.translationEn: Hope you can go next time.

options.japanese: うん、来年こそは絶対行きたいな。
options.romaji: Un, rainen koso wa zettai ikitai na.
options.translation: Iya, tahun depan pasti aku ingin pergi.
options.translationEn: Yeah, next year I definitely want to go.

options.japanese: もう二度と旅行には行かないつもりだよ。
options.romaji: Mou nidoto ryokou ni wa ikanai tsumori da yo.
options.translation: Berniat tidak akan bepergian lagi selamanya.

npcLine.japanese: 楽しみにしてるよ。
npcLine.romaji: Tanoshimi ni shiteru yo.
npcLine.translationEn: I've been looking forward to it.

titleEn: Explaining Why You're Canceling Vacation Plans
descriptionEn: You explain to a friend why you're canceling next month's vacation plans.

title: Menegosiasikan Cuti Panjang dengan Atasan
description: Kamu menegosiasikan cuti panjang dengan atasan untuk liburan.

npcLine.japanese: 長期休暇を取りたいと聞きましたが、本当ですか。
npcLine.romaji: Chouki kyuuka wo toritai to kikimashita ga, hontou desu ka.
npcLine.translation: Kudengar mau ambil cuti panjang, benar?
npcLine.translationEn: I heard you're taking a long leave, is that right?

options.japanese: はい、可能であれば、二週間ほどいただきたいと考えております。
options.romaji: Hai, kanou de areba, nishuukan hodo itadakitai to kangaete orimasu.
options.translation: Iya, kalau memungkinkan, saya berpikir ingin ambil sekitar dua minggu.
options.translationEn: Yeah, if possible, I'm thinking of taking about two weeks.

options.japanese: 特にそのような予定はございません。
options.romaji: Toku ni sono you na yotei wa gozaimasen.
options.translation: Tidak ada rencana seperti itu khususnya.

npcLine.japanese: 業務への影響は考えていますか。
npcLine.romaji: Gyoumu e no eikyou wa kangaete imasu ka.
npcLine.translationEn: Have you thought about the impact on your work?

options.japanese: はい、事前に引き継ぎを済ませておくつもりです。
options.romaji: Hai, jizen ni hikitsugi wo sumasete oku tsumori desu.
options.translation: Iya, saya berniat menyelesaikan serah terima terlebih dahulu.
options.translationEn: Yeah, I intend to finish the handover first.

options.japanese: それは特に考えておりません。
options.romaji: Sore wa toku ni kangaete orimasen.

npcLine.japanese: いつ頃を希望していますか。
npcLine.romaji: Itsugoro wo kibou shite imasu ka.
npcLine.translationEn: About when is it expected?

options.japanese: 来月の後半を希望しております。
options.romaji: Raigetsu no kouhan wo kibou shite orimasu.
options.translation: Saya berharap paruh kedua bulan depan.
options.translationEn: I'm hoping for the latter half of next month.

npcLine.japanese: 分かりました、調整してみましょう。
npcLine.romaji: Wakarimashita, chousei shite mimashou.
npcLine.translationEn: Understood, let's try arranging it.

options.japanese: ありがとうございます、よろしくお願いします。
options.translationEn: Thank you, please help me with this.

options.japanese: もう休暇は要りません。

npcLine.japanese: 良い休暇になるといいですね。
npcLine.romaji: Ii kyuuka ni naru to ii desu ne.
npcLine.translation: Semoga jadi cuti yang bagus ya.
npcLine.translationEn: Hope it's a good leave.

options.japanese: はい、ありがとうございます。
別に期待していません。

titleEn: Negotiating Extended Leave With Your Boss
descriptionEn: You negotiate extended leave with your boss for a vacation.

title: Menceritakan Pengalaman Liburan yang Berantakan
description: Kamu bercerita ke teman tentang liburan yang berantakan karena penerbangan terlambat.

npcLine.japanese: この前の旅行、大変だったって聞いたよ。
npcLine.romaji: Kono mae no ryokou, taihen datta tte kiita yo.
npcLine.translationEn: I heard the last vacation was tough.

options.japanese: うん、フライトが遅延して、予定が全部狂ってしまったんだ。
options.romaji: Un, furaito ga chien shite, yotei ga zenbu kurutte shimatta n da.
options.translation: Iya, penerbangannya terlambat, jadi semua rencana kacau.
options.translationEn: Yeah, the flight was late, so all the plans got messed up.

options.japanese: 全て予定通りに進んだよ。
options.romaji: Subete yotei doori ni susunda yo.

npcLine.japanese: それでどうしたの？
npcLine.romaji: Sore de dou shita no?
npcLine.translationEn: So what happened?

options.japanese: 予約していたホテルも変更せざるを得なかったよ。
options.romaji: Yoyaku shite ita hoteru mo henkou sezaru wo enakatta yo.
options.translation: Terpaksa mengubah hotel yang sudah dipesan juga.
options.translationEn: Had to change the already-booked hotel too.

options.japanese: 何も変更する必要はなかったよ。
options.romaji: Nanimo henkou suru hitsuyou wa nakatta yo.

npcLine.japanese: 大変だったね。
npcLine.romaji: Taihen datta ne.
npcLine.translationEn: That must be tough.

options.japanese: うん、途中で泣きそうになったよ。
options.romaji: Un, tochuu de nakisou ni natta yo.
options.translation: Iya, di tengah jalan hampir menangis.
options.translationEn: Yeah, partway through I almost cried.

npcLine.japanese: それでも楽しめた部分はあった？
npcLine.romaji: Sore demo tanoshimeta bubun wa atta?
npcLine.translation: Meski begitu ada bagian yang bisa dinikmati?
npcLine.translationEn: Even so, is there a part you can enjoy?

options.japanese: 意外と、思い出に残る旅行になったと思う。
options.romaji: Igai to, omoide ni nokoru ryokou ni natta to omou.
options.translation: Ternyata di luar dugaan, jadi liburan yang berkesan.
options.translationEn: It turned out unexpectedly, became a memorable vacation.

options.japanese: 全く楽しめなかったよ。

npcLine.japanese: いい経験になったんだね。
npcLine.romaji: Ii keiken ni natta n da ne.
npcLine.translationEn: That became a good experience.

options.japanese: あまりいい経験じゃなかったな。
options.translationEn: Not that great of an experience.

titleEn: Talking About a Vacation That Went Wrong
descriptionEn: You tell a friend about a vacation that fell apart because of a delayed flight.

title: Mendiskusikan Anggaran Liburan yang Membengkak
description: Kamu dan teman mendiskusikan anggaran liburan yang membengkak.

npcLine.japanese: 旅行の予算、結局オーバーしたって聞いたよ。
npcLine.romaji: Ryokou no yosan, kekkyoku oobaa shita tte kiita yo.
npcLine.translation: Kudengar anggaran liburan akhirnya kelebihan ya.
npcLine.translationEn: I heard the vacation budget ended up going over.

options.japanese: うん、想定していた以上にお金がかかってしまったよ。
options.romaji: Un, soutei shite ita ijou ni okane ga kakatte shimatta yo.
options.translation: Iya, jadi makan biaya lebih dari yang diperkirakan.
options.translationEn: Yeah, it ended up costing more than expected.

options.japanese: 予算内で完璧に収まったよ。
options.romaji: Yosannai de kanpeki ni osamatta yo.

npcLine.japanese: 何にそんなにかかったの？
npcLine.romaji: Nani ni sonna ni kakatta no?
npcLine.translationEn: What did it get spent on to reach that much?

options.japanese: 現地でのアクティビティ代が、思っていたより高くついたんだ。
options.romaji: Genchi de no akutibiti dai ga, omotte ita yori takaku tsuita n da.
options.translation: Biaya aktivitas di tempat tujuan ternyata lebih mahal dari perkiraan.
options.translationEn: The activity costs at the destination turned out more expensive than expected.

options.japanese: 何にも余分にはかからなかったよ。
options.romaji: Nan ni mo yobun ni wa kakaranakatta yo.
options.translation: Tidak ada yang makan biaya lebih sama sekali.

npcLine.japanese: 次回はどうする？
npcLine.romaji: Jikai wa dou suru?
npcLine.translationEn: How about next time?

options.japanese: 余裕を持った予算を組むようにしようと思う。
options.romaji: Yoyuu wo motta yosan wo kumu you ni shiyou to omou.
options.translation: Aku berpikir mau menyusun anggaran dengan lebih longgar.
options.translationEn: I'm thinking of setting a more relaxed budget.

options.japanese: 次回も同じように計画するつもりだよ。
options.romaji: Jikai mo onaji you ni keikaku suru tsumori da yo.
options.translation: Lain kali juga berniat rencanakan seperti biasa.
options.translationEn: Next time too, intending to plan as usual.

npcLine.japanese: 予備費とか用意しておいたほうがいいかもね。
npcLine.romaji: Yobihi toka youi shite oita hou ga ii kamo ne.
npcLine.translation: Mungkin sebaiknya siapkan dana cadangan juga ya.
npcLine.translationEn: Maybe it's also better to prepare an emergency fund.

options.japanese: そうだね、今度から取り入れてみる。
options.romaji: Sou da ne, kondo kara toriirete miru.
options.translation: Betul juga, mulai lain kali akan aku terapkan.
options.translationEn: True, I'll apply it starting next time.

options.japanese: 予備費なんて必要ないと思うよ。
options.romaji: Yobihi nante hitsuyou nai to omou yo.
options.translationEn: I don't think a reserve fund is necessary.

npcLine.japanese: いい教訓になったね。
npcLine.romaji: Ii kyoukun ni natta ne.
npcLine.translationEn: That became a good lesson.

options.japanese: 別に教訓にはならなかったよ。
options.romaji: Betsu ni kyoukun ni wa naranakatta yo.
options.translationEn: It wasn't really a lesson learned.

titleEn: Discussing a Ballooning Vacation Budget
descriptionEn: You and a friend discuss a vacation budget that ballooned.

title: Menjelaskan Alasan Memilih Liburan Solo
description: Kamu menjelaskan ke teman alasan memilih jalan-jalan sendirian.

npcLine.japanese: 一人旅、初めてだって聞いたけど、どうして始めたの？
npcLine.romaji: Hitoritabi, hajimete da tte kiita kedo, doushite hajimeta no?
npcLine.translation: Katanya jalan-jalan sendirian, ini pertama kali ya, kenapa mulai?
npcLine.translationEn: I heard this is your first time traveling alone, why did you start?

options.japanese: 誰にも気を遣わずに、自分のペースで楽しみたいと思ったんだ。
options.romaji: Dare ni mo ki wo tsukawazu ni, jibun no peesu de tanoshimitai to omotta n da.
options.translation: Aku berpikir ingin menikmati sesuai kecepatan sendiri tanpa memedulikan siapa pun.
options.translationEn: I want to enjoy it at my own pace without worrying about anyone else.

options.japanese: 誰かと一緒に行きたくてたまらないんだ。
options.romaji: Dareka to issho ni ikitakute tamaranai n da.
options.translationEn: Really want to go with someone.

npcLine.japanese: 不安はなかった？
npcLine.romaji: Fuan wa nakatta?
npcLine.translationEn: No anxiety?

options.japanese: 正直、出発前は少し不安だったよ。
options.romaji: Shoujiki, shuppatsu mae wa sukoshi fuan datta yo.
options.translationEn: Honestly, before departing I was a bit anxious.

options.japanese: 全く不安を感じなかったよ。

npcLine.japanese: 実際に行ってみてどうだった？
npcLine.romaji: Jissai ni itte mite dou datta?
npcLine.translationEn: How was it after you actually left?

options.japanese: 思っていた以上に、自由を満喫できたよ。
options.romaji: Omotte ita ijou ni, jiyuu wo mankitsu dekita yo.
options.translation: Bisa menikmati kebebasan lebih dari yang dibayangkan.
options.translationEn: Could enjoy more freedom than imagined.

options.japanese: 思っていたより自由を感じられなかったよ。
options.romaji: Omotte ita yori jiyuu wo kanjirarenakatta yo.
options.translation: Tidak merasakan kebebasan seperti yang dibayangkan.
options.translationEn: Not feeling the freedom I imagined.

npcLine.japanese: 寂しくなる瞬間はなかった？
npcLine.romaji: Sabishiku naru shunkan wa nakatta?
npcLine.translationEn: No moments of feeling lonely?

options.japanese: たまにはあったけど、それも含めて楽しめたよ。
options.romaji: Tamani wa atta kedo, sore mo fukumete tanoshimeta yo.
options.translation: Kadang ada, tapi termasuk itu pun bisa dinikmati.
options.translationEn: It happens sometimes, but even that can be enjoyed.

options.japanese: ずっと寂しさしかなかったよ。
options.translation: Sepanjang waktu cuma ada rasa kesepian.
options.translationEn: There was only a feeling of loneliness the whole time.

npcLine.japanese: また一人旅したいと思う？
npcLine.romaji: Mata hitoritabi shitai to omou?
npcLine.translationEn: Want to travel alone again?

options.japanese: うん、癖になりそうだよ。
options.romaji: Un, kuse ni narisou da yo.
options.translationEn: Yeah, it seems like it'll become a habit.

options.japanese: もう二度としたくないよ。

titleEn: Explaining Why You Chose a Solo Vacation
descriptionEn: You explain to a friend your reason for choosing to travel alone.

title: Membicarakan Perbedaan Gaya Liburan Antar Generasi
description: Kamu membicarakan perbedaan gaya liburan antar generasi dengan teman.

npcLine.japanese: 親世代と自分たちの旅行スタイル、結構違うと思わない？
npcLine.romaji: Oya sedai to jibuntachi no ryokou sutairu, kekkou chigau to omowanai?
npcLine.translation: Menurutmu gaya liburan generasi orang tua dan kita, cukup beda ya?
npcLine.translationEn: Don't you think our parents' generation's vacation style and ours are quite different?

options.japanese: うん、計画の立て方からして違う気がするよ。
options.romaji: Un, keikaku no tatekata kara shite chigau ki ga suru yo.
options.translation: Iya, dari cara membuat rencana saja rasanya sudah beda.
options.translationEn: Yeah, even just how you make plans feels different.

options.romaji: Mattaku onaji da to omou yo.
options.translationEn: I think it's exactly the same.

npcLine.japanese: どんなところが違うと思う？
npcLine.romaji: Donna tokoro ga chigau to omou?
npcLine.translationEn: Which part do you think is different?

options.japanese: 親世代はツアーを好む傾向があるけど、私たちは自由旅行が多い気がする。
options.romaji: Oya sedai wa tsuaa wo konomu keikou ga aru kedo, watashitachi wa jiyuu ryokou ga ooi ki ga suru.
options.translation: Generasi orang tua cenderung suka tur, tapi rasanya kita lebih banyak jalan-jalan bebas.
options.translationEn: Our parents' generation tends to like guided tours, but it feels like we do more independent travel.

options.japanese: どちらの世代も同じ傾向があると思うよ。
options.romaji: Dochira no sedai mo onaji keikou ga aru to omou yo.
options.translation: Kupikir kedua generasi punya kecenderungan yang sama.
options.translationEn: I think both generations have the same tendency.

npcLine.japanese: SNSの影響も大きいと思う？
npcLine.romaji: Esunuesu no eikyou mo ookii to omou?
npcLine.translation: Menurutmu pengaruh media sosial juga besar?
npcLine.translationEn: Do you think social media's influence is significant too?

options.japanese: うん、映える写真を撮ることが目的化している面もあると思う。
options.romaji: Un, haeru shashin wo toru koto ga mokutekika shite iru men mo aru to omou.
options.translation: Iya, kurasa ada juga sisi di mana mengambil foto yang bagus jadi tujuan tersendiri.
options.translationEn: Yeah, I think there's also a side where taking a good photo becomes a goal in itself.

options.japanese: SNSは全く関係ないと思うよ。
options.romaji: Esunuesu wa mattaku kankei nai to omou yo.
options.translation: Kupikir media sosial sama sekali tidak ada hubungannya.
options.translationEn: I don't think social media has anything to do with it at all.

npcLine.japanese: どちらのスタイルが好き？
npcLine.romaji: Dochira no sutairu ga suki?
npcLine.translationEn: Which style do you like?

options.japanese: 一概には言えないけど、どちらにもいい面があると思う。
options.romaji: Ichigai ni wa ienai kedo, dochira ni mo ii men ga aru to omou.
options.translation: Tidak bisa dikatakan secara pasti, tapi kurasa keduanya ada sisi bagusnya.
options.translationEn: Can't say for certain, but I think both have their good sides.

options.japanese: 完全に一方のスタイルしか認められないよ。
options.romaji: Kanzen ni ippou no sutairu shika mitomerarenai yo.
options.translation: Sama sekali tidak bisa menerima salah satu gaya saja.
options.translationEn: Can't accept just one style at all.

npcLine.japanese: 面白い視点だね。
npcLine.romaji: Omoshiroi shiten da ne.
npcLine.translationEn: That's an interesting perspective.

options.japanese: そう言ってもらえると嬉しいよ。
options.romaji: Sou itte moraeru to ureshii yo.

options.japanese: 別に面白くないと思うよ。
options.romaji: Betsu ni omoshirokunai to omou yo.
options.translationEn: I don't think it's interesting at all.

titleEn: Talking About Generational Differences in Vacation Style
descriptionEn: You talk about generational differences in vacation style with a friend.

title: Menceritakan Pengalaman Tersesat Saat Liburan
description: Kamu bercerita ke teman tentang pengalaman tersesat di jalan pegunungan saat liburan.

npcLine.japanese: 旅行中に迷子になったことがあるって言ってたよね。
npcLine.romaji: Ryokouchuu ni maigo ni natta koto ga aru tte itteta yo ne.
npcLine.translation: Katanya pernah tersesat saat liburan ya.
npcLine.translationEn: I heard you once got lost on vacation.

options.japanese: うん、山道で道に迷ってしまって、本当に焦ったよ。
options.romaji: Un, yamamichi de michi ni mayotte shimatte, hontou ni aseta yo.
options.translation: Iya, tersesat di jalan pegunungan, benar-benar panik.
options.translationEn: Yeah, got lost on a mountain road, really panicked.

options.japanese: 一度も迷ったことないよ。
options.romaji: Ichido mo mayotta koto nai yo.

npcLine.japanese: どうやって解決したの？
npcLine.romaji: Dou yatte kaiketsu shita no?
npcLine.translationEn: How did it get resolved?

options.japanese: 地図アプリを頼りに、なんとか元の道に戻れたよ。
options.romaji: Chizu apuri wo tayori ni, nantoka moto no michi ni modoreta yo.
options.translation: Bisa kembali ke jalan semula dengan mengandalkan aplikasi peta.
options.translationEn: Was able to get back to the original road by relying on the map app.

options.japanese: 誰にも頼らずに、感覚だけで戻れたよ。
options.romaji: Dare ni mo tayorazu ni, kankaku dake de modoreta yo.
options.translation: Bisa kembali hanya dengan insting tanpa mengandalkan apa pun.
options.translationEn: Was able to get back with just instinct, without relying on anything.

npcLine.japanese: 怖かったでしょう。
npcLine.romaji: Kowakatta deshou.
npcLine.translationEn: That must be scary.

options.japanese: うん、日が暮れかけていたから、余計に怖かったよ。
options.romaji: Un, hi ga kurekakete ita kara, yokei ni kowakatta yo.
options.translation: Iya, karena hari mulai gelap, jadi tambah takut.
options.translationEn: Yeah, since it started getting dark, it got even scarier.

npcLine.japanese: その後は気をつけるようになった？
npcLine.romaji: Sono ato wa ki wo tsukeru you ni natta?
npcLine.translationEn: Did you become more careful after that?

options.japanese: うん、事前に下調べをしっかりするようになったよ。
options.romaji: Un, jizen ni shitashirabe wo shikkari suru you ni natta yo.
options.translation: Iya, jadi terbiasa melakukan riset dengan baik sebelumnya.
options.translationEn: Yeah, I've gotten used to researching thoroughly beforehand.

options.japanese: 全く気をつけるようにならなかったよ。
options.romaji: Mattaku ki wo tsukeru you ni naranakatta yo.
options.translation: Sama sekali tidak jadi lebih hati-hati.

npcLine.japanese: いい教訓になったね。
npcLine.romaji: Ii kyoukun ni natta ne.
npcLine.translationEn: That became a good lesson.

options.japanese: 別に教訓にはならなかったよ。
options.romaji: Betsu ni kyoukun ni wa naranakatta yo.
options.translationEn: It wasn't really a lesson learned.

titleEn: Talking About Getting Lost on Vacation
descriptionEn: You tell a friend about getting lost on a mountain trail during a vacation.

title: Menjelaskan Cara Merencanakan Itinerary yang Efisien
description: Kamu menjelaskan ke teman cara merencanakan itinerary liburan yang efisien.

npcLine.japanese: 旅行の計画、いつも効率よく立ててるよね。
npcLine.romaji: Ryokou no keikaku, itsumo kouritsu yoku tateteru yo ne.
npcLine.translation: Rencana liburan, selalu disusun dengan efisien ya.
npcLine.translationEn: Vacation plans are always arranged efficiently, huh.

options.japanese: うん、移動時間を最小限に抑えることを意識しているよ。
options.romaji: Un, idou jikan wo saishougen ni osaeru koto wo ishiki shite iru yo.
options.translation: Iya, aku memperhatikan supaya waktu perjalanan ditekan seminimal mungkin.
options.translationEn: Yeah, I make sure to minimize travel time as much as possible.

options.japanese: 特に何も意識せずに計画しているよ。
options.romaji: Toku ni nanimo ishiki sezu ni keikaku shite iru yo.
options.translation: Merencanakan tanpa memperhatikan apa pun khususnya.
options.translationEn: Planning without paying attention to anything in particular.

npcLine.japanese: どうやって情報を集めてるの？
npcLine.romaji: Dou yatte jouhou wo atsumeteru no?
npcLine.translationEn: How do you gather information?

options.japanese: 現地の人の口コミを参考にすることが多いかな。
options.romaji: Genchi no hito no kuchikomi wo sankou ni suru koto ga ooi ka na.
options.translation: Mungkin sering menjadikan ulasan penduduk lokal sebagai referensi.
options.translationEn: Probably often uses local residents' reviews as a reference.

options.japanese: 情報は一切集めずに行くことが多いかな。
options.romaji: Jouhou wa issai atsumezu ni iku koto ga ooi ka na.
options.translation: Mungkin sering pergi tanpa mengumpulkan informasi apa pun.
options.translationEn: Probably often goes without gathering any information.

npcLine.japanese: 予備日は作ってる？
npcLine.romaji: Yobibi wa tsukutteru?
npcLine.translationEn: Do you set aside a backup day?

options.japanese: うん、何かあった時のために、一日は空けておくようにしているよ。
options.romaji: Un, nanika atta toki no tame ni, ichinichi wa akete oku you ni shite iru yo.
options.translation: Iya, aku usahakan kosongkan satu hari untuk berjaga-jaga kalau ada apa-apa.
options.translationEn: Yeah, I try to keep one day free just in case something comes up.

options.japanese: 予備日なんて考えたこともないよ。
options.romaji: Yobibi nante kangaeta koto mo nai yo.
options.translation: Belum pernah memikirkan hari cadangan sama sekali.
options.translationEn: Never thought about a backup day at all.

npcLine.japanese: 計画を立てすぎると疲れない？
npcLine.romaji: Keikaku wo tatesugiru to tsukarenai?
npcLine.translation: Kalau terlalu banyak buat rencana tidak capek?
npcLine.translationEn: Doesn't it get tiring making too many plans?

options.japanese: そこはバランスを取るように心がけているよ。
options.romaji: Soko wa baransu wo toru you ni kokorogakete iru yo.
options.translation: Bagian itu aku usahakan jaga keseimbangannya.
options.translationEn: I try to keep that part balanced.

options.japanese: 計画を立てれば立てるほど楽しいと思っているよ。
options.romaji: Keikaku wo tatereba tateru hodo tanoshii to omotte iru yo.
options.translation: Kupikir semakin banyak buat rencana semakin menyenangkan.
options.translationEn: I think the more you plan, the more fun it is.

npcLine.japanese: 参考になったよ、ありがとう。
npcLine.romaji: Sankou ni natta yo, arigatou.
npcLine.translationEn: That's a good reference, thanks.

titleEn: Explaining How to Plan an Efficient Itinerary
descriptionEn: You explain to a friend how to plan an efficient vacation itinerary.

title: Mendiskusikan Dampak Overtourism di Destinasi Populer
description: Kamu dan teman mendiskusikan dampak overtourism di destinasi populer.

npcLine.japanese: 人気の観光地、観光客が多すぎる問題があるらしいね。
npcLine.romaji: Ninki no kankouchi, kankoukyaku ga oosugiru mondai ga aru rashii ne.
npcLine.translation: Destinasi wisata populer, katanya ada masalah turis yang terlalu banyak ya.
npcLine.translationEn: I heard popular tourist destinations have an overtourism problem.

options.japanese: うん、地元住民の生活に支障が出ているところもあるらしいよ。
options.romaji: Un, jimoto juumin no seikatsu ni shishou ga dete iru tokoro mo aru rashii yo.
options.translation: Iya, katanya ada juga tempat yang kehidupan penduduk lokalnya jadi terganggu.
options.translationEn: Yeah, they say there are also places where the local residents' lives get disrupted.

options.japanese: 全く問題になっていないと思うよ。
options.romaji: Mattaku mondai ni natte inai to omou yo.
options.translation: Kupikir sama sekali tidak jadi masalah.
options.translationEn: I don't think it's a problem at all.

npcLine.japanese: どんな対策が取られているのかな。
npcLine.romaji: Donna taisaku ga torarete iru no ka na.
npcLine.translation: Tindakan seperti apa yang diambil ya kali.
npcLine.translationEn: I wonder what kind of action was taken.

options.japanese: 入場料を導入する動きが、広がりつつあるみたいだよ。
options.romaji: Nyuujouryou wo dounyuu suru ugoki ga, hirogaritsutsu aru mitai da yo.
options.translation: Sepertinya gerakan untuk menerapkan biaya masuk mulai menyebar.
options.translationEn: It seems the movement to introduce entry fees is starting to spread.

options.japanese: 何の対策も取られていないみたいだよ。
options.romaji: Nan no taisaku mo torarete inai mitai da yo.
options.translation: Sepertinya tidak ada tindakan apa pun yang diambil.
options.translationEn: It seems no action was taken at all.

npcLine.japanese: 観光客側にできることはある？
npcLine.romaji: Kankoukyaku gawa ni dekiru koto wa aru?
npcLine.translation: Ada yang bisa dilakukan dari pihak turis?
npcLine.translationEn: Is there anything tourists can do?

options.japanese: 混雑を避けて、時期をずらして訪れることも一つの手だと思う。
options.romaji: Konzatsu wo sakete, jiki wo zurashite otozureru koto mo hitotsu no te da to omou.
options.translation: Kurasa menghindari keramaian dan mengunjungi dengan menggeser waktu juga salah satu caranya.
options.translationEn: I think avoiding crowds and visiting at a different time is also one way.

options.japanese: 観光客にできることは何もないと思う。
options.romaji: Kankoukyaku ni dekiru koto wa nanimo nai to omou.
options.translation: Kupikir tidak ada yang bisa dilakukan turis apa pun.
options.translationEn: I don't think there's anything a tourist can do.

npcLine.japanese: マナーも大事だよね。
npcLine.romaji: Manaa mo daiji da yo ne.
npcLine.translationEn: Etiquette matters too.

options.japanese: うん、地域の文化を尊重する姿勢が求められると思う。
options.romaji: Un, chiiki no bunka wo sonchou suru shisei ga motomerareru to omou.
options.translation: Iya, kurasa dibutuhkan sikap menghormati budaya daerah.
options.translationEn: Yeah, I think an attitude of respecting local culture is needed.

options.japanese: マナーなんて特に気にしなくていいと思うよ。
options.romaji: Manaa nante toku ni ki ni shinakute ii to omou yo.
options.translation: Kupikir etika tidak perlu terlalu dipedulikan.
options.translationEn: I don't think etiquette needs to be worried about too much.

npcLine.japanese: 難しい問題だね。
npcLine.romaji: Muzukashii mondai da ne.
npcLine.translationEn: That's a difficult problem.

options.japanese: 別に難しくないと思うよ。
options.romaji: Betsu ni muzukashikunai to omou yo.
options.translationEn: I don't think it's difficult at all.

titleEn: Discussing the Impact of Overtourism at Popular Destinations
descriptionEn: You and a friend discuss the impact of overtourism at popular destinations.

title: Menceritakan Pengalaman Liburan Bersama Keluarga Besar
description: Kamu bercerita ke teman tentang pengalaman liburan bersama keluarga besar.

npcLine.japanese: 大家族での旅行、大変だったんじゃない？
npcLine.romaji: Daikazoku de no ryokou, taihen datta n janai?
npcLine.translation: Liburan dengan keluarga besar, pasti berat ya?
npcLine.translationEn: A vacation with the extended family must be tough, right?

options.japanese: うん、全員の希望を調整するのが、想像以上に大変だったよ。
options.romaji: Un, zen'in no kibou wo chousei suru no ga, souzou ijou ni taihen datta yo.
options.translation: Iya, mengatur keinginan semua orang, ternyata lebih berat dari bayangan.
options.translationEn: Yeah, coordinating everyone's wishes turned out tougher than imagined.

options.japanese: 全然大変じゃなかったよ。

npcLine.japanese: 具体的にどんなことで揉めたの？
npcLine.romaji: Gutaiteki ni donna koto de mometa no?
npcLine.translationEn: Specifically, what was the argument about?

options.japanese: 行き先を決める段階から、意見が分かれてしまったんだ。
options.romaji: Ikisaki wo kimeru dankai kara, iken ga wakarete shimatta n da.
options.translation: Sejak tahap menentukan tujuan saja, pendapat sudah terpecah.
options.translationEn: Even from the stage of deciding the destination, opinions were already divided.

options.japanese: 全員があっさり同じ意見でまとまったよ。
options.romaji: Zen'in ga assari onaji iken de matomatta yo.
options.translation: Semua langsung sepakat dengan pendapat yang sama.
options.translationEn: Everyone immediately agreed on the same opinion.

npcLine.japanese: どうやってまとめたの？
npcLine.romaji: Dou yatte matometa no?
npcLine.translationEn: How do you bring it together?

options.japanese: 多数決も交えながら、なんとか折り合いをつけたよ。
options.romaji: Tasuuketsu mo majienagara, nantoka oriai wo tsuketa yo.
options.translation: Sambil menyisipkan voting mayoritas juga, entah bagaimana bisa mencapai kesepakatan.
options.translationEn: While also incorporating a majority vote, somehow we managed to reach an agreement.

options.japanese: 何も話し合わずに決めたよ。

npcLine.japanese: それでも楽しめた？
npcLine.romaji: Sore demo tanoshimeta?
npcLine.translationEn: Even so, can it still be enjoyed?

options.japanese: うん、大変だったけど、いい思い出になったよ。
options.romaji: Un, taihen datta kedo, ii omoide ni natta yo.
options.translation: Iya, meski berat, jadi kenangan yang bagus.
options.translationEn: Yeah, even though it was tough, it became a good memory.

options.japanese: 全く楽しめなかったよ。

npcLine.japanese: いい経験だったね。
npcLine.romaji: Ii keiken datta ne.
npcLine.translationEn: That's a good experience.

options.japanese: うん、また機会があればやりたいな。
options.romaji: Un, mata kikai ga areba yaritai na.
options.translation: Iya, kalau ada kesempatan lagi ingin melakukannya.
options.translationEn: Yeah, if I get the chance again I want to do it.

options.japanese: もう二度とやりたくないな。

titleEn: Talking About Vacationing With Extended Family
descriptionEn: You tell a friend about vacationing with your extended family.

title: Menjelaskan Alasan Memilih Staycation daripada Bepergian
description: Kamu menjelaskan ke teman kenapa memilih staycation daripada bepergian tahun ini.

npcLine.japanese: 今年の休みは、旅行しないで家で過ごすんだって？
npcLine.romaji: Kotoshi no yasumi wa, ryokou shinaide ie de sugosu n datte?
npcLine.translation: Liburan tahun ini, katanya tidak bepergian dan habiskan waktu di rumah ya?
npcLine.translationEn: I heard this year's vacation is spent at home without traveling?

options.japanese: うん、たまにはゆっくり休むことも大事だと思ったんだ。
options.romaji: Un, tamani wa yukkuri yasumu koto mo daiji da to omotta n da.
options.translation: Iya, aku berpikir kadang istirahat dengan tenang juga penting.
options.translationEn: Yeah, I think resting calmly sometimes is important too.

options.japanese: 旅行の計画は特に立てていないだけだよ。
options.romaji: Ryokou no keikaku wa toku ni tatete inai dake da yo.
options.translation: Hanya sekadar belum buat rencana liburan.
options.translationEn: Just simply haven't made vacation plans yet.

npcLine.japanese: 移動疲れがないのはいいよね。
npcLine.romaji: Idou tsukare ga nai no wa ii yo ne.
npcLine.translation: Bagus juga tidak ada kelelahan karena perjalanan ya.
npcLine.translationEn: It's also good there's no travel fatigue.

options.japanese: うん、それも大きなメリットの一つだと思っているよ。
options.romaji: Un, sore mo ookina meritto no hitotsu da to omotte iru yo.
options.translation: Iya, kupikir itu juga salah satu keuntungan besar.
options.translationEn: Yeah, I think that's one of the big advantages too.

options.japanese: 移動疲れなんて全く関係ないよ。
options.romaji: Idou tsukare nante mattaku kankei nai yo.
options.translation: Kelelahan perjalanan sama sekali tidak ada hubungannya.
options.translationEn: Travel fatigue has nothing to do with it at all.

npcLine.japanese: 家で何をして過ごすの？
npcLine.romaji: Ie de nani wo shite sugosu no?
npcLine.translationEn: What have you been doing at home?

options.japanese: 溜まっていた本を読んだり、映画を見たりするつもりだよ。
options.romaji: Tamatte ita hon wo yondari, eiga wo mitari suru tsumori da yo.
options.translation: Berniat baca buku yang menumpuk, atau nonton film.
options.translationEn: Intending to read the pile of books, or watch a movie.

options.japanese: 特に何もせずに、ただ寝ているつもりだよ。
options.romaji: Toku ni nanimo sezu ni, tada nete iru tsumori da yo.
options.translation: Berniat tidur saja tanpa melakukan apa pun.
options.translationEn: Intending to just sleep without doing anything.

npcLine.japanese: 節約にもなりそうだね。
npcLine.romaji: Setsuyaku ni mo narisou da ne.
npcLine.translationEn: Seems like it saves money too.

options.japanese: うん、それも理由の一つなんだ。
options.romaji: Un, sore mo riyuu no hitotsu nan da.
options.translation: Iya, itu juga salah satu alasannya.
options.translationEn: Yeah, that's one of the reasons too.

options.japanese: 節約は全く関係ないよ。
options.romaji: Setsuyaku wa mattaku kankei nai yo.
options.translation: Hemat sama sekali tidak ada hubungannya.
options.translationEn: Saving money has nothing to do with it at all.

npcLine.japanese: いい休み方だね。
npcLine.romaji: Ii yasumikata da ne.
npcLine.translationEn: That's a good way to rest.

options.japanese: ありがとう、そう思うよ。
別にいい休み方だとは思わないよ。
options.romaji: Betsu ni ii yasumikata da to wa omowanai yo.
options.translation: Kupikir bukan cara istirahat yang bagus.
options.translationEn: I don't think it's a good way to rest.

titleEn: Explaining Why You Chose a Staycation Over Traveling
descriptionEn: You explain to a friend why you chose a staycation over traveling this year.

title: Membicarakan Kebiasaan Menabung untuk Liburan
description: Kamu membicarakan kebiasaan menabung untuk liburan dengan teman.

npcLine.japanese: 旅行のために、貯金してるって聞いたよ。
npcLine.romaji: Ryokou no tame ni, chokin shiteru tte kiita yo.
npcLine.translation: Kudengar sedang menabung untuk liburan ya.
npcLine.translationEn: I heard you're saving up for a vacation.

options.japanese: うん、毎月決まった額を、旅行用の口座に入れているんだ。
options.romaji: Un, maitsuki kimatta gaku wo, ryokouyou no kouza ni irete iru n da.
options.translation: Iya, aku masukkan jumlah tetap tiap bulan ke rekening khusus liburan.
options.translationEn: Yeah, I put a fixed amount every month into a dedicated vacation account.

options.japanese: 特に貯金なんてしていないよ。
options.romaji: Toku ni chokin nante shite inai yo.
options.translation: Sama sekali tidak menabung apa pun khususnya.
options.translationEn: Not saving anything in particular at all.

npcLine.japanese: どのくらい目標にしてるの？
npcLine.romaji: Dono kurai mokuhyou ni shiteru no?
npcLine.translationEn: What target has been set?

options.japanese: 半年で三十万円貯めることを目標にしているよ。
options.romaji: Hantoshi de sanjuuman'en tameru koto wo mokuhyou ni shite iru yo.
options.translation: Aku targetkan menabung 300 ribu yen dalam setengah tahun.
options.translationEn: I'm targeting saving 300,000 yen within half a year.

options.japanese: 特に目標は決めていないよ。
options.romaji: Toku ni mokuhyou wa kimete inai yo.

npcLine.japanese: 誘惑に負けそうになることはない？
npcLine.romaji: Yuuwaku ni makesou ni naru koto wa nai?
npcLine.translation: Tidak pernah hampir kalah dengan godaan?
npcLine.translationEn: Never nearly given in to temptation?

options.japanese: 正直、たまに使いたくなる時もあるよ。
options.romaji: Shoujiki, tamani tsukaitaku naru toki mo aru yo.
options.translation: Jujur, kadang juga muncul keinginan untuk pakai.
options.translationEn: Honestly, sometimes the urge to use it comes up too.

options.japanese: 全く誘惑を感じたことないよ。
options.romaji: Mattaku yuuwaku wo kanjita koto nai yo.
options.translation: Sama sekali tidak pernah merasakan godaan.

npcLine.japanese: どうやって我慢してるの？
npcLine.romaji: Dou yatte gaman shiteru no?
npcLine.translationEn: How do you hold yourself back?

options.japanese: 旅行先の写真を見て、モチベーションを保つようにしているよ。
options.romaji: Ryokousaki no shashin wo mite, mochibeeshon wo tamotsu you ni shite iru yo.
options.translation: Aku usahakan jaga motivasi dengan lihat foto tempat tujuan liburan.
options.translationEn: I try to keep my motivation up by looking at photos of the vacation destination.

options.japanese: 特に何もせずに我慢しているよ。
options.romaji: Toku ni nanimo sezu ni gaman shite iru yo.
options.translation: Cuma menahan diri tanpa melakukan apa pun.
options.translationEn: Just holding back without doing anything.

npcLine.japanese: いい方法だね。
npcLine.romaji: Ii houhou da ne.
npcLine.translationEn: That's a good method.

options.japanese: あまりおすすめしないよ。

titleEn: Talking About Saving Habits for Vacation
descriptionEn: You talk about saving habits for vacation with a friend.

title: Menceritakan Pengalaman Liburan yang Mengubah Cara Pandang
description: Kamu bercerita ke teman tentang liburan yang mengubah cara pandang hidupmu.

npcLine.japanese: あの旅行、人生観が変わったって言ってたよね。
npcLine.romaji: Ano ryokou, jinseikan ga kawatta tte itteta yo ne.
npcLine.translation: Katanya liburan itu mengubah pandangan hidup ya.
npcLine.translationEn: I heard that vacation changed your outlook on life.

options.japanese: うん、貧しくても幸せそうな人たちを見て、価値観が変わったんだ。
options.romaji: Un, mazushikutemo shiawase sou na hitotachi wo mite, kachikan ga kawatta n da.
options.translation: Iya, melihat orang-orang yang meski miskin terlihat bahagia, nilai-nilaiku jadi berubah.
options.translationEn: Yeah, seeing people who look happy even though they're poor changed my values.

options.japanese: 特に何も変わらなかったよ。
options.translation: Sama sekali tidak ada yang berubah.

npcLine.japanese: 具体的にどう変わったの？
npcLine.romaji: Gutaiteki ni dou kawatta no?
npcLine.translationEn: Specifically, how did it change?

options.japanese: 物質的な豊かさだけが幸せじゃないと、気づかされたんだ。
options.romaji: Busshitsuteki na yutakasa dake ga shiawase janai to, kizukasareta n da.
options.translation: Aku jadi disadarkan bahwa kekayaan materi saja bukan segalanya untuk bahagia.
options.translationEn: It made me realize material wealth alone isn't everything for happiness.

options.japanese: やっぱりお金が全てだと確信したよ。
options.romaji: Yappari okane ga subete da to kakushin shita yo.
options.translation: Aku semakin yakin bahwa uang adalah segalanya.
options.translationEn: I've become more convinced that money is everything.

npcLine.japanese: 帰国してからも、その考えは続いてる？
npcLine.romaji: Kikoku shite kara mo, sono kangae wa tsuzuiteru?
npcLine.translation: Setelah pulang juga, pemikiran itu masih berlanjut?
npcLine.translationEn: Even after coming home, did that thought still continue?

options.japanese: うん、今でもその時の気持ちを大切にしているよ。
options.romaji: Un, ima demo sono toki no kimochi wo taisetsu ni shite iru yo.
options.translation: Iya, sampai sekarang masih aku jaga perasaan saat itu.
options.translationEn: Yeah, I still hold onto that feeling from back then.

options.japanese: 帰国したらすぐに忘れてしまったよ。
options.romaji: Kikoku shitara sugu ni wasurete shimatta yo.
options.translationEn: Forgot the moment I got home.

npcLine.japanese: すごい経験だったんだね。
npcLine.romaji: Sugoi keiken datta n da ne.
npcLine.translationEn: That's an amazing experience.

options.japanese: うん、人生の中でも特別な旅だったと思う。
options.romaji: Un, jinsei no naka demo tokubetsu na tabi datta to omou.
options.translation: Iya, kurasa perjalanan yang spesial dalam hidupku.
options.translationEn: Yeah, I think it's a special journey in my life.

options.japanese: 別に特別な旅ではなかったよ。
options.romaji: Betsu ni tokubetsu na tabi dewa nakatta yo.

npcLine.japanese: 私もそんな経験をしてみたいな。
npcLine.romaji: Watashi mo sonna keiken wo shite mitai na.
npcLine.translation: Aku juga ingin coba mengalami pengalaman seperti itu.
npcLine.translationEn: I want to try experiencing something like that too.

options.japanese: あまりおすすめしないよ。

titleEn: Talking About a Vacation That Changed Your Perspective
descriptionEn: You tell a friend about a vacation that changed your outlook on life.

title: Menjelaskan Cara Memilih Akomodasi yang Tepat
description: Kamu menjelaskan ke teman cara memilih akomodasi liburan yang tepat.

npcLine.japanese: 宿選び、いつも慎重にしてるよね。
npcLine.romaji: Yado erabi, itsumo shinchou ni shiteru yo ne.
npcLine.translationEn: Always careful when choosing accommodation, huh.

options.japanese: うん、立地とレビューを重視して選ぶようにしているよ。
options.romaji: Un, tacchi to rebyuu wo juushi shite erabu you ni shite iru yo.
options.translation: Iya, aku usahakan pilih dengan mengutamakan lokasi dan ulasan.
options.translationEn: Yeah, I try to choose by prioritizing location and reviews.

options.japanese: 特に何も気にせず適当に選んでいるよ。
options.romaji: Toku ni nanimo ki ni sezu tekitou ni erande iru yo.
options.translation: Memilih asal saja tanpa memperhatikan apa pun khususnya.
options.translationEn: Choosing randomly without paying attention to anything in particular.

npcLine.japanese: 値段も気にする？
npcLine.romaji: Nedan mo ki ni suru?
npcLine.translationEn: Do you pay attention to the price too?

options.japanese: もちろん、予算内で一番良さそうな宿を探すようにしているよ。
options.romaji: Mochiron, yosannai de ichiban yosasou na yado wo sagasu you ni shite iru yo.
options.translation: Tentu, aku usahakan cari penginapan yang kelihatan paling bagus dalam anggaran.
options.translationEn: Sure, I try to find the accommodation that looks the best within the budget.

options.japanese: 値段は全く気にしていないよ。
options.romaji: Nedan wa mattaku ki ni shite inai yo.
options.translationEn: Price isn't cared about at all.

npcLine.japanese: 失敗したことある？
npcLine.romaji: Shippai shita koto aru?
npcLine.translationEn: Ever failed?

options.japanese: 一度、写真と実際の様子が全然違ったことがあるよ。
options.romaji: Ichido, shashin to jissai no yousu ga zenzen chigatta koto ga aru yo.
