npcLine.japanese: 目標額とか決めてる？
npcLine.romaji: Mokuhyougaku toka kimeteru?
npcLine.translationEn: Setting a target amount?

options.japanese: うん、大まかな目標額は設定しているよ。
options.romaji: Un, oomaka na mokuhyougaku wa settei shite iru yo.
options.translation: Iya, aku sudah tentukan target jumlah kasarnya.
options.translationEn: Yeah, I've already set a rough target amount.

options.japanese: 目標額なんて考えたこともないよ。
options.romaji: Mokuhyougaku nante kangaeta koto mo nai yo.
options.translation: Belum pernah memikirkan target jumlah sama sekali.
options.translationEn: Never thought about a target amount at all.

npcLine.japanese: 不安に思うことはない？
npcLine.romaji: Fuan ni omou koto wa nai?
npcLine.translationEn: Anything worrying you?

options.japanese: 正直、インフレの影響には不安を感じているよ。
options.romaji: Shoujiki, infure no eikyou ni wa fuan wo kanjite iru yo.
options.translation: Jujur, merasakan kecemasan soal pengaruh inflasi.
options.translationEn: Honestly, I feel anxious about the effects of inflation.

options.japanese: 全く不安に思うことはないよ。
options.romaji: Mattaku fuan ni omou koto wa nai yo.
options.translation: Sama sekali tidak ada yang dikhawatirkan.
options.translationEn: Nothing to worry about at all.

npcLine.japanese: 計画的だね。
npcLine.romaji: Keikakuteki da ne.
npcLine.translationEn: That's well-planned.

options.japanese: ありがとう、そう心がけているよ。
options.translationEn: Thank you, I'll try to do that.

options.japanese: 別に計画的じゃないよ。

titleEn: Explaining How to Plan for Retirement Savings
descriptionEn: You explain to a friend how to plan for retirement savings.

title: Membicarakan Literasi Keuangan yang Kurang di Masyarakat
description: Kamu membicarakan literasi keuangan yang kurang di masyarakat dengan teman.

npcLine.japanese: 日本人って、金融の知識があまりないってよく言われるよね。
npcLine.romaji: Nihonjin tte, kin'yuu no chishiki ga amari nai tte yoku iwareru yo ne.
npcLine.translation: Katanya orang Jepang kurang punya pengetahuan finansial ya.
npcLine.translationEn: I heard Japanese people tend to lack financial literacy.

options.japanese: うん、学校でお金について学ぶ機会が、少なかったことも一因だと思う。
options.romaji: Un, gakkou de okane ni tsuite manabu kikai ga, sukunakatta koto mo ichiin da to omou.
options.translation: Iya, kurasa kesempatan belajar soal uang di sekolah yang sedikit juga jadi salah satu penyebab.
options.translationEn: Yeah, I think the lack of opportunities to learn about money in school is also one of the causes.

options.japanese: 全くそんなことはないと思うよ。
options.romaji: Mattaku sonna koto wa nai to omou yo.
options.translation: Kupikir sama sekali tidak seperti itu.
options.translationEn: I don't think it's like that at all.

npcLine.japanese: 自分は投資とか詳しい？
npcLine.romaji: Jibun wa toushi toka kuwashii?
npcLine.translationEn: Do you understand investing yourself?

options.japanese: 正直、最近になってようやく勉強し始めたところなんだ。
options.romaji: Shoujiki, saikin ni natte youyaku benkyou shihajimeta tokoro nan da.
options.translation: Jujur, baru-baru ini akhirnya mulai belajar.
options.translationEn: Honestly, I only recently started learning.

options.japanese: 昔からずっと詳しかったよ。
options.translationEn: Always understood it from the start.

npcLine.japanese: どうやって勉強してるの？
npcLine.romaji: Dou yatte benkyou shiteru no?
npcLine.translationEn: How do you study?

options.japanese: 本を読んだり、セミナーに参加したりしているよ。
options.romaji: Hon wo yondari, seminaa ni sanka shitari shite iru yo.
options.translation: Aku baca buku atau ikut seminar.
options.translationEn: I read books or attend seminars.

options.japanese: 特に何も勉強していないよ。
options.romaji: Toku ni nanimo benkyou shite inai yo.

npcLine.japanese: 子供にも早く教えたほうがいいのかな。
npcLine.romaji: Kodomo ni mo hayaku oshieta hou ga ii no ka na.
npcLine.translation: Mungkin lebih baik anak juga diajari sejak dini ya.
npcLine.translationEn: Maybe it's better to teach children from an early age too.

options.japanese: うん、早めに金融教育を受けさせたほうがいいと思う。
options.romaji: Un, hayame ni kin'yuu kyouiku wo ukesaseta hou ga ii to omou.
options.translation: Iya, kurasa lebih baik dibiarkan menerima edukasi finansial lebih dini.
options.translationEn: Yeah, I think it's better for them to receive financial education earlier.

options.japanese: 子供には全く必要ないと思うよ。
options.romaji: Kodomo ni wa mattaku hitsuyou nai to omou yo.
options.translation: Kupikir sama sekali tidak perlu untuk anak.
options.translationEn: I don't think it's necessary for kids at all.

npcLine.japanese: 大事な視点だね。
npcLine.romaji: Daiji na shiten da ne.
npcLine.translationEn: That's an important perspective.

options.japanese: そう言ってもらえると嬉しいよ。
options.romaji: Sou itte moraeru to ureshii yo.

options.japanese: 別に大事だとは思わないよ。
options.romaji: Betsu ni daiji da to wa omowanai yo.

titleEn: Talking About Low Financial Literacy in Society
descriptionEn: You talk about low financial literacy in society with a friend.

title: Menceritakan Pengalaman Menjadi Penjamin Pinjaman
description: Kamu bercerita ke teman tentang pengalaman menjadi penjamin utang teman.

npcLine.japanese: 友達の借金の保証人になったことがあるって聞いたけど。
npcLine.romaji: Tomodachi no shakkin no hoshounin ni natta koto ga aru tte kiita kedo.
npcLine.translation: Kudengar pernah jadi penjamin utang teman ya.
npcLine.translationEn: I heard you once co-signed a friend's debt.

options.japanese: うん、頼まれて、断りきれずに引き受けてしまったんだ。
options.romaji: Un, tanomarete, kotowarikirezu ni hikiukete shimatta n da.
options.translation: Iya, diminta tolong, tidak bisa menolak sepenuhnya jadi terima.
options.translationEn: Yeah, asked for help, I couldn't fully refuse so I accepted.

options.japanese: 保証人になったことは一度もないよ。
options.romaji: Hoshounin ni natta koto wa ichido mo nai yo.
options.translation: Belum pernah jadi penjamin sama sekali.
options.translationEn: Never been a guarantor at all.

npcLine.japanese: 後悔してる？
npcLine.romaji: Koukai shiteru?
npcLine.translationEn: Any regrets?

options.japanese: 正直、今振り返ると、慎重になるべきだったと思う。
options.romaji: Shoujiki, ima furikaeru to, shinchou ni naru beki datta to omou.
options.translation: Jujur, sekarang kalau diingat kembali, kurasa harusnya lebih hati-hati.
options.translationEn: Honestly, looking back now, I think I should have been more careful.

options.japanese: 全く後悔していないよ。

npcLine.japanese: 相手はきちんと返済してるの？
npcLine.romaji: Aite wa kichinto hensai shiteru no?
npcLine.translationEn: Did the person involved pay properly?

options.japanese: 今のところは、問題なく返済されているよ。
options.romaji: Ima no tokoro wa, mondai naku hensai sarete iru yo.
options.translationEn: So far, paid without any problem.

options.japanese: 全く返済されていないよ。

npcLine.japanese: もし返済が滞ったらどうする？
npcLine.romaji: Moshi hensai ga todokottara dou suru?
npcLine.translationEn: What if the payment ends up stuck?

options.japanese: その時は、自分が肩代わりするしかないと思う。
options.romaji: Sono toki wa, jibun ga katagawari suru shika nai to omou.
options.translation: Saat itu, kurasa terpaksa aku yang menanggung.
options.translationEn: At that time, I think I had no choice but to bear it myself.

options.japanese: 全く関係ないと思っているよ。
options.romaji: Mattaku kankei nai to omotte iru yo.
options.translation: Kupikir sama sekali tidak ada hubungannya.
options.translationEn: I don't think it has anything to do with it at all.

npcLine.japanese: 大変な立場だね。
npcLine.romaji: Taihen na tachiba da ne.
npcLine.translationEn: That's a tough position.

titleEn: Talking About Being a Loan Guarantor
descriptionEn: You tell a friend about being a guarantor for a friend's debt.

title: Menjelaskan Alasan Memilih Bank Syariah
description: Kamu menjelaskan ke teman alasan memilih bank syariah.

npcLine.japanese: イスラム銀行を使ってるって聞いたけど、どうして選んだの？
npcLine.romaji: Isuramu ginkou wo tsukatteru tte kiita kedo, doushite eranda no?
npcLine.translation: Kudengar pakai bank syariah ya, kenapa memilihnya?
npcLine.translationEn: I heard you use an Islamic bank, why did you choose it?

options.japanese: 宗教上の理由から、利子のない仕組みを選ぶことにしたんだ。
options.romaji: Shuukyoujou no riyuu kara, rishi no nai shikumi wo erabu koto ni shita n da.
options.translation: Karena alasan agama, aku memutuskan memilih mekanisme tanpa bunga.
options.translationEn: For religious reasons, I decided to choose an interest-free mechanism.

options.japanese: 特に理由はなく、なんとなく選んだよ。
options.romaji: Toku ni riyuu wa naku, nantonaku eranda yo.
options.translation: Tidak ada alasan khususnya, sekadar pilih saja.
options.translationEn: No particular reason, just chose it.

npcLine.japanese: 一般的な銀行と、仕組みはどう違うの？
npcLine.romaji: Ippanteki na ginkou to, shikumi wa dou chigau no?
npcLine.translation: Dengan bank umum, mekanismenya beda bagaimana?
npcLine.translationEn: How does the mechanism differ from a regular bank?

options.japanese: 利子の代わりに、利益を分配する仕組みになっているんだ。
options.romaji: Rishi no kawari ni, rieki wo bunpai suru shikumi ni natte iru n da.
options.translation: Sebagai ganti bunga, mekanismenya membagikan keuntungan.
options.translationEn: Instead of interest, the mechanism shares profits.

options.japanese: 一般的な銀行と全く同じ仕組みだよ。
options.romaji: Ippanteki na ginkou to mattaku onaji shikumi da yo.
options.translation: Mekanismenya sama persis dengan bank umum.
options.translationEn: The mechanism is exactly the same as a regular bank.

npcLine.japanese: 不便に感じることはない？
npcLine.romaji: Fuben ni kanjiru koto wa nai?
npcLine.translationEn: Does anything feel inconvenient?

options.japanese: 正直、対応している店舗が少ないと感じることはあるよ。
options.romaji: Shoujiki, taiou shite iru tenpo ga sukunai to kanjiru koto wa aru yo.
options.translation: Jujur, kadang merasa cabangnya yang melayani sedikit.
options.translationEn: Honestly, I sometimes feel my sport is underserved.

options.japanese: 全く不便に感じたことないよ。
options.romaji: Mattaku fuben ni kanjita koto nai yo.
options.translation: Sama sekali tidak pernah merasa kurang praktis.
options.translationEn: Never felt it was impractical at all.

npcLine.japanese: それでも満足してる？
npcLine.romaji: Sore demo manzoku shiteru?
npcLine.translationEn: Even so, still satisfied?

options.japanese: うん、自分の信念に沿った選択ができて、満足しているよ。
options.romaji: Un, jibun no shinnen ni sotta sentaku ga dekite, manzoku shite iru yo.
options.translation: Iya, aku puas bisa memilih sesuai keyakinanku.
options.translationEn: Yeah, I'm satisfied being able to choose according to my beliefs.

options.japanese: 全く満足していないよ。

npcLine.japanese: 自分らしい選択だね。
npcLine.romaji: Jibun rashii sentaku da ne.
npcLine.translationEn: That's a choice uniquely you.

titleEn: Explaining Why You Chose a Sharia Bank
descriptionEn: You explain to a friend your reason for choosing a sharia bank.

title: Mendiskusikan Masa Depan Uang Tunai di Era Digital
description: Kamu dan teman mendiskusikan masa depan uang tunai di era cashless.

npcLine.japanese: キャッシュレス化が進んで、現金を使う機会が減ってきたよね。
npcLine.romaji: Kyasshuresuka ga susunde, genkin wo tsukau kikai ga hette kita yo ne.
npcLine.translation: Cashless makin berkembang, kesempatan pakai uang tunai jadi berkurang ya.
npcLine.translationEn: As cashless payments spread more, the chance to use cash decreases.

options.japanese: うん、財布を持ち歩かなくなった人も増えていると思う。
options.romaji: Un, saifu wo mochiarukanaku natta hito mo fuete iru to omou.
options.translation: Iya, kurasa orang yang tidak lagi membawa dompet juga bertambah.
options.translationEn: Yeah, I think people who no longer carry a wallet are also increasing.

options.japanese: 全く減っていないと思うよ。
options.romaji: Mattaku hette inai to omou yo.
options.translationEn: I don't think it's decreased at all.

npcLine.japanese: 現金は完全になくなると思う？
npcLine.romaji: Genkin wa kanzen ni nakunaru to omou?
npcLine.translation: Menurutmu uang tunai akan hilang sepenuhnya?
npcLine.translationEn: Do you think cash will disappear completely?

options.japanese: 完全になくなることはないと思うけど、役割は縮小していくと思う。
options.romaji: Kanzen ni nakunaru koto wa nai to omou kedo, yakuwari wa shukushou shite iku to omou.
options.translation: Kupikir tidak akan sepenuhnya hilang, tapi kurasa perannya akan menyusut.
options.translationEn: I don't think it'll disappear completely, but I think its role will shrink.

options.japanese: すぐに完全になくなると思うよ。
options.romaji: Sugu ni kanzen ni nakunaru to omou yo.
options.translationEn: I think it'll disappear completely soon.

npcLine.japanese: 高齢者にとっては難しい変化かもね。
npcLine.romaji: Koureisha ni totte wa muzukashii henka kamo ne.
npcLine.translation: Mungkin perubahan yang sulit bagi lansia ya.
npcLine.translationEn: That might be a difficult change for the elderly.

options.japanese: うん、デジタルに慣れていない人への配慮も必要だと思う。
options.romaji: Un, dejitaru ni narete inai hito e no hairyo mo hitsuyou da to omou.
options.translation: Iya, kurasa perlu juga perhatian bagi orang yang belum terbiasa digital.
options.translationEn: Yeah, I think attention is also needed for people not yet used to digital.

options.japanese: 高齢者のことは考える必要ないと思うよ。
options.romaji: Koureisha no koto wa kangaeru hitsuyou nai to omou yo.
options.translationEn: I don't think elderly people need to be considered.

npcLine.japanese: 停電とかの時はどうする？
npcLine.romaji: Teiden toka no toki wa dou suru?
npcLine.translation: Waktu mati listrik dan semacamnya gimana?
npcLine.translationEn: What about during a power outage and things like that?

options.japanese: そういう時のために、多少の現金は持っておいたほうがいいと思う。
options.romaji: Sou iu toki no tame ni, tashou no genkin wa motte oita hou ga ii to omou.
options.translation: Untuk saat seperti itu, kurasa sebaiknya tetap bawa sedikit uang tunai.
options.translationEn: For times like that, I think it's still best to carry a little cash.

options.japanese: 停電の時でもキャッシュレスで十分だと思うよ。
options.romaji: Teiden no toki demo kyasshuresu de juubun da to omou yo.
options.translation: Kupikir waktu mati listrik pun cashless sudah cukup.
options.translationEn: I think cashless is enough even during a power outage.

npcLine.japanese: バランスが大事だね。
npcLine.romaji: Baransu ga daiji da ne.
npcLine.translationEn: Balance matters.

titleEn: Discussing the Future of Cash in the Digital Age
descriptionEn: You and a friend discuss the future of cash in a cashless era.

title: Menjelaskan Alasan Berhenti Menjadi Atlet Profesional
description: Kamu menjelaskan ke teman alasan pensiun dari karier atlet profesional.

npcLine.japanese: 現役を引退したって聞いたけど、本当？
npcLine.romaji: Gen'eki wo intai shita tte kiita kedo, hontou?
npcLine.translation: Kudengar sudah pensiun dari karier aktif ya, benar?
npcLine.translationEn: I heard you've retired from active competition, is that right?

options.japanese: うん、体への負担を考えて、引退することにしたんだ。
options.romaji: Un, karada e no futan wo kangaete, intai suru koto ni shita n da.
options.translation: Iya, aku memutuskan pensiun dengan mempertimbangkan beban pada tubuh.
options.translationEn: Yeah, I decided to retire considering the strain on my body.

options.japanese: いや、まだ現役を続けているよ。
options.romaji: Iya, mada gen'eki wo tsuzukete iru yo.
options.translationEn: No, still continuing an active career.

npcLine.japanese: 未練はなかった？
npcLine.romaji: Miren wa nakatta?
npcLine.translationEn: No regrets?

options.japanese: 正直、少しは名残惜しい気持ちもあったよ。
options.romaji: Shoujiki, sukoshi wa nagorioshii kimochi mo atta yo.
options.translation: Jujur, ada juga sedikit rasa sayang untuk melepaskan.
options.translationEn: Honestly, there's also a bit of reluctance to let go.

options.japanese: 全く未練はなかったよ。

npcLine.japanese: 引退を決めた瞬間はいつだったの？
npcLine.romaji: Intai wo kimeta shunkan wa itsu datta no?
npcLine.translationEn: When was the moment you decided to retire?

options.japanese: 大きな怪我をした時に、限界を感じたんだ。
options.romaji: Ookina kega wo shita toki ni, genkai wo kanjita n da.
options.translation: Waktu mengalami cedera besar, aku merasakan batasnya.
options.translationEn: When I had a major injury, I felt my limit.

options.japanese: 特に決定的な瞬間はなかったよ。
options.romaji: Toku ni ketteiteki na shunkan wa nakatta yo.

npcLine.japanese: これから何をするつもり？
npcLine.romaji: Kore kara nani wo suru tsumori?
npcLine.translationEn: What do you want to do going forward?

options.japanese: 後進の指導に携わっていきたいと思っているよ。
options.romaji: Koushin no shidou ni tazusawatte ikitai to omotte iru yo.
options.translation: Aku berpikir ingin terus terlibat dalam membimbing generasi penerus.
options.translationEn: I want to keep being involved in mentoring the next generation.

options.japanese: しばらくは何もするつもりはないよ。
options.romaji: Shibaraku wa nanimo suru tsumori wa nai yo.
options.translation: Sementara berniat tidak melakukan apa pun.
options.translationEn: For now, intending not to do anything.

npcLine.japanese: いいセカンドキャリアだね。
npcLine.romaji: Ii sekando kyaria da ne.
npcLine.translationEn: That's a great second career.

options.japanese: 別に良くないと思うよ。
options.romaji: Betsu ni yokunai to omou yo.
options.translationEn: I don't think it's good at all.

titleEn: Explaining Why You Quit Being a Professional Athlete
descriptionEn: You explain to a friend your reason for retiring from a professional athletic career.

title: Mendiskusikan Doping dalam Dunia Olahraga
description: Kamu dan teman mendiskusikan masalah doping dalam dunia olahraga.

npcLine.japanese: ドーピング問題、最近またニュースになってたね。
npcLine.romaji: Doopingu mondai, saikin mata nyuusu ni natteta ne.
npcLine.translation: Masalah doping, belakangan jadi berita lagi ya.
npcLine.translationEn: The doping issue is back in the news lately.

options.japanese: うん、あれだけ厳しく取り締まられているのに、なくならないんだよね。
options.romaji: Un, are dake kibishiku torishimararete iru noni, nakunaranai n da yo ne.
options.translation: Iya, meski sudah diawasi dengan sangat ketat, tetap tidak hilang ya.
options.translationEn: Yeah, even with very strict monitoring, it still doesn't go away.

options.japanese: ドーピング問題なんて聞いたことないよ。
options.romaji: Doopingu mondai nante kiita koto nai yo.
options.translationEn: Never heard of a doping problem.

npcLine.japanese: なぜなくならないと思う？
npcLine.romaji: Naze nakunaranai to omou?
npcLine.translationEn: Why do you think it doesn't disappear?

options.japanese: 勝利へのプレッシャーが、選手を追い詰めているんだと思う。
options.romaji: Shouri e no puresshaa ga, senshu wo oitsumete iru n da to omou.
options.translation: Kurasa tekanan untuk menang yang mendesak para atlet.
options.translationEn: I think it's the pressure to win that's pressuring the athletes.

options.japanese: 選手には全くプレッシャーがないと思うよ。
options.romaji: Senshu ni wa mattaku puresshaa ga nai to omou yo.
options.translation: Kupikir atlet sama sekali tidak ada tekanan.
options.translationEn: I don't think athletes have any pressure at all.

npcLine.japanese: 罰則を厳しくすれば解決すると思う？
npcLine.romaji: Basshoku wo kibishiku sureba kaiketsu suru to omou?
npcLine.translation: Menurutmu kalau hukumannya diperketat akan terselesaikan?
npcLine.translationEn: Do you think it'll be resolved if the penalties are tightened?

options.japanese: それだけでは、根本的な解決にはならないと思う。
options.romaji: Sore dake dewa, konponteki na kaiketsu ni wa naranai to omou.
options.translation: Kurasa itu saja tidak akan jadi solusi fundamental.
options.translationEn: I don't think that alone will be a fundamental solution.

options.japanese: それだけで完全に解決すると思うよ。
options.romaji: Sore dake de kanzen ni kaiketsu suru to omou yo.
options.translation: Kupikir hanya dengan itu akan terselesaikan sepenuhnya.
options.translationEn: I think that alone will resolve it completely.

npcLine.japanese: 選手のメンタルケアも必要だよね。
npcLine.romaji: Senshu no mentaru kea mo hitsuyou da yo ne.
npcLine.translation: Perawatan mental atlet juga perlu ya.
npcLine.translationEn: Athletes' mental care matters too.

options.japanese: うん、それも大事な対策の一つだと思う。
options.romaji: Un, sore mo daiji na taisaku no hitotsu da to omou.
options.translation: Iya, kurasa itu juga salah satu tindakan penting.
options.translationEn: Yeah, I think that's also one important measure.

options.japanese: メンタルケアなんて必要ないと思うよ。
options.romaji: Mentaru kea nante hitsuyou nai to omou yo.
options.translationEn: I don't think mental care is necessary.

npcLine.japanese: 難しい問題だね。
npcLine.romaji: Muzukashii mondai da ne.
npcLine.translationEn: That's a difficult problem.

options.japanese: 別に難しくないと思うよ。
options.romaji: Betsu ni muzukashikunai to omou yo.
options.translationEn: I don't think it's difficult at all.

titleEn: Discussing Doping in Sports
descriptionEn: You and a friend discuss the issue of doping in sports.

title: Menceritakan Pengalaman Cedera Parah dalam Olahraga
description: Kamu bercerita ke teman tentang pengalaman mengalami cedera parah.

npcLine.japanese: 大怪我をしたことがあるって聞いたよ。
npcLine.romaji: Ookega wo shita koto ga aru tte kiita yo.
npcLine.translation: Kudengar pernah mengalami cedera besar ya.
npcLine.translationEn: I heard you once had a major injury.

options.japanese: うん、靭帯を断裂して、手術を受けることになったんだ。
options.romaji: Un, jintai wo danretsu shite, shujutsu wo ukeru koto ni natta n da.
options.translation: Iya, ligamennya robek, jadi harus operasi.
options.translationEn: Yeah, the ligament tore, so surgery was necessary.

options.japanese: 大した怪我はしたことないよ。
options.romaji: Taishita kega wa shita koto nai yo.

npcLine.japanese: リハビリは大変だった？
npcLine.romaji: Rihabiri wa taihen datta?
npcLine.translationEn: Is the rehabilitation tough?

options.japanese: うん、想像していた以上に、長くて辛い道のりだったよ。
options.romaji: Un, souzou shite ita ijou ni, nagakute tsurai michinori datta yo.
options.translation: Iya, jalannya panjang dan berat, lebih dari yang dibayangkan.
options.translationEn: Yeah, the path is longer and tougher than imagined.

options.japanese: 全然大変じゃなかったよ。

npcLine.japanese: 復帰できるか不安だった？
npcLine.romaji: Fukki dekiru ka fuan datta?
npcLine.translationEn: Worried about whether it'll be returned?

options.japanese: 正直、二度と復帰できないかもしれないと思ったこともあったよ。
options.romaji: Shoujiki, nidoto fukki dekinai kamoshirenai to omotta koto mo atta yo.
options.translation: Jujur, pernah juga berpikir mungkin tidak bisa kembali lagi.
options.translationEn: Honestly, I've also thought I might not be able to come back.

options.japanese: 全く不安にならなかったよ。

npcLine.japanese: 今はどう？
npcLine.romaji: Ima wa dou?
npcLine.translationEn: How is it now?

options.japanese: おかげさまで、以前とほぼ変わらない動きができているよ。
options.romaji: Okagesama de, izen to hobo kawaranai ugoki ga dekite iru yo.
options.translation: Berkat itu, bisa bergerak hampir sama seperti sebelumnya.
options.translationEn: Thanks to that, I can move almost the same as before.

options.japanese: いまだに全く動けないよ。
options.translation: Sampai sekarang sama sekali tidak bisa bergerak.
options.translationEn: Still can't move at all to this day.

npcLine.japanese: 良かったね。
npcLine.romaji: Yokatta ne.
npcLine.translationEn: What a relief.

options.japanese: うん、本当に良かったよ。

titleEn: Talking About a Severe Sports Injury
descriptionEn: You tell a friend about experiencing a severe injury.

title: Menjelaskan Tekanan Mental sebagai Atlet Kompetitif
description: Kamu menjelaskan ke teman tekanan mental yang kamu rasakan sebagai atlet kompetitif.

npcLine.japanese: 試合前、いつも緊張してる感じがするけど、大丈夫？
npcLine.romaji: Shiai mae, itsumo kinchou shiteru kanji ga suru kedo, daijoubu?
npcLine.translation: Sebelum pertandingan, sepertinya selalu gugup, tidak apa-apa?
npcLine.translationEn: You always seem nervous before a match, are you okay?

options.japanese: 正直、期待に応えなければというプレッシャーを感じているんだ。
options.romaji: Shoujiki, kitai ni kotaenakereba to iu puresshaa wo kanjite iru n da.
options.translation: Jujur, aku merasakan tekanan bahwa harus memenuhi harapan.
options.translationEn: Honestly, I feel the pressure of having to meet expectations.

options.japanese: 全くプレッシャーは感じていないよ。
options.romaji: Mattaku puresshaa wa kanjite inai yo.

npcLine.japanese: どうやって乗り越えてるの？
npcLine.romaji: Dou yatte norikoeteru no?
npcLine.translationEn: How do you get through it?

options.japanese: カウンセラーに相談しながら、少しずつ対処法を見つけているよ。
options.romaji: Kaunseraa ni soudan shinagara, sukoshi zutsu taishohou wo mitsukete iru yo.
options.translation: Aku sambil konsultasi ke konselor, sedikit demi sedikit menemukan cara mengatasinya.
options.translationEn: While consulting a counselor, I gradually found a way to deal with it.

options.japanese: 誰にも相談せずに我慢し続けているよ。
options.romaji: Dare ni mo soudan sezu ni gaman shitsuzukete iru yo.
options.translation: Terus bertahan tanpa konsultasi ke siapa pun.
options.translationEn: Kept holding on without consulting anyone.

npcLine.japanese: 結果が出ない時は辛くない？
npcLine.romaji: Kekka ga denai toki wa tsurakunai?
npcLine.translation: Waktu tidak menghasilkan hasil apa pun tidak berat?
npcLine.translationEn: Isn't it tough when it doesn't produce any results?

options.japanese: 正直、自分の存在価値まで疑ってしまうことがあるよ。
options.romaji: Shoujiki, jibun no sonzai kachi made utagatte shimau koto ga aru yo.
options.translation: Jujur, kadang sampai meragukan nilai keberadaanku sendiri.
options.translationEn: Honestly, I sometimes even doubt my own worth.

npcLine.japanese: それでも続けられる理由は？
npcLine.romaji: Sore demo tsuzukerareru riyuu wa?
npcLine.translation: Meski begitu alasan bisa terus bertahan?
npcLine.translationEn: Even so, what's the reason you could keep going?

options.japanese: この競技が本当に好きだという気持ちが、支えになっているんだ。
options.romaji: Kono kyougi ga hontou ni suki da to iu kimochi ga, sasae ni natte iru n da.
options.translation: Perasaan benar-benar suka cabang olahraga ini yang jadi penopangku.
options.translationEn: The genuine love for this sport is what supports me.

options.japanese: 特に続ける理由はないよ。
options.romaji: Toku ni tsuzukeru riyuu wa nai yo.
options.translationEn: No particular reason to hold on.

npcLine.japanese: 素敵な思いだね。
npcLine.romaji: Suteki na omoi da ne.
npcLine.translationEn: What a beautiful feeling.

options.japanese: 別に大したことじゃないよ。
options.romaji: Betsu ni taishita koto janai yo.

titleEn: Explaining the Mental Pressure of Being a Competitive Athlete
descriptionEn: You explain to a friend the mental pressure you feel as a competitive athlete.

title: Membicarakan Kesenjangan Gaji Antar Cabang Olahraga
description: Kamu membicarakan kesenjangan gaji antar cabang olahraga dengan teman.

npcLine.japanese: スポーツによって、選手の年収がかなり違うよね。
npcLine.romaji: Supootsu ni yotte, senshu no nenshuu ga kanari chigau yo ne.
npcLine.translation: Tergantung olahraganya, penghasilan tahunan atlet cukup berbeda ya.
npcLine.translationEn: Depending on the sport, athletes' annual income differs quite a bit.

options.japanese: うん、人気のある競技とそうでない競技で、格差が大きいと思う。
options.romaji: Un, ninki no aru kyougi to sou de nai kyougi de, kakusa ga ookii to omou.
options.translation: Iya, kurasa ada kesenjangan besar antara cabang olahraga yang populer dan yang tidak.
options.translationEn: Yeah, I think there's a big gap between popular and unpopular sports.

options.japanese: どの競技でも全く同じ年収だと思うよ。
options.romaji: Dono kyougi demo mattaku onaji nenshuu da to omou yo.
options.translation: Kupikir penghasilan tahunannya sama persis di cabang mana pun.
options.translationEn: I think the annual income is exactly the same in any sport.

npcLine.japanese: なぜそんなに差が出ると思う？
npcLine.romaji: Naze sonna ni sa ga deru to omou?
npcLine.translation: Menurutmu kenapa sampai muncul selisih segitu?
npcLine.translationEn: Why do you think such a gap arose?

options.japanese: スポンサー収入や放映権料の違いが、大きく影響していると思う。
options.romaji: Suponsaa shuunyuu ya houeiken ryou no chigai ga, ookiku eikyou shite iru to omou.
options.translation: Kurasa perbedaan pendapatan sponsor dan hak siar berpengaruh besar.
options.translationEn: I think the difference in sponsorship and broadcast rights income has a big influence.

options.japanese: 差が出る理由は特にないと思うよ。
options.romaji: Sa ga deru riyuu wa toku ni nai to omou yo.
options.translation: Kupikir tidak ada alasan khususnya muncul selisih.
options.translationEn: I don't think there's a particular reason for the discrepancy.

npcLine.japanese: マイナー競技の選手は大変そうだね。
npcLine.romaji: Mainaa kyougi no senshu wa taihen sou da ne.
npcLine.translation: Atlet cabang olahraga minor kelihatannya berat ya.
npcLine.translationEn: Athletes in minor sports seem to have it tough.

options.japanese: うん、副業をしながら競技を続けている選手も多いらしいよ。
options.romaji: Un, fukugyou wo shinagara kyougi wo tsuzukete iru senshu mo ooi rashii yo.
options.translation: Iya, katanya banyak atlet yang terus berkompetisi sambil kerja sampingan.
options.translationEn: Yeah, they say many athletes keep competing while working a side job.

options.japanese: マイナー競技の選手も十分な収入があるらしいよ。
options.romaji: Mainaa kyougi no senshu mo juubun na shuunyuu ga aru rashii yo.
options.translation: Katanya atlet cabang minor juga punya penghasilan yang cukup.
options.translationEn: They say athletes in minor sports also earn enough income.

npcLine.japanese: 何か改善策はあると思う？
npcLine.romaji: Nanika kaizensaku wa aru to omou?
npcLine.translationEn: Do you think there's a solution for improvement?

options.japanese: マイナー競技への投資を増やすことが必要だと思う。
options.romaji: Mainaa kyougi e no toushi wo fuyasu koto ga hitsuyou da to omou.
options.translation: Kurasa perlu menambah investasi ke cabang olahraga minor.
options.translationEn: I think more investment is needed in minor sports.

options.japanese: 特に何も改善する必要はないと思うよ。
options.romaji: Toku ni nanimo kaizen suru hitsuyou wa nai to omou yo.
options.translation: Kupikir tidak perlu memperbaiki apa pun khususnya.
options.translationEn: I don't think anything in particular needs to be fixed.

npcLine.japanese: 難しい課題だね。
npcLine.romaji: Muzukashii kadai da ne.
npcLine.translationEn: That's a tough challenge.

options.japanese: 別に難しくないと思うよ。
options.romaji: Betsu ni muzukashikunai to omou yo.
options.translationEn: I don't think it's difficult at all.

titleEn: Talking About Salary Gaps Between Sports
descriptionEn: You talk about salary gaps between different sports with a friend.

title: Menceritakan Pengalaman Menjadi Pelatih Tim Junior
description: Kamu bercerita ke teman tentang pengalaman menjadi pelatih tim junior setelah pensiun.

npcLine.japanese: 引退後、ジュニアチームのコーチをしてるって聞いたよ。
npcLine.romaji: Intaigo, junia chiimu no koochi wo shiteru tte kiita yo.
npcLine.translation: Kudengar setelah pensiun jadi pelatih tim junior ya.
npcLine.translationEn: I heard after retiring you became a junior team coach.

options.japanese: うん、次世代の育成に関わりたいと思って、始めたんだ。
options.romaji: Un, jisedai no ikusei ni kakawaritai to omotte, hajimeta n da.
options.translation: Iya, aku mulai karena ingin terlibat dalam membina generasi berikutnya.
options.translationEn: Yeah, I started because I wanted to be involved in developing the next generation.

options.japanese: コーチなんて一度もしたことないよ。
options.romaji: Koochi nante ichido mo shita koto nai yo.
options.translation: Belum pernah jadi pelatih sama sekali.
options.translationEn: Never been a coach at all.

npcLine.japanese: 教えるのは難しい？
npcLine.romaji: Oshieru no wa muzukashii?
npcLine.translationEn: Is teaching hard?

options.japanese: 選手それぞれの個性に合わせて指導するのが、意外と難しいんだ。
options.romaji: Senshu sorezore no kosei ni awasete shidou suru no ga, igai to muzukashii n da.
options.translation: Ternyata sulit untuk membimbing sesuai karakteristik masing-masing atlet.
options.translationEn: It turned out to be difficult to coach according to each athlete's individual characteristics.

npcLine.japanese: やりがいは感じる？
npcLine.romaji: Yarigai wa kanjiru?
npcLine.translationEn: Feeling job satisfaction?

options.japanese: うん、選手が成長していく姿を見るたびに、やりがいを感じるよ。
options.romaji: Un, senshu ga seichou shite iku sugata wo miru tabi ni, yarigai wo kanjiru yo.
options.translation: Iya, tiap kali melihat atlet berkembang, aku merasakan kepuasan kerja.
options.translationEn: Yeah, every time I see an athlete grow, I feel job satisfaction.

options.japanese: やりがいなんて全く感じないよ。
options.translation: Sama sekali tidak merasakan kepuasan kerja.
options.translationEn: Not feeling job satisfaction at all.

npcLine.japanese: 自分の現役時代と比べてどう？
npcLine.romaji: Jibun no genyaku jidai to kurabete dou?
npcLine.translationEn: How does it compare to your own active years?

options.japanese: プレーする喜びとは、また違う喜びがあると感じているよ。
options.romaji: Puree suru yorokobi to wa, mata chigau yorokobi ga aru to kanjite iru yo.
options.translation: Aku rasakan ada kebahagiaan yang berbeda dari kebahagiaan bermain.
options.translationEn: I feel there's a happiness different from the happiness of playing.

options.japanese: 現役時代のほうがずっと楽しかったよ。
options.romaji: Genyaku jidai no hou ga zutto tanoshikatta yo.
options.translationEn: The active period is much more fun.

npcLine.japanese: 素敵な仕事だね。
npcLine.romaji: Suteki na shigoto da ne.
npcLine.translationEn: That's a wonderful job.

titleEn: Talking About Becoming a Junior Team Coach
descriptionEn: You tell a friend about becoming a junior team coach after retiring.

title: Mendiskusikan Kesetaraan Gender dalam Olahraga
description: Kamu dan teman mendiskusikan kesetaraan gender dalam dunia olahraga.

npcLine.japanese: 女子スポーツへの注目度、少しずつ上がってきてるよね。
npcLine.romaji: Joshi supootsu e no chuumokudo, sukoshi zutsu agatte kiteru yo ne.
npcLine.translation: Perhatian terhadap olahraga wanita, sedikit demi sedikit meningkat ya.
npcLine.translationEn: Attention to women's sports has been growing little by little.

options.japanese: うん、以前と比べると、扱いも良くなってきていると思う。
options.romaji: Un, izen to kuraberu to, atsukai mo yoku natte kite iru to omou.
options.translation: Iya, dibandingkan sebelumnya, kurasa perlakuannya juga jadi lebih baik.
options.translationEn: Yeah, compared to before, I think the treatment has also gotten better.

options.japanese: 全く変わっていないと思うよ。
options.romaji: Mattaku kawatte inai to omou yo.
options.translationEn: I don't think it's changed at all.

npcLine.japanese: まだ改善すべき点はあると思う？
npcLine.romaji: Mada kaizen subeki ten wa aru to omou?
npcLine.translation: Masih ada bagian yang harus diperbaiki menurutmu?
npcLine.translationEn: Do you think there's still a part that needs fixing?

options.japanese: うん、賞金の格差は、まだ解消されていないと思う。
options.romaji: Un, shoukin no kakusa wa, mada kaishou sarete inai to omou.
options.translation: Iya, kurasa kesenjangan hadiah uang masih belum terselesaikan.
options.translationEn: Yeah, I think the prize money gap still hasn't been resolved.

options.japanese: もう完全に平等になったと思うよ。
options.romaji: Mou kanzen ni byoudou ni natta to omou yo.
options.translationEn: I think it's already completely equal.

npcLine.japanese: 男女混合の競技についてはどう思う？
npcLine.romaji: Danjo kongou no kyougi ni tsuite wa dou omou?
npcLine.translation: Bagaimana pendapatmu soal olahraga campuran pria wanita?
npcLine.translationEn: What's your opinion on mixed-gender sports?

options.japanese: 新しい可能性を感じさせる、面白い試みだと思う。
options.romaji: Atarashii kanousei wo kanjisaseru, omoshiroi kokoromi da to omou.
options.translation: Kurasa itu upaya menarik yang membuat merasakan kemungkinan baru.
options.translationEn: I think that's an interesting effort that makes you feel new possibilities.

options.japanese: 全く意味がない試みだと思うよ。
options.romaji: Mattaku imi ga nai kokoromi da to omou yo.
options.translation: Kupikir upaya yang sama sekali tidak ada artinya.
options.translationEn: I think it's a completely meaningless effort.

npcLine.japanese: メディアの取り上げ方も影響してると思う？
npcLine.romaji: Media no toriagekata mo eikyou shiteru to omou?
npcLine.translation: Menurutmu cara media meliput juga berpengaruh?
npcLine.translationEn: Do you think how the media covers it has an influence too?

options.japanese: うん、報道量が増えれば、注目度も上がると思う。
options.romaji: Un, houdouryou ga fuereba, chuumokudo mo agaru to omou.
options.translation: Iya, kurasa kalau jumlah liputan bertambah, perhatiannya juga akan naik.
options.translationEn: Yeah, I think if the amount of coverage increases, attention will rise too.

options.japanese: メディアの取り上げ方は全く関係ないと思うよ。
options.romaji: Media no toriagekata wa mattaku kankei nai to omou yo.
options.translation: Kupikir cara media meliput sama sekali tidak ada hubungannya.
options.translationEn: I don't think how the media covers it has anything to do with it at all.

npcLine.japanese: 変わっていくといいね。
npcLine.romaji: Kawatte iku to ii ne.
npcLine.translationEn: Hope it keeps changing.

options.japanese: 別に変わらなくていいと思うよ。
options.romaji: Betsu ni kawaranakute ii to omou yo.
options.translation: Kupikir tidak usah berubah juga tidak apa-apa.
options.translationEn: I think it's fine even if it doesn't need to change.

titleEn: Discussing Gender Equality in Sports
descriptionEn: You and a friend discuss gender equality in sports.

title: Menjelaskan Alasan Memilih Olahraga Ekstrem
description: Kamu menjelaskan ke teman alasan memulai skydiving.

npcLine.japanese: スカイダイビングを始めたって聞いたけど、怖くないの？
npcLine.romaji: Sukaidaibingu wo hajimeta tte kiita kedo, kowakunai no?
npcLine.translation: Kudengar mulai skydiving ya, tidak takut?
npcLine.translationEn: I heard you started skydiving, aren't you scared?

options.japanese: 最初は怖かったけど、その恐怖を乗り越える快感がやみつきになったんだ。
options.romaji: Saisho wa kowakatta kedo, sono kyoufu wo norikoeru kaikan ga yamitsuki ni natta n da.
options.translation: Awalnya takut, tapi kenikmatan melewati rasa takut itu jadi bikin ketagihan.
options.translationEn: At first I was scared, but the thrill of overcoming that fear became addictive.

options.japanese: 全く怖さは感じないよ。

npcLine.japanese: 危険だと思わない？
npcLine.romaji: Kiken da to omowanai?
npcLine.translationEn: Don't you think it's dangerous?

options.japanese: リスクがあることは承知の上で、始めているよ。
options.romaji: Risuku ga aru koto wa shouchi no ue de, hajimete iru yo.
options.translation: Aku mulai dengan sudah memahami ada risikonya.
options.translationEn: I started already understanding there's a risk.

options.japanese: 危険性なんて全く考えたことないよ。
options.romaji: Kikensei nante mattaku kangaeta koto nai yo.
options.translation: Belum pernah memikirkan bahaya sama sekali.
options.translationEn: Never thought about the danger at all.

npcLine.japanese: 家族は心配してない？
npcLine.romaji: Kazoku wa shinpai shitenai?
npcLine.translationEn: Isn't your family worried?

options.japanese: 最初はかなり反対されたけど、今では応援してくれているよ。
options.romaji: Saisho wa kanari hantai sareta kedo, ima dewa ouen shite kurete iru yo.
options.translation: Awalnya sangat ditentang, tapi sekarang mendukungku.
options.translationEn: At first they strongly opposed it, but now they support me.

options.japanese: 家族は一切気にしていないよ。
options.romaji: Kazoku wa issai ki ni shite inai yo.

npcLine.japanese: 日常生活が退屈に感じたりしない？
npcLine.romaji: Nichijou seikatsu ga taikutsu ni kanjitari shinai?
npcLine.translation: Tidak pernah merasa kehidupan sehari-hari membosankan?
npcLine.translationEn: Never felt everyday life is boring?

options.japanese: 正直、あの高揚感を味わうと、日常が物足りなく感じることもあるよ。
options.romaji: Shoujiki, ano kouyoukan wo ajiwau to, nichijou ga monotarinaku kanjiru koto mo aru yo.
options.translation: Jujur, setelah merasakan sensasi tinggi itu, kadang kehidupan sehari-hari terasa kurang.
options.translationEn: Honestly, after experiencing that intense thrill, everyday life sometimes feels lacking.

options.japanese: 日常生活のほうがずっと楽しいと感じているよ。
options.romaji: Nichijou seikatsu no hou ga zutto tanoshii to kanjite iru yo.
options.translationEn: Everyday life is much more enjoyable.

npcLine.japanese: 刺激的な趣味だね。
npcLine.romaji: Shigekiteki na shumi da ne.
npcLine.translationEn: That's a challenging hobby.

titleEn: Explaining Why You Chose an Extreme Sport
descriptionEn: You explain to a friend your reason for taking up skydiving.

title: Membicarakan Dampak Media Sosial terhadap Atlet
description: Kamu membicarakan dampak media sosial terhadap atlet dengan teman.

npcLine.japanese: 最近のアスリートって、SNSでの誹謗中傷にさらされやすいよね。
npcLine.romaji: Saikin no asuriito tte, esunuesu de no hibou chuushou ni sarasareyasui yo ne.
npcLine.translation: Atlet belakangan ini mudah terpapar cemoohan di media sosial ya.
npcLine.translationEn: Athletes these days are easily exposed to backlash on social media, huh.

options.japanese: うん、試合に負けると、すぐに批判が殺到するらしいよ。
options.romaji: Un, shiai ni makeru to, sugu ni hihan ga sattou suru rashii yo.
options.translation: Iya, katanya begitu kalah pertandingan, langsung dibanjiri kritik.
options.translationEn: Yeah, they say as soon as they lose a match, they get flooded with criticism.

options.japanese: SNSでの誹謗中傷なんて聞いたことないよ。
options.romaji: Esunuesu de no hibou chuushou nante kiita koto nai yo.
options.translation: Belum pernah dengar cemoohan di media sosial.
options.translationEn: Never heard of jeering on social media.

npcLine.japanese: メンタルへの影響も大きそうだね。
npcLine.romaji: Mentaru e no eikyou mo ookisou da ne.
npcLine.translation: Sepertinya dampak ke mentalnya juga besar ya.
npcLine.translationEn: Seems like the mental impact is significant too.

options.japanese: うん、精神的に追い詰められる選手も少なくないと思う。
options.romaji: Un, seishinteki ni oitsumerareru senshu mo sukunakunai to omou.
options.translation: Iya, kurasa tidak sedikit atlet yang tertekan secara mental.
options.translationEn: Yeah, I think quite a few athletes are mentally stressed.

options.japanese: 精神的な影響は全くないと思うよ。
options.romaji: Seishinteki na eikyou wa mattaku nai to omou yo.
options.translation: Kupikir sama sekali tidak ada dampak mental.
options.translationEn: I don't think there's any mental impact at all.

npcLine.japanese: SNSを見ないようにする選手もいるらしいね。
npcLine.romaji: Esunuesu wo minai you ni suru senshu mo iru rashii ne.
npcLine.translation: Katanya ada juga atlet yang berusaha tidak lihat media sosial ya.
npcLine.translationEn: I heard there are also athletes who try not to look at social media.

options.japanese: うん、自分を守るための、賢い選択だと思う。
options.romaji: Un, jibun wo mamoru tame no, kashikoi sentaku da to omou.
options.translation: Iya, kurasa itu pilihan bijak untuk melindungi diri sendiri.
options.translationEn: Yeah, I think that's a wise choice to protect yourself.

options.japanese: それは意味がない行動だと思うよ。
options.romaji: Sore wa imi ga nai koudou da to omou yo.
options.translation: Kupikir itu tindakan yang tidak ada artinya.
options.translationEn: I think that's a pointless action.

npcLine.japanese: ファンとの繋がりという意味では、メリットもあるよね。
npcLine.romaji: Fan to no tsunagari to iu imi dewa, meritto mo aru yo ne.
npcLine.translation: Dalam artian koneksi dengan penggemar, ada juga keuntungannya ya.
npcLine.translationEn: In terms of connecting with fans, there's an upside too.

options.japanese: うん、そこは諸刃の剣だと思う。
options.romaji: Un, soko wa morohanoyaiba da to omou.
options.translation: Iya, kurasa itu bagai pisau bermata dua.
options.translationEn: Yeah, I think it's like a double-edged sword.

options.japanese: メリットは何もないと思うよ。
options.romaji: Meritto wa nanimo nai to omou yo.
options.translation: Kupikir tidak ada keuntungan apa pun.
options.translationEn: I don't think there's any benefit.

npcLine.japanese: 難しい時代だね。
npcLine.romaji: Muzukashii jidai da ne.
npcLine.translationEn: These are tough times.

options.japanese: 別に難しくないと思うよ。
options.romaji: Betsu ni muzukashikunai to omou yo.
options.translationEn: I don't think it's difficult at all.

titleEn: Talking About Social Media's Impact on Athletes
descriptionEn: You talk about social media's impact on athletes with a friend.

title: Menceritakan Pengalaman Pensiun Dini dari Olahraga
description: Kamu bercerita ke teman tentang pengalaman pensiun dini akibat cedera berkali-kali.

npcLine.japanese: 若くして引退したって聞いたけど、なぜ？
npcLine.romaji: Wakakushite intai shita tte kiita kedo, naze?
npcLine.translation: Kudengar pensiun di usia muda ya, kenapa?
npcLine.translationEn: I heard you retired young, why?

options.japanese: 度重なる怪我で、体が限界を迎えてしまったんだ。
options.romaji: Tabikasanaru kega de, karada ga genkai wo mukaete shimatta n da.
options.translation: Karena cedera berkali-kali, tubuhku sampai mencapai batasnya.
options.translationEn: Due to repeated injuries, my body reached its limit.

options.japanese: 特に理由もなく引退したよ。
options.romaji: Toku ni riyuu mo naku intai shita yo.

npcLine.japanese: 決断するのは辛かった？
npcLine.romaji: Ketsudan suru no wa tsurakatta?
npcLine.translationEn: Was it hard to make the decision?

options.japanese: 正直、何日も眠れないほど悩んだよ。
options.romaji: Shoujiki, nannichi mo nemurenai hodo nayanda yo.
options.translation: Jujur, sampai berhari-hari tidak bisa tidur karena galau.
options.translationEn: Honestly, I couldn't sleep for days because I was troubled.

options.japanese: 全く悩まずに決めたよ。
options.translationEn: Decided without any hesitation at all.

npcLine.japanese: 周りの反応はどうだった？
npcLine.romaji: Mawari no hannou wa dou datta?
npcLine.translationEn: How did people around you react?

options.japanese: 応援してくれる人もいれば、もったいないと言う人もいたよ。
options.romaji: Ouen shite kureru hito mo ireba, mottainai to iu hito mo ita yo.
options.translation: Ada juga yang mendukung, ada juga yang bilang sayang.
options.translationEn: Some support it, some say it's a shame.

options.japanese: 誰からも何も言われなかったよ。
options.romaji: Dare kara mo nanimo iwarenakatta yo.
options.translation: Tidak dibilang apa-apa oleh siapa pun.

npcLine.japanese: 今の生活には満足してる？
npcLine.romaji: Ima no seikatsu ni wa manzoku shiteru?
npcLine.translationEn: Satisfied with your current life?

options.japanese: うん、新しい道を歩めていることに、感謝しているよ。
options.romaji: Un, atarashii michi wo ayumete iru koto ni, kansha shite iru yo.
options.translation: Iya, aku bersyukur bisa menjalani jalan yang baru.
options.translationEn: Yeah, I'm grateful to be able to walk a new path.

options.japanese: 全く満足していないよ。

npcLine.japanese: 前向きだね。
npcLine.romaji: Maemuki da ne.
npcLine.translationEn: That's positive.

options.japanese: 別に前向きじゃないよ。

titleEn: Talking About Retiring Early From Sports
descriptionEn: You tell a friend about retiring early due to repeated injuries.

title: Menjelaskan Pentingnya Nutrisi bagi Performa Atlet
description: Kamu menjelaskan ke teman pentingnya manajemen nutrisi bagi performa atlet.

npcLine.japanese: アスリートの食事管理って、本当に厳しいんだね。
npcLine.romaji: Asuriito no shokuji kanri tte, hontou ni kibishii n da ne.
npcLine.translation: Manajemen makanan atlet itu, benar-benar ketat ya.
npcLine.translationEn: An athlete's diet management is really strict.

options.japanese: うん、パフォーマンスに直結するから、妥協はできないんだ。
options.romaji: Un, pafoomansu ni chokketsu suru kara, dakyou wa dekinai n da.
options.translation: Iya, karena berhubungan langsung dengan performa, jadi tidak bisa berkompromi.
options.translationEn: Yeah, since it directly affects performance, I can't compromise.

options.japanese: 実はそんなに気にしていないよ。
options.romaji: Jitsu wa sonna ni ki ni shite inai yo.

npcLine.japanese: 具体的にどんなことに気をつけてるの？
npcLine.romaji: Gutaiteki ni donna koto ni ki wo tsuketeru no?
npcLine.translationEn: Specifically, what do you pay attention to?

options.japanese: 栄養バランスだけでなく、食べるタイミングも重視しているよ。
options.romaji: Eiyou baransu dake de naku, taberu taimingu mo juushi shite iru yo.
options.translation: Bukan cuma keseimbangan gizi, aku juga mementingkan waktu makan.
options.translationEn: Not just nutritional balance, I also prioritize meal timing.

options.japanese: 特に何も気にせず好きに食べているよ。
options.romaji: Toku ni nanimo ki ni sezu suki ni tabete iru yo.
options.translation: Makan bebas tanpa memperhatikan apa pun khususnya.
options.translationEn: Eating freely without paying attention to anything in particular.

npcLine.japanese: 好きなものを我慢することも多い？
npcLine.romaji: Suki na mono wo gaman suru koto mo ooi?
npcLine.translation: Sering juga menahan diri dari yang disukai?
npcLine.translationEn: Do you often hold back from things you like too?

options.japanese: うん、正直、我慢を強いられることが多いな。
options.romaji: Un, shoujiki, gaman wo shiirareru koto ga ooi na.
options.translation: Iya, jujur, sering dipaksa menahan diri.
options.translationEn: Yeah, honestly, I'm often forced to hold back.

options.japanese: 好きなものを我慢したことは一度もないよ。
options.romaji: Suki na mono wo gaman shita koto wa ichido mo nai yo.
options.translation: Belum pernah menahan diri dari yang disukai sama sekali.
options.translationEn: Never held back from what I like at all.

npcLine.japanese: 栄養士とかにも相談してる？
npcLine.romaji: Eiyoushi toka ni mo soudan shiteru?
npcLine.translationEn: Consulting a nutritionist too?

options.japanese: うん、専属の栄養士に、細かく指導してもらっているよ。
options.romaji: Un, senzoku no eiyoushi ni, komakaku shidou shite moratte iru yo.
options.translation: Iya, dibimbing secara detail oleh ahli gizi pribadi.
options.translationEn: Yeah, guided in detail by a personal nutritionist.

options.japanese: 栄養士には一度も相談したことないよ。
options.romaji: Eiyoushi ni wa ichido mo soudan shita koto nai yo.
options.translation: Belum pernah konsultasi ke ahli gizi sama sekali.
options.translationEn: Never consulted a nutritionist at all.

npcLine.japanese: プロ意識が高いね。
npcLine.romaji: Puro ishiki ga takai ne.
npcLine.translationEn: That's a high level of professionalism.

options.japanese: 別に高くないと思うよ。
options.romaji: Betsu ni takakunai to omou yo.
options.translationEn: I don't think it's high at all.

titleEn: Explaining the Importance of Nutrition for Athletic Performance
descriptionEn: You explain to a friend the importance of nutrition management for athletic performance.

title: Mendiskusikan Fanatisme Suporter yang Berlebihan
description: Kamu dan teman mendiskusikan fanatisme suporter yang berlebihan.

npcLine.japanese: サポーターの過激な行動、たまにニュースになるよね。
npcLine.romaji: Sapootaa no kageki na koudou, tamani nyuusu ni naru yo ne.
npcLine.translation: Tindakan berlebihan suporter, kadang jadi berita ya.
npcLine.translationEn: Excessive supporter behavior sometimes makes the news.

options.japanese: うん、応援の域を超えてしまっているケースもあると思う。
options.romaji: Un, ouen no iki wo koete shimatte iru keesu mo aru to omou.
options.translation: Iya, kurasa ada juga kasus yang sudah melampaui batas dukungan.
options.translationEn: Yeah, I think there are also cases that have gone beyond the limit of support.

options.japanese: そんなニュースは聞いたことないよ。
options.romaji: Sonna nyuusu wa kiita koto nai yo.
options.translation: Belum pernah dengar berita seperti itu.

npcLine.japanese: どうしてそこまで熱くなってしまうんだろう。
npcLine.romaji: Doushite soko made atsuku natte shimau n darou.
npcLine.translation: Kenapa sampai jadi begitu emosional ya.
npcLine.translationEn: I wonder why it got so emotional.

options.japanese: チームへの愛着が強すぎるあまり、感情的になるんだと思う。
options.romaji: Chiimu e no aichaku ga tsuyosugiru amari, kanjouteki ni naru n da to omou.
options.translation: Kurasa karena kecintaan pada tim terlalu kuat, jadi emosional.
options.translationEn: I think it's because love for the team is too strong, so it gets emotional.

options.japanese: 全く愛着がないから熱くなるんだと思うよ。
options.romaji: Mattaku aichaku ga nai kara atsuku naru n da to omou yo.
options.translation: Kupikir jadi emosional karena sama sekali tidak ada kecintaan.
options.translationEn: I think getting emotional happens because there's no love for it at all.

npcLine.japanese: 選手側にも影響あると思う？
npcLine.romaji: Senshu gawa ni mo eikyou aru to omou?
npcLine.translation: Menurutmu ada dampak ke pihak atlet juga?
npcLine.translationEn: Do you think there's an impact on the athletes too?

options.japanese: うん、過度なプレッシャーになってしまうこともあると思う。
options.romaji: Un, kado na puresshaa ni natte shimau koto mo aru to omou.
options.translation: Iya, kurasa kadang jadi tekanan berlebihan juga.
options.translationEn: Yeah, I think it sometimes becomes excessive pressure too.

options.japanese: 選手には全く影響ないと思うよ。
options.romaji: Senshu ni wa mattaku eikyou nai to omou yo.
options.translation: Kupikir sama sekali tidak berdampak ke atlet.
options.translationEn: I don't think it affects athletes at all.

npcLine.japanese: 健全な応援って、どんなものだと思う？
npcLine.romaji: Kenzen na ouen tte, donna mono da to omou?
npcLine.translation: Menurutmu dukungan yang sehat itu seperti apa?
npcLine.translationEn: What do you think healthy support looks like?

options.japanese: 勝敗に関わらず、選手を尊重する姿勢が大事だと思う。
options.romaji: Shouhai ni kakawarazu, senshu wo sonchou suru shisei ga daiji da to omou.
options.translation: Kurasa sikap menghormati atlet terlepas dari menang kalah itu penting.
options.translationEn: I think an attitude of respecting athletes regardless of winning or losing is important.

options.japanese: 勝った時だけ応援すればいいと思うよ。
options.romaji: Katta toki dake ouen sureba ii to omou yo.
options.translation: Kupikir cukup dukung waktu menang saja.
options.translationEn: I think it's enough to support them only when they win.

npcLine.japanese: 深い視点だね。
npcLine.romaji: Fukai shiten da ne.
npcLine.translationEn: That's a deep perspective.

options.japanese: そう言ってもらえると嬉しいよ。
options.romaji: Sou itte moraeru to ureshii yo.

options.japanese: 別に深くないと思うよ。
options.romaji: Betsu ni fukakunai to omou yo.
options.translationEn: I don't think it's deep at all.

titleEn: Discussing Excessive Fan Fanaticism
descriptionEn: You and a friend discuss excessive fan fanaticism.

title: Menceritakan Pengalaman Menjadi Wasit dalam Pertandingan
description: Kamu bercerita ke teman tentang pengalaman menjadi wasit di turnamen.

npcLine.japanese: 大会で審判をしたことがあるって聞いたよ。
npcLine.romaji: Taikai de shinpan wo shita koto ga aru tte kiita yo.
npcLine.translation: Kudengar pernah jadi wasit di turnamen ya.
npcLine.translationEn: I heard you once refereed at a tournament.

options.japanese: うん、公平にジャッジすることの難しさを、痛感したよ。
options.romaji: Un, kouhei ni jajji suru koto no muzukashisa wo, tsuukan shita yo.
options.translation: Iya, aku benar-benar merasakan sulitnya menghakimi secara adil.
options.translationEn: Yeah, I really feel how hard it is to judge fairly.

options.japanese: 審判なんて一度もしたことないよ。
options.romaji: Shinpan nante ichido mo shita koto nai yo.
options.translation: Belum pernah jadi wasit sama sekali.
options.translationEn: Never been a referee at all.

npcLine.japanese: 判定に文句を言われたことある？
npcLine.romaji: Hantei ni monku wo iwareta koto aru?
npcLine.translationEn: Have you ever been complained to about a decision?

options.japanese: うん、選手や観客から、厳しい声を浴びせられたこともあるよ。
options.romaji: Un, senshu ya kankyaku kara, kibishii koe wo abiserareta koto mo aru yo.
options.translation: Iya, pernah juga dihujani suara keras dari atlet dan penonton.
options.translationEn: Yeah, I've also been showered with loud shouts from athletes and spectators.

options.japanese: 誰にも文句を言われたことないよ。
options.romaji: Dare ni mo monku wo iwareta koto nai yo.
options.translation: Belum pernah dikomplain oleh siapa pun.
options.translationEn: Never been complained about by anyone.

npcLine.japanese: それでも続けられる理由は？
npcLine.romaji: Sore demo tsuzukerareru riyuu wa?
npcLine.translation: Meski begitu alasan bisa terus bertahan?
npcLine.translationEn: Even so, what's the reason you could keep going?

options.japanese: 競技を陰から支えているという誇りがあるからだと思う。
options.romaji: Kyougi wo kage kara sasaete iru to iu hokori ga aru kara da to omou.
options.translation: Kurasa karena ada kebanggaan mendukung olahraga itu dari balik layar.
options.translationEn: I think it's because there's pride in supporting that sport from behind the scenes.

options.japanese: 特に続ける理由はないよ。
options.romaji: Toku ni tsuzukeru riyuu wa nai yo.
options.translationEn: No particular reason to hold on.

npcLine.japanese: プレッシャーは大きい？
npcLine.romaji: Puresshaa wa ookii?
npcLine.translationEn: Is the pressure great?

options.japanese: うん、一瞬の判断が、結果を左右してしまうこともあるからね。
options.romaji: Un, isshun no handan ga, kekka wo sayuu shite shimau koto mo aru kara ne.
options.translation: Iya, karena kadang penilaian sesaat bisa menentukan hasil.
options.translationEn: Yeah, since a split-second judgment can sometimes determine the outcome.

options.japanese: 全くプレッシャーは感じないよ。

npcLine.japanese: 大変な役割だね。
npcLine.romaji: Taihen na yakuwari da ne.
npcLine.translationEn: That's a tough role.

titleEn: Talking About Being a Match Referee
descriptionEn: You tell a friend about being a referee at a tournament.

title: Menjelaskan Cara Bangkit dari Kekalahan Beruntun
description: Kamu menjelaskan ke teman cara bangkit dari kekalahan beruntun.

npcLine.japanese: 連敗が続いてるって聞いたけど、大丈夫？
npcLine.romaji: Renpai ga tsuzuiteru tte kiita kedo, daijoubu?
npcLine.translation: Kudengar kekalahan beruntun terus berlanjut ya, tidak apa-apa?
npcLine.translationEn: I heard the losing streak has continued, are you okay?

options.japanese: 正直、自信を失いかけていたけど、なんとか立て直そうとしているよ。
options.romaji: Shoujiki, jishin wo ushinaikakete ita kedo, nantoka tatenaosou to shite iru yo.
options.translation: Jujur, hampir kehilangan percaya diri, tapi entah bagaimana berusaha bangkit lagi.
options.translationEn: Honestly, I nearly lost my confidence, but somehow tried to bounce back.

options.japanese: 全く気にしていないよ。
options.romaji: Mattaku ki ni shite inai yo.

npcLine.japanese: 原因は分かってるの？
npcLine.romaji: Gen'in wa wakatteru no?
npcLine.translationEn: Do you know the cause?

options.japanese: 基本に立ち返って、見直してみたところなんだ。
options.romaji: Kihon ni tachikaette, minaoshite mita tokoro nan da.
options.translation: Baru saja mencoba meninjau ulang dengan kembali ke dasar.
options.translationEn: I just tried reviewing it by going back to basics.

options.japanese: 原因は全く分からないままだよ。
options.romaji: Gen'in wa mattaku wakaranai mama da yo.
options.translation: Masih sama sekali tidak tahu penyebabnya.
options.translationEn: Still don't know the cause at all.

npcLine.japanese: チームの雰囲気は大丈夫？
npcLine.romaji: Chiimu no fun'iki wa daijoubu?
npcLine.translationEn: Is the team atmosphere okay?

options.japanese: 正直、ぎこちない雰囲気になってしまっているよ。
options.romaji: Shoujiki, gikochinai fun'iki ni natte shimatte iru yo.

options.japanese: いつも通り明るい雰囲気だよ。
options.romaji: Itsumo doori akarui fun'iki da yo.
options.translationEn: The atmosphere is cheerful as usual.

npcLine.japanese: どうやって乗り越えようとしてるの？
npcLine.romaji: Dou yatte norikoeyou to shiteru no?
npcLine.translationEn: How did you try to get through it?

options.japanese: 小さな成功体験を積み重ねることを意識しているよ。
options.romaji: Chiisana seikou taiken wo tsumikasaneru koto wo ishiki shite iru yo.
options.translation: Aku memperhatikan untuk menumpuk pengalaman sukses kecil.
options.translationEn: I make sure to accumulate small successful experiences.

options.japanese: 特に何も意識せずにただ戦っているよ。
options.romaji: Toku ni nanimo ishiki sezu ni tada tatakatte iru yo.
options.translation: Hanya bertanding tanpa memperhatikan apa pun khususnya.
options.translationEn: Just competing without paying attention to anything in particular.

npcLine.japanese: きっと流れは変わるよ。
npcLine.romaji: Kitto nagare wa kawaru yo.
npcLine.translationEn: The flow will surely change.

options.japanese: もう無理だと思っているよ。
options.romaji: Mou muri da to omotte iru yo.

titleEn: Explaining How to Bounce Back From a Losing Streak
descriptionEn: You explain to a friend how to bounce back from a losing streak.

title: Membicarakan Masa Depan E-sports sebagai Olahraga
description: Kamu membicarakan masa depan e-sports sebagai olahraga resmi dengan teman.

npcLine.japanese: eスポーツって、正式なスポーツとして認められつつあるよね。
npcLine.romaji: Ii supootsu tte, seishiki na supootsu toshite mitomerare tsutsu aru yo ne.
npcLine.translation: E-sports itu, mulai diakui sebagai olahraga resmi ya.
npcLine.translationEn: E-sports is starting to be recognized as an official sport.

options.japanese: うん、オリンピック種目になる可能性も、議論され始めているらしいよ。
options.romaji: Un, orinpikku shumoku ni naru kanousei mo, girons are hajimete iru rashii yo.
options.translation: Iya, katanya kemungkinan jadi cabang Olimpiade juga mulai dibahas.
options.translationEn: Yeah, they say the possibility of becoming an Olympic event is also starting to be discussed.

options.japanese: eスポーツなんてスポーツとは呼べないと思うよ。
options.romaji: Ii supootsu nante supootsu to wa yobenai to omou yo.
options.translation: Kupikir e-sports tidak bisa disebut olahraga.
options.translationEn: I don't think esports can be called a sport.

npcLine.japanese: 従来のスポーツとの違いは何だと思う？
npcLine.romaji: Juurai no supootsu to no chigai wa nan da to omou?
npcLine.translation: Menurutmu bedanya dengan olahraga tradisional apa?
npcLine.translationEn: What do you think is the difference from traditional sports?

options.japanese: 身体的な要素より、反応速度や戦略が重視される点かな。
options.romaji: Shintaiteki na youso yori, hannou sokudo ya senryaku ga juushi sareru ten ka na.
options.translation: Mungkin bagian di mana kecepatan reaksi dan strategi lebih diutamakan daripada faktor fisik.
options.translationEn: Maybe the part where reaction speed and strategy are prioritized over physical factors.

options.romaji: Mattaku onaji da to omou yo.
options.translationEn: I think it's exactly the same.

npcLine.japanese: プロゲーマーの生活も大変そうだね。
npcLine.romaji: Puro geemaa no seikatsu mo taihen sou da ne.
npcLine.translation: Kehidupan gamer profesional kelihatannya juga berat ya.
npcLine.translationEn: A pro gamer's life looks tough too.

options.japanese: うん、長時間の練習で、体を壊す選手も少なくないらしいよ。
options.romaji: Un, choujikan no renshuu de, karada wo kowasu senshu mo sukunakunai rashii yo.
options.translation: Iya, katanya tidak sedikit pemain yang sampai sakit karena latihan berjam-jam.
options.translationEn: Yeah, they say quite a few players even get sick from hours of training.

options.japanese: プロゲーマーは全く練習しなくていいらしいよ。
options.romaji: Puro geemaa wa mattaku renshuu shinakute ii rashii yo.
options.translation: Katanya gamer profesional sama sekali tidak perlu latihan.
options.translationEn: They say professional gamers don't need to practice at all.

npcLine.japanese: 今後さらに人気が高まると思う？
npcLine.romaji: Kongo sara ni ninki ga takamaru to omou?
npcLine.translation: Menurutmu ke depannya popularitasnya akan makin naik?
npcLine.translationEn: Do you think its popularity will keep rising going forward?

options.japanese: うん、若い世代を中心に、ますます広がっていくと思う。
options.romaji: Un, wakai sedai wo chuushin ni, masumasu hirogatte iku to omou.
options.translation: Iya, kurasa akan semakin menyebar terutama di kalangan generasi muda.
options.translationEn: Yeah, I think it'll keep spreading especially among the younger generation.

options.japanese: だんだん人気がなくなっていくと思うよ。
options.romaji: Dandan ninki ga nakunatte iku to omou yo.
options.translationEn: I think its popularity will keep fading.

npcLine.japanese: 面白い時代の変化だね。
npcLine.romaji: Omoshiroi jidai no henka da ne.
npcLine.translationEn: That's an interesting change of the times.

options.japanese: 別に面白くないと思うよ。
options.romaji: Betsu ni omoshirokunai to omou yo.
options.translationEn: I don't think it's interesting at all.

titleEn: Talking About the Future of Esports as a Sport
descriptionEn: You talk about the future of esports as an official sport with a friend.

title: Menjelaskan Alasan Lebih Suka Menonton Film Sendirian
description: Kamu menjelaskan ke teman alasan lebih suka menonton film sendirian.

npcLine.japanese: 映画、いつも一人で見に行ってるよね。
npcLine.romaji: Eiga, itsumo hitori de mi ni itteru yo ne.
npcLine.translation: Film, kamu selalu nonton sendirian ya.
npcLine.translationEn: You always watch films alone, huh.

options.japanese: うん、誰にも気を遣わずに集中できるから、一人がいいんだ。
options.romaji: Un, dare ni mo ki wo tsukawazu ni shuuchuu dekiru kara, hitori ga ii n da.
options.translation: Iya, karena bisa fokus tanpa perlu memperhatikan siapa pun, sendirian lebih baik.
options.translationEn: Yeah, since I can focus without needing to worry about anyone else, alone is better.

options.japanese: 誰かと一緒じゃないと絶対に見ないよ。
options.romaji: Dareka to issho janai to zettai ni minai yo.
options.translation: Tidak pernah nonton kalau tidak bersama orang lain.
options.translationEn: Never watch unless it's with someone else.

npcLine.japanese: 誰かと感想を共有したくならない？
npcLine.romaji: Dareka to kansou wo kyouyuu shitakunaranai?
npcLine.translation: Tidak ingin berbagi kesan dengan seseorang?
npcLine.translationEn: Don't you want to share your impressions with someone?

options.japanese: 見終わった後、自分の中でじっくり考える時間も好きなんだ。
options.romaji: Miowatta ato, jibun no naka de jikkuri kangaeru jikan mo suki nan da.
options.translation: Aku juga suka waktu untuk merenung sendiri setelah selesai nonton.
options.translationEn: I also like the time to reflect alone after finishing watching.

options.japanese: 感想なんて一切気にしたことないよ。
options.romaji: Kansou nante issai ki ni shita koto nai yo.
options.translation: Tidak pernah peduli kesan sama sekali.
options.translationEn: Never care about the impression at all.

npcLine.japanese: 周りの反応を気にせず泣けるのもいいよね。
npcLine.romaji: Mawari no hannou wo ki ni sezu nakeru no mo ii yo ne.
npcLine.translation: Bisa menangis tanpa memedulikan reaksi orang sekitar juga bagus ya.
npcLine.translationEn: Being able to cry without caring about others' reactions is good too.

options.japanese: そうなんだ、感動的なシーンで思い切り泣けるのが最高なんだ。
options.romaji: Sou nan da, kandouteki na shiin de omoikiri nakeru no ga saikou nan da.
options.translation: Benar, bisa menangis sepuasnya di adegan mengharukan itu yang terbaik.
options.translationEn: Right, being able to cry as much as I want at that touching scene is the best.

options.japanese: 泣くことは絶対にないよ。
options.romaji: Naku koto wa zettai ni nai yo.

npcLine.japanese: 混んでる時間は避けてる？
npcLine.romaji: Konderu jikan wa saketeru?
npcLine.translationEn: Avoiding peak hours?

options.japanese: うん、なるべく空いている平日の昼間を選ぶようにしているよ。
options.romaji: Un, narubeku suite iru heijitsu no hiruma wo erabu you ni shite iru yo.
options.translation: Iya, aku berusaha memilih siang hari kerja yang biasanya lebih sepi.
options.translationEn: Yeah, I try to choose weekday afternoons, which are usually quieter.

options.japanese: 混んでいる時間を選んで行っているよ。
options.romaji: Konde iru jikan wo erande itte iru yo.
options.translation: Malah memilih jam ramai untuk pergi.
options.translationEn: Actually chose the busy time to go.

npcLine.japanese: 一人の時間、大事だね。
npcLine.romaji: Hitori no jikan, daiji da ne.
npcLine.translationEn: Time alone matters.

titleEn: Explaining Why You Prefer Watching Movies Alone
descriptionEn: You explain to a friend why you prefer watching movies alone.

title: Mendiskusikan Dampak Streaming terhadap Bisnis Bioskop
description: Kamu dan teman mendiskusikan dampak layanan streaming terhadap bisnis bioskop.

npcLine.japanese: 最近、映画館に行く人が減ってるらしいね。
npcLine.romaji: Saikin, eigakan ni iku hito ga hetteru rashii ne.
npcLine.translation: Katanya belakangan orang yang pergi ke bioskop berkurang ya.
npcLine.translationEn: I heard fewer people have been going to movie theaters lately.

options.japanese: うん、配信サービスの普及が、大きく影響していると思う。
options.romaji: Un, haishin saabisu no fukyuu ga, ookiku eikyou shite iru to omou.
options.translation: Iya, kurasa penyebaran layanan streaming berpengaruh besar.
options.translationEn: Yeah, I think the spread of streaming services has a big influence.

options.japanese: 映画館の観客はむしろ増えているらしいよ。
options.romaji: Eigakan no kankyaku wa mushiro fuete iru rashii yo.
options.translationEn: They say cinema audiences have actually increased.

npcLine.japanese: 映画館ならではの魅力って何だと思う？
npcLine.romaji: Eigakan naradewa no miryoku tte nan da to omou?
npcLine.translation: Menurutmu daya tarik khas bioskop itu apa?
npcLine.translationEn: What do you think is unique about the theater experience?

options.japanese: 大画面と音響で味わう没入感は、家では再現できないと思う。
options.romaji: Ooogamen to onkyou de ajiwau botsunyuukan wa, ie dewa saigen dekinai to omou.
options.translation: Kurasa sensasi imersif dari layar besar dan suara tidak bisa direproduksi di rumah.
options.translationEn: I think the immersive sensation of the big screen and sound can't be reproduced at home.

options.japanese: 家で見るのと全く変わらないと思うよ。
options.romaji: Ie de miru no to mattaku kawaranai to omou yo.
options.translation: Kupikir sama sekali tidak beda dengan nonton di rumah.
options.translationEn: I don't think it's any different from watching at home at all.

npcLine.japanese: 映画館側も対策をしてるの？
npcLine.romaji: Eigakan gawa mo taisaku wo shiteru no?
npcLine.translationEn: Is the theater also taking action?

options.japanese: うん、座席のグレードアップとか、色々工夫しているみたいだよ。
options.romaji: Un, zaseki no gureedoappu toka, iroiro kufuu shite iru mitai da yo.
options.translation: Iya, sepertinya mereka berusaha macam-macam, seperti upgrade kursi.
options.translationEn: Yeah, it seems they're trying various things, like upgrading the seats.

options.japanese: 映画館は何も対策をしていないみたいだよ。
options.romaji: Eigakan wa nanimo taisaku wo shite inai mitai da yo.
options.translation: Sepertinya bioskop sama sekali tidak melakukan tindakan.
options.translationEn: It seems the cinema didn't take any action at all.

npcLine.japanese: それでも配信には勝てないのかな。
npcLine.romaji: Sore demo haishin ni wa katenai no ka na.
npcLine.translation: Meski begitu tetap tidak bisa mengalahkan streaming ya.
npcLine.translationEn: Even so, it still can't beat streaming, huh.

options.japanese: 価格と手軽さの面では、配信に軍配が上がると思う。
options.romaji: Kakaku to tegarusa no men dewa, haishin ni gunbai ga agaru to omou.
options.translation: Dari segi harga dan kepraktisan, kurasa streaming yang unggul.
options.translationEn: In terms of price and convenience, I think streaming is superior.

options.japanese: 価格の面では映画館のほうが安いと思うよ。
options.romaji: Kakaku no men dewa eigakan no hou ga yasui to omou yo.
options.translation: Kupikir dari segi harga bioskop lebih murah.
options.translationEn: I think in terms of price the cinema is cheaper.

npcLine.japanese: 難しい時代だね。
npcLine.romaji: Muzukashii jidai da ne.
npcLine.translationEn: These are tough times.

options.japanese: 別に難しくないと思うよ。
options.romaji: Betsu ni muzukashikunai to omou yo.
options.translationEn: I don't think it's difficult at all.

titleEn: Discussing Streaming's Impact on the Movie Theater Business
descriptionEn: You and a friend discuss the impact of streaming services on the movie theater business.

title: Menceritakan Pengalaman Menangis Saat Menonton Film
description: Kamu bercerita ke teman tentang pengalaman menangis saat menonton film.

npcLine.japanese: この前の映画、すごく泣いたって言ってたよね。
npcLine.romaji: Kono mae no eiga, sugoku naita tte itteta yo ne.
npcLine.translation: Katanya film kemarin bikin nangis banget ya.
npcLine.translationEn: I heard yesterday's film made you cry a lot.

options.japanese: うん、恥ずかしいくらい大泣きしてしまったよ。
options.romaji: Un, hazukashii kurai ounaki shite shimatta yo.
options.translationEn: Yeah, I embarrassingly cried my eyes out.

npcLine.japanese: どのシーンが一番心に響いた？
npcLine.romaji: Dono shiin ga ichiban kokoro ni hibiita?
npcLine.translation: Adegan mana yang paling menyentuh hati?
npcLine.translationEn: Which scene was the most touching?

options.japanese: 主人公が最後に家族と再会する場面に、涙が止まらなかったよ。
options.romaji: Shujinkou ga saigo ni kazoku to saikai suru bamen ni, namida ga tomaranakatta yo.
options.translation: Di adegan tokoh utama akhirnya bertemu kembali dengan keluarganya, air mataku tidak berhenti.
options.translationEn: In the scene where the protagonist finally reunites with their family, my tears wouldn't stop.

options.japanese: 特にどのシーンも印象に残らなかったよ。
options.romaji: Toku ni dono shiin mo inshou ni nokoranakatta yo.
options.translation: Tidak ada adegan yang berkesan khususnya.
options.translationEn: No scene left a particular impression.

npcLine.japanese: 周りの目、気にならなかった？
npcLine.romaji: Mawari no me, ki ni naranakatta?
npcLine.translationEn: Not worried about being seen by those around you?

options.japanese: 暗闇の中だったから、あまり気にせずに泣けたよ。
options.romaji: Kurayami no naka datta kara, amari ki ni sezu ni naketa yo.
options.translation: Karena dalam kegelapan, jadi bisa menangis tanpa terlalu khawatir.
options.translationEn: Since it's dark, I can cry without worrying too much.

options.japanese: 明るい場所だったから、すごく恥ずかしかったよ。
options.romaji: Akarui basho datta kara, sugoku hazukashikatta yo.
options.translation: Karena tempat terang, jadi sangat malu.
options.translationEn: Since the place is bright, it's really embarrassing.

npcLine.japanese: 映画で泣くのって、いいストレス発散になるよね。
npcLine.romaji: Eiga de naku no tte, ii sutoresu hassan ni naru yo ne.
npcLine.translation: Menangis karena film itu, jadi pelepas stres yang baik ya.
npcLine.translationEn: Crying because of a film is a good stress reliever.

options.japanese: うん、心が洗われるような感覚があるよ。
options.romaji: Un, kokoro ga arawareru you na kankaku ga aru yo.
options.translation: Iya, ada rasa seperti hati dibersihkan.
options.translationEn: Yeah, there's a feeling like my heart's been cleansed.

options.japanese: 逆にストレスが溜まる感じがするよ。
options.romaji: Gyaku ni sutoresu ga tamaru kanji ga suru yo.
options.translationEn: Actually feels like it's building up stress.

npcLine.japanese: また泣ける映画、探そうね。
npcLine.romaji: Mata nakeru eiga, sagasou ne.
npcLine.translation: Cari lagi film yang bikin nangis yuk.
npcLine.translationEn: Let's find another film that makes you cry.

options.translationEn: Yeah, I'm looking forward to it.

options.japanese: 別に見たいとは思わないよ。
options.romaji: Betsu ni mitai to wa omowanai yo.
options.translation: Tidak berpikir ingin nonton sama sekali.
options.translationEn: Don't feel like watching it at all.

titleEn: Talking About Crying While Watching a Movie
descriptionEn: You tell a friend about crying while watching a movie.

title: Membicarakan Film yang Kontroversial
description: Kamu dan teman membicarakan sebuah film yang menimbulkan kontroversi.

npcLine.japanese: あの映画、公開当時かなり物議を醸したらしいね。
npcLine.romaji: Ano eiga, koukai touji kanari butsugi wo kamoshita rashii ne.
npcLine.translation: Film itu, katanya waktu rilis sempat menimbulkan kontroversi besar ya.
npcLine.translationEn: I heard that film caused major controversy when it was released.

options.japanese: うん、テーマがテーマだけに、賛否が分かれたみたいだよ。
options.romaji: Un, teema ga teema dake ni, sanpi ga wakareta mitai da yo.
options.translation: Iya, karena temanya memang berat, sepertinya pendapatnya terbelah.
options.translationEn: Yeah, since the theme really is heavy, opinions seem divided.

options.japanese: 全く話題にならなかった映画らしいよ。
options.romaji: Mattaku wadai ni naranakatta eiga rashii yo.
options.translation: Katanya film yang sama sekali tidak jadi topik pembicaraan.
options.translationEn: They say it's a film that never became a topic of conversation at all.

npcLine.japanese: どんな点が批判されたの？
npcLine.romaji: Donna ten ga hihan sareta no?
npcLine.translationEn: Which part gets criticized?

options.japanese: 歴史的な事実を、都合よく歪めているという指摘があったんだ。
options.romaji: Rekishiteki na jijitsu wo, tsugou yoku yugamete iru to iu shiteki ga atta n da.
options.translation: Ada kritik bahwa fakta sejarah diputarbalikkan seenaknya.
options.translationEn: There's criticism that historical facts were distorted carelessly.

options.japanese: 批判された点は特になかったよ。
options.romaji: Hihan sareta ten wa toku ni nakatta yo.
options.translation: Tidak ada bagian yang dikritik khususnya.

npcLine.japanese: 監督はどう反応したの？
npcLine.romaji: Kantoku wa dou hannou shita no?
npcLine.translationEn: How did the director react?

options.japanese: あくまでフィクションだと、繰り返し説明していたよ。
options.romaji: Akumade fikushon da to, kurikaeshi setsumei shite ita yo.
options.translation: Dia berulang kali menjelaskan bahwa itu murni fiksi.
options.translationEn: They repeatedly explained that it's purely fiction.

options.japanese: 一切コメントを出さなかったよ。
options.translationEn: Not making any comment at all.

npcLine.japanese: それでも見る価値はあると思う？
npcLine.romaji: Sore demo miru kachi wa aru to omou?
npcLine.translation: Meski begitu menurutmu masih layak ditonton?
npcLine.translationEn: Even so, do you think it's still worth watching?

options.japanese: 賛否はあるにしても、考えさせられる作品だとは思うよ。
options.romaji: Sanpi wa aru ni shite mo, kangaesaserareru sakuhin da to wa omou yo.
options.translation: Terlepas ada pro dan kontra, kurasa itu karya yang membuat berpikir.
options.translationEn: Regardless of the pros and cons, I think it's a thought-provoking work.

options.japanese: 見る価値は全くないと思うよ。
options.romaji: Miru kachi wa mattaku nai to omou yo.
options.translation: Kupikir sama sekali tidak layak ditonton.
options.translationEn: I don't think it's worth watching at all.

npcLine.japanese: 一度見てみようかな。
npcLine.romaji: Ichido mite miyou ka na.
npcLine.translationEn: Might be worth watching it once.

options.japanese: 別におすすめはしないよ。
options.romaji: Betsu ni osusume wa shinai yo.

titleEn: Talking About a Controversial Movie
descriptionEn: You and a friend talk about a movie that stirred up controversy.

title: Menjelaskan Preferensi terhadap Genre Film Tertentu
description: Kamu menjelaskan ke teman preferensimu terhadap genre film tertentu.

npcLine.japanese: ホラー映画って、全然見ないよね。
npcLine.romaji: Horaa eiga tte, zenzen minai yo ne.
npcLine.translation: Film horor, sama sekali tidak pernah nonton ya.
npcLine.translationEn: Never watched horror films at all, huh.

options.japanese: うん、怖がりなだけに、どうしても避けてしまうんだ。
options.romaji: Un, kowagari na dake ni, dou shitemo sakete shimau n da.
options.translation: Iya, karena penakut, jadi mau tidak mau selalu menghindarinya.
options.translationEn: Yeah, since I'm a coward, I inevitably always avoid it.

options.japanese: ホラー映画が一番好きなジャンルだよ。
options.romaji: Horaa eiga ga ichiban suki na janru da yo.
options.translationEn: Horror is actually my favorite genre.

npcLine.japanese: じゃあ、どんなジャンルが好きなの？
npcLine.romaji: Jaa, donna janru ga suki na no?
npcLine.translation: Kalau begitu, genre apa yang disukai?
npcLine.translationEn: In that case, what genre do you like?

options.japanese: 心温まるヒューマンドラマを、よく選んで見ているよ。
options.romaji: Kokoro atatamaru hyuuman dorama wo, yoku erande mite iru yo.
options.translation: Aku sering memilih menonton drama manusia yang menghangatkan hati.
options.translationEn: I often choose to watch heartwarming human dramas.

options.japanese: 特に好きなジャンルはないよ。
options.romaji: Toku ni suki na janru wa nai yo.

npcLine.japanese: アクション映画はどう？
npcLine.romaji: Akushon eiga wa dou?
npcLine.translationEn: How about an action film?

options.japanese: 派手すぎる演出は、逆に疲れてしまうんだよね。
options.romaji: Hadesugiru enshutsu wa, gyaku ni tsukarete shimau n da yo ne.
options.translation: Sebaliknya aku malah capek dengan sajian yang terlalu berlebihan.
options.translationEn: On the contrary, I actually get tired of overly excessive presentations.

options.japanese: アクション映画は何時間でも見ていられるよ。
options.romaji: Akushon eiga wa nanjikan demo mite irareru yo.
options.translationEn: Can watch action movies for hours.

npcLine.japanese: 好みがはっきりしてるね。
npcLine.romaji: Konomi ga hakkiri shiteru ne.
npcLine.translationEn: That's a clear preference.

options.japanese: うん、自分でもそう思うよ。
options.romaji: Un, jibun demo sou omou yo.
options.translation: Iya, aku sendiri juga berpikir begitu.
options.translationEn: Yeah, I think so too myself.

options.japanese: 実は自分でもよく分からないんだ。
options.romaji: Jitsu wa jibun demo yoku wakaranai n da.
options.translation: Sebenarnya aku sendiri juga tidak begitu paham.
options.translationEn: Actually, I myself don't really understand it either.

npcLine.japanese: いいと思うよ、好みがあって。
npcLine.romaji: Ii to omou yo, konomi ga atte.
npcLine.translationEn: I think it's good to have your own preferences.

options.japanese: 別に良くないと思うよ。
options.romaji: Betsu ni yokunai to omou yo.
options.translationEn: I don't think it's good at all.

titleEn: Explaining Your Preference for a Certain Movie Genre
descriptionEn: You explain to a friend your preference for a certain movie genre.

title: Mendiskusikan Remake Film Klasik
description: Kamu dan teman mendiskusikan rencana remake sebuah film klasik.

npcLine.japanese: あの名作、リメイクされるんだって。
npcLine.romaji: Ano meisaku, rimeiku sareru n datte.
npcLine.translation: Katanya film klasik terkenal itu akan dibuat ulang.
npcLine.translationEn: I heard that famous classic film is being remade.

options.japanese: え、また？最近リメイクブームが続いてるよね。
options.romaji: E, mata? Saikin rimeiku buumu ga tsuzuiteru yo ne.
options.translation: Eh, lagi? Belakangan tren remake terus berlanjut ya.
options.translationEn: Huh, again? The remake trend keeps going lately.

options.japanese: リメイクなんて聞いたことないよ。
options.romaji: Rimeiku nante kiita koto nai yo.

npcLine.japanese: リメイクについてどう思う？
npcLine.romaji: Rimeiku ni tsuite dou omou?
npcLine.translationEn: What's your opinion on remakes?

options.japanese: オリジナルを尊重しつつ、新しい解釈を加えてほしいな。
options.romaji: Orijinaru wo sonchou shitsutsu, atarashii kaishaku wo kuwaete hoshii na.
options.translation: Aku ingin mereka menghormati versi asli sambil menambahkan interpretasi baru.
options.translationEn: I want them to respect the original version while adding a new interpretation.

options.japanese: オリジナルを完全に無視してほしいな。
options.romaji: Orijinaru wo kanzen ni mushi shite hoshii na.
options.translation: Aku ingin mereka mengabaikan versi asli sepenuhnya.
options.translationEn: I want them to completely ignore the original version.

npcLine.japanese: 原作ファンの反応は複雑そうだね。
npcLine.romaji: Gensaku fan no hannou wa fukuzatsu sou da ne.
npcLine.translation: Reaksi penggemar versi asli sepertinya rumit ya.
npcLine.translationEn: The original version's fans' reaction seems complicated.

options.japanese: うん、期待と不安が入り混じっているみたいだよ。
options.romaji: Un, kitai to fuan ga irimajitte iru mitai da yo.
options.translation: Iya, sepertinya harapan dan kecemasan bercampur aduk.
